  • Foster and facilitate collaboration and shared accountability for outcomes with Leadership
  • Report directly to Shield AI’s Senior Director of Program Management

• Program Management experience for Direct Commercial Sales / Foreign Military Sales / Department of Defense programs
  • Proven experience building, growing, and leading an program team
  • Deep expertise in project and program management
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as needed
  • Ability to focus on long-term business objectives
  • Ability to run advanced projects/programs consisting of multiple interrelated projects, in a manner that is largely self-directed
  • Experience with scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet. 
  • Significant experience and excellent skills with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Excellent skills in leadership, time management, organization, team management
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and verbal and written ability
  • Expert understanding of complex project financials
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others

Job Description:

The Discrete Planning Group is a part of the Autonomy Team for Hivemind Enterprise Product. The group is an agile set of engineers focused on researching and developing state-of-the-art algorithms that drive intelligent and confidence-inspiring flight behaviors while accounting for an uncertain and dynamic world. As a member of the group, you will work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, discrete optimization, and motion planning. You will architect and write high-quality software for core systems, set standards for software engineering, refine technical requirements, drive strategic technical improvements, and mentor other engineers.

lists.content:
• Research, design, and implement state-of-the-art algorithms for optimal task allocation, scheduling and temporal sequencing of heterogeneous teams of autonomous vehicles (land, air, other). 
  • Solidify and improve existing C++ based mission planning software applicable across disparate vehicle types and compute platforms. 
  • Work with our engineers, program managers, and product managers to define a technical roadmap for future autonomy solutions and SDK offerings.

• Breakdown a mission into assignable tasks based on agent capabilities such as navigating in contested and denied environments and adapting to mission changes in real-time. 
  • Construct feasible and optimal action plans for distributed teams of autonomous vehicles that also minimize human operator workload.  
  • Full software and hardware-in-the-loop simulation of complex multi-agent missions.

• Typically requires a PhD with graduate work in Optimization or Operations Research. Master’s degree with 4 or more years of work in the same areas. 
  • Expert in Integer or Mixed Integer Linear Programming, Constraint Programming, Convex Optimization, Multi-Objective-Optimization and using established solvers such as Gurobi, Google-OR, CPLEX etc. 
  • Significant experience in implementing algorithms in C++ and using debuggers such as gdb to troubleshoot execution within a multi-threaded environment.

• Past publications on Optimization(google scholar profile). 
    •  

    Engineer II- $135,000-$200,000

    Senior Engineer: $165,000-$250,000

    Staff Engineer: $200,000-$300,000

    Senior Staff Engineer: $230,000-$350,000

We are seeking a highly motivated engineer to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

lists.content:
• Define and execute the vision of the aircraft power system from concept to production. This includes power generation, regulation, distribution, power quality, control, etc.
  • Design, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art high-power systems tailored for optimal performance and reliability in harsh environments (high altitude, radiation, etc.)
  • Design custom power electronics for high power and high voltage
  • Design an uninterruptible power system with a high-capacity battery
  • Make vs. buy trade studies. Select, test, and integrate modules for use in the aircraft
  • Build a world class power electronics lab
  • Ensure system performance and reliability are met through rigorous verification
  • Debug complex problems related to the electrical design, environmental, manufacturing, etc.
  • Build your team and lead multiple engineers dedicated to the power system design
  • Drive a cross-functional team to execute the top-level architecture
  • Provide mentorship, design review, and program execution leadership
  • Work in a fast-paced environment

• Power system design experience on large aircraft, or an equivalent power system (rocket, satellite, submarine, etc.)
  • 10+ years relevant experience
  • Have delivered power system and power electronic products to market
  • Proficient with electrical engineering development tools, simulation, and test equipment
  • Strong technical fundamentals and analysis

Job Description:
Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed deep-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include the V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, Hivemind Enterprise, and the Hivemind Vision product lines. We are building the best team in aviation to drive rapid development and deployment of X-BAT.
 
We are looking for an entry level Electrical Engineer that is ready to help us bring X-BAT to first flight. You will own a project that ties directly to our critical path avionics development while receiving directly mentorship from Senior Electrical Engineers and other cross-functional leads. Our team looks for engineers that value first principles engineering and extreme ownership.

lists.content:
• Own a design that directly impacts the X-BAT system and major flight test milestones. A senior engineer is assigned as a direct mentor to provide technical review and professional feedback.
  • Full lifecycle ownership: concept, design, verification, integration, flight test, and manufacturing
  • Design efforts include:
  • Circuit design for our embedded system. You will design with analog, digital, power conversion, high-speed, FPGA, MCU, EMI/EMC, etc.
  • System integration and verification
  • Environmental test, qualification, and automation
  • Debug, root cause, and drive resolution
  • Systems must be designed for high-reliability, radiation, aggressive temperature changes, and high magnitude vibration

• Have a degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Strong technical fundamentals
  • Have been part of an engineering team/club
  • Experience with electrical design software, Altium, KiCAD, etc.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Job Description:

At Shield AI, we are revolutionizing defense technology to protect service members and civilians with intelligent, autonomous systems. Our Hardware Test Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring X-BAT is reliable, resilient, and mission-ready. We develop custom electrical and mechanical test systems that evaluate aircraft hardware under representative and extreme environmental conditions.

As an Electrical Engineer I supporting X-BAT, you will help design, build, and automate systems that validate hardware ranging from power electronics and communications equipment to integrated aircraft subsystems. You will gain hands-on experience with PCB design, Python-based automation, instrumentation, and environmental testing, including HASS, ESS, and HALT. If you enjoy solving multidisciplinary problems, learning quickly, and building dependable aerospace hardware, this role is for you.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and validate test systems for critical X-BAT components and subsystems.
  • Translate engineering requirements into test plans, procedures, and measurable pass/fail criteria.
  • Support testing across power electronics, RF, communications, embedded hardware, and aircraft system integration.
  • Design PCBs and interface electronics that connect test equipment to devices under test.
  • Build custom test fixtures incorporating relays, PLCs, PCBAs, sensors, instrumentation, and harnessing.
  • Develop Python scripts and other automation tools to improve test repeatability, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Configure and operate laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, data-acquisition systems, and network analyzers.
  • Analyze test data, identify trends and anomalies, and communicate results through clear technical reports.
  • Troubleshoot aircraft hardware and test-system failures using structured root-cause analysis.
  • Participate in cross-functional design reviews and advocate for design-for-test, reliability, and maintainability improvements.
  • Partner with design, systems, software, manufacturing, and flight-test teams to resolve integration issues.
  • Create and maintain schematics, bills of materials, test procedures, calibration records, and system documentation.
  • Follow laboratory safety, configuration-control, and equipment-handling practices.
  • Work closely with experienced engineers and technicians while progressively taking ownership of increasingly complex projects.
  • Adapt and innovate in a fast-moving environment where your work directly affects aircraft performance, product quality, and mission success.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant hands-on experience may be considered. Students completing an applicable undergraduate or graduate degree in 2026 are also encouraged to apply.
  • Strong foundation in circuit analysis, analog and digital electronics, and laboratory measurement techniques.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical and software concepts used in multidisciplinary aerospace systems.
  • Hands-on engineering experience through coursework, internships, employment, research, student organizations, or personal projects.
  • Ability to read schematics, use standard electrical test equipment, and methodically troubleshoot hardware.
  • Ability to document technical work clearly and communicate effectively with engineers, technicians, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, sound judgment, and willingness to take ownership of technical problems.
  • A team-first mindset and a record of working hard, acting with integrity, maintaining high standards, and treating others with respect.

• Experience with Python or another scripting language used for test automation or data analysis.
  • Experience with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, or Eagle.
  • Familiarity with hardware interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, or USB.
  • Experience with automated test equipment, data-acquisition systems, or hardware-in-the-loop test systems.
  • Familiarity with RF equipment, power electronics, embedded systems, or communications hardware.
  • Exposure to environmental and reliability testing such as HASS, ESS, HALT, thermal cycling, vibration, or shock testing.
  • Familiarity with mechanical CAD tools such as SolidWorks, NX, or CATIA.
  • Experience with requirements management, version control, issue tracking, or configuration-controlled engineering workflows.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively, solve problems under pressure, and adjust quickly as program needs evolve.

lists.content:
• Serve as the electrical SME for Fleet Support and lead escalated investigations involving aircraft electrical and avionics issues.
  • Diagnose avionics system issues, onboard communication hardware issues, wiring and harness problems, power-distribution faults, connector failures, grounding issues, and intermittent electrical anomalies.
  • Troubleshoot aircraft electrical problems at the aircraft, subsystem, harness, connector, and line-replaceable unit levels.
  • Review and maintain schematics, pinouts, wiring diagrams, interface definitions, and troubleshooting documentation used by Fleet Support and customer teams.
  • Use standard debug equipment to isolate faults, validate corrective actions, and support return-to-service decisions.
  • Partner closely with software, mission systems, and radio frequency (RF) engineers on issues that cross electrical, software, and communications boundaries.
  • Identify recurring failure patterns and drive clear feedback into design, manufacturing, integration, and quality organizations.
  • Develop field-ready troubleshooting guides, repair recommendations, and service documentation for the Fleet Support organization.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in avionics, aircraft electrical systems, embedded hardware integration, or aerospace electrical engineering.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, pinouts, and interface documentation.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting harnesses, connectors, power systems, avionics hardware, and electrical integration issues.
  • Experience diagnosing intermittent failures caused by vibration, temperature, installation, environment, or interface mismatch.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to support technical conversations with both customers and internal engineering teams.
  • Ability to possess a Secret DoD security clearance as required by customers.

• Experience with unmanned aircraft system electrical or avionics integration.
  • Experience supporting fielded military, maritime, or expeditionary systems.
  • Experience with sensors, radios, onboard compute, or payload electrical interfaces.
  • Experience supporting ground test, flight test, or operational readiness events.

Job Description:
Our 2027 intern program is an excellent opportunity for rising graduates to gain deep, hands-on experience in a mission-driven and innovative engineering environment. This paid, full-time program spans multiple months during the academic year, offering extended immersion in real-world hardware development and testing.
 
Shield AI is seeking an exceptional Co-op candidate to join the team in building our autonomous aircraft. You will join a team of highly talented cross-functional engineers that exhibit a culture of mentorship, kindness, ownership, and hard work.

lists.content:
• You will be given ownership of a project that is tailored to the start date, duration, and location of your Co-op.
  • Your work will directly contribute to the success of our novel aircraft development program. You will understand exactly why your project matters and how it ties into our critical path development objectives.
  • You will be partnered with a senior engineer as mentor and guide for technical input and professional development.

• Design a circuit board involving analog, digital, mixed signal, high speed circuits that enables us to test a prototype flight computer.
  • Design, simulate, and verify high voltage power electronics (>10kW) DC/DC Converters and DC/AC inverters.
  • Work with a senior engineer to bring-up and validate a new Avionics system.
  • Identify bugs and drive changes to fix them.
  • Build a test rack to deliver fully automated test coverage of a flight critical sub-system.
  • Run a HALT campaign to ensure a series of new circuit boards are highly reliable.
    •

• Have completed at least the 2nd year of a relevant degree. Typically, Electrical Engineering.
  • Strong technical fundamentals.
  • Have been part of an engineering team/club.
  • Experience with electrical design software and tools such as Altium, KiCAD, an oscilloscope, etc.
  • Demonstrated history of showing ownership of project outcomes and delivering exceptional results.
  • Record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, robotics systems, embedded software development, distributed systems, simulation environments, or machine learning workflows
  • Experience supporting hiring at scale during periods of rapid organizational growth

lists.content:
• Support test planning and execution for integration of Hivemind Mission Autonomy capabilities onto unmanned platforms and mission-system configurations.
  • Assist senior test engineers with defining test objectives, expected system behavior, acceptance criteria, verification methods, and test schedules.
  • Help develop, execute, and maintain system-level test procedures, test cases, checklists, and test configurations.
  • Support setup, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), simulation, laboratory, and automated test environments.
  • Assist with installation, configuration, and verification of test hardware, software, networks, ground-control equipment, sensors, radios, computing systems, and supporting tools as applicable.
  • Collect and organize test data, telemetry, logs, video, configuration information, and other evidence needed to evaluate system behavior.
  • Help analyze test results, identify deviations from expected performance, document defects, and support root-cause investigations with systems, software, autonomy, and platform-integration teams.
  • Contribute to performance metrics, test reports, test-readiness materials, dashboards, and other reporting artifacts for internal engineering teams and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with maintaining test infrastructure, test automation, simulation tools, and repeatable test configurations.
  • Support development and maintenance of test procedures, standard operating procedures, configuration-control records, lessons learned, and engineering documentation.
  • Participate in test-readiness reviews, technical planning meetings, issue-triage sessions, and post-test debriefs.
  • Follow established safety, security, configuration-management, and operational procedures during laboratory, simulation, integration, and flight-test activities.
  • Travel periodically to internal test sites, customer locations, and platform-integration events as needed.

• Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, such as Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational experience with engineering test, integration, troubleshooting, or verification activities through coursework, internships, research, military service, laboratory work, personal projects, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with basic systems-engineering and test concepts, including requirements, verification, validation, test procedures, configuration management, defect tracking, and technical documentation.
  • Interest in autonomous systems, robotics, unmanned aircraft systems, flight-test operations, simulation, embedded systems, or software-and-hardware integration.
  • Familiarity with Linux, Windows, command-line tools, networking basics, and/or scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, C++, or similar tools.
  • Ability to work methodically, follow detailed procedures, maintain accurate records, and manage several tasks in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate unexpected system behavior using logs, telemetry, test results, and input from subject-matter experts.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated reliability, accountability, teamwork, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining a respectful and high-performing engineering culture.
  • Ability to travel periodically in support of integration, testing, and customer activities.

• Internship, academic research, military, laboratory, personal-project, or professional experience involving UAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, aviation, embedded systems, or complex integrated systems.
  • Exposure to software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, modeling-and-simulation, or automated test environments.
  • Familiarity with test automation, scripting, data collection, telemetry analysis, log analysis, or defect-tracking tools.
  • Exposure to software-development and configuration-management practices, including Git, issue tracking, build systems, continuous integration, or test automation.
  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts, including Ethernet, IP networking, UDP/TCP communication, and network troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to flight-test, aviation, safety, or operational-risk-management processes.
  • Working knowledge of Department of Defense development, test, evaluation, or acquisition processes, including Developmental Test and Evaluation (DT&E) or Operational Test and Evaluation (OT&E).
  • Experience working in a laboratory, integration facility, field-test environment, maker space, research environment, or similar hands-on technical setting.

Job Description:
Are you a curious and motivated engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art autonomous aircraft? Are you eager to apply your engineering fundamentals to real hardware while learning from experienced teammates? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused people? Shield AI may be the place for you.
As a Mechanical Engineer on the Mechanisms team, you will contribute to the design, development, and integration of mechanical systems for Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft. Your work may include a focus on gearbox development and integration, including gears, shafts, bearings, housings, lubrication systems, and related interfaces.
You will complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance from experienced engineers and collaborate with internal and external partners to design, prototype, test, and release hardware. This role offers the opportunity to build practical experience across the product-development lifecycle while helping the team achieve its performance, schedule, and reliability goals.

Job Description:

Are you a curious and motivated engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art autonomous aircraft? Are you eager to apply your engineering fundamentals to real hardware while learning from experienced teammates? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused people? Shield AI may be the place for you.

As a Mechanical Engineer on the Mechanisms team, you will contribute to the design, development, and integration of mechanical systems for Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft. Your work may include a focus on gearbox development and integration, including gears, shafts, bearings, housings, lubrication systems, and related interfaces.

You will complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance from experienced engineers and collaborate with internal and external partners to design, prototype, test, and release hardware. This role offers the opportunity to build practical experience across the product-development lifecycle while helping the team achieve its performance, schedule, and reliability goals.

lists.content:
• Support the design and integration of mechanical mechanisms for autonomous aircraft, potentially including gearboxes and other power-transmission systems
  • Create and update 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and interface documentation
  • Complete defined design tasks involving component sizing, material selection, tolerance analysis, and mechanical packaging
  • Perform foundational structural, kinematic, and machine-design calculations with guidance from senior engineers
  • Assist with preliminary finite element analysis and document assumptions, methods, and results
  • Support the selection and integration of gears, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, fasteners, and lubrication components
  • Help build, inspect, test, and iterate prototype hardware for functionality, performance, and reliability
  • Support pre-production builds, aircraft integration, and ground and flight testing
  • Investigate well-defined technical issues, document findings, and contribute to root-cause and corrective-action activities
  • Collaborate with mechanical, propulsion, electrical, avionics, flight-controls, manufacturing, and test teams
  • Follow established engineering, configuration-management, and product-release processes
  • Develop plans for assigned tasks, communicate progress and risks, and incorporate feedback from teammates

• 0-1 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience
  • Understanding of fundamental mechanical engineering principles, including statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, materials science, and machine design
  • Academic, internship, student-team, research, or project experience using 3D CAD software
  • Ability to create or interpret basic engineering drawings
  • Familiarity with dimensional tolerancing and GD&T fundamentals
  • Ability to perform foundational engineering calculations and clearly document assumptions and results
  • Hands-on interest in designing, building, integrating, or testing mechanical hardware
  • Strong problem-solving, organization, documentation, and communication skills
  • Ability to complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance from peers and managers
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept feedback, and work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
  • Ability to obtain an S//SAR-level security clearance is desired

• Internship, student-team, research, or project experience involving aircraft, UAVs, robotics, automotive systems, or other mechanical products
  • Coursework or project experience related to gearboxes, gearing, bearings, shafts, splines, seals, lubrication, or rotating machinery
  • Familiarity with gear geometry, gear-train calculations, bearing selection, or mechanical power transmission
  • Experience with NX or a similar production CAD platform
  • Exposure to tolerance stack-ups, mechanical fits, and GD&T application
  • Exposure to finite element analysis, including static, modal, buckling, or fatigue analysis
  • Familiarity with MATLAB, Python, or other engineering analysis tools
  • Hands-on machine-shop, mechanic, fabrication, assembly, or inspection experience through professional, academic, or hobby activities
  • Exposure to FMEA, design of experiments, root-cause analysis, or reliability testing
  • Familiarity with additive manufacturing, machining, casting, forging, or other mechanical manufacturing processes
  • Exposure to RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810, structural testing, vibration testing, or mechanism testing
  • Ability to thrive in startup, R&D, or defense-innovation environments

lists.content:

  • Familiar with PCB materials and manufacturing process, and stack-up construction.
  • Familiar with controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length matching, and high-current power distribution.
  • Familiar with scripting and automation

lists.content:

Job Description:
As a Simulation Framework Engineer (L1) on the Simulation Framework Team, you will help develop and maintain the software that connects modeling and simulation (M&S) environments with core autonomy software. You will work alongside experienced engineers to write C++ and Python code, build adapters and plugins, and support reusable software components that reduce the simulation-specific complexity exposed to autonomy developers.
This is a hands-on software engineering role intended for an early-career engineer who is interested in defense simulation, autonomy, distributed systems, and technical integration. You will contribute to simulation environments and frameworks such as NGTS, AFSIM, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and the emerging Hivemind Simulation Framework (HMSF).
You will support the team’s migration of HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF by helping implement baseline adapters, port selected modules, test functionality, and maintain compatibility for programs that continue to use HMSSimBlocks. You will also assist integration teams by investigating framework, plugin, interface, and data-exchange issues under the guidance of senior engineers.

Job Description:

As a Simulation Framework Engineer (L1) on the Simulation Framework Team, you will help develop and maintain the software that connects modeling and simulation (M&S) environments with core autonomy software. You will work alongside experienced engineers to write C++ and Python code, build adapters and plugins, and support reusable software components that reduce the simulation-specific complexity exposed to autonomy developers.

This is a hands-on software engineering role intended for an early-career engineer who is interested in defense simulation, autonomy, distributed systems, and technical integration. You will contribute to simulation environments and frameworks such as NGTS, AFSIM, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and the emerging Hivemind Simulation Framework (HMSF).

You will support the team’s migration of HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF by helping implement baseline adapters, port selected modules, test functionality, and maintain compatibility for programs that continue to use HMSSimBlocks. You will also assist integration teams by investigating framework, plugin, interface, and data-exchange issues under the guidance of senior engineers.

lists.content:
• Develop, compile, test, and maintain C++ and Python software for simulation adapters, plugins, and interfaces.
  • Contribute to baseline integrations for simulation backends such as AFSIM, NGTS, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and HMSF.
  • Assist with the transition from HMSSimBlocks to HMSF by porting simulation features, updating interfaces, validating behavior, and documenting migration considerations.
  • Help maintain and improve existing HMSSimBlocks integrations for programs that still depend on the legacy framework.
  • Support the development of reusable simulation components and plugin patterns that enable other engineering teams to integrate custom sensors, vehicle models, effects, or mission capabilities.
  • Assist with implementation and maintenance of CIGI-based plugins and interfaces that enable communication between simulation frameworks and Aechelon image generators.
  • Help verify functional behavior across simulation plugins, including Common Scenario Format (CSF) file loading, DDS communications, GRID interface requirements, and Hivemind SDK compatibility.
  • Diagnose simulation and autonomy integration issues by reviewing application logs, network traffic, DDS messages, API behavior, configuration files, and call stacks.
  • Write and maintain unit tests, automated integration tests, developer documentation, and example configurations.
  • Participate in code reviews, engineering design discussions, bug triage, and collaborative debugging with simulation, autonomy, and integration teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational programming experience in C++ and Python through coursework, internships, personal projects, research, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with Linux development environments, including command-line tools, compiling software, and basic scripting.
  • Understanding of core software engineering practices, including Git-based version control, debugging, code review, and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with object-oriented programming, software interfaces, APIs, and modular software design.
  • Exposure to networking concepts such as TCP, UDP, client-server communication, message passing, or data serialization.
  • Interest in modeling and simulation, autonomy, robotics, distributed systems, game engines, visualization systems, or defense technology.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn from senior engineers and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship is required.

• Internship, academic project, research, or personal-project experience involving simulation, robotics, autonomy, game engines, embedded systems, or vehicle modeling.
  • Exposure to modeling and simulation tools or frameworks, including AFSIM, NGTS, Unreal Engine, Unity, Gazebo, ROS/ROS 2, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar environments.
  • Familiarity with middleware or distributed communications technologies such as DDS, ROS 2, ZeroMQ, gRPC, or message queues.
  • Basic familiarity with CIGI, DIS, HLA, CSF, or other simulation and interoperability standards.
  • Experience writing unit tests or automated tests using tools such as GoogleTest, pytest, CTest, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience using build systems such as CMake, Make, Bazel, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with containerized development environments, including Docker or Podman.

lists.content:
• Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts and libraries used to analyze simulation data, extract log information, and calculate basic mission or system-performance metrics.
  • Support the development of analysis tools that process simulation outputs, telemetry, rosbags, and other test artifacts.
  • Help build and maintain automated test workflows and wrappers around HMS Forge and other internal test-orchestration tools.
  • Assist with developing program-specific test adapters, configuration files, and automation utilities in Python and, when needed, C++.
  • Contribute to programmatic scenario-generation tools that create varied simulation conditions for testing autonomy behaviors.
  • Write and maintain domain-randomization scripts that vary environmental, vehicle, sensor, mission, or operational parameters across test runs.
  • Investigate test failures and simulation issues by reviewing logs, configuration files, telemetry, rosbags, network captures, and automated test results.
  • Help improve repeatability and consistency in simulation testing by maintaining reusable test templates, common analysis utilities, and standardized reporting outputs.
  • Assist with containerized development and testing environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure tooling.
  • Contribute to prototype configurations for distributed testing and batch simulation runs, including Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, or similar deployment configurations.
  • Help maintain stable development workflows by supporting source-control practices, dependency updates, CI/CD pipelines, and software build troubleshooting.
  • Create clear developer documentation, setup guides, API references, example workflows, and workspace templates for engineers using automated simulation-test tools.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, test reviews, and collaborative debugging sessions with autonomy, simulation, platform, and program teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational software-development experience in Python gained through coursework, internships, research, personal projects, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with Python scripting, automation, and data processing. Experience with libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, matplotlib, or similar tools is helpful.
  • Familiarity with Linux development environments, including command-line tools, basic shell scripting, software installation, and debugging.
  • Understanding of core software-engineering practices, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, and debugging.
  • Familiarity with structured data formats and APIs, such as JSON, YAML, CSV, REST APIs, or command-line interfaces.
  • Exposure to automated testing, CI/CD systems, simulation environments, robotics, autonomy, data pipelines, or developer tooling.
  • Basic understanding of container concepts and tools such as Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes.
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving, collaborative engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship is required.

• Internship, academic project, research, or personal-project experience involving autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, software testing, data analysis, or distributed computing.
  • Experience creating Python-based data-analysis workflows using NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, matplotlib, Plotly, or similar libraries.
  • Exposure to continuous-integration systems such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, or similar tools.

Job Description:
The Systems & Platform Integration team serves as the engineering bridge between Hivemind autonomy and operational platforms across Shield AI’s Expeditionary and Emerging Operations portfolio. Our mission is to rapidly enable new platform adoption by developing the software interfaces, configurations, and integration frameworks required to connect autonomy with vehicle systems, sensors, payloads, mission computers, and communications systems.

Job Description:
The Hivemind Software Engineering Integration and Test team is seeking an Automated Test Engineer to design, develop, and scale advanced automated testing and CI/CD infrastructure for our next-generation autonomy platform. You will help develop test frameworks that enable this software ecosystem to create, test and deploy resilient autonomy capabilities for unmanned aircraft and robotic platforms operating in complex, contested, and GPS-denied environments. You will work with a robust suite of autonomy and mission software components, including production flight code, simulation and synthetic environment tooling, mission planning and orchestration systems, operator-facing Ground Control Station (GCS) applications, telemetry and data pipelines, and cloud-native developer infrastructure. 
In this role, you will help ensure the reliability, scalability, and quality of the Hivemind ecosystem through advanced automation, validation infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. You will develop automated test frameworks, CI/CD systems, and verification tooling that support distributed autonomy software spanning onboard edge compute, APIs, web-based operator interfaces, simulation environments, and hardware-in-the-loop systems. Working closely with software, autonomy, simulation, and systems engineering teams, you will contribute to a high-assurance development environment focused on mission-critical reliability, rapid iteration, and engineering excellence. The ideal candidate has strong experience in Python-based automation, distributed systems testing, developer tooling, and modern CI/CD practices, along with an interest in autonomy, aerospace, robotics, or safety-critical software systems. Experience leveraging AI-assisted development and intelligent automation tools to accelerate testing, debugging, analytics, and developer productivity is highly valued.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for Autonomy and UI applications.  
  • Develop scalable automated test infrastructure for functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across distributed software and hardware environments.  
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab using YAML configurations and shell scripting to support automated build, test, and deployment workflows.  
  • Build workflow automation tools and utilities in Python to improve test execution efficiency, reporting, environment setup, and developer productivity.  
  • Develop and maintain UI and API test automation using Go and TypeScript for modern web-based operator interfaces and mission control applications.  
  • Integrate automated testing into continuous integration environments to support rapid software delivery and high reliability standards.  
  • Collaborate closely with software, autonomy, simulation, and systems engineering teams to define verification strategies and improve software quality throughout the development lifecycle.  
  • Develop automated validation solutions for safety-critical and mission-critical aerospace software systems.  
  • Create test harnesses, simulators, stubs, and mocks to support automated verification in both simulated and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments.  
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and work with development teams to isolate root causes and improve system reliability.  
  • Improve test coverage, execution speed, maintainability, and observability of automated test systems.  
  • Contribute to software quality standards, coding best practices, and automation architecture decisions.  
  • Maintain clear technical documentation for test frameworks, automation workflows, CI/CD infrastructure, and validation procedures.  
  • Support release qualification activities and ensure traceability between requirements, tests, and verification results where applicable.  
  • Represent the Integration and Test Role in design reviews and advocate for a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.  
  • Develop AI-assisted engineering workflows and analytics tools using modern coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and related LLM-based development platforms to improve test generation, failure triage, debugging, and developer productivity.  
  • Design intelligent automation pipelines that leverage AI-assisted code generation, log analysis, test analysis, and workflow orchestration to accelerate software verification and validation processes.  
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI-driven software engineering tools into automated test and CI/CD ecosystems while maintaining reliability, traceability, and engineering quality standards.

• 2+ years of experience building scalable, maintainable automation frameworks and/or developer tooling in Python.  
  • 2+ years of experience working with package management, dependency management, and build systems using tools such as conan, pip, setuptools, poetry, and nix or similar. 
  • 2+ years of experience building tooling for automated log collection, analytics, reporting, and failure triage. 
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous and concurrent programming in Python for scalable automation and parallel test execution.  
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, YAML, and shell scripting.  
  • Experience with automated testing of distributed systems, backend services, APIs, and web-based UIs.  
  • Familiarity with modern test frameworks, automated validation strategies, and software quality methodologies.  
  • Experience working in Linux-based development environments.  
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in complex software systems.  
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional engineering environments.

• Experience integrating Python with native C/C++ libraries and applications using bindings, wrappers, subprocess interfaces, or interoperability tooling. 
  • Proficiency with Go and/or TypeScript for automation tooling or UI test development. 
  • Experience with C++ development or testing.  
  • Aerospace, robotics, autonomy, or safety-critical software experience.  
  • Familiarity with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), or embedded system testing.

Job Description:

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state of the art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates?  Shield AI is just the place for you!

As a Level 2 Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own  the design, analysis, and integration of aircraft avionics thermal management systems and electronics cooling.

This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can communicate well across functions, ensuring well coordinated thermal management solutions.

lists.content:
• Own thermal solutions for unmanned aerial vehicle avionics including design, analysis, and test.
  • Develop and validate analytical, numerical, and computational models for heat transfer and fluid flow using hand calculations and CFD tools such as FloEFD.
  • Provide technical leadership in trade studies, system architecture decisions, and risk assessments.
  • Drive test planning, instrumentation, and data analysis to correlate models with experimental results.
  • Guide cross-disciplinary teams in applying thermal/fluid fundamentals.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly through design reviews, and written reports.
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and influence electrical and/or PCBA design direction.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in avionics or electronics thermal engineering.
  • Strong expertise in heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and fluid mechanics.
  • Strong understanding of active and passive cooling solutions and their integration at component and system level.
  • Understanding of thermal management design elements including TIMs, spreaders, heat sinks, vapor chambers, heat pipes, and fans
  • Proficiency with thermal analysis and CFD tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, STAR-CCM+).
  • Experience with CAD design tools such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience applying first-principles reasoning to complex engineering problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new tools, processes, and technical challenges in a fast paced, startup environment.

• M.S. in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with high altitude aircraft avionics cooling and thermal design.
  • Familiarity with aircraft integration constraints (power, weight, volume, maintainability, safety).
  • Hands-on experience with thermal and fluid system testing, instrumentation, and validation.
  • Knowledge of materials and manufacturing methods relevant to thermal management

lists.content:

Job Description:
As an System Test Engineer II, you will support the integration, verification, and validation of Hivemind Mission Autonomy across a variety of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and mission applications. You will work with experienced test, systems, software, autonomy, hardware, and program teams to help prepare, execute, document, and improve system-level test activities.
This is a hands-on engineering role for an early-career candidate interested in autonomy, robotics, unmanned systems, simulation, software-and-hardware integration, and flight-test operations. You will help evaluate whether autonomy capabilities perform as intended in simulation, laboratory, hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and, when applicable, flight-test environments.
Under the guidance of senior engineers, you will contribute to test planning, test execution, data collection, issue investigation, and technical documentation. You will also have opportunities to support integration events with internal teams, external platform partners, and customers.

Job Description:

As an System Test Engineer II, you will support the integration, verification, and validation of Hivemind Mission Autonomy across a variety of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and mission applications. You will work with experienced test, systems, software, autonomy, hardware, and program teams to help prepare, execute, document, and improve system-level test activities.

This is a hands-on engineering role for an early-career candidate interested in autonomy, robotics, unmanned systems, simulation, software-and-hardware integration, and flight-test operations. You will help evaluate whether autonomy capabilities perform as intended in simulation, laboratory, hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and, when applicable, flight-test environments.

Under the guidance of senior engineers, you will contribute to test planning, test execution, data collection, issue investigation, and technical documentation. You will also have opportunities to support integration events with internal teams, external platform partners, and customers.

lists.content:
• Support test planning and execution for integration of Hivemind Mission Autonomy capabilities onto unmanned platforms and mission-system configurations.
  • Assist senior test engineers with defining test objectives, expected system behavior, acceptance criteria, verification methods, and test schedules.
  • Help develop, execute, and maintain system-level test procedures, test cases, checklists, and test configurations.
  • Support setup, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), simulation, laboratory, and automated test environments.
  • Assist with installation, configuration, and verification of test hardware, software, networks, ground-control equipment, sensors, radios, computing systems, and supporting tools as applicable.
  • Collect and organize test data, telemetry, logs, video, configuration information, and other evidence needed to evaluate system behavior.
  • Help analyze test results, identify deviations from expected performance, document defects, and support root-cause investigations with systems, software, autonomy, and platform-integration teams.
  • Contribute to performance metrics, test reports, test-readiness materials, dashboards, and other reporting artifacts for internal engineering teams and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with maintaining test infrastructure, test automation, simulation tools, and repeatable test configurations.
  • Support development and maintenance of test procedures, standard operating procedures, configuration-control records, lessons learned, and engineering documentation.
  • Participate in test-readiness reviews, technical planning meetings, issue-triage sessions, and post-test debriefs.
  • Follow established safety, security, configuration-management, and operational procedures during laboratory, simulation, integration, and flight-test activities.
  • Travel periodically to internal test sites, customer locations, and platform-integration events as needed.

• Master’s degree in a STEM discipline, such as Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational experience with engineering test, integration, troubleshooting, or verification activities through coursework, internships, research, military service, laboratory work, personal projects, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with basic systems-engineering and test concepts, including requirements, verification, validation, test procedures, configuration management, defect tracking, and technical documentation.
  • Interest in autonomous systems, robotics, unmanned aircraft systems, flight-test operations, simulation, embedded systems, or software-and-hardware integration.
  • Familiarity with Linux, Windows, command-line tools, networking basics, and/or scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, C++, or similar tools.
  • Ability to work methodically, follow detailed procedures, maintain accurate records, and manage several tasks in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate unexpected system behavior using logs, telemetry, test results, and input from subject-matter experts.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated reliability, accountability, teamwork, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining a respectful and high-performing engineering culture.
  • Ability to travel periodically in support of integration, testing, and customer activities.

• Internship, academic research, military, laboratory, personal-project, or professional experience involving UAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, aviation, embedded systems, or complex integrated systems.
  • Exposure to software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, modeling-and-simulation, or automated test environments.
  • Familiarity with test automation, scripting, data collection, telemetry analysis, log analysis, or defect-tracking tools.
  • Exposure to software-development and configuration-management practices, including Git, issue tracking, build systems, continuous integration, or test automation.
  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts, including Ethernet, IP networking, UDP/TCP communication, and network troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to flight-test, aviation, safety, or operational-risk-management processes.
  • Working knowledge of Department of Defense development, test, evaluation, or acquisition processes, including Developmental Test and Evaluation (DT&E) or Operational Test and Evaluation (OT&E).
  • Experience working in a laboratory, integration facility, field-test environment, maker space, research environment, or similar hands-on technical setting.

Job Description:

The Future Concepts team plays a critical role in shaping next-generation technical concepts and solutions for Hivemind applications across multiple domains. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and customer-facing teams, Future Concepts Engineers turn emerging technologies, operational needs, and novel ideas into detailed concepts and models. In this role, you will drive innovation by blending creativity with robust technical expertise. You will explore new applications for Hivemind and use data-driven analysis to assess alternatives and inform decisions. By contributing to white papers, proposals, and technical presentations, you will help shape the future roadmap for Hivemind and ensure that it remains on the cutting edge of advanced autonomy and AI.  

The ideal candidate for this role is a curious problem-solver who can generate original ideas and make them technically credible. If you thrive on collaboration, enjoy engaging with customers, and possess a strong foundation in engineering, you’ll find a dynamic environment here for developing transformative solutions that push the boundaries of Hivemind’s evolving portfolio.

lists.content:
• Develop technology-driven future concepts for Hivemind applications across air, space, land, and maritime domains. 
  • Translate emerging customer needs, operational challenges, and technology trends into compelling and technically credible concepts and mission-oriented use cases for autonomous systems. 
  • Produce concept studies, analytical reports, white papers, RFIs, proposals, and other high-quality technical artifacts to explore how future capabilities could create value. 
  • Use quantitative programming or analysis tools to organize data, build models, and communicate results. 
  • Generate and deliver clear technical briefings for internal and external audiences, adapting complex material for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Go-To-Market teams to align future concepts with technical roadmaps and early-stage product development. 
  • Monitor developments in aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, and related technologies to identify new opportunities and challenges. 
  • Travel to customer sites as needed to support engagements, gather insights, and present concepts and analysis.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, operations research, data science, or another relevant quantitative field. 
  • 2+ years of experience in engineering, technical analysis, concept development, modeling and simulation, product management, or a related area. 
  • Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative analysis to support technical decision-making. 
  • Ability to explain complex material clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences through written products and verbal briefings. 
  • Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills, including the ability to apply creativity and collaboration to ambiguous or evolving problems. 
  • Experience with at least one quantitative programming, modeling, or analysis tool, such as Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar. 
  • Familiarity with aerospace, autonomy, robotics, or defense systems. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a USG security clearance.

• Master's degree in a relevant quantitative or technical field. 
  • Experience developing novel concepts, models, or analytical artifacts to explore complex technical questions. 
  • Familiarity with trade studies, modeling and simulation, sensitivity analysis, data visualization, or other structured approaches to comparing technical alternatives. 
  • Experience briefing customers, executives, operators, government stakeholders, or other decision-makers. 
  • Experience contributing to product roadmaps, white papers, RFIs, proposals, or customer-facing technical material. 
  • Prior military operations, mission analysis, or defense-industry experience. 
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.

lists.content:

  • Support the full design process: concept, CAD, tolerance analysis, material selection, and drawing release

  • Materials selection inclusive of alloys, heat treatments, allowables, and finishes
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, cross-functional teams

Job Description:

The Hivemind Solutions HIL Infrastructure and Test Engineering Team is seeking an Integration Engineer II to develop and test the systems that bring Hivemind mission autonomy and vision capabilities onto real aircraft. You'll build Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) infrastructure, develop automated tests, and validate mission autonomy software in HIL and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments. You'll also support vision system development through HIL testing and hands on integration of imaging sensors, onboard processing, camera pods, and gimbals for crewed and uncrewed aircraft. Working across software, electrical, and mechanical disciplines, you'll own integration and test tasks from setup through validation, collaborating with experienced engineers to resolve issues and prepare systems for ground and flight testing. We're looking for someone who enjoys building and debugging complex systems, embraces learning, and takes ownership of delivering reliable results.

lists.content:
• Develop, build, and maintain HIL test infrastructure for mission autonomy and vision systems, including electrical integration, mechanical fixtures, and sensor interfaces, working with engineers and lab technicians.
  • Create and execute integration, regression, and system test plans for Hivemind mission autonomy software in HIL, SIL, and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments, including simulated flight and mission scenarios.
  • Build Python tools and automated test utilities for test execution, data collection, and analysis across hardware and simulation environments.
  • Develop and execute HIL tests for vision systems to validate imaging, onboard processing, detection capabilities, and hardware/software interfaces throughout development and software releases.
  • Identify, reproduce, and diagnose failures using test data, system logs; collaborate with development teams to resolve issues and verify fixes.
  • Improve test fixtures, automation, and test coverage through rapid prototyping and repeatable validation methods; document test configurations, procedures, and results.
  • Install, integrate, and perform functional checkout of vision systems, including camera pods, gimbals, imaging sensors, onboard processing hardware, and supporting electronics on test assets and aircraft.
  • Load, configure, and validate software and firmware releases; maintain accurate hardware, software, and asset records so lab and field configurations remain reproducible.
  • Troubleshoot sensor, compute, power, network, and mechanical interfaces using wiring diagrams, pinouts, logs, and test equipment; perform connector inspections, continuity checks, and basic wiring work under established procedures.
  • Support ground and flight tests, customer demonstrations, and field evaluations through equipment setup, system configuration, data collection, and post-test troubleshooting; communicate findings to engineering teams and mission partners.

• Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related discipline; or a Master's degree without experience; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and testing hardware and software in robotics, small UAS, avionics, vision systems, or related engineering projects.
  • Proficiency in Python for test automation, system utilities, or data analysis.
  • Practical electrical and mechanical skills, including interpreting wiring diagrams and pinouts and safely using a digital multimeter.
  • Familiarity with Linux, software installation and configuration, and basic networking concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills, with attention to configuration accuracy and clear technical documentation.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across software, hardware, and mechanical engineering teams, with ownership of assigned work and a willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance.

• Experience with HIL, SIL, or VIL testing, simulation environments, or validation of autonomous systems.
  • Experience with electro-optical or infrared imaging systems, cameras, gimbals, sensor pods, or onboard image processing and detection systems.
  • Familiarity with C++, Git, automated regression testing, or development pipelines (CI/CD).
  • Experience with Ethernet, serial communications, CAN, or sensor and compute interfaces.
  • Exposure to CAD, fixture design, rapid prototyping, or hands-on robotics and aircraft projects.
  • Experience with oscilloscopes, bench power supplies, cable assembly, connector inspection, or harness troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting aircraft integration, field demonstrations, customer deployments, or ground and flight test campaigns.

lists.content:
• Directly contribute to the design, analysis, and integration of mechanical systems and subsystems for V-BAT aircraft and ground support equipment, including payload integrations, avionics packaging, harnessing and connector selection, transport structures, and launch & recovery systems.

lists.content:

  • Collaborate with operators, mission SMEs, and internal stakeholders to understand user needs and prioritize system features and capabilities.
  • Support and drive 0→1 development: take loosely defined mission problems, propose solutions, prototype quickly, iterate with flight test data, and mature systems into production-ready capabilities.

• Experience integrating avionics, sensors, radios, mission payloads, or flight computing systems.
  • Experience with flight test, field testing, or hardware-in-the-loop development.
  • Experience with Python or any scripting language.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance (or ability to obtain one if needed.
  • Demonstrated adaptability, agility, and the ability to innovate under pressure to meet dynamic project demands and drive successful outcomes.
  • Experience contributing to the development of a hardware + software system from concept through testing or deployment.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a Propulsion Performance Engineer to own engine calibration and performance for the reciprocating engines that power the V-BAT platform. This role serves as the technical owner for engine calibration strategy — driving test plans, ECU tuning, and performance analysis from bench through flight test — and is accountable for the torque, power, speed, and fuel efficiency characteristics the engine delivers across its full operating envelope.

You'll work hands-on with engine hardware, electronic fuel injection and engine control systems, and engine test stands, creating and executing engine testing strategies under the direction of senior staff propulsion engineers. Candidates with a background in air-cooled or aviation two-stroke engines are especially encouraged to apply; at minimum, we're looking for someone with deep hands-on experience on reciprocating engines (four-stroke or two-stroke) who can own calibration decisions with minimal oversight.

lists.text: What You'll Do In This Role
lists.content:
• Support the engine calibration strategy by defining test plans, calibration methodology, and acceptance criteria across dynamometer, bench, and flight test campaigns.
  • Perform ECU configuration and tuning (including fuel mapping, ignition timing, and injector phasing) to optimize engine performance, fuel efficiency, and reliability across the operating envelope.
  • Analyze and deliver torque, power, and fuel consumption results, identifying calibration or hardware improvement opportunities and driving corrective action.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause investigations for engine testing for the development team and production teams.
  • Reduce and interpret test and flight data to validate performance against requirements, closing gaps between design intent and measured behavior.
  • Represent engine calibration and performance in design reviews, technical readiness checkpoints, and cross-functional discussions with design, controls, and flight test teams.
  • Develop and maintain calibration documentation, procedures, and performance reporting to support program milestones.
  • Support refinement of performance models for the propulsion system and the vehicle through targeted test campaigns and data review.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 2-3 years of experience in a mechanical or aerospace engineering role, with a focus on engine performance or calibration.
  • Deep hands-on experience with reciprocating (piston) engines.
  • Demonstrated experience with electronically controlled fuel injectors and fuel injection systems.
  • Proven experience with ECU configuration and engine calibration, including ownership of calibration decisions.
  • Strong ability to analyze and interpret engine torque, power, and fuel consumption data to drive engine design, ECU calibration, and vehicle performance decisions.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

• Podium finish in FSAE competition, with at least one first place trophy in any dynamic event.
  • Background in air-cooled engines, particularly aviation two-stroke platforms.
  • Experience with dynamometer test cells and associated data acquisition systems.
  • Deep familiarity with fuel maps, ignition timing strategies, and closed-loop engine control logic.
  • Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data reduction and calibration tooling.
  • Experience writing custom data analysis tools to automate engine performance analysis and calibration workflows.
  • Experience supporting military propulsion systems, tactical aircraft, or high-performance aerospace platforms.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Job Description:
As a Simulation Framework Engineer (L2) on the Simulation Framework Team, you will help develop and maintain the software that connects modeling and simulation (M&S) environments with core autonomy software. You will work alongside experienced engineers to write C++ and Python code, build adapters and plugins, and support reusable software components that reduce the simulation-specific complexity exposed to autonomy developers.
This is a hands-on software engineering role intended for an early-career engineer who is interested in defense simulation, autonomy, distributed systems, and technical integration. You will contribute to simulation environments and frameworks such as NGTS, AFSIM, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and the emerging Hivemind Simulation Framework (HMSF).
You will support the team’s migration of HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF by helping implement baseline adapters, port selected modules, test functionality, and maintain compatibility for programs that continue to use HMSSimBlocks. You will also assist integration teams by investigating framework, plugin, interface, and data-exchange issues under the guidance of senior engineers.

Job Description:

As a Simulation Framework Engineer (L2) on the Simulation Framework Team, you will help develop and maintain the software that connects modeling and simulation (M&S) environments with core autonomy software. You will work alongside experienced engineers to write C++ and Python code, build adapters and plugins, and support reusable software components that reduce the simulation-specific complexity exposed to autonomy developers.

This is a hands-on software engineering role intended for an early-career engineer who is interested in defense simulation, autonomy, distributed systems, and technical integration. You will contribute to simulation environments and frameworks such as NGTS, AFSIM, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and the emerging Hivemind Simulation Framework (HMSF).

You will support the team’s migration of HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF by helping implement baseline adapters, port selected modules, test functionality, and maintain compatibility for programs that continue to use HMSSimBlocks. You will also assist integration teams by investigating framework, plugin, interface, and data-exchange issues under the guidance of senior engineers.

lists.content:
• Develop, compile, test, and maintain C++ and Python software for simulation adapters, plugins, and interfaces.
  • Contribute to baseline integrations for simulation backends such as AFSIM, NGTS, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and HMSF.
  • Assist with the transition from HMSSimBlocks to HMSF by porting simulation features, updating interfaces, validating behavior, and documenting migration considerations.
  • Help maintain and improve existing HMSSimBlocks integrations for programs that still depend on the legacy framework.
  • Support the development of reusable simulation components and plugin patterns that enable other engineering teams to integrate custom sensors, vehicle models, effects, or mission capabilities.
  • Assist with implementation and maintenance of CIGI-based plugins and interfaces that enable communication between simulation frameworks and Aechelon image generators.
  • Help verify functional behavior across simulation plugins, including Common Scenario Format (CSF) file loading, DDS communications, GRID interface requirements, and Hivemind SDK compatibility.
  • Diagnose simulation and autonomy integration issues by reviewing application logs, network traffic, DDS messages, API behavior, configuration files, and call stacks.
  • Write and maintain unit tests, automated integration tests, developer documentation, and example configurations.
  • Participate in code reviews, engineering design discussions, bug triage, and collaborative debugging with simulation, autonomy, and integration teams.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational programming experience in C++ and Python through coursework, internships, personal projects, research, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with Linux development environments, including command-line tools, compiling software, and basic scripting.
  • Understanding of core software engineering practices, including Git-based version control, debugging, code review, and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with object-oriented programming, software interfaces, APIs, and modular software design.
  • Exposure to networking concepts such as TCP, UDP, client-server communication, message passing, or data serialization.
  • Interest in modeling and simulation, autonomy, robotics, distributed systems, game engines, visualization systems, or defense technology.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn from senior engineers and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship is required.

• Internship, academic project, research, or personal-project experience involving simulation, robotics, autonomy, game engines, embedded systems, or vehicle modeling.
  • Exposure to modeling and simulation tools or frameworks, including AFSIM, NGTS, Unreal Engine, Unity, Gazebo, ROS/ROS 2, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar environments.
  • Familiarity with middleware or distributed communications technologies such as DDS, ROS 2, ZeroMQ, gRPC, or message queues.
  • Basic familiarity with CIGI, DIS, HLA, CSF, or other simulation and interoperability standards.
  • Experience writing unit tests or automated tests using tools such as GoogleTest, pytest, CTest, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience using build systems such as CMake, Make, Bazel, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with containerized development environments, including Docker or Podman.

As an Software EngineerII on the HMS Factory Team, you will help build and maintain automated testing, log-analysis, and scenario-generation tools that support the Hivemind Platform (HMP). You will work with experienced software, autonomy, and systems engineers to help teams evaluate AI Pilot behaviors through repeatable simulation testing and data-driven performance analysis.
This is a hands-on engineering role for an early-career developer interested in autonomy, simulation, software test infrastructure, data analysis, and distributed systems. You will contribute Python-based tooling, test automation scripts, analysis utilities, and documentation that help autonomy and systems developers run tests, understand simulation results, and identify software issues.
