Job DescriptIon:

As an Software Engineer II on the HMS Factory Team, you will help build and maintain automated testing, log-analysis, and scenario-generation tools that support the Hivemind Platform (HMP). You will work with experienced software, autonomy, and systems engineers to help teams evaluate AI Pilot behaviors through repeatable simulation testing and data-driven performance analysis.

This is a hands-on engineering role for an early-career developer interested in autonomy, simulation, software test infrastructure, data analysis, and distributed systems. You will contribute Python-based tooling, test automation scripts, analysis utilities, and documentation that help autonomy and systems developers run tests, understand simulation results, and identify software issues.

You will also gain exposure to secure and commercial development environments, build and dependency-management workflows, containerized infrastructure, and distributed test orchestration. Under guidance from senior engineers, you will help improve the reliability, usability, and scalability of the team’s testing and analysis ecosystem.

lists.content:
• Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts and libraries used to analyze simulation data, extract log information, and calculate basic mission or system-performance metrics.
  • Support the development of analysis tools that process simulation outputs, telemetry, rosbags, and other test artifacts.
  • Help build and maintain automated test workflows and wrappers around HMS Forge and other internal test-orchestration tools.
  • Assist with developing program-specific test adapters, configuration files, and automation utilities in Python and, when needed, C++.
  • Contribute to programmatic scenario-generation tools that create varied simulation conditions for testing autonomy behaviors.
  • Write and maintain domain-randomization scripts that vary environmental, vehicle, sensor, mission, or operational parameters across test runs.
  • Investigate test failures and simulation issues by reviewing logs, configuration files, telemetry, rosbags, network captures, and automated test results.
  • Help improve repeatability and consistency in simulation testing by maintaining reusable test templates, common analysis utilities, and standardized reporting outputs.
  • Assist with containerized development and testing environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure tooling.
  • Contribute to prototype configurations for distributed testing and batch simulation runs, including Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, or similar deployment configurations.
  • Help maintain stable development workflows by supporting source-control practices, dependency updates, CI/CD pipelines, and software build troubleshooting.
  • Create clear developer documentation, setup guides, API references, example workflows, and workspace templates for engineers using automated simulation-test tools.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, test reviews, and collaborative debugging sessions with autonomy, simulation, platform, and program teams.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Foundational software-development experience in Python gained through coursework, internships, research, personal projects, or professional experience.
  • Familiarity with Python scripting, automation, and data processing. Experience with libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, matplotlib, or similar tools is helpful.
  • Familiarity with Linux development environments, including command-line tools, basic shell scripting, software installation, and debugging.
  • Understanding of core software-engineering practices, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, and debugging.
  • Familiarity with structured data formats and APIs, such as JSON, YAML, CSV, REST APIs, or command-line interfaces.
  • Exposure to automated testing, CI/CD systems, simulation environments, robotics, autonomy, data pipelines, or developer tooling.
  • Basic understanding of container concepts and tools such as Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes.
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving, collaborative engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship is required.

• Internship, academic project, research, or personal-project experience involving autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, software testing, data analysis, or distributed computing.
  • Experience creating Python-based data-analysis workflows using NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, matplotlib, Plotly, or similar libraries.
  • Exposure to continuous-integration systems such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with test frameworks such as pytest, unittest, GoogleTest, Robot Framework, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with containers using Docker or Podman, including writing Dockerfiles and running local containerized applications.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, or other infrastructure-as-code and container-orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with ROS, ROS 2, rosbag files, telemetry formats, robotics middleware, network diagnostics, or simulation logs.
  • Familiarity with distributed compute frameworks or container orchestration tools is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Python-based distributed-computing concepts and large-scale simulation workloads; exposure to Ray, task or actor-based parallelism, Monte Carlo testing, parameter sweeps, and Design of Experiments (DOE) is preferred.
  • Experience creating Python-based data-analysis workflows using NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, matplotlib, Plotly, or similar libraries.
  • Experience using Linux debugging and observability tools, such as grep, jq, tail, journalctl, tcpdump, Wireshark, or Python logging.
  • Interest in generative AI, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, automated analysis, or developer productivity tooling.

Job Description:
Shield AI's Software Test & Automation Team develops the verification, validation, and automation capabilities that enable rapid delivery of Hivemind autonomy across the Autonomous Collaborative Platform (ACP) portfolio. Our mission is to provide objective evidence of software quality, reliability, and mission readiness by building scalable automated test frameworks, repeatable validation environments, and data-driven readiness assessments spanning simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments. 
As a Software Test & Automation Engineer (L2), you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop automated tests, improve validation tooling, analyze software performance, and support system-level verification activities for autonomous systems. You will gain hands-on experience working with autonomy software, simulation environments, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and real-world robotic platforms while contributing directly to the tools and processes used to evaluate software quality and mission readiness.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI's Software Test & Automation Team develops the verification, validation, and automation capabilities that enable rapid delivery of Hivemind autonomy across the Autonomous Collaborative Platform (ACP) portfolio. Our mission is to provide objective evidence of software quality, reliability, and mission readiness by building scalable automated test frameworks, repeatable validation environments, and data-driven readiness assessments spanning simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments. 

As a Software Test & Automation Engineer (L2), you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop automated tests, improve validation tooling, analyze software performance, and support system-level verification activities for autonomous systems. You will gain hands-on experience working with autonomy software, simulation environments, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and real-world robotic platforms while contributing directly to the tools and processes used to evaluate software quality and mission readiness.

lists.content:
• Develop Python-based automated tests, test utilities, and analysis tools supporting autonomy software validation. 
  • Support verification and validation activities across simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, and representative system environments. 
  • Build and improve regression, integration, functional, and performance tests with guidance from experienced engineers. 
  • Analyze test results, identify unexpected system behavior, and assist with debugging software and integration issues. 
  • Develop scripts and tools that reduce manual testing effort and improve the repeatability of test execution and analysis. 
  • Support the development of software quality metrics, dashboards, test reports, and readiness assessments. 
  • Assist with integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows to provide rapid feedback to software developers. 
  • Collaborate with autonomy software, systems engineering, flight test, and integration teams to understand system behavior and validation requirements. 
  • Participate in laboratory and hardware testing of autonomous systems, sensors, flight controllers, networking equipment, and mission computers. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, documentation, and validation workflows.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Python programming experience from coursework, projects, research, or student teams. 
  • Familiarity with software development and debugging fundamentals. 
  • Interest in robotics, autonomy, aerospace, embedded systems, or software testing. 
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Experience with Linux, Git, or Docker. 
  • Exposure to automated testing, unit testing, or integration testing. 
  • Experience with sensors, flight controllers, embedded systems, or networking. 
  • Coursework or projects in robotics, controls, autonomy, computer vision, or embedded systems

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking an Engineer II, Structural Analysis to support the structural analysis and testing of advanced UAVs. In this role, you will work closely with Mechanical, Systems, Propulsion, and Aerospace Engineers to ensure the structural integrity of our lightweight, high-performance aircraft. You will contribute to the design, analysis, testing, and optimization of airframe structures and components, ensuring they meet performance, weight, and safety requirements.
 
This role is ideal for engineers with 2+ years of experience looking to gain expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), composite materials, mechanical testing, and aircraft loads analysis in a fast-paced, high-tech aerospace environment.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Engineer II, Structural Analysis to support the structural analysis and testing of advanced UAVs. In this role, you will work closely with Mechanical, Systems, Propulsion, and Aerospace Engineers to ensure the structural integrity of our lightweight, high-performance aircraft. You will contribute to the design, analysis, testing, and optimization of airframe structures and components, ensuring they meet performance, weight, and safety requirements.
 
This role is ideal for engineers with 2+ years of experience looking to gain expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), composite materials, mechanical testing, and aircraft loads analysis in a fast-paced, high-tech aerospace environment.

lists.content:
• Assist in building and refining finite element models (FEM) to evaluate the structural performance of UAV components.
  • Perform static, modal, fatigue, and vibration analyses to assess stress, deformation, and durability.
  • Conduct hand calculations to validate FEA results, ensuring accuracy and structural reliability.
  • Work with design engineers to optimize airframe structures, balancing weight, strength, and manufacturability.
  • Support the development of test plans for structural validation, including quasi-static, vibration, and shock testing.
  • Analyze flight telemetry and structural test data to improve modeling accuracy and correlate predictions with real-world performance.
  • Assist in defining load cases, material properties, and design margins for UAV airframe and mechanical components.
  • Document and present structural analysis reports and technical recommendations to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure structural requirements align with system performance goals.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of structural analysis methodologies, tools, and best practices.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in structural analysis, finite element modeling, or aircraft loads analysis.
  • Experience with FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, or similar).
  • Strong ability to perform hand calculations for structural strength, stability, and fatigue analysis.
  • Knowledge of composite materials and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing methods (static, vibration, and fatigue).
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Master’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
  • Experience in aircraft structural design, UAV airframe development, or aerospace testing.
  • Hands-on experience with structural testing, modal analysis, or composite modeling.
  • Exposure to CAD software (NX, SolidWorks) and PLM tools (Teamcenter or similar).
  • Understanding of aerospace industry standards, structural certification processes, and material selection.

The Hivemind Solutions Test Department is seeking an Engineer II (Software & Simulation Focus) to join our DC-based team. Since Shield AI's mission is to protect service members and civilians, The Hivemind Solutions Test Department makes this a reality by validating the reliability, safety, and performance of our world-class autonomy software.

You’ll lead simulation-driven testing, automation, and software quality efforts for Hivemind, building and executing test frameworks that ensure our autonomy software performs reliably across simulated and real-world mission environments.

Shield AI is growing quickly, and we're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces learning, and brings a high-ownership, mission-driven mindset. This is a chance to have a real impact—advancing autonomy that protects lives—while working with a collaborative, high-performing team.

lists.content:
• Develop automated regression, integration, and system-level tests to ensure Hivemind software quality and stability across releases
  • Identify, reproduce, and diagnose software issues—collaborating closely with development teams to drive fixes and improvements
  • Create and execute test plans and documentation for autonomy software in simulated environments, ensuring mission and safety requirements are met
  • Design, implement, and maintain simulation-based test frameworks to validate Hivemind autonomy behavior and performance
  • Build tools and utilities in Python to automate testing, data processing, and analysis workflows
  • Develop test harnesses and data validation tools for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) / Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) / Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) and simulation environments
  • Contribute to the definition of testing methodologies, metrics, and performance benchmarks for autonomy software validation
  • Support the scaling and reliability of simulation infrastructure used for large-scale software validation
  • Maintain detailed and accurate test documentation, ensuring traceability and knowledge sharing across teams
  • Work with developers to integrate test coverage directly into the development pipeline (CI/CD)

• Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 0 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Experience in robotics, small UAS, or related hands-on engineering projects
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills
  • Passionate about intelligent aircraft systems
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional software, hardware and mechanical engineering teams
  • Adaptability and a willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies quickly in a fast-paced environment 
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET Clearance. US citizenship is required as only US citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

• Experience testing autonomous systems, robotics software, or flight autonomy algorithms
  • Familiarity with C++ and software/hardware integration concepts.
  • Experience with HIL or VIL test environments.
  • Exposure to machine learning or AI-driven autonomy systems.
  • Background in simulation infrastructure design, distributed testing, or test data management.
  • Quality Assurance (QA) experience, including process definition, metrics, and validation tracking
  • Experience with aerospace, defense, or mission-critical software
  • Active SECRET clearance preferred

As a Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own the design, analysis, and integration of thermal management systems for the launch and recovery system structural and electronics components. This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can communicate well across functions, ensuring well- coordinated thermal management solutions.
You’ll work across disciplines to ensure structural integrity, manufacturability, and mission-readiness in one of the most advanced autonomous aircraft platforms being built today. This role is ideal for an experienced thermal engineer who thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments and is passionate about building systems that matter.

Job Description:

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!

As a Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own the design, analysis, and integration of thermal management systems for the launch and recovery system structural and electronics components. This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can communicate well across functions, ensuring well- coordinated thermal management solutions.

You’ll work across disciplines to ensure structural integrity, manufacturability, and mission-readiness in one of the most advanced autonomous aircraft platforms being built today. This role is ideal for an experienced thermal engineer who thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments and is passionate about building systems that matter.

lists.content:
• Own thermal solutions for the autonomous aircraft launch and recovery system
  • Develop and validate analytical, numerical, and computational models for heat transfer and fluid flow using hand calculations and CFD tools such as FloEFD.
  • Prototype, test, and iterate mechanism designs for functionality and reliability
  • Provide technical leadership in trade studies, system architecture decisions, and risk assessments.
  • Drive test planning, instrumentation, and data analysis to correlate models with experimental results.
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and influence mechanical, electrical and/or PCBA design direction.
  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, avionics, flight controls, manufacturing, and test teams
  • Support pre-production builds, prototype integration, and ground/flight testing on the pathway to production and field deployment
  • Participate in design reviews, architecture discussions, and technical decision-making forums related to structural systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve design processes, configuration management, and team workflows for increased engineering velocity and design quality.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in thermal engineering.
  • Strong expertise in heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and fluid mechanics.
  • Strong understanding of active and passive cooling solutions and their integration at component and system level.
  • Understanding of thermal management design elements including TIMs, spreaders, heat sinks, vapor chambers, heat pipes, and fans
  • Proficiency with thermal analysis and CFD tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, STAR-CCM+).
  • Experience with CAD design tools such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience applying first-principles reasoning to complex engineering problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new tools, processes, and technical challenges in a fast paced, startup environment.
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• M.S. in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with thermal and fluid system testing, instrumentation, and validation.
  • Knowledge of materials and manufacturing methods relevant to thermal management
  • MIL-STD-810, structural, or actuated mechanism testing experience
  • Ability to thrive in startup, R&D, or defense innovation environments

Job Description:
Shield AI builds intelligent systems that protect service members and civilians. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software and aircraft systems, and our teams support customers and operations across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. 
Shield AI is seeking a senior, hands-on UxS Integration and Systems Expert to help ensure Hivemind can be developed, tested, demonstrated, and supported on representative unmanned systems with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of autonomy software, unmanned aircraft and robotic systems, onboard compute, networking, radios, sensors, flight controllers, simulation, test operations, and customer-facing demonstrations. 
This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who is both a builder and an operator. The right candidate can move comfortably from architecture discussions to benchtop integration, from lab troubleshooting to field execution, and from platform evaluation to clear recommendations for engineering, test, product, and operations leaders. 
You will serve as a trusted systems-integration authority for Hivemind test and demonstration hardware. You will help teams select and prepare representative platforms, understand integration tradeoffs, improve test readiness, diagnose cross-disciplinary issues, and translate lessons from real hardware into better engineering, test, and operational practice. The role requires strong judgment, calm execution under pressure, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous technical environments without overfitting to a single platform or workflow.

lists.content:
• Serve as a senior technical focal point for Hivemind integration and test readiness across unmanned aircraft, robotic systems, representative test vehicles, onboard compute, radios, sensors, payloads, and supporting ground equipment. 
  • Lead hands-on integration and troubleshooting efforts that span autonomy software, hardware, flight controllers, communications systems, networking, operator interfaces, and field operations. 
  • Partner with engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams to evaluate new platforms and determine how they can best support Hivemind development, validation, training, demonstrations, and customer objectives. 
  • Help take systems from early concept or benchtop integration through representative test, field execution, and operationally relevant demonstrations. 
  • Provide senior-level technical judgment on platform suitability, integration complexity, test readiness, risk, safety, maintainability, cost, availability, and customer value. 
  • Support test planning and execution across simulated, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, and flight-test environments while keeping the role focused on practical system readiness and evidence quality. 
  • Help define clear readiness criteria, test expectations, operating assumptions, and handoff points for representative hardware used by Hivemind teams. 
  • Diagnose complex cross-disciplinary issues and help route them effectively across software, autonomy, hardware, flight-test, networking, and operations stakeholders. 
  • Contribute to test methods, metrics, and evidence practices that improve confidence in Hivemind behavior across representative and real-world environments. 
  • Support automation, tooling, and data-review practices that improve repeatability, reduce manual burden, and make hardware-based testing easier to operate at scale. 
  • Capture and share practical knowledge from platform bring-up, test events, flight operations, and customer-facing demonstrations so teams can reuse lessons learned. 
  • Mentor engineers and operators on systems integration, hardware readiness, field troubleshooting, test discipline, and practical autonomy test execution.

• Evaluating a new unmanned aircraft, ground robot, customer-selected platform, or lab setup for suitability as a Hivemind development, test, training, or demonstration asset. 
  • Leading technical preparation for a Hivemind test event or customer demonstration that depends on representative hardware, onboard compute, communications, sensors, and operator workflows. 
  • Advising a program team on the right level of platform fidelity needed for a pilot effort, internal test campaign, or customer-facing technical engagement. 
  • Supporting integration between Hivemind and flight-control systems, onboard compute, sensors, payloads, radios, ground-control equipment, or simulation environments. 
  • Helping a test team define practical readiness criteria, test coverage, data-review expectations, and evidence standards for hardware-based autonomy validation. 
  • Working with engineering and operations leaders to turn lessons from field or lab execution into reusable guidance, training, and better test practices.

• 10+ years of experience in UxS or UAS systems integration, robotics hardware integration, autonomy test operations, flight test, field engineering, embedded systems, or similar hands-on technical roles. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex integration efforts across hardware, software, autonomy, networking, communications, sensors, and operational test environments. 
  • Strong practical experience bringing up, configuring, operating, and troubleshooting unmanned systems, onboard compute, flight controllers, radios, sensors, ground stations, and supporting test equipment. 
  • Working knowledge of Linux, embedded systems, networking, system configuration, data collection, logs, services, and field diagnostics. 
  • Experience with unmanned-systems autopilot or flight-control ecosystems such as PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, Pixhawk/Cube-class flight controllers, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or equivalent systems. 
  • Experience supporting testing across simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, field, or flight-test environments. 
  • Ability to develop and communicate test plans, readiness criteria, operating assumptions, technical recommendations, and post-test findings for cross-functional audiences. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills across ambiguous, cross-disciplinary technical issues. 
  • Ability to lead through influence across engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Familiarity with scripting, automation, or data-analysis workflows using Python, Bash, MATLAB, or similar tools. 
  • Strong ownership, urgency, and judgment in fast-moving environments where requirements, platforms, and constraints may evolve quickly. 
  • Ability to comply with export-control, safety, security, customer-site, and mission-specific operating requirements. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

• Experience with Hivemind, autonomy SDKs, autonomous aircraft systems, robotics middleware, simulation infrastructure, or edge-deployed autonomy software. 
  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson, embedded Linux, systemd services, containerized deployment, device provisioning, and field update workflows. 
  • Experience with RF/radio setup, mesh networking, tactical datalinks, software-defined radios, or communications-degraded test scenarios. 
  • Experience supporting flight test, range operations, customer trials, operational rehearsals, or complex demonstrations. 
  • Experience integrating EO/IR cameras, gimbals, lidar, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, payloads, or perception sensors. 
  • Experience contributing to test automation, regression frameworks, data validation, performance benchmarking, or CI/CD-integrated test workflows. 
  • Familiarity with C++ for debugging, interface review, or collaboration with software engineering teams. 
  • FAA Part 107, private pilot license, military UAS, aviation maintenance, flight-test, or range-safety experience. 
  • Experience defining reference configurations, hardware baselines, supported configurations, or setup guidance for internal and external users. 
  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

Job Description:
The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO’s vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. Individuals within this team make direct and at times forward-sprinting contributions to all three pillars of Hivemind, Shield AI’s software ecosystem for developing and deploying resilient intelligent teaming for aircrafts. Hivemind consists of four products: EdgeOS (C++ based high-performance middleware for autonomy development), Pilot (autonomy for the edge built atop EdgeOS; a models-based, modular and open architecture C++ codebase), Forge (Shield AI's AI Factory for the design, development, and testing of Hivemind Edge systems; a service-oriented architecture leveraged through an SDK, CLI, and web portal; a Go, Python, Typescript codebase), Commander (Software and hardware to support rich human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interactions with the Hivemind; a C++-based back-end for interaction with Pilot; and a web-application UI for mission planning, command and control by operators implemented in a Typescript/React codebase).
The Special Projects team is chartered to operate effectively within ambiguity. While this team does not own any software products, it tactically and strategically impacts the development of all foundational Hivemind products and leverages those technologies to rapidly deliver low-TRL solutions. This work happens shoulder-to-shoulder with the product teams in some cases, and in a forward-sprinting manner within the Special Projects team in other cases. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.

In this high-ownership, high visibility role you will lead a team of engineers developing mechanical systems to support Shield AI’s next generation aircraft program(s). 
 
You will work the director of engineering in a deputy capacity to support collaboration across engineering sites, align technical leaders, create mentorship opportunities for junior engineers, and assist in leveling engineering resources across vehicles and programs. 
 
You will set the bar for excellence through technical demonstration, guidance, and mentorship.

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Manager of Actuated Systems to lead an aircraft mechanical systems team for our groundbreaking jet-engine VTOL military UAV platform, X-BAT. You will manage a team of engineers designing and integrating flight- and mission-critical mechanisms such as doors, uplocks/downlocks, landing gear, folding/packaging mechanisms, flight-control actuation integration, and propulsion/nozzle actuation mechanisms. You will support your team in making key architectural decisions, by being a key technical resource, and by being a strong leader of great engineers.
 
Projects that you might work on:
X-BAT Doors, FCAS, Landing Gear, Up/Down Locks

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a team of high talent mechanical engineers, from new grad to Principal, focused on aircraft mechanisms and actuation systems (architecture, detailed design, analysis support, release, and sustaining).
  • Support your team as a technical resource for end-to-end design of mechanisms including (as applicable):
  • Doors & latching
  • Uplocks / Downlocks
  • Landing gear mechanisms
  • Actuation integration for flight controls
  • Nozzle / propulsion actuation mechanisms
  • Actuation, Hydraulics
  • Set the quality bar for mechanisms engineering: what “good” looks like in sizing, tolerances, margins, drawings/MBD, materials/process selection, and verification evidence.
  • Enable extreme ownership by ensuring engineers have clear goals, interfaces, resources, and decision rights
  • Drive effective cross-functional collaboration (systems, structures/loads, aero, propulsion, GNC, avionics, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, test, flight test) by fostering excelling communication across interfaces.
  • Coach and develop engineers through technical mentorship, career development, feedback, hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Manage team workload across multiple builds and test campaigns; communicate risk, staffing needs, and schedule impacts with transparency.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years experience with aerospace mechanisms and actuated system design, build, integration, test and flight.
  • 2+ years leading teams or performing in a team leadership role.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams with high autonomy—setting direction, ensuring quality, and scaling output through people.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: kinematics, statics/dynamics, fatigue/wear, tolerancing/GD&T, materials and finishes, lubrication/bearings, failure modes.
  • Experience shipping hardware through prototype build, test, iteration, and release, including supplier and manufacturing engagement.

• Experience with environmental and operational robustness (vibration/shock, thermal extremes, contamination, corrosion, sand/dust, etc.).
  • Experience supporting ground test and flight test campaigns and mechanism failure investigations.
  • Familiarity with reliability and safety methods (DFMEA/FTA, fault containment, safe-state thinking) in collaboration with systems safety.
  • Experience building supplier relationships for machined parts, actuation systems, mechanisms assemblies, understanding of special processes and inspection/acceptance strategies.

Job Description:

This Engineering Technician will support XBAT prototype ground testing and flight testing. This hands-on role will work closely with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, and Design Engineering to verify hardware quality, identify and investigate issues, and ensure prototype configurations and test articles meet defined requirements.

lists.content:
• Perform in-process, final, pre-test, and post-test inspections of XBAT prototype hardware.
  • Inspect mechanical, electrical, structural, composite, and electromechanical assemblies using appropriate measurement equipment.
  • Verify hardware configuration, workmanship, dimensions, torque, installation, and traceability against engineering requirements.
  • Support ground and flight test readiness by verifying required inspections and documentation are complete.
  • Inspect and document hardware condition following testing, including damage, failures, and abnormal conditions.
  • Collect objective evidence such as measurements, photographs, and inspection results to support engineering investigations.
  • Identify, document, and contain nonconformances; support MRB, root-cause investigations, and corrective actions.
  • Work directly with Quality, Manufacturing, Test, and Design Engineering to resolve prototype quality issues.
  • Support development and improvement of inspection plans, checklists, acceptance criteria, and quality processes.
  • Maintain accurate inspection, configuration, and quality records for serialized prototype hardware.
  • Identify recurring issues and provide feedback to engineering and manufacturing teams to improve product and process quality.

• 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, aviation, or a related technical field.
  • Experience supporting prototype development or flight testing.
  • Experience with hands-on inspection, testing, manufacturing, or troubleshooting of complex aerospace hardware.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and work instructions.

• Experience with UAVs, aircraft, flight hardware, or aerospace structures.
  • Experience with GD&T, composites, electrical systems, or electromechanical assemblies.
  • Experience with nonconformance, MRB, RCCA, or failure investigation.
  • Familiarity with AS9100.

Shield AI is on a mission to build the world’s best aircraft—and we’re looking for a Harness Design Engineer to help power that vision. In this high-impact, high-ownership role, you’ll be designing complex wire harnesses and cable assemblies that are the nervous system of X-BAT, our next-generation autonomous UAV platform.

lists.content:
• Design wire harnesses and cable assemblies for X-BAT and supporting ground equipment
  • Collaborate with electrical engineering to define connector selection, current/voltage requirements, shielding, and other design aspects

  • Prototype and test harnesses in dynamic, mission-critical environments 
  • Collaborate with avionics, systems, supply chain, and manufacturing teams for integration 
  • Lead technicians in building, testing, and debugging various parts of the EWIS system

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering 
  • 0-2 years working with wire harness designs for automotive, aerospace, or robotics. Professional, personal, or club experience is acceptable
  • 3D CAD modeling tool experience, such as NX or CATIA
  • Knowledge of GD&T best practices, tolerance stack-ups, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards 
  • Experience with electrical schematics and connector selection 
  • Hands-on experience with harness fabrication or testing 
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, cross-functional teams  
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an FAA Regulatory Operations & Program Coordinator to establish and manage the administrative processes that support FAA authorizations across the company. This full-time individual contributor will create enterprise visibility into aircraft registrations, authorizations, applications, operating limitations, renewals, and future regulatory needs while coordinating work across V-BAT, Hivemind, X-BAT, and supporting teams.

You will work closely with Airworthiness, Safety, Flight Operations, Engineering, Legal, Government Relations, and program teams to organize submission schedules, maintain regulatory records, and keep actions moving to closure. This is a regulatory operations and program coordination role; designated subject matter experts will retain responsibility for technical analyses, compliance determinations, and approval of technical content. The ideal candidate can build structure across multiple programs, work accurately with regulated records, and communicate effectively with internal teams, test sites, and government stakeholders.

lists.content:
• Establish and manage an enterprise FAA regulatory operations process covering FAA DroneZone, aircraft registrations and N-numbers, COA and airspace authorization activities, waiver submissions, and other applicable FAA systems.
  • Maintain a single authoritative tracker for active authorizations, pending applications, operating limitations, account ownership, expiration and renewal dates, dependencies, decisions, and anticipated needs.
  • Coordinate the intake, prioritization, schedule, development, review, submission, and follow-up of FAA-related packages across V-BAT, Hivemind, X-BAT, and supporting organizations; collect subject matter expert inputs and confirm completeness, version control, and approval status before authorized submission.
  • Manage procedural correspondence, submission status, records, and administrative coordination with the FAA, UAS test sites, and other authorization stakeholders; route technical questions to the appropriate experts.
  • Lead recurring cross-program regulatory status and planning reviews, document decisions and actions, and escalate schedule risks, unresolved dependencies, and approaching expirations.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams using integrated schedules, action and decision logs, dependency tracking, controlled records, and concise status reporting.
  • Working knowledge of FAA aviation or UAS authorization processes and the judgment to distinguish administrative coordination from technical and regulatory decision authority.
  • Strong professional and technical writing skills, with the ability to organize complex subject matter expert inputs into accurate, review-ready packages.
  • Strong cross-functional communication, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with proficiency in Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and project-tracking or document-management tools.

• Direct experience with FAA DroneZone, FAA aircraft registration, COAs or airspace authorizations, Part 107 waivers, or experimental certification support.
  • Experience supporting UAS, autonomous aircraft, defense aviation, or developmental flight-test programs.
  • Previous administrative or programmatic interaction with the FAA, UAS test sites, Department of Defense organizations, or other aviation authorities.
  • Familiarity with Section 927, 44807 and SAC-EC waivers, BVLOS, higher-altitude, one-to-many, or large-UAS approval pathways.[D(1] 
  • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, CAPM or PMP certification, or comparable regulatory or project-management training.
  • Experience building scalable workflows, dashboards, and automated tracking for a growing organization in a regulated environment.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements such as demos, technical briefings, proposal support, integration discussions, technical interchange meetings, or operational workshops.
  • Experience supporting international defense, security, aerospace, government, or advanced technology customers.
  • Ability to translate customer mission needs into technically feasible solution concepts, requirements, demos, and product feedback.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Engagement, and Program teams.
  • Strong judgment in representing product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap dependencies to customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with customers and internal stakeholders through technical credibility, responsiveness, and clear communication.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally for customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, and internal meetings.
  • Professional fluency in Polish and English

• Direct experience supporting defense, security, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, or advanced technology customers in Europe, NATO, Africa, or allied international markets.

  • Experience with autonomous aircraft, unmanned systems, robotic systems, AI-enabled mission systems, or defense software platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, C++, Linux, APIs, SDKs, autonomy software, robotics middleware, or technical prototyping.
  • Familiarity with autonomy development workflows, mission planning, system integration, operational evaluation, or customer demonstration planning.
  • Experience supporting proposals, RFIs, RFPs, white papers, technical volumes, or complex capture activities.
  • Experience working across varied customer cultures, acquisition processes, operational concepts, and partner ecosystems.

The Flight Ops Technician III is a senior, hands-on technical role supporting the development, testing, and operation of unmanned aircraft systems in Ukraine. The role bridges aircraft prototyping, hardware integration, HIL/ground testing, aircraft maintenance, and field flight operations, working closely with hardware, software, autonomy, and flight-test teams.

The technician will build and modify prototype aircraft, integrate avionics and electrical systems, fabricate parts using 3D printing and other rapid-prototyping methods, and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level issues. They will also build, maintain, and troubleshoot HIL rigs and related test infrastructure, help establish and maintain a local prototyping and flight-operations lab, and support aircraft readiness and field testing.

This role is best suited for a versatile, self-sufficient senior technician who can move seamlessly between the lab, aircraft, HIL environment, and flight-test site—rapidly solving problems and helping engineering teams get systems ready for test and flight.
Flight Ops Technician III.

lists.content:
• Build, modify, assemble, maintain, and repair prototype unmanned aircraft and related test systems.
  • Install and integrate avionics, sensors, compute hardware, radios, antennas, payloads, wiring, and other experimental hardware.
  • Fabricate prototype and replacement components using 3D printing, hand and power tools, and other rapid-prototyping methods.
  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot wiring harnesses, connectors, electrical assemblies, and aircraft electrical systems.
  • Build, wire, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot HIL rigs, test fixtures, and related engineering test infrastructure.
  • Integrate flight computers, avionics, sensors, actuators, communications equipment, and other aircraft hardware into HIL and bench-test environments.
  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, avionics, communications, networking, and system-level issues across aircraft and test equipment.
  • Support SIL, HIL, VIL, bench, ground, and live-flight testing, including aircraft functional checks and troubleshooting.
  • Perform aircraft inspections, maintenance, repairs, configuration changes, and pre- and post-flight activities.
  • Help establish and maintain a local prototyping and flight-operations lab, including tools, test equipment, fabrication equipment, spares, batteries, and support equipment.
  • Support flight operations, including aircraft setup, launch and recovery, test-site setup and teardown, and preparation of equipment for field deployments.
  • Maintain aircraft, test-system, maintenance, configuration, inventory, and other technical documentation.
  • Work closely with hardware, software, autonomy, and flight-test engineers to rapidly diagnose problems, implement modifications, and improve test capabilities.
  • Transport personnel and equipment to test sites and travel within Ukraine to support testing, demonstrations, and operations.
  • Mentor less-experienced technicians and maintain high standards for workmanship, configuration control, organization, and safety.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in UAS, aviation, aerospace, robotics, electronics, manufacturing, test support, or a related technical field.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with experience building, modifying, maintaining, or repairing complex electromechanical systems.
  • Experience integrating hardware into aircraft, robotics, prototypes, test systems, or comparable platforms.
  • Hands-on electrical experience, including wiring, connectors, soldering, crimping, cable fabrication, and electrical troubleshooting.
  • Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting HIL rigs, test stands, test fixtures, or similar hardware/software integration environments.
  • Ability to read and work from mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and engineering documentation
  • Experience with rapid prototyping, fabrication, and iterative hardware development.
  • Ability to systematically troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level problems.
  • Experience using common mechanical and electrical tools and test equipment.
  • Experience supporting engineering, ground, flight, or field testing.
  • Strong attention to detail, workmanship, safety, and configuration control.
  • Ability to work independently and solve technical problems in fast-moving workshop, laboratory, flight-line, and field environments.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to transport equipment and personnel to operational sites.
  • Ability to travel within Ukraine as required.

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in UAS, aviation, aerospace, robotics, electronics, manufacturing, test support, or a related technical field.
* Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with experience building, modifying, maintaining, or repairing complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience integrating hardware into aircraft, robotics, prototypes, test systems, or comparable platforms.
* Hands-on electrical experience, including wiring, connectors, soldering, crimping, cable fabrication, and electrical troubleshooting.
* Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting HIL rigs, test stands, test fixtures, or similar hardware/software integration environments.
* Ability to read and work from mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and engineering documentation.
* Experience with rapid prototyping, fabrication, and iterative hardware development.
* Ability to systematically troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level problems.
* Experience using common mechanical and electrical tools and test equipment.
* Experience supporting engineering, ground, flight, or field testing.
* Strong attention to detail, workmanship, safety, and configuration control.
* Ability to work independently and solve technical problems in fast-moving workshop, laboratory, flight-line, and field environments.
* Valid driver's license and ability to transport equipment and personnel to operational sites.
* Ability to travel within Ukraine as required.

* Experience maintaining or integrating fixed-wing and multirotor UAS.
* Experience with autonomous or experimental aircraft and Group 1 or Group 2 UAS.
* Experience building or maintaining HIL environments for aircraft, robotics, or autonomous systems.
* Experience with 3D printing, CAD, and prototype part fabrication.
* Experience integrating avionics, flight computers, sensors, actuators, radios, antennas, or payload systems.
* Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or similar flight-control systems.
* Familiarity with Ground Control Stations, telemetry, RF systems, datalinks, and networking.
* Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, scripting, or basic software troubleshooting.
* Experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, or similar electrical test equipment.
* Experience establishing or maintaining an engineering lab, prototype shop, HIL lab, or flight-operations facility.
* Background in defense, aerospace, robotics, aircraft maintenance, manufacturing, or flight test.
* Experience working in austere or rapidly changing field environments.
* Ukrainian and English language proficiency.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an highly motivated and experienced Flight Test Engineer to develop, plan, execute, and analyze ground and flight test operations for a fast-paced next gen aircraft system. You will work closely across several segment owners of engineering, operations, autonomy, systems integration, product support, manufacturing, and customers.

lists.content:
• Develop, publish, and execute comprehensive flight test plans, procedures, cards, risk assessments, safety, and readiness reviews
  • Support integration and test of aircraft systems, payloads, comms/data links, software, ground control systems, and mission equipment
  • Lead and coordinate pre-flight, flight, and post-flight activities, including system configuration, instrumentation, telemetry, data collection and test reports
  • Analyze ground and flight test data to identify performance trends, anomalies, root causes, and corrective actions
  • Coordinate with engineering teams to validate requirements, troubleshoot issues, and mature system capabilities
  • Lead or participate in test range operations, safety briefings, go/no-go decisions, and test setup and logistics
  • Document test results, lessons learned, anomalies, and recommendations in clear technical reports
  • Support aircraft maintenance, configuration control, and system readiness
  • Create and improve flight test processes, tools, data workflows, and operational efficiency
  • Create and maintain ground and air operating limitations requirements
  • Travel to test sites, customer locations, and field exercises as required

• Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM Degree)
  • 5+ years of experience with developmental and/or operational ground and flight test, unmanned/manned aircraft systems, aircraft integration, or aerospace systems engineering
  • Strong understanding of aircraft systems, flight dynamics, avionics, telemetry, sensors, or control systems
  • Proven ability to write and execute structured test plans, procedures, and reports
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in field and/or lab environments
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across engineering and operations teams
  • Willingness to travel and work outdoors, fields, or test range environments
  • Overtime and weekend coverage as required
  • U.S. Citizenship Only with In-Scope active Secret clearance required to start

• 8+ years of experience with developmental and/or operational ground and flight test, unmanned aircraft systems, aircraft integration, or aerospace systems engineering
  • Experience in Group 4-5 UAS and/or fighter type capability or similar weapons systems
  • Familiarity with FAA, DoW, and test range flight operations
  • Experience with autonomy, navigation, mission planning, and Command-and-Control (C2) systems
  • Hands-on experience with aircraft maintenance, avionics integration, payload integration, and ground support equipment
  • Experience with telemetry systems, flight and data logs, sensor data, datalinks, and RF systems
  • Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate or crewed aviation experience
  • Proven Mission Control Room experience using Integrated Analysis & Data System (IADS) or similar development FTI display system
  • Experience leading or supporting developmental flight test campaigns from design through planning and execution to include reporting

The ideal candidate is practical, detail-oriented engineer who is comfortable in control rooms, hangar/maintenance areas, solving complex problems, taking ownership, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering concept environments. You can write a detailed test plan, troubleshoot hardware and software at a test site, analyze flight data, and communicate clearly under operational pressure. You are safety-minded, have high technical acumen, and motivated by building and validating advanced and complex aircraft systems to field to the operators quickly.

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a highly capable Flight Test Instrumentation Engineer to support the development, integration, and execution of instrumentation systems for X-BAT, the world’s first autonomous VTOL jet aircraft. In this role, you will design, install, validate, and maintain data acquisition systems essential to aircraft-level testing, safety, and mission success. 
 
The Flight Test Instrumentation Engineer is responsible for ensuring high-quality, reliable data capture across propulsion, structural, avionics, and autonomy systems. This engineer works closely with Flight Test, Systems Engineering, Avionics, Autonomy, and Safety teams to ensure instrumentation supports rigorous test objectives and enables rapid, data-driven iteration. 
 
This is a hands-on, field-focused role that requires strong technical depth, disciplined execution, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic test environment.

lists.content:
• Design, integrate, and maintain flight test instrumentation systems including sensors, data acquisition hardware, telemetry links, harnessing, and ground station interfaces. 
  • Develop instrumentation architecture, sensor selection plans, wiring diagrams, and installation documentation in accordance with engineering standards. 
  • Support installation and calibration of sensors such as strain gauges, accelerometers, pressure transducers, temperature sensors, current/voltage taps, and position measurement devices. 
  • Configure and validate data acquisition systems including signal conditioning, synchronization, sampling rates, and data integrity verification. 
  • Perform pre-flight and post-flight data checks, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and traceability of all captured data.  
  • Troubleshoot instrumentation issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions under tight test timelines.
  • Collaborate with Flight Test teams to define instrumentation requirements, test plans, and safety considerations. 
  • Manage instrumentation inventories, spares, tools, and calibration records 
  • Support field deployments, remote test campaigns, and static engine/hover test operations. 
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of instrumentation processes and documentation.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical field.  
  • 10-15+ years of experience in flight test instrumentation, data acquisition systems, or related hardware integration roles.  
  • Hands-on experience installing and configuring sensors, DAQs, wiring harnesses, and telemetry systems.  
  • Strong understanding of instrumentation standards, signal conditioning, sampling theory, and data synchronization.   
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, and system architectures.  
  • Proficiency with instrumentation tools and software (e.g., NI, Dewesoft, HBM, ICS, telemetry systems).  
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to operate in a fast-paced test environment.  
  • Excellent communication and documentation capabilities.  
  • Ability to support extended travel and remote test deployments as required.

• Experience with developmental aircraft, flight test environments, or experimental test programs. 
  • Familiarity with IRIG time standards, PCM, Ethernet-based DAQ systems, and avionics data buses (ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, CAN, Ethernet). 
  • Familiarity with Curtis Wright DAS Studio and IADS software. 
  • Experience applying strain gauges, thermal instrumentation, or structural measurement sensors. 
  • Background in propulsion or structural testing, including engine run and hover test instrumentation. 
  • Experience with environmental sealing, harness fabrication standards, and EMI/EMC considerations. 
  • Master’s degree or higher in a related technical discipline.

The Forward Deployed Engineer, Operations & Sustainment is a highly technical, customer-facing role focused on deploying, supporting, and sustaining Hivemind products in real operating environments. This role bridges field deployment, customer operations, technical troubleshooting, training, and sustainment. 

This is a travel-intensive role. Candidates must be willing and able to travel at least 50% of the time, including frequent domestic and international trips, customer-site work, test events, training events, and multi-week deployments as program needs require. 

In this role, you will work directly with customers and internal teams to install, configure, validate, train, troubleshoot, and support Hivemind products. The role requires strong technical judgment, clear customer communication, comfort operating under field pressure, and the discipline to turn field lessons into durable support artifacts: runbooks, supported baselines, evidence packages, known-issue records, escalation paths, customer-safe updates, and product feedback.

lists.content:
• Deploy with customers on site globally, with an expectation of up to 50% travel, to support installation, configuration, validation, training, troubleshooting, and sustainment of Hivemind products. 
  • Become an expert user of the Hivemind Enterprise software stack, autonomy modules, deployment tooling, supported configurations, and diagnostic workflows. 
  • Execute and improve deployment runbooks covering software install, version/configuration validation, licensing or provisioning status, pre-mission checks, log readiness, and acceptance steps. 
  • Provide hands-on technical support to customer operators, maintainers, partners, and internal field teams during deployment, test, training, demonstration, and sustainment windows. 
  • Capture and organize field evidence for triage, including logs, telemetry, recorded data, screenshots, version/configuration state, asset context, operator notes, mission phase, and environmental constraints. 
  • Drive issues through the support flow: intake, severity assessment, ownership, workaround or fix delivery, customer-safe status, closure, and learning loop. 
  • Convert recurring field issues, workarounds, customer questions, and training gaps into support tickets, knowledge-base content, known-issue records, runbooks, and product feedback. 
  • Partner with engineering, product, program, sustainment, licensing, safety, legal, commercial, and support teams to route issues to the right owner for seamless customer support.Support root-cause investigation and corrective-action validation by reproducing issues, collecting field context, testing updates, and confirming fixes or workarounds. 
  • Support Field Service Representative-style obligations when required by contract, including on-site support posture, issue intake, operator assistance, troubleshooting, documentation, escalation, and evidence capture.

• Deploying Hivemind software and autonomy capabilities during customer integration events, exercises, test campaigns, demonstrations, or operational support windows. 
  • Building deployment-to-sustainment handoff packages with supported baselines, configuration checklists, evidence checklists, known issues, escalation contacts, and training material. 
  • Standing up a repeatable support flow so field issues move from informal chats and ad hoc engineering asks into a durable support hub, severity model, owner route, and closure loop. 
  • Troubleshooting field behavior across software, autonomy, networking, telemetry, configuration, sensors, operator workflows, and customer environment constraints. 
  • Creating customer-safe documentation that helps operators and maintainers self-serve routine issues while preserving the right escalation path for mission-critical problems.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience in field engineering, forward-deployed engineering, applications engineering, systems integration, flight test, robotics support, unmanned systems operations, technical operations, customer deployment, or a similar hands-on technical role. 
  • Strong technical background in software engineering, systems integration, or autonomy-adjacent systems. 
  • Proficiency writing, reading, and debugging modern C++ code. 
  • Working proficiency with Python, Bash, or similar scripting for diagnostics, automation, data handling, and field support workflows. 
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux or embedded systems, networking, configuration management, logs, telemetry, release packages, sensors or payloads, and operator workflows. 
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, training, expectation-management, and escalation skills in customer-facing environments. 
  • Ability to write clear field notes, deployment records, troubleshooting guides, evidence packages, and support updates that engineering and support teams can act on. 
  • Willingness and ability to travel at least 50% of the time, including frequent domestic and international travel and multi-week deployments. 
  • Ability to operate professionally in lab, flight-test, range, customer-site, and field environments under time pressure. 
  • Ability to comply with export-control, security, safety, sensitive-data, customer-site, and mission-specific operating requirements.

• Experience with autonomy, robotics, defense aviation, unmanned aircraft, deployed defense systems, flight test, payload integration, sensors, operator systems, or edge compute environments. 
  • Experience supporting defense, government, allied, or international customers in operational, test, training, or overseas environments. 
  • Experience building or scaling a support, field-service, customer-success, sustainment, or applications-engineering function during an early product rollout. 
  • Experience with enterprise software deployment, customer support, licensing, provisioning, release management, configuration baselines, or offline/air-gapped operating environments. 
  • Hands-on experience with recorded-data analysis, diagnostic tooling, telemetry review, networking tools, system health checks, or support automation.

descriptionBody:
Job Description:

Shield AI builds intelligent systems that protect service members and civilians. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software and V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and our teams support customers and operations across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. 

The Forward Deployed Engineer, Operations & Sustainment is a highly technical, customer-facing role focused on deploying, supporting, and sustaining Hivemind products in real operating environments. This role bridges field deployment, customer operations, technical troubleshooting, training, and sustainment. 

This is a travel-intensive role. Candidates must be willing and able to travel at least 50% of the time, including frequent domestic and international trips, customer-site work, test events, training events, and multi-week deployments as program needs require. 

In this role, you will work directly with customers and internal teams to install, configure, validate, train, troubleshoot, and support Hivemind products. The role requires strong technical judgment, clear customer communication, comfort operating under field pressure, and the discipline to turn field lessons into durable support artifacts: runbooks, supported baselines, evidence packages, known-issue records, escalation paths, customer-safe updates, and product feedback.

lists.content:

Shield AI People Experience is seeking a highly organized and service-oriented Global Mobility Specialist to support the day-to-day execution and administration of our global mobility program. Reporting to and working closely with the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager, this role will help coordinate employee relocations, international assignments, immigration activities, and related mobility services.

The Global Mobility Specialist will be responsible for keeping mobility cases moving, coordinating across employees, internal teams, and external vendors, maintaining accurate records and timelines, and providing employees with a high-quality mobility experience.

This is an execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys managing details, solving operational issues, and supporting employees through complex transitions while partnering closely with a senior program leader.

lists.content:
Mobility Operations & Case Management

  • Support the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager with the day-to-day administration and execution of the global mobility program.
  • Coordinate domestic and international relocations, expatriate assignments, transfers, repatriations, and other mobility cases from initiation through completion.
  • Manage routine mobility cases and escalate complex, sensitive, or policy-related matters to the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager.
  • Track case milestones, required documentation, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding actions.
  • Coordinate relocation logistics, including temporary housing, household goods, destination services, travel, and other applicable benefits.
  • Support assignment extensions, changes, repatriations, and assignment closeout activities.

    • Immigration Coordination Support

  • Help coordinate with immigration counsel and employees on visa and work authorization processes.
  • Collect and organize employee and company documentation required for immigration filings.
  • Track immigration case status, visa and work authorization expiration dates, and other critical deadlines.
  • Follow up with employees, internal stakeholders, and immigration partners to keep cases progressing as needed.
  • Escalate potential immigration or compliance risks to the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager and appropriate internal partners.

    • Employee Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for employees participating in relocation or international assignment programs.
  • Guide employees through mobility processes, timelines, documentation requirements, benefits, and available resources.
  • Respond to routine questions related to relocation, immigration, reimbursements, and assignment logistics.
  • Provide timely and thoughtful communication throughout the employee’s mobility journey.
  • Identify employee issues or exceptions requiring additional guidance and partner with the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager on resolution.

    • Vendor & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day activities with relocation providers, immigration counsel, tax advisors, and other mobility partners.
  • Partner with People/HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Security, and other internal teams to support mobility cases.
  • Monitor vendor deliverables and follow up on open items and service issues.
  • Assist with reviewing mobility-related invoices and expenses for accuracy and alignment with program guidelines.

    • Program Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate mobility case records, employee data, documentation, and trackers.
  • Monitor important dates, case status, costs, and program activity.
  • Prepare recurring reports and provide program data to the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager.
  • Support mobility-related audits, reconciliations, and compliance activities.
  • Maintain employee resources, process documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities to streamline or improve mobility processes.
  • Support implementation of new mobility processes, tools, policies, and vendor programs led by the Senior Global Mobility Program Manager.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 2–4+ years of experience in Global Mobility, immigration, relocation, HR operations, or a related field.
  • Experience coordinating multiple employee cases, projects, or workflows simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a service-oriented approach.
  • Ability to manage deadlines, follow up proactively, and keep multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting domestic and international employee mobility.
  • Familiarity with expatriate assignments, relocations, immigration processes, and mobility benefits.
  • Experience working with immigration counsel, relocation management companies, tax providers, or other mobility vendors.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, case management, or global mobility platforms.
  • Experience supporting a global mobility program within a rapidly growing organization.

This role is ideal for engineers with a strong foundation in real-time, performance-sensitive software who also bring experience with modern web technologies.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and optimize ground control software that enables low-latency communication with UAVs and other autonomous platforms. 
  • Build high-performance client and server applications that support telemetry processing, mission planning, and real-time control. 
  • Implement responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript for operator workflows and visualization of spatial data, sensor feeds, and mission state. 
  • Collaborate closely with teams across autonomy, embedded systems, backend, and UX to deliver integrated, field-ready solutions. 
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and system designs that ensure responsiveness, scalability, and fault-tolerance. 
  • Lead development efforts on key features or subsystems, from early design through deployment and iteration. 
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate in peer design/code reviews.

• Senior: Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 4+ years, or PhD with 2+ years.
  • Staff: Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 6+ years, or PhD with 4+ years.
  • Senior Staff: Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 9+ years, or PhD with 7+ years.
  • Demonstrated experience building real-time or performance-sensitive applications—preferably for UAVs, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or simulation environments. 
  • Proficiency in a strongly typed programming language (e.g. C#, TypeScript, Java, C++) with exposure to lower-level systems or protocol integration.
