lists.content:
• Lead and Grow the Team – Manage a team of autonomy engineers, typically 5–10 people. Own performance, growth, leveling, engagement, and delivery while providing regular coaching, feedback, and technical mentorship. 

  • Build the Team – Identify the skills needed within your area, partner closely with recruiting, conduct interviews, maintain a high hiring bar, and help close and onboard strong candidates. 

  • Own Technical Delivery – Lead autonomy capabilities from initial design through integration, validation, and field deployment. Translate program objectives into clear technical priorities, execution plans, and ownership across the team. 

  • Set Technical Direction – Define technical approaches and architectures for mission autonomy, balancing reuse of existing Shield AI capabilities with new development required for specific platforms and missions. 

  • Develop Tactical Autonomy – Guide the development of motion planning, tactical behaviors, multi-agent coordination, track fusion, perception-aware decision-making, and weapons- or sensor-target assignment for platforms operating in complex and communications-constrained environments. 

  • Remain Technically Engaged – Stay close to the code and contribute directly where it provides the most value, including prototyping capabilities, reviewing critical designs, investigating difficult problems, and supporting key delivery milestones. This is a manager role, not a managing-only role. 

  • Drive Engineering and Integration Rigor – Ensure the team develops high-performance, well-tested software with clear interfaces and the reliability required for operational deployment. Lead design reviews and strengthen development, testing, and integration practices. 

  • Navigate Ambiguity and Changing Priorities – Make sound technical, staffing, and sequencing decisions when requirements are incomplete or program priorities shift. Communicate changes clearly and protect the team’s ability to execute. 

  • Partner Across Teams and With Customers – Collaborate with Perception, Platform Integration, Simulation, Hardware, Flight Test, and Program teams, as well as U.S. and international defense customers, to shape requirements, resolve technical tradeoffs, and successfully integrate autonomy onto real-world platforms. 

  • Lead Testing and Continuous Improvement – Own validation across software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and live test environments. Use mission data and test results to diagnose failures, improve capabilities, and inform the team’s technical roadmap. 

  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel approximately 10–15% of the year to other Shield AI offices, customer sites, integration events, flight tests, and demonstrations.

• BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience; or 5 years with a master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Experience leading and developing engineers as a people manager, team lead, feature lead, or similar technical leadership role, including mentoring, providing feedback, and coordinating team delivery. 

  • Track record of leading a technical team or major capability from initial design through integration, validation, and field delivery. 

  • Significant experience with robotics or autonomous systems, including areas such as motion planning, tactical behaviors, decision-making, controls, or multi-agent coordination. 

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with experience developing production-quality software for real-time, robotics, or autonomy systems. 

  • Experience with unmanned systems, autonomy simulation environments, and software- or hardware-in-the-loop testing. 

  • Strong systems-level problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. SECRET security clearance.

• Direct people-management experience, including responsibility for performance management, hiring, feedback, and employee development. 

  • Experience developing tactical autonomy for weapons, strike, collaborative combat aircraft, launched effects, or related defense applications. 

  • Experience with multi-agent coordination, distributed decision-making, trajectory optimization, track fusion, or weapons- and sensor-target assignment. 

  • Hands-on experience integrating autonomy onto unmanned platforms and supporting flight tests, demonstrations, or field exercises. 

  • Experience developing capabilities for disconnected, communications-denied, or air-gapped environments. 

  • Experience authoring interface-control documents or working with UCI, OMS, or similar defense interoperability standards. 

  • Experience partnering directly with DoD or international defense customers.

lists.content:

  • Serve as an escalation point and trusted technical leader for customers using Hivemind in real-world environments 
  • Translate customer goals, mission needs, and program objectives into clear technical milestones, execution plans, and team priorities 
  • Drive accountability across the team for achieving intended customer outcomes during active engagements 
  • Guide the team through debugging and resolution of complex software and integration issues 
  • Partner with customer teams and internal stakeholders to remove blockers, improve time-to-value, and sustain adoption 
  • Build mechanisms to collect, synthesize, and communicate recurring customer pain points, product gaps, and field insights to internal teams 
  • Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and prioritization discussions 
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve product quality, usability, deployment readiness, and repeatable field execution

• You enjoy leading technical teams while staying close to customers and field execution

  • You can translate ambiguous customer needs into structured technical plans, team priorities, and measurable outcomes 
  • You are comfortable making decisions, removing blockers, and helping a team drive progress under pressure

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical leadership role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applications engineering, or customer engineering 
  • Strong technical background in software engineering, including the ability to review and debug complex systems and guide technical tradeoffs 
  • Strong proficiency with modern C++ and experience with Python in a professional setting 
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, coaching, and people leadership skills 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with sound judgment under pressure  
  • Ability to travel up to 30%

• Experience working in a startup environment 
  • Experience managing or leading teams in the defense, robotics, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry 
  • Experience building or scaling a forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applications engineering, or customer engineering function 
  • Experience gathering field feedback, influencing product direction based on customer needs, and establishing repeatable customer success playbooks

• Help build the defining defence technology company of this century.  
  • Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems.  
  • Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission-driven environment.  
  • Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships.

Job Description:
Are you a passionate and innovative engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art AI and robotics products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!
The Hivemind Integration & Test team is committed to ensuring our autonomy platform delivers a seamless developer experience and enables customers to build world-class autonomous systems. We focus on integrating, validating, and continuously improving the Hivemind ecosystem—spanning autonomy behaviors, sensor processing, multi-agent coordination, ground-control systems, and embedded platforms. Our mission is to ensure that autonomy developers can efficiently build, test, and deploy autonomous applications that meet real-world mission objectives.

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for integrating, validating, and scaling the Hivemind autonomy platform across simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and operational environments. You will serve as both a technical leader and people manager—guiding engineers in the development of robust integration and test capabilities while remaining actively engaged in hands-on system integration, validation, and customer-focused workflows.
As a power user of the Hivemind SDK, you will develop a deep understanding of its capabilities, identify gaps from a customer perspective, and drive improvements across the platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Program teams to integrate new autonomy capabilities, evaluate feature completeness, and ensure customers can efficiently build, test, and deploy mission-ready autonomous systems. This position bridges technical leadership, engineering execution, and real-world autonomy applications—ensuring our platform empowers customers to build reliable, world-class autonomous systems.

Job Description:

As Manager, Environmental Control Systems & Thermal, you will directly lead and develop a team of individual contributors responsible for environmental control systems, aircraft thermal management, and associated fluid and heat-transfer hardware on the X-BAT program, while supporting the advancement of these capabilities across Group 5 programs. You will be accountable for team execution and people development while maintaining enough technical depth to guide architecture, requirements, design, integration, test, supplier execution, and flight readiness. This position requires a balance of direct people leadership, technical judgment, and hands-on engagement when needed in a fast-moving aircraft development environment. The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering manager who can set clear priorities, grow strong engineers, create a high technical bar, and help the team deliver meaningful capability to operators quickly.

lists.content:
• People Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop individual contributors; set goals, give feedback, support growth, and build a high-trust, high-standard team.
  • Team Planning and Execution: Set priorities, ownership, staffing, and execution cadence for X-BAT and Group 5 work; remove blockers and manage dependencies.
  • Technical Direction and Review: Guide ECS and thermal architecture, trades, and design reviews across thermal environments, cooling, airflow, ducting, heat exchangers, fluid circuits, and related hardware.
  • Requirements, Risk, and Maturity: Set expectations for requirements, reviews, verification, risk management, configuration control, and design release through flight-ready hardware.
  • Vehicle Integration and Interfaces: Resolve interfaces with structures, propulsion, avionics, EWIS, payloads, manufacturing, systems engineering, and test teams.
  • Test and Flight Readiness: Lead component, qualification, ground, and flight test planning; ensure data, anomaly resolution, and corrective actions support hardware delivery.
  • Hardware and Suppliers: Set expectations for components, specifications, SOWs, supplier reviews, prototype builds, and acceptance activities.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership: Engage in first-principles analysis and root-cause investigations, coach engineers, and unblock complex technical problems.
  • Communication and Accountability: Represent the team in program and engineering reviews; communicate decisions, risks, progress, resources, and dependencies.

• Clearance required: US Citizens Only & Must have an Active Secret or higher clearance.
  • Experience: 8+ years in aerospace environmental control systems, thermal engineering, fluid systems, or comparable aircraft mechanical systems development.
  • People Leadership: Experience directly managing and developing individual contributors, including setting expectations, giving feedback, and supporting career growth.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Core Fundamentals: Deep understanding of thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and aircraft thermal management.
  • System Development Leadership: Ability to guide architecture, requirements, analysis, design, integration, and verification through hardware delivery.
  • Technical Judgment and Communication: Sound engineering judgment, early risk identification, and clear communication across technical and program teams.
  • Team Culture: Record of working hard, building trust, maintaining high standards, and treating others with kindness.

• Experience managing engineers on UAV, autonomous aircraft, fighter, tactical aircraft, or other high-performance aerospace programs.
  • Experience with Group 5 aircraft, aircraft-level thermal management, ECS, or integrated fluid and thermal systems.
  • Hands-on experience with thermal and fluid testing, instrumentation, data acquisition, model correlation, or flight-test troubleshooting.
  • Experience with first-principles analysis, fluid-thermal network modeling, CFD, or thermal-analysis tools such as FloEFD, STAR-CCM+, Thermal Desktop, Amesim, or Flowmaster.
  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental, qualification, and airworthiness practices, including MIL-STD-810, MIL-HDBK-516, RTCA DO-160, and SAE AIR or ARP standards.
  • Experience with aerospace suppliers, COTS or custom components, technical specifications, SOWs, and prototype or vehicle-level test setups.
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and scaling a small engineering team in a rapid R&D or production environment.
  • Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Infrastructure Manager to lead the team responsible for the enterprise systems and physical infrastructure supporting our engineering, manufacturing, business, and mission-critical environments. This includes compute, storage, virtualization, Windows and Linux platforms, backup and disaster recovery, core infrastructure services, PLM infrastructure, and infrastructure supporting offices, labs, manufacturing facilities, and data centers. This leader will ensure that hybrid infrastructure services remain reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally mature as Shield AI grows. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure, this role partners closely with Cloud Platform, Network, Cybersecurity, Facilities, Service Delivery, Enterprise Technology Solutions, and engineering teams. The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader with broad infrastructure judgment and a strong record of delivering resilient services. This position may be based in San Mateo, CA or the surrounding San Francisco Bay Area; San Diego, CA; Frisco, TX; or the Seattle-Tacoma, WA area.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of infrastructure engineers and systems administrators, including specialists supporting PLM and engineering infrastructure.
  • Own team capacity, resource planning, hiring priorities, workload balancing, succession planning, and development of technical leaders within the Infrastructure organization.
  • Own the Infrastructure strategy, roadmap, standards, operating model, and service portfolio across on-premises, colocation, edge, lab, manufacturing, and hybrid environments.
  • Oversee architecture, implementation, and operations for enterprise compute, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, Windows and Linux server platforms, and core infrastructure services.
  • Provide management oversight for the infrastructure supporting Teamcenter and other mission-critical engineering platforms, partnering with application owners and vendors on reliability, capacity, upgrades, and recovery.
  • Drive infrastructure modernization, automation, configuration standardization, lifecycle management, observability, and reduction of operational toil and technical debt.
  • Establish priorities, project plans, service objectives, capacity forecasts, lifecycle plans, and measurable outcomes aligned with aircraft, engineering, manufacturing, and company growth.
  • Ensure infrastructure services meet requirements for availability, performance, security, compliance, recoverability, and operational supportability.
  • Provide management oversight for site and data-center infrastructure, including rack capacity, power and cooling, equipment lifecycle, DCIM and documentation, colocation environments, and infrastructure readiness for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and acquisitions; partner closely with Facilities and Network Engineering while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.
  • Partner with Network and Cloud Platform teams on hybrid architecture, connectivity, workload placement, identity integration, and migration of shared services.
  • Lead major incidents, root-cause analysis, problem management, change governance, patching and vulnerability remediation, maintenance planning, and on-call readiness.
  • Manage hardware, software, licensing, support contracts, managed services, and professional-services vendors; contribute to budgets, forecasts, sourcing, and contract decisions.
  • Maintain architecture, configuration, recovery, lifecycle, and operational documentation; communicate service health, project status, risks, and dependencies to technical and executive stakeholders.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure or systems engineering, including 4+ years leading infrastructure engineers or systems administrators.
  • Broad experience designing and operating enterprise compute, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and Windows and Linux server environments.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, capacity planning, performance management, patching, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting data centers, colocation facilities, server rooms, labs, manufacturing environments, or other distributed infrastructure at enterprise scale.
  • Experience leading infrastructure modernization, automation, migrations, platform upgrades, and recovery testing with limited business disruption.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage production operations, incidents, changes, service health, technical debt, and geographically distributed services.
  • Strong partnership skills across Facilities, Network, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Service Delivery, application teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, performance management, delegation, and development of senior technical talent.
  • Experience managing infrastructure vendors, support agreements, professional services, budgets, forecasts, and lifecycle investment planning.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready status, risk, and decision communication.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel periodically to Shield AI locations and participate in planned after-hours work or incident response as needed.

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, manufacturing, engineering, government contracting, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure following acquisitions, site consolidations, relocations, or rapid organizational growth.
  • Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, NetApp, Cohesity, Active Directory, Entra ID, infrastructure monitoring, and configuration-management tools.
  • Experience supporting PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter or similarly complex engineering applications and their infrastructure dependencies.
  • Knowledge of CMMC, NIST 800-171, ITAR, backup immutability, disaster recovery, and controlled unclassified information environments.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or related automation practices.
  • Relevant infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, security, or IT service management certifications.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Infrastructure Manager to lead the team responsible for the enterprise systems and physical infrastructure supporting our engineering, manufacturing, business, and mission-critical environments. This includes compute, storage, virtualization, Windows and Linux platforms, backup and disaster recovery, core infrastructure services, PLM infrastructure, and infrastructure supporting offices, labs, manufacturing facilities, and data centers. This leader will ensure that hybrid infrastructure services remain reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally mature as Shield AI grows. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure, this role partners closely with Cloud Platform, Network, Cybersecurity, Facilities, Service Delivery, Enterprise Technology Solutions, and engineering teams. The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader with broad infrastructure judgment and a strong record of delivering resilient services. This position may be based in San Mateo, CA or the surrounding San Francisco Bay Area; San Diego, CA; Frisco, TX; or the Seattle-Tacoma, WA area.

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


About Shield AI
Shield AI develops AI-powered autonomy software and aircraft systems that protect service members and civilians by enabling intelligent operations in contested environments. As part of the X-BAT program, you will help develop and validate next-generation autonomous aircraft and mission-critical hardware that must perform reliably in demanding operational conditions.
Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Manager, Mechanical Engineering to lead the mechanical hardware-test team supporting X-BAT. The team develops and sustains the test stands, fixtures, tooling, support equipment, and facility interfaces used to validate mission-critical aircraft hardware across development, integration, qualification, and production.
You will be accountable for the team's people, technical direction, operating model, and delivery across a portfolio of test-equipment projects. You will translate program and verification priorities into a clear roadmap, build the capacity needed to execute it, and establish the engineering standards that make test systems safe, repeatable, maintainable, and ready for sustained use.
The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical and test-equipment judgment with demonstrated people leadership. You know how to grow engineers, manage competing priorities, make sound technical tradeoffs, and scale a hardware capability from rapid prototype work into disciplined, configuration-controlled operations. You remain close enough to the hardware to guide architecture, lead critical reviews, and help the team resolve its hardest problems.

Shield AI develops AI-powered autonomy software and aircraft systems that protect service members and civilians by enabling intelligent operations in contested environments. As part of the X-BAT program, you will help develop and validate next-generation autonomous aircraft and mission-critical hardware that must perform reliably in demanding operational conditions.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Manager, Mechanical Engineering to lead the mechanical hardware-test team supporting X-BAT. The team develops and sustains the test stands, fixtures, tooling, support equipment, and facility interfaces used to validate mission-critical aircraft hardware across development, integration, qualification, and production.

You will be accountable for the team's people, technical direction, operating model, and delivery across a portfolio of test-equipment projects. You will translate program and verification priorities into a clear roadmap, build the capacity needed to execute it, and establish the engineering standards that make test systems safe, repeatable, maintainable, and ready for sustained use.

The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical and test-equipment judgment with demonstrated people leadership. You know how to grow engineers, manage competing priorities, make sound technical tradeoffs, and scale a hardware capability from rapid prototype work into disciplined, configuration-controlled operations. You remain close enough to the hardware to guide architecture, lead critical reviews, and help the team resolve its hardest problems.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and grow a team of mechanical engineers responsible for X-BAT hardware-test equipment; set clear expectations and provide regular feedback, career development, performance management, hiring, and onboarding.
  • Own the mechanical hardware-test roadmap and delivery portfolio across development, subsystem integration, qualification, and production-test needs.
  • Convert program milestones and verification needs into executable plans with clear scope, priorities, staffing, schedule, dependencies, decision owners, and risk-reduction actions.
  • Manage team capacity and workload across concurrent test campaigns; identify resource gaps and communicate staffing, schedule, budget, and technical tradeoffs with transparency.
  • Set the quality bar for requirements, concepts, design reviews, analysis, GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFM/DFA, drawing and model release, configuration control, validation, acceptance, and sustaining documentation.
  • Ensure test stands and fixtures are safe, repeatable, maintainable, serviceable, and efficient for operators while meeting structural, thermal, durability, environmental, and facility-interface requirements.
  • Serve as the senior mechanical escalation point for test-equipment architecture, load paths, materials, mechanisms, mounting, cooling, plumbing, instrumentation accommodation, guarding, and other hazards or interfaces.
  • Establish and use meaningful operating metrics such as schedule predictability, design-review closure, first-pass checkout, equipment uptime, recurring failures, corrective-action closure, and reuse of proven designs.
  • Drive standardization and reuse across test assets, including common design practices, modular hardware, documentation, checkout methods, and maintenance strategies.
  • Partner with test, electrical, avionics, systems, manufacturing, quality, facilities, supply chain, technicians, and program leadership to resolve interfaces and deliver integrated test capability when it is needed.
  • Oversee fabrication, procurement, assembly, commissioning, and sustainment strategies with internal shops and external suppliers; make informed make-versus-buy and schedule-risk decisions.
  • Lead high-impact root-cause investigations and corrective actions involving test equipment or units under test, ensuring lessons learned improve future designs and team practices.
  • Build a culture of technical rigor, urgency, ownership, candid communication, and safe hands-on execution.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a related STEM discipline.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience developing complex mechanical hardware, test equipment, tooling, fixtures, or ground-support equipment in aerospace, defense, robotics, automotive, industrial systems, or another high-consequence environment.
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including goal setting, work allocation, coaching, performance management, hiring, and developing engineers.
  • Demonstrated success leading a team or function through the design, release, fabrication, assembly, checkout, deployment, and sustainment of multiple complex hardware systems.
  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, including statics and dynamics, load paths, strength and stiffness, fatigue and durability, materials and finishes, fastener design, tolerancing, GD&T, and machine or fixture safety.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and leading effective requirements, architecture, and design reviews.
  • Proficiency with an industry-standard CAD and product-lifecycle or release workflow such as NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, Teamcenter, or an equivalent toolset.
  • Experience managing a multi-project technical roadmap, balancing resources and priorities, and communicating risk and tradeoffs to program and engineering leadership.
  • Hands-on judgment developed in lab, prototype, manufacturing, or production environments, including collaboration with technicians, machinists, suppliers, and test operators.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a record of building alignment across engineering, operations, and program organizations.

• Experience developing and sustaining aerospace ground-test or production-test equipment for avionics, propulsion, structures, actuation, power systems, or other flight-critical hardware.
  • Experience with environmental or qualification testing, including vibration, shock, thermal, pressure, contamination, or durability testing and the facility interfaces those tests require.
  • Experience with high-load structural fixtures, rotating equipment, fluid systems, thermal-management hardware, or propulsion-related test equipment.
  • Working knowledge of analysis tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran, or equivalent methods used to support test-equipment design decisions.
  • Experience with system-safety and reliability practices such as hazard analysis, DFMEA, FTA, proof-load testing, guarding, interlocks, or safe-state design.
  • Experience improving equipment uptime, throughput, repeatability, maintainability, calibration, traceability, or configuration control in a production or qualification environment.
  • Experience developing capital-equipment plans and managing fabrication partners or equipment suppliers.
  • Active secret clearance or eligibility to obtain one, as well as SCI eligibility.

Job Description:
We are seeking a Manager of Propulsion to lead the development and execution of engine and thrust vector control (TVC) systems for the X-BAT vehicle, powered by a fighter-class, afterburning jet engine. This role leads a team of propulsion engineers and technicians responsible for developing, integrating, testing, and operating flight-critical propulsion hardware from concept through flight and operational deployment.
You will work closely with propulsion Responsible Engineers (REs), controls, airframe, flight test, manufacturing, and leadership teams to ensure engine and TVC development aligns with vehicle-level objectives, mission requirements, and program milestones. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engagement, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced aerospace development environment.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Manager of Propulsion to lead the development and execution of engine and thrust vector control (TVC) systems for the X-BAT vehicle, powered by a fighter-class, afterburning jet engine. This role leads a team of propulsion engineers and technicians responsible for developing, integrating, testing, and operating flight-critical propulsion hardware from concept through flight and operational deployment.

You will work closely with propulsion Responsible Engineers (REs), controls, airframe, flight test, manufacturing, and leadership teams to ensure engine and TVC development aligns with vehicle-level objectives, mission requirements, and program milestones. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engagement, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced aerospace development environment.

lists.content:
• Lead propulsion engineering efforts related to engine and TVC development, integration, testing, and flight operations.
  • Support and mentor propulsion REs responsible for engine modules, nozzles, actuators, vectoring hardware, and associated propulsion systems.
  • Drive technical execution, staffing, prioritization, and schedule alignment across propulsion activities.
  • Guide teams through propulsion trade studies involving thermodynamics, transient behavior, thermal management, structural integration, and operability limits.
  • Coordinate closely with controls, airframe, and mission teams to ensure propulsion integration supports aircraft maneuverability, survivability, and CONOPS requirements.
  • Support root cause investigations, performance anomalies, design reviews, and flight readiness activities.
  • Drive technical rigor, accountability, and measurable execution across the propulsion organization.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners supporting propulsion hardware and testing.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in propulsion system development, integration, test, or flight operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams or large cross-functional technical efforts.
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and aerospace propulsion fundamentals.
  • Deep understanding of gas turbine engine operation, transient response, thrust production, operability limits, and thermal constraints.
  • Hands-on experience supporting propulsion hardware development and test programs.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience with fighter-class or low-bypass turbofan propulsion systems.
  • Familiarity with engine controls, TVC systems, transient response, and actuator integration.
  • Experience with GFSSP, REFPROP, ANSYS, FEA, or propulsion performance analysis tools.
  • Background in rocket propulsion or thrust vector control systems.
  • Experience operating in hardware-centric, test-driven aerospace environments.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline

lists.content:
• Lead fuel system development activities from architecture through testing and flight operations.
  • Support and mentor fuel system REs responsible for fuel tanks, pumps, valves, vent systems, and associated propulsion hardware.
  • Drive system integration efforts considering elevated-G maneuvers, transient operation, vapor ingestion, cavitation, thermal effects, and fault tolerance.
  • Guide teams through fuel system thermodynamic and fluid dynamic trade studies involving heat soak, vapor pressure behavior, venting, and transient flow response.
  • Coordinate testing activities, instrumentation planning, and performance validation efforts.
  • Support failure investigations, root cause analysis, and design iteration activities.
  • Ensure schedules, technical execution, and supplier activities remain aligned with program goals.
  • Collaborate closely with propulsion, airframe, mission systems, and manufacturing teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
  • 7-10+ years of experience developing aerospace fuel or fluid systems.
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and aerospace propulsion fundamentals.
  • Deep understanding of compressible and incompressible flow systems and aerospace fluid dynamics.
  • Experience with fuel system integration, testing, and operational support.
  • Experience leading engineering teams or major subsystem development activities.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

• Experience with jet-powered UAVs, tactical aircraft, or aerospace fuel systems.
  • Familiarity with GFSSP, REFPROP, ANSYS, or fluid system modeling tools.
  • Experience with slosh dynamics, cavitation, vapor ingestion, venting, thermal management, and pressurization systems.
  • Background in rocket propulsion fluid systems.
  • Experience operating in test-driven aerospace development environments.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

lists.content:
• Lead propulsion subsystem and component development activities from concept through flight operations.
  • Mentor propulsion REs responsible for propulsion hardware design, integration, testing, and operational support.

  • Guide engineering teams through challenging thermal and flow environments involving high temperatures, pressure loads, vibration, and transient operation.
  • Drive component-level architecture and integration decisions for valves, actuators, ducts, mounts, and supporting propulsion hardware.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between design, manufacturing, supply chain, test, and vehicle teams.

  • Strong understanding of aerospace component design, structural integration, and thermal/mechanical design constraints.
  • Hands-on experience supporting development hardware and rapid iteration programs.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

  • Familiarity with valve design, sealing strategies, high-temperature materials, and flow path optimization.
  • Background in rocket propulsion, turbomachinery, or high-temperature aerospace hardware.
  • Experience operating in test-driven aerospace development environments.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline.

Job Description:

The Quality Manager is responsible for leading and maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS) for VBAT manufacturing operations. This role ensures product conformity, regulatory compliance, and manufacturing quality across VBAT production, inspection, and testing.

lists.content:
Quality Management System (QMS)
  • Maintain and improve the company Quality Management System in alignment with AS9100 standard.
  • Develop, implement, and enforce quality policies, procedures, work instructions, and inspection criteria.
  • Support external customer and regulatory audits.
  • Drive compliance to AS9100 principles and customer-specific quality requirements.
    • Manufacturing Quality Oversight
  • Lead quality operations across VBAT assembly, composite fabrication, avionics integration, mechanical assembly, and test operations.
  • Ensure robust in-process and final inspection processes are in place and effective.
  • Establish inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and manufacturing quality controls.
  • Monitor production quality metrics including defects, escapes, rework, scrap, MRB activity, and yield.
  • Partner with production and manufacturing leadership to improve build quality, process discipline, and throughput.
    • Nonconformance & Corrective Action
  • Own the Material Review Board (MRB) process and disposition of nonconforming material.
  • Drive effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to closure.
  • Ensure containment actions are timely and effective while long-term solutions are implemented.
    • Inspection
  • Oversee inspection personnel including in-process inspection and final acceptance testing.
  • Ensure calibrated tooling and measurement systems are maintained and compliant.
  • Improve inspection efficiency while maintaining product integrity and traceability.
    • Leadership & Team Development
  • Build and develop a high-performing quality organization in a startup-growth environment.
  • Mentor Quality Engineers, Inspectors, and Technicians.
  • Promote a proactive quality culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration between Quality, Production, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5–10+ years of quality experience in aerospace, defense, UAV, aviation, or complex electromechanical manufacturing.
  • 3+ years of leadership or management experience.
  • Experience supporting low-rate/high-mix manufacturing environments.
  • Experience working directly on production floors and collaborating cross-functionally.

• AS9100 internal or lead auditor certification.
  • Familiarity with defense contracting and customer quality requirements.
  • Experience implementing quality systems in scaling manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of ERP/MES systems and quality data analysis tools.

lists.content:
• Own and continuously improve the enterprise QMS, ensuring compliance with AS9100 and applicable AQAP, customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Revenue Accounting Manager to join our growing Accounting team. As Shield AI continues to expand globally, this role presents an opportunity to support and enhance the accounting function at a high-growth, mission-driven technology company. As a Revenue Manager, you will be responsible for the entire revenue recognition process, from contract review to monthly transacting, while developing cross functional relationships with legal, business development and program finance.

lists.content:
• Own and evolve the company’s ASC 606 revenue policies, including SSP analyses and allocations, as new products, pricing models, and contract structures are introduced.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on ASC 606, owning the end-to-end revenue accounting process and ensuring consistent application of revenue recognition policies across the organization.
  • Lead the monthly revenue close process, including revenue recognition, deferred revenue, unbilled revenue, contract assets and liabilities, and related account reconciliations.
  • Review and analyze revenue results, including period-over-period fluctuations, revenue trends, and unusual or non-recurring transactions, and provide clear explanations and insights to Accounting and Finance leadership.
  • Oversee revenue-related journal entries, accruals, adjustments, and reconciliations, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies and GAAP.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations, Billing, Accounts Receivable, FP&A, Sales, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely execution of the revenue lifecycle from contract inception through billing and cash collection.
  • Establish and maintain operational revenue accounting processes, procedures, and controls to support a scalable and efficient revenue close as the company continues to grow.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve revenue accounting processes, systems, reporting, and data flows, including partnering with Finance Systems and Revenue Operations on system enhancements and implementations.
  • Develop and maintain revenue accounting controls and documentation in support of the company’s internal control and SOX readiness objectives.
  • Support internal and external audits, including preparation of audit schedules, documentation, and responses to technical accounting inquiries.
  • Continuously assess revenue accounting processes and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, scalability, controls, and efficiency as the business evolves.

• 5+ years of relevant experience across public and private accounting, with a strong focus on technical revenue accounting under ASC 606/IFRS 15.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field of study, or equivalent experience.
  • Intermediate knowledge of general accounting concepts and ASC 606.
  • Deep understanding of order-to-cash (OTC) processes and how technical accounting decisions impact operations.
  • Experience with revenue recognition and OTC systems (e.g., Salesforce) or equivalent tools.
  • Knowledge of SOX compliance protocols.
  • Experience with high-growth companies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and balance technical rigor with operational practicality.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively and work as part of a team.
  • Ability to deliver results and meet expectations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical issues into clear, actionable guidance.
  • A data-driven mindset with a proactive approach.

• CPA preferred.
  • Big 4 experience is preferred.
  • Experience in the Software as a Service (SaaS) and/or Platform as a Service (PaaS) industry is preferred.

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on building advanced perception systems that enable autonomous aircraft to operate effectively in complex and contested environments. A successful candidate will be skilled in developing real-time object detection, sensor fusion, and state estimation algorithms using data from diverse mission sensors such as EO/IR cameras, radars, and IMUs. The role requires strong algorithmic thinking, deep familiarity with airborne sensing systems, and the ability to deliver performant software in simulation and real-world conditions. We are seeking a skilled and motivated manager to lead technical teams and support direct projects integrating perception solutions for defense platforms.
 
Shield AI is committed to developing cutting-edge autonomy for unmanned aircraft operating across all Department of Defense (DoD) domains, including air, sea, and land. Our Perception Engineers are instrumental in creating the situational awareness that underpins autonomy, ensuring our systems understand and respond to the operational environment with speed, precision, and resilience.

lists.content:
• Multidisciplinary Team Leadership – Lead teams across autonomy, integration, and testing by aligning technical efforts, resolving cross-functional challenges, and driving mission-focused execution. Balance hands-on technical oversight with performance optimization, innovation, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Develop advanced perception algorithms — Design and implement robust algorithms for object detection, classification, and multi-target tracking across diverse sensor modalities.
  • Implement sensor fusion frameworks — Integrate data from vision systems, radars, and other mission sensors using probabilistic and deterministic fusion techniques to generate accurate situational awareness.
  • Develop state estimation capabilities — Design and refine algorithms for localization and pose estimation using IMU, GPS, vision, and other onboard sensing inputs to enable stable and accurate navigation.
  • Analyze and utilize sensor ICDs — Interpret interface control documents (ICDs) and technical specifications for aircraft-mounted sensors to ensure correct data handling, interpretation, and synchronization.
  • Optimize perception performance — Tune and evaluate perception pipelines for performance, robustness, and real-time efficiency in both simulation and real-world environments.
  • Support autonomy integration — Work closely with autonomy, systems, and integration teams to interface perception outputs with planning, behaviors, and decision-making modules.
  • Validate in simulated and operational settings — Leverage synthetic data, simulation environments, and field testing to validate algorithm accuracy and mission readiness.
  • Collaborate with hardware and sensor teams — Ensure seamless integration of perception algorithms with onboard compute platforms and diverse sensor payloads.
  • Drive innovation in airborne sensing — Contribute novel ideas and state-of-the-art techniques to advance real-time perception capabilities for unmanned aircraft operating in complex, GPS-denied, or contested environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-15% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Unmanned Systems programs in the DoD or applied R&D
  • 2+ years of people leadership experience
  • Background in implementing algorithms such as Kalman Filters, multi-target tracking, or deep learning-based detection models.
  • Familiarity with fusing data from radar, EO/IR cameras, or other sensors using probabilistic or rule-based approaches.
  • Familiarity with SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, or sensor-fused localization approaches in real-time applications.
  • Ability to interpret and work with Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and hardware integration specs.
  • Proficiency with version control, debugging, and test-driven development in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Hands-on integration or algorithm development with airborne sensing systems.
  • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow, particularly for vision-based object detection or classification tasks.
  • Experience deploying perception software on SWaP-constrained platforms.
  • Familiarity with validating perception systems during flight test events or operational environments.
  • Understanding of sensing challenges in denied or degraded conditions.
  • Exposure to perception applications across air, maritime, and ground platforms.

lists.content:
• Build and lead the Shared Services Engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development 
  • Define and execute the team’s roadmap, balancing customer needs, cross-product priorities, operational health, and long-term technical investment 
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to identify shared capabilities, establish ownership and integration boundaries, and guide initiatives including shared authentication, telemetry integrations, the Customer Support Portal, and future public telemetry APIs

  • Track record of setting technical direction, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and executing across immediate and long-term priorities 
  • Effective cross-functional leadership, with the ability to build alignment and trusted partnerships across engineering, product, and organizational stakeholders

• Track record of leading teams that build shared services and customer-facing applications from scratch and own them through production operation 
  • Depth in one or more relevant domains, such as identity and authentication, public APIs and SDKs, or OpenTelemetry and high-volume telemetry data 
  • Experience establishing a new engineering capability, consolidating fragmented ownership, or driving adoption across multiple product teams

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a highly motivated Marketing Intelligence & Analytics Manager to own the analytics strategy for the Marketing organization, and to drive operational execution alongside it. This role will work closely with Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners to define how marketing data is structured, reported, and used to inform decisions. 

The ideal candidate combines a strategic mind with hands-on technical fluency. They can sit with stakeholders to define requirements and design how data should be structured and stored, partner closely with technical builders on pipeline and infrastructure decisions, and own cross-functional performance analysis at the CMO level, turning that analysis into clear storylines for the C-suite.

lists.content:
• Own the definition of marketing data and reporting requirements. Partner with stakeholders across Marketing and cross-functional teams to translate business questions into clear data specifications, schemas, and reporting structures 
  • Design how marketing data is structured, stored, and governed, partnering closely with MarTech, data engineering, and contractors to ensure infrastructure and pipeline decisions map back to business requirements 
  • Bring enough technical fluency (SQL, data modeling, ETL concepts) to review technical designs, troubleshoot issues, and be a credible partner to the engineers and vendors building the infrastructure 
  • Own the design and maintenance of centralized reporting and dashboards across the marketing funnel, ensuring a consistent, single source of truth for leadership 
  • Lead cross-functional performance analyses at the CMO level, synthesizing data across channels and functions into a clear view of what happened, why, and what to do next 
  • Prepare executive updates, business reviews, and strategic storylines for Marketing leadership and the C-suite, translating complex data into clear, action-oriented narratives 
  • Partner with Marketing leadership on annual and quarterly operating plans, defining metrics and targets and tracking progress against goals 
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality, instrumentation, and operational efficiency across marketing programs

• 5-8 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, strategy consulting, or a similar role, with a track record spanning both strategic analysis and data/schema ownership 
  • Demonstrated experience defining data and reporting requirements with stakeholders and designing how that data should be structured and stored 
  • Hands-on technical fluency, including SQL, data modeling, and enough understanding of ETL and data pipeline concepts to partner effectively with engineers and MarTech on build decisions 
  • Experience owning executive-level, cross-functional performance analysis, synthesizing data across channels into a strategic narrative for senior leadership 
  • Strong storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, C-suite-ready narratives 
  • Experience with analytics tools such as Google BigQuery, Google Analytics, Marketo, Looker Studio / Tableau, and Salesforce 
  • Strong project management skills, with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution 
  • Highly proactive and self-starting, able to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy

• Direct experience building or maintaining ETL pipelines, data models, or analytics infrastructure 
  • Familiarity with marketing funnel measurement and attribution models 
  • Fluent in AI/automation tools to improve analytics, reporting, or marketing workflows

  • Conduct independent inspections of maintenance tasks, logbooks, technical data use, service bulletin compliance, configuration accuracy, release practices, tool/FOD control, ground handling, and field operations. 
  • Verify maintenance quality, data integrity, critical‑step completion, serial/time‑tracked item accuracy, deferred discrepancy management, and in‑process inspection discipline. 
  • Develop and execute standardized evaluation programs, including sampling plans, audits, acceptance criteria, and documented finding categories. 
  • Maintain dashboards and indicators such as maintenance quality, data error rates, open findings, CAPA status, repeat discrepancies, tool/FOD events, and potential readiness blockers.

  • Hands‑on experience in operational environments (hangars, flightlines, test ranges, customer sites, or deployed locations). 
  • Strong data discipline and ability to generate accurate, actionable reports and dashboards. 
  • Working knowledge of audit practices, root‑cause methods, CAPA, and safety/quality systems. 
  • High ownership and independence; able to ask difficult questions, build trust, and drive corrective actions without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to travel and support non‑standard operational tempos.

• Experience with military aviation maintenance/QA. 
  • Experience with NASA‑style mission assurance, DoD QA, AS9100, ICAO safety assurance, or similar frameworks. 
  • Experience supporting developmental flight test programs or rapidly evolving aircraft platforms 
  • Training in auditing, root‑cause analysis, CAPA, HFACS, TapRooT, Six Sigma, human factors, or maintenance evaluation. 
  • Experience with autonomous systems, configuration management, telemetry‑based maintenance, or digital maintenance systems. 
  • Familiarity with aviation safety assurance, risk management, and continuous monitoring. 
  • Active or eligible security clearance.

lists.content:
• Serve as the mission systems SME for Fleet Support and lead escalated investigations involving payloads, transponders, and externally connected mission systems.
  • Diagnose payload integration and performance issues involving power, thermal behavior, compute, configuration, data interfaces, timing, and subsystem interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot systems that communicate with external sources or provide data externally, including mission-data outputs, external interfaces, and system-to-system connectivity issues.
  • Support the introduction of emerging technologies and new mission capabilities into the fielded fleet by identifying support risks, validation needs, and integration challenges.
  • Work directly with customers, operators, and maintainers to understand mission impact, reproduce issues, and define corrective actions.
  • Partner with electrical, software, and RF teams on cross-functional mission-system problems.
  • Support lab validation, hardware integration, test readiness, and field demonstrations related to mission-system fixes.
  • Create technical guidance, interface notes, troubleshooting procedures, and customer-facing documentation for fielded mission capabilities.
  • Capture recurring issues and feed lessons learned back into product, systems, and design teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in payload integration, sensor integration, mission systems, avionics integration, or aircraft systems engineering.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex systems that span hardware, software, networking, and operational workflows.
  • Strong ability to move between high-level mission context and detailed subsystem investigation.
  • Experience working across design, integration, test, and field-support environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in customer-facing technical settings.

• Experience with electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) payloads, radar, transponders, or other externally connected aircraft mission systems.
  • Experience with interface control documents, validation planning, and flight-test support.
  • Experience introducing new payloads or mission kits into operational fleets.
  • Experience with defense, maritime, or expeditionary mission systems.

Job Description:
The Mission Systems Software Engineer will work on developing solutions of a real time system environment to provide mission computing support at the center of an autonomous aircraft with sensor and weapons. This role will work to establish a software architecture for a real time system that operates in a multi-level environment at real time. The role will require work with hardware, software and systems teams to come to a consensus design. This role will focus on development of new systems and software designs from PDR, CoDR, CDR to lab test, flight test and fielding.

Job Description:

The Mission Systems Software Engineer will work on developing solutions of a real time system environment to provide mission computing support at the center of an autonomous aircraft with sensor and weapons. This role will work to establish a software architecture for a real time system that operates in a multi-level environment at real time. The role will require work with hardware, software and systems teams to come to a consensus design. This role will focus on development of new systems and software designs from PDR, CoDR, CDR to lab test, flight test and fielding.

lists.content:
• Serve as a software mission systems engineer for a safety- and mission-critical real-time mission-computing system aligned with A-GRA and AMS-GRA principles, profiles, interfaces, and data standards. 

  • Define and maintain the end-to-end software architecture, including mission applications, platform services, middleware, operating-system interfaces, hardware-abstraction layers, networking, data distribution, component boundaries, and APIs. 

  • Architect for deterministic real-time performance by addressing scheduling, latency, jitter, synchronization, throughput, resource utilization, distributed processing, and CPU/GPU/accelerator allocation. 

  • Develop architecture views, interface definitions, data-flow and deployment models, sequence and timing diagrams, resource budgets, trade studies, and technical decision records. 

  • Integrate sensors, effectors, communications, navigation, autonomy, mission management, command-and-control, data-processing, and vehicle services in collaboration with hardware, FPGA, cybersecurity, safety, systems, integration, and test teams. 

  • Design for mission resilience and assurance through fault detection and isolation, redundancy, graceful degradation, recovery, health monitoring, cybersecurity, airworthiness, certification, and requirements traceability. 

  • Establish engineering practices for concurrency, synchronization, memory and resource management, deterministic execution, interface control, configuration management, and predictable component integration. 

  • Define and execute verification strategies across HIL/SIL laboratories, simulations, test benches, flight-test environments, and deployed systems using automated, performance, stress, fault-injection, interface, and timing tests. 

  • Maintain technical ownership throughout the system lifecycle by evaluating enabling technologies and supplier designs, analyzing performance, managing technical debt and modernization roadmaps, promoting reuse, and communicating architectural decisions.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 

  • 8+ years of professional software-engineering experience, including 3+ years in software architecture, systems architecture, or technical leadership. 

  • Experience developing embedded, distributed, real-time, safety-critical, or mission-critical software systems. 

  • Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, or another strongly typed systems-programming language. 

  • Strong understanding of real-time software principles, including scheduling, concurrency, synchronization, latency, jitter, memory management, and deterministic execution. 

  • Experience with embedded operating systems or RTOSs, middleware, interprocess communication, networking, and data-distribution technologies. 

  • Experience defining software architectures, APIs, interface-control documents, data flows, deployment models, and system resource budgets. 

  • Experience integrating software with hardware, sensors, communications systems, navigation systems, effectors, or other mission-system components. 

  • Experience supporting software through requirements development, design reviews, implementation, integration, verification, system test, and deployment. 

  • Working knowledge of systems-engineering processes, requirements management, traceability, configuration management, and verification and validation. 

  • Ability to analyze system performance using instrumentation, telemetry, traces, profiling, network captures, timing data, and resource-utilization measurements. 

  • Strong cross-functional technical leadership, problem-solving, written communication, and presentation skills. 

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense security clearance; U.S. citizenship may be required for clearance eligibility.

• Experience developing software for autonomous aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems, avionics, mission computers, robotics, or aerospace and defense platforms. 

  • Experience with A-GRA, AMS-GRA, OMS, UCI, FACE, or other government reference architectures and open-mission-system standards. 

  • Experience integrating autonomy, mission management, command-and-control, sensor processing, communications, navigation, and effector capabilities. 

  • Familiarity with airworthiness, safety-assurance, or certification standards such as DO-178C, DO-254, ARP4754A, or applicable military airworthiness guidance. 

  • Experience with CPU-, GPU-, FPGA-, or accelerator-based heterogeneous computing architectures. 

  • Experience with publish/subscribe middleware, quality-of-service controls, high-rate data distribution, precision timing, and distributed time synchronization. 

  • Experience designing cybersecurity controls for embedded or mission systems, including trust boundaries, least privilege, authentication, authorization, secure communications, and software integrity. 

  • Experience with HIL/SIL environments, simulation systems, laboratory integration, flight testing, or operational deployment. 

  • Experience evaluating supplier designs, RTOSs, middleware, computing platforms, or third-party software for architectural compliance and integration readiness. 

  • Active or previously held U.S. Department of Defense Secret clearance.

Job Description:

The Aircraft Simulation team is the nerve center of autonomy integration at Shield AI. We deploy the innovative tools, intelligent models, and streamlined processes that make it possible to evaluate complex autonomous flight algorithms at scale. Our tools are utilized in a broad range of simulation - from mission autonomy simulation to Hardware-in-the-loop, and every layer between. In an era of rapid advancement in Artificial Intelligence, our goal is simple: make AI fly - safely, reliably, and fast.

As a Modeling & Simulation Engineer, you will be a pivotal force in engineering Shield AI’s foundational simulation platform for our next-generation VTOL aircraft. You’ll develop our emerging simulation engine and deploy advanced aircraft models in C++ across multiple engineering domains - ranging from mathematical physics to the latest in surrogate machine learning methods. You will also utilize your multiphysics and aeronautical systems knowledge to conduct system performance analysis against test and vendor data to ensure simulation results are valid in operational scenarios, and simulation platforms are both stable and fast.

lists.content:
• Develop infrastructure and models in C++ for autonomous aircraft simulation.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in modern aerospace and software engineering.
  • Architect deterministic, high-performance simulation software.
  • Lead verification and validation (V&V) analysis studies on models and model tooling.
  • Collaborate tightly across autonomy, embedded, GNC, and test engineering teams to ensure our simulation mirrors real aircraft behavior and mission scenarios.
  • Contribute to platform-agnostic simulation tooling to accelerate future development efforts.
  • Train and guide junior engineers in modeling and simulation best practices.

• BS in Computer Science, Aerospace, Robotics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in simulation software development with C++ competency; exceptional candidates with less experience and demonstrated depth will be considered.
  • Strong understanding of rigid-body dynamics, kinematics, and the physics of dynamic systems.
  • Proven experience developing or integrating simulation systems for robotics, aerospace, and/or other complex dynamic systems (e.g., maritime, space, defense ground systems, or gaming).
  • Ability to debug complex build and runtime environments.
  • Experience with simulation verification and validation.
  • Strong communication skills across software, hardware, and systems disciplines.
  • Must be eligible to obtain a Secret Clearance; Secret clearance eligibility requires US Citizenship.

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Aerospace, Robotics, or related field.
  • Familiarity with modern C++ standards (C++20 or later).
  • Grasp of real-time and deterministic software design, including multi-threading, synchronization, and memory management. 
  • Experience with DevOps-integrated simulation workflows, including CI/CD and automated testing environments.
  • Experience with Hardware- and Software-in-the-Loop simulation environments, including integration of real hardware into simulation environments.
  • Experience with CMake, package management tools (e.g. Conan, Nix), and profiling tools.
  • Experience with software testing tools (GTest, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, test automation, or simulation orchestration.
  • Experience working on autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret Clearance is desired.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Working in our Hivemind Solutions team you will lead the Modelling and Simulation capability for our Australian based Mission Autonomy programs. You will be responsible for developing and integrating the simulation and test environments which our autonomy engineers use to develop, test and demonstrate Mission Autonomy solutions for uncrewed aircraft.  

In this role, you will guide multidisciplinary engineering teams in designing, implementing, and integrating high‑performance real-time and faster than real-time simulation frameworks across distributed, containerized, and hardware‑in‑the‑loop environments.

Your work will directly support key customer programs, internal R&D, and mission‑critical autonomy development—ensuring our simulation ecosystem is robust, scalable, and operationally representative.

lists.content:
• Simulation Architecture Leadership – Lead the design and evolution of distributed, real‑time simulation systems that support autonomy development, verification, and validation across virtual, constructive, and live environments.
  • High‑Performance Software Development – Architect and implement C++,  software for modelling, simulation, and integration workflows, while maintaining compatibility with legacy standards for seamless system interoperability.
  • Real-Time & Distributed Simulation – Develop, optimize, and deploy software for real‑time mission execution environments, including multi‑agent scenarios and high‑fidelity system-of-systems simulations.  
  • Simulation Framework Integration – Apply practical experience with defence simulation frameworks such as AFSIM or NGTS to accelerate capability delivery and ensure alignment with defence customer expectations.
  • Containerized Deployment – Leverage Docker, Kubernetes or similar technologies to ensure repeatable, scalable, and modular simulation deployments across development, CI, and operational environments.
  • Technical & Project Leadership – Lead engineering teams of 5+ contributors, ensuring alignment across software, test, autonomy, perception, and program stakeholders. Drive quality, delivery, and technical excellence.
  • Collaboration & Delivery – Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate simulation with autonomy algorithms, hardware interfaces, and test pipelines, enabling rapid experimentation, regression testing, and mission readiness.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement – Champion best practices in CI/CD, test‑driven development, design patterns, and system architecture. Explore and adopt modern technologies to expand modelling and simulation capabilities.

• A tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field
  • Extensive professional experience in software engineering and systems integration
  • Strong experience in modern C++ with familiarity across legacy standards
  • Professional experience with Python
  • Significant experience building and delivering reliable software systems in fast‑paced environments
  • Experience leading teams to deliver complex engineering projects
  • Experience with real‑time, distributed simulation systems or HWIL/SWIL environments
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker or equivalent)
  • Experience working in Linux development environments
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems quickly and effectively
  • Proven history of strong collaboration, accountability, and being a trusted and kind teammate
  • Ability to obtain an Australian NV1 security clearance 

    •  

    Preferred qualifications:  

  • Defence industry experience
  • Experience with uncrewed systems, particularly in the air domain
  • Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, or equivalent defence simulation tools
  • Experience with data processing, analysis pipelines, or test automation workflows, especially those using Python

Our mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems, and this role supports that mission directly by working with Australian Government classified material. It requires an Australian Government security clearance at [Baseline / NV1 / NV2] level. 

You don't need to hold a clearance already, we will sponsor your clearance and support you, because mission first, people always. Australian citizenship is a mandatory requirement for this role. It is a condition of clearance eligibility set by the Australian Government, eligibility details are here: https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-suitability
