Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Network Architect to define and evolve the secure, scalable, and resilient network architecture supporting our engineering, manufacturing, autonomy development, and enterprise operations environments.

As part of the Cloud & Infrastructure team within Enterprise Operations, this highly technical individual contributor will establish network strategy, standards, and reference architectures across Shield AI's offices, engineering labs, manufacturing facilities, data centers, public cloud environments, and international locations. You will remain hands-on for first-of-kind, complex, and high-risk deployments while partnering closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Cloud Platform, Site Infrastructure, Facilities, and Cybersecurity teams.

lists.content:
Enterprise Network Architecture

  • Define and maintain Shield AI's enterprise network architecture, technical strategy, standards, roadmaps, and reference designs.
  • Architect scalable LAN, WAN, wireless, internet edge, data-center, VPN, SASE, NAC, and network security solutions across a globally distributed environment.
  • Develop high-level and low-level designs for new offices, engineering labs, manufacturing facilities, data centers, cloud environments, acquisitions, and site integrations.
  • Design resilient routing and connectivity architectures using BGP, OSPF, IPsec, private circuits, cloud interconnects, diverse internet services, and related technologies.
  • Establish standards for segmentation, IP addressing, naming, routing, high availability, quality of service, observability, capacity, and lifecycle management.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technology evaluations, proofs of concept, and design decisions for strategic network initiatives.

    • Manufacturing IoT and Hybrid Connectivity

  • Develop secure network architectures for manufacturing, IoT, industrial, engineering, lab, and operational technology environments.
  • Define segmentation and access patterns for manufacturing equipment, sensors, robotics, test systems, building systems, cameras, and other connected devices.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Facilities, and Cybersecurity teams to integrate operational environments without introducing unacceptable risk to enterprise or controlled networks.
  • Design hybrid connectivity across AWS, Azure, data centers, colocation facilities, and on-premises environments, including cloud transit, private connectivity, routing integration, secure ingress and egress, and shared services.
  • Support the integration of acquired companies, legacy networks, international locations, and newly constructed facilities into enterprise standards.

    • Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for complex network designs, escalations, performance issues, and resiliency improvements.
  • Lead and actively participate in first-of-kind, complex, or high-risk deployments, migrations, cutovers, validation testing, incident response, and advanced troubleshooting.
  • Translate architecture into implementation plans, reusable configurations, operational standards, and clear handoffs for Network Engineering and Network Security teams.
  • Advance network automation and infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform, Ansible, Python, APIs, and configuration-management platforms.
  • Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, design documents, decision records, implementation standards, and operational documentation.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering and architecture across complex, multi-site environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading network architecture from requirements and design through implementation, validation, and operational handoff.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise routing, switching, wireless, WAN, internet edge, VPN, network segmentation, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced knowledge of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, QoS, IPsec, DNS, DHCP, NAT, route redistribution, and resilient traffic-engineering patterns.
  • Experience architecting networks across offices, engineering facilities, manufacturing environments, data centers, colocation facilities, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with firewall architecture, zero-trust principles, network access control, secure remote access, and layered segmentation.
  • Experience with AWS and Azure networking, including transit architectures, private connectivity, cloud routing, and network security controls.
  • Ability to create clear architecture diagrams, reference designs, technical standards, implementation guidance, and decision documentation.
  • Experience evaluating network technologies, vendors, carrier services, and professional-services designs.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, mentor engineers, and influence outcomes across teams without direct authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain architecture decisions, alternatives, and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel periodically and support planned after-hours implementations or critical incidents.

• Demonstrated experience designing secure IoT, Industrial IoT, operational technology, or manufacturing networks, including segmentation of production equipment, sensors, robotics, test systems, building systems, and other connected devices.
  • Experience applying manufacturing or OT security architecture practices such as zone-and-conduit segmentation, the Purdue model, or ISA/IEC 62443 principles.
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks, Panorama, Prisma Access, Juniper, Mist, Aruba, ClearPass, or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Experience designing high-density or industrial wireless networks for manufacturing, warehouse, lab, or engineering environments.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, government contracting, or another regulated environment.
  • Knowledge of CMMC, NIST 800-171, ITAR, controlled unclassified information, and network designs supporting regulated or isolated environments.
  • Experience integrating acquisitions, legacy environments, or international locations into global enterprise standards.
  • Experience with network automation, source-controlled configuration, validation testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Relevant advanced certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, JNCIE, PCNSE, AWS Advanced Networking, or equivalent experience.

description:

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on building advanced perception systems that enable autonomous aircraft to operate effectively in complex and contested environments. A successful candidate will be skilled in developing real-time object detection, sensor fusion, and state estimation algorithms using data from diverse mission sensors such as EO/IR cameras, radars, and IMUs.
 
The role requires strong algorithmic thinking, deep familiarity with airborne sensing systems, and the ability to deliver performant software in simulation and real-world conditions. Our Perception Engineers are instrumental in creating the situational awareness that underpins autonomy, ensuring our systems understand and respond to the operational environment with speed, precision, and resilience.

lists.content:
• Develop advanced perception algorithms — Design and implement robust algorithms for object detection, classification, and multi-target tracking across diverse sensor modalities.
  • Implement sensor fusion frameworks — Integrate data from vision systems, radars, and other mission sensors using probabilistic and deterministic fusion techniques to generate accurate situational awareness.
  • Develop state estimation capabilities — Design and refine algorithms for localization and pose estimation using IMU, GPS, vision, and other onboard sensing inputs to enable stable and accurate navigation.
  • Analyze and utilize sensor ICDs — Interpret interface control documents (ICDs) and technical specifications for aircraft-mounted sensors to ensure correct data handling, interpretation, and synchronization.
  • Optimize perception performance — Tune and evaluate perception pipelines for performance, robustness, and real-time efficiency in both simulation and real-world environments.
  • Support autonomy integration — Work closely with autonomy, systems, and integration teams to interface perception outputs with planning, behaviors, and decision-making modules.
  • Validate in simulated and operational settings — Leverage synthetic data, simulation environments, and field testing to validate algorithm accuracy and mission readiness.
  • Collaborate with hardware and sensor teams — Ensure seamless integration of perception algorithms with onboard compute platforms and diverse sensor payloads.
  • Drive innovation in airborne sensing — Contribute novel ideas and state-of-the-art techniques to advance real-time perception capabilities for unmanned aircraft operating in complex, GPS-denied, or contested environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-15% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Background in implementing algorithms such as Kalman Filters, multi-target tracking, or deep learning-based detection models.
  • Familiarity with fusing data from radar, EO/IR cameras, or other sensors using probabilistic or rule-based approaches.
  • Familiarity with SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, or sensor-fused localization approaches in real-time applications.
  • Ability to interpret and work with Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and hardware integration specs.
  • Proficiency with version control, debugging, and test-driven development in cross-functional teams.

• Hands-on integration or algorithm development with airborne sensing systems.
  • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow, particularly for vision-based object detection or classification tasks. * Experience deploying perception software on SWaP-constrained platforms.
  • Familiarity with validating perception systems during flight test events or operational environments.
  • Understanding of sensing challenges in denied or degraded conditions.
  • Exposure to perception applications across air, maritime, and ground platforms.

• Help build the defining defence technology company of this century.  
  • Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems.  
  • Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission-driven environment.  
  • Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships.  
  • Collaborate with exceptional teams solving some of the world’s most complex operational challenges.

  • Serve as a day-to-day operational contact for employees, managers, local providers, and employers of record (EORs); resolve queries, monitor service delivery, and escalate complex or nonstandard matters.
  • Support new-country and entity launches by coordinating assigned operational workstreams for employment processes, systems, payroll, benefits, and employee support, including transitions from EOR arrangements.

  • Ability to work independently within established policies and processes, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Demonstrated success resolving operational problems and improving processes through automation, system enhancements, or simpler ways of working.

    • Preferred qualifications

Job Description:
Bring promising AI research into autonomous systems that operate in the real world.  Shield AI’s Perception team is looking for an engineer who enjoys exploring new ideas and making them work on real hardware. You’ll help turn advances in multimodal computer vision, visual foundation models, and embodied AI into useful capabilities for autonomous aircraft and vehicles.

Job Description:

Bring promising AI research into autonomous systems that operate in the real world.  Shield AI’s Perception team is looking for an engineer who enjoys exploring new ideas and making them work on real hardware. You’ll help turn advances in multimodal computer vision, visual foundation models, and embodied AI into useful capabilities for autonomous aircraft and vehicles. 

Working alongside researchers and autonomy engineers, you’ll evaluate promising approaches, build prototypes, and carry successful ideas into the Hivemind product. You’ll combine learned methods with established perception techniques, working through the sensor, software, and compute challenges that make edge robotics different from a benchmark.

lists.content:
• Evaluate emerging models and methods against representative sensor data and autonomy needs. 

  • Build prototypes and experiments that reveal strengths, limitations, and practical deployment opportunities. 

  • Combine learned and classical approaches to improve detection, tracking, geometric vision, or sensor fusion. 

  • Optimize and integrate capabilities for edge deployment, contributing Python and C++ software with support from experienced product engineers. 

  • Help deliver tested, documented capabilities and stay involved as other teams adopt them.

• A PhD in computer vision, machine learning (ML/DL), robotics, or a related field, or an equivalent record of advanced research and hands-on engineering. 

  • Research depth in an area such as multimodal vision, visual foundation models, video understanding, open-vocabulary perception, or embodied learning. 

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework. 

  • A thoughtful approach to experiments, evaluation data, and understanding why models fail. 

  • Experience building substantial research software, an interest in developing production-quality C++, and a collaborative approach to solving problems.

• Experience bringing a research prototype into sustained use. 

  • Experience with robotics, real sensors, temporal data, or multi-sensor perception. 

  • Familiarity with vision-language models, vision-language-action models, or embodied AI. 

  • Experience with C++, edge inference, or model optimization using tools such as ONNX, TensorRT, or CUDA. 

You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification or arrive as an expert C++ engineer. We welcome recent PhD graduates and early-career researchers, and we value technical depth, curiosity, and enthusiasm to transfer research to business value more than publication count alone.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Systems Administrator to support and maintain our PLM ecosystem, with a primary focus on Siemens Teamcenter. This role will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, support, and continuous improvement of PLM systems that enable engineering and manufacturing workflows.

This is a hands-on role focused on system administration, user support, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate brings experience supporting Teamcenter or a similar PLM platform and has a strong foundation in PLM concepts and engineering system integrations.

This role is intended to be based in Dallas, TX.

lists.content:
• Administer, support, and maintain PLM systems, primarily Siemens Teamcenter
  • Perform system configuration, upgrades, patching, and routine maintenance across PLM environments (production and test)
  • Support multi-tier PLM architecture including web, enterprise, and database layers
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and resolve incidents impacting engineering users
  • Support environment management, including refreshes, deployments, and basic automation of repeatable tasks
  • Assist with implementation of new features, modules, and system enhancements
  • Provide day-to-day support to engineering users, including issue resolution, training, and documentation
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, engineering, and business systems teams to support integrations with ERP, MES, and other enterprise systems
  • Maintain system documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
  • Work with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and improve system capabilities

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3–5 years of experience administering or supporting PLM systems (Teamcenter preferred; other PLM platforms acceptable)
  • Working knowledge of PLM concepts, including product structures, workflows, and lifecycle management
  • Experience supporting Windows and/or Linux server environments
  • Familiarity with system administration fundamentals (patching, monitoring, backups, troubleshooting)
  • Basic understanding of database-backed applications and multi-tier architectures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a customer-focused mindset
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

• Hands-on experience with Siemens Teamcenter (installation, configuration, or support)
  • Experience with CAD integrations (e.g., NX, SolidWorks, CATIA)
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud or virtualization platforms (Azure, VMware, or similar)
  • Experience supporting engineering or manufacturing environments
  • Familiarity with system integrations across PLM, ERP, or MES platforms
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth or defense-related environment

Job Description:
Shield AI is redefining autonomous aviation with cutting-edge AI and GPS/RF-denied navigation technologies. Now, we’re building our next-generation aircraft, XBAT, like no other—one that will push the boundaries of innovation and performance.
 
We are looking for an entry-level Power Electronics Engineer who is excited to help bring X-BAT’s next-generation power systems to first flight. In this role, you will own a meaningful project directly tied to our power architecture critical path, while receiving direct mentorship from senior power and electrical engineers. We value first-principles thinking, hands-on engineering, and extreme ownership.

lists.content:
• Own a power electronics design that directly impacts X-BAT system performance and major flight test milestones, supported by a senior engineer who provides technical guidance and review.
  • Contribute to the full hardware lifecycle including concept development, modeling, worst-case analysis, schematic capture, simulation, prototyping, bring-up, verification, integration, and flight test support.
  • Design and analyze low-voltage and high-voltage power systems including DC-DC converters, inverters, motor controllers, battery systems, power distribution, and protection circuits.
  • Design systems across power ranges from <1 kW low-power loads to >10 kW high-power applications while balancing efficiency, thermal constraints, EMI/EMC performance, and reliability.
  • Partner with ECAD engineers on PCB layout for power density, thermal performance, EMI mitigation, and manufacturability.
  • Execute hands-on board bring-up, debug, root-cause analysis, and validation using oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and other test equipment.
  • Support environmental, stress, and qualification testing (HALT, vibration, temperature cycling) for aerospace-grade reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Embedded, Software, Production, and Aircraft teams to ensure robust system integration and clear interface ownership.
  • Drive disciplined engineering practices including documentation, risk reduction, and closing the loop between analysis and test results.

• B.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Strong technical fundamentals in circuits, electronics, and power systems.
  • Hands-on experience (coursework, labs, clubs, or internships) with power electronics such as converters, motor drivers, batteries, or high-power systems.
  • Familiarity with electrical design tools (Altium, KiCad, etc.).
  • Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, e-loads, and multimeters.
  • Participation in an engineering team/club or hands-on project experience.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state of the art aircraft? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates?  Shield AI is just the place for you!
 
As a Senior Staff Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will lead the design, analysis, and integration of aircraft avionics thermal management systems. As a Senior Staff Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will lead the design, analysis, and integration of aircraft avionics thermal management systems. We are designing a high voltage, high power system using custom power electronics and energy storage. This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can bridge technical disciplines with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to simplify and communicate complex problems. lists.content:
• Own thermal analysis and design efforts for unmanned aerial vehicle avionics including custom power electronics
  • Develop and validate analytical, numerical, and computational models for heat transfer and fluid flow using hand calculations and CFD tools such as FloEFD
  • Provide technical leadership in trade studies, system architecture decisions, and risk assessments
  • Lead cross-functional teams designing power electronic circuits and environmental enclosures. Provide design requirements that impact circuit part selection, board layout, material selection, and other design aspects
  • Drive test planning, instrumentation, and data analysis to correlate models with experimental results
  • Mentor junior engineers and guide cross-disciplinary teams in applying thermal/fluid fundamentals
  • Communicate technical findings clearly through executive-level briefings, design reviews, and written reports
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and influence electrical and/or PCBA design direction

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline
  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience in avionics or electronics thermal engineering
  • Strong expertise in heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and fluid mechanics
  • Deep understanding of active and passive cooling solutions and their integration at component and system level
  • Deep understanding of thermal management design elements including TIMs, spreaders, heat sinks, vapor chambers, heat pipes, and fans
  • Proficiency with thermal analysis and CFD tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, STAR-CCM+)
  • Proficiency with CAD design tools such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar
  • Demonstrated experience applying first-principles reasoning to complex engineering problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of leading technical discussions and presenting to stakeholders
  • Proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new tools, processes, and technical challenges in a fast paced, startup environment
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

lists.content:

  • Setup and operate battery energy storage systems for testing 

  • Configure instrumentation, sensors, fixtures, harnesses and data-acquisition equipment 

  • Execute test campaigns for electromechanical or electrochemical subsystems, verifying voltage rails, logic levels, performance, thermal behavior and overall functionality  

  • Perform testing, debugging and system-level troubleshooting  

  • Collect and evaluate test data, identify abnormal behavior and communicate findings  

  • Support environmental qualification testing, including temperature, vibration, altitude and humidity  

  • Install, verify, and deploy DC-sources, power converters, test fixtures and harnesses

Job Description:
The Marketing Team at Shield AI is hiring a Slide Designer to design high-impact presentation decks primarily in PowerPoint, translating complex ideas into clear, compelling visual narratives. You will take rough content, outlines, and stakeholder input and transform them into polished, presentation-ready slides with strong structure, hierarchy, and flow. This role requires a deep focus on storytelling through slides, balancing clarity, visual precision, and executive-level polish across a range of use cases.
You will partner closely with marketing, business development, product marketing, and solutions engineering teams to shape messaging and build effective presentations from the ground up. A core part of the role is owning and maintaining key PowerPoint assets, including templates, slide masters, reusable components, and flagship product decks. You will help evolve scalable template systems and slide libraries to ensure consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the organization.
In addition, you will apply advanced PowerPoint capabilities such as custom layouts, animations, transitions, charts, and visual systems to elevate storytelling. You will iterate quickly on feedback, balance high-volume, fast-turn requests with more strategic, high-visibility presentations, and maintain organized files and version control. This role also requires careful handling of sensitive or export-controlled material when applicable.

Job Description:
The Lead Edge Applications and Mission System is responsible to drive the technical direction, architecture, and delivery of our edge application platform for autonomous systems. This platform connects operators, autonomous platforms, mission data, and external command-and-control systems, supporting applications ranging from single-vehicle ground control to coordinated fleet operations and theater-level mission planning and execution. 
You will shape a platform that customers and partners can readily integrate, extend, and adapt to new missions. The scope includes ground control stations (GCS), command and control (C2), integration with battle-management systems (BMS), fleet and configuration management, and agentic workflows that help operators plan, supervise, and manage autonomous robotic systems. 
As the technical lead, you will combine deep defense-domain knowledge with strong software engineering judgment and a record of shipping operational products. You will remain directly involved in architecture, critical implementation work, and technical problem-solving while aligning engineering teams, product leaders, customers, and other stakeholders around a clear technical roadmap.

Job Description:

The Lead Edge Applications and Mission System is responsible to drive the technical direction, architecture, and delivery of our edge application platform for autonomous systems. This platform connects operators, autonomous platforms, mission data, and external command-and-control systems, supporting applications ranging from single-vehicle ground control to coordinated fleet operations and theater-level mission planning and execution. 

You will shape a platform that customers and partners can readily integrate, extend, and adapt to new missions. The scope includes ground control stations (GCS), command and control (C2), integration with battle-management systems (BMS), fleet and configuration management, and agentic workflows that help operators plan, supervise, and manage autonomous robotic systems. 

As the technical lead, you will combine deep defense-domain knowledge with strong software engineering judgment and a record of shipping operational products. You will remain directly involved in architecture, critical implementation work, and technical problem-solving while aligning engineering teams, product leaders, customers, and other stakeholders around a clear technical roadmap.

lists.content:
• Own the platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture across operator applications, backend services, mission data, integration interfaces, and edge deployment environments. Establish boundaries that allow teams to deliver capabilities independently while maintaining a coherent product. 
  • Enable the full range of mission applications. Guide the evolution from single-vehicle GCS workflows to multi-vehicle supervision, heterogeneous fleet operations, and applications supporting theater-level planning, execution monitoring, and battlespace management. 
  • Make customer extensibility a core capability. Establish APIs, SDKs, shared data models, extension mechanisms, and integration tooling that help customers and partners add platforms, data sources, applications, and workflows quickly. Preserve compatibility as the platform evolves. 
  • Lead C2 and BMS interoperability. Guide integration with external mission systems and comparable defense C2 environments. Enable the aggregation and exchange of vehicle state, mission information, sensor-derived data, and operational context. 
  • Advance operator and agentic workflows. Partner with autonomy, AI, product, and design teams to deliver intuitive planning, supervision, execution, and debrief experiences. Define clear operator authority, approval boundaries, observability, and evaluation criteria for AI-assisted workflows. 
  • Own fleet and configuration architecture. Establish capabilities for asset inventory, readiness and health monitoring, software and configuration versioning, compatibility management, controlled updates, rollback, and traceability across deployed autonomous systems. 
  • Engineer for edge applications in contested environment. Design for intermittent connectivity, constrained bandwidth and compute, distributed state, and recovery from partial failures. Ensure useful and predictable behavior in disconnected and degraded environments. 
  • Drive the technical roadmap and execution. Translate product strategy, customer needs, and operational feedback into architectural priorities, milestones, and measurable deliverables. Resolve dependencies and make explicit tradeoffs among near-term delivery, platform investment, reliability, and technical debt. 
  • Lead products through customer deployment. Partner with integration, test, field, and customer teams from initial requirements through acceptance, deployment, and sustainment. Use field experience, telemetry, and customer feedback to improve subsequent releases.

• 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, or an equivalent record of technical depth and impact, including substantial responsibility for complex production systems. 
  • 5+ years providing technical leadership as a technical lead, architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent, with demonstrated influence across multiple teams and ownership of significant architectural decisions. 
  • Deep experience developing defense GCS and C2 applications, with working knowledge of mission planning, mission execution, operator workflows, and integration with broader battle-management environments. 
  • A demonstrated record of shipping and sustaining software products for defense customers, including responsibility for operational deployment, customer acceptance, and improvements informed by field use. 
  • Strong software architecture and implementation skills across distributed systems, application services, APIs, data management, and operator-facing software. 
  • Experience building extensible platforms used by multiple teams and external customers, including interface design, reusable capabilities, versioning, and integration across organizational boundaries. 
  • Experience with autonomous robotics applications, including fleet operations, configuration management, telemetry, and interactions between ground applications and platform-side autonomy. 
  • Strong understanding of networked systems and edge deployments, including performance, reliability, security, and behavior under limited or interrupted connectivity. 
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer and stakeholder needs into technical roadmaps, executable plans, and delivered capabilities; excellent written and verbal communication. 
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Direct experience developing or integrating platforms such as Lattice, other extensible defense C2/BMS products, or comparable mission-management systems. 
  • Experience with multi-domain operations, heterogeneous autonomous fleets, and the relationship between tactical GCS applications and higher-echelon mission systems. 
  • Experience delivering agentic or AI-assisted applications, including workflow orchestration, human-machine teaming, evaluation, and operator supervision. 
  • Experience with geospatial applications, common operational pictures, mission rehearsal, telemetry replay, or post-mission analysis. 
  • Experience with secure software delivery into defense environments, including collaboration with cybersecurity and authorization teams.

Job Description:

Shield AI is pioneering AI pilots for aircraft that protect service members and civilians - pushing the boundaries of autonomous flight. V-BAT is designed for deployment in the most demanding, high-stakes environments. 

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our team, focused on the design, integration and troubleshooting of electronics systems critical to our aircraft. This role is perfect for an engineer with a solid foundation in power, embedded and control systems who is eager to grow, own challenging projects, and see their work move rapidly from concept to flight. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help build the future of autonomous aviation, we want to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Own flight critical avionics designs for V-BAT
  • Own circuit and sub-system design for V-BAT and its support equipment. This includes complex system architectures utilizing custom circuitry (power management, analog, digital, servos, microcontrollers, sensors, radios, etc.)  
  • Lead others to execute design, verification, and manufacturing deployment
  • Provide mentorship and technical feedback to others on the power team and cross-functionally
  • Harden the designs for harsh environments such as shock/vibe, high reliability, radiation, and high-altitude
  • Full-cycle hardware development: Own the entire flow - concept, modeling, worst case analysis, schematic capture, simulation, prototyping, design reiteration for improving design maturity, testing and validation
  • PCB ownership: Drive PCB layout and design with ECAD engineers, optimizing for power density, EMI, thermal, and manufacturability
  • Design for Safety, Manufacturability and Reliability: Design robust systems keeping in mind best practices for safety, manufacturing and reliability
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Mechanical, CAD, Embedded, Software, Supply Chain, Test Automation, Production and various aircraft teams throughout the product lifecycle
  • Design review leadership: Lead and contribute to cross-functional reviews ensuring robust, high-integrity engineering decisions. Mentor junior engineers that support your design
  • Program execution: Manage project timelines, deliverables, and technical milestones to drive on-time, high-quality outcomes
  • Help define technical product requirements and features

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering; or equivalent work experience 
  • You have 10+ years of industry experience as an Electrical Engineer 
  • Strong technical fundamentals
  • You are experienced with: circuit design, schematic capture, component selection, circuit testing, and debugging
  • You have a demonstrated record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement within hardware development projects, demonstrating initiative to propose and implement innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and overall project success and aircraft reliability

Lead the software architecture for Shield AI’s XBAT program across Mission, Vehicle, and Autonomy software domains. Build a safe, secure, and scalable architecture that enables high‑assurance, cyber‑relevant software development for an advanced airborne system and its ground stations, reporting to the XBAT Software Lead.

lists.content:
• Define and evolve the system‑wide software architecture for XBAT, spanning airborne vehicle, ground station, and autonomy layers. 
  • Translate safety and security goals into technical requirements, standards, and design patterns that guide engineers across multiple software teams. 
  • Ensure architecture supports safety‑critical and cyber‑relevant workflows. This includes formalizing architecture decisions, traceability, and compliance pathways appropriate for advanced airborne systems. 
  • Drive cross‑team alignment on APIs, data flows, fault handling, verification strategy, and risk management so mission, vehicle, and autonomy components integrate cleanly. 
  • Partner with engineering leadership, system architects, and validation teams to balance innovation speed with rigorous assurance practices. 
  • Set technical direction for long‑term scalability: modularity, maintainability, testability, and support for future capability growth or certification needs. 
  • Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising the bar for design rigor, documentation quality, and architectural judgment across the organization. 
  • Produce and maintain architecture artifacts: high‑level system diagrams, component interfaces, data models, risk analyses, and design rationales. 
  • Lead technical reviews for major features, changes, or integration points; ensure alignment with architectural standards and safety/security constraints. 
  • Define architecture governance: decision records, change control processes, quality gates, and collaboration flows among development, verification, and operations. 
  • Collaborate with systems, hardware, and avionics teams to manage boundaries, timing, resource allocation, and failure modes that affect overall aircraft and mission performance. 
  • Drive technology evaluation and roadmap: select or validate frameworks, middleware, and tooling that meet performance, assurance, and cyber‑hardening needs. 
  • Support external or internal readiness evaluations: provide architectural evidence, participate in reviews, and help the program articulate compliance posture as requirements evolve. 
  • Advocate for continuous improvement in architecture practice: metrics, architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and onboarding for new team members.

• Deep expertise in software architecture for complex, multi‑domain systems—ideally aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, or similarly safety‑critical fields. 
  • Proven track record designing and delivering production software that must satisfy stringent safety, security, or mission assurance requirements. 
  • Strong systems thinking: able to navigate tradeoffs across performance, latency, reliability, testability, and certification or compliance considerations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to convey architecture vision and rationale to engineers, program leads, and stakeholders. 
  • Experience driving architecture adoption and discipline across multiple teams, not just authoring designs in isolation. 
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Familiarity with aerospace software assurance frameworks or standards that guide high‑assurance airborne software development.  
  • Experience working on or integrating autonomy, mission planning, or AI‑enabled software into real‑world systems. 
  • Strong understanding of cyber hardening and secure design practices for distributed or networked vehicle systems and ground infrastructure. 
  • Prior leadership or mentor role with responsibility for building and scaling architecture practices and design culture in a fast‑moving engineering organization. 
  • Experience dealing with constrained platforms: real‑time requirements, limited compute, or avionics‑style integration challenges. 
  • Hands‑on experience in VTOL or other advanced aircraft programs, or in programs that require austere operations, long‑range operations, or resilient autonomy. 
  • Exposure to end‑to‑end product lifecycle from concept through flight test or operational deployment. 
  • Practical knowledge of modern software tooling that supports traceability, CI/CD, automated verification, static analysis, or high‑assurance pipelines. 
  • Comfort working in a highly collaborative, fast‑paced environment where requirements can evolve quickly and architecture must adapt without losing rigor.

lists.content:
• Own the design of propulsion components and subsystems from concept through production release
  • Develop and maintain high-quality CAD models, detailed drawings, and assemblies using Siemens NX with fully applied GD&T
  • Write and enforce propulsion design standards and contribute to company-wide design best practices
  • Collaborate closely with the machine shop, production team, and technicians to support builds, resolve non-conformances, and drive iterative improvements
  • Develop initial work instructions, assembly guidance, and design documentation for repeatability and scalability
  • Ensure designs are practical, manufacturable, and cost-effective, with strong understanding of machining, tolerances, materials, and assembly workflows
  • Apply engineering analysis and judgment (e.g., hand calcs, GFSSP, ANSYS, FEA, REFPROP) to support sizing, load cases, and design validation
  • Support configuration management, BOM control, and change processes using Teamcenter or equivalent PLM
  • Participate in design reviews, interface control working groups, and root cause investigations

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in mechanical design for aerospace, with direct propulsion hardware experience preferred
  • Expert-level proficiency in CAD modeling and drawing creation (NX preferred) and application of GD&T
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with production, machine shop personnel, and technicians to solve real-time hardware issues
  • Familiarity with design for manufacturing, including machining processes, surface modeling, stack-up analysis, and fabrication limitations
  • Hands-on experience developing assembly work instructions, troubleshooting build issues, and implementing hardware-driven design changes
  • Experience with configuration management, PLM systems (Teamcenter), and BOM structure
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements; Ability to obtain Secret clearance

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with GFSSP, REFPROP, ANSYS, FEA, or other mechanical and thermal analysis tools
  • Ability to write Python scripts for design automation, data analysis, or simulation support
  • Proficient in interface control and tolerance stack-up analysis for complex assemblies
  • Knowledge of fastening methods and joint design for high-vibration, aerospace environments
  • Familiarity with high-temperature materials and design practices for thermally stressed components
  • Prior experience designing hardware for internal combustion, turbine, or rocket propulsion systems, particularly in development or test environments
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

descriptionPlain:
Principal Technical Program Manager — Ranger
Shield AI’s mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We develop autonomy software and advanced aircraft to help U.S. and allied forces accomplish their missions in challenging environments.
About the Role
Shield AI is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead execution of our aircraft development efforts supporting the U.S. Air Force’s Ranger program. This leader will translate customer objectives into an integrated execution plan spanning concept development, aircraft and mission systems integration, prototype demonstration, flight test, and production readiness.
You will partner closely with the program leader, Chief Engineer, engineering teams, manufacturing, supply chain, and government stakeholders to deliver against technical, schedule, and cost commitments. Success requires balancing mission capability with affordability, modularity, and speed—making disciplined decisions about what must be developed, what can be reused, and what is required to demonstrate readiness for the next phase.
The ideal candidate combines engineering depth with program leadership experience and a record of delivering complex aerospace systems under demanding timelines. You can challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and build alignment across organizations while maintaining clear ownership of program outcomes.
 
What You’ll Do
Own integrated program execution. Establish and maintain the program baseline, connecting engineering deliverables, hardware availability, supplier commitments, integration activities, test events, and customer milestones.
Translate customer needs into executable plans. Partner with systems engineering and technical leadership to define program scope, measurable success criteria, requirements priorities, and verification milestones as the program evolves.
Drive multidisciplinary coordination. Align air vehicle, propulsion, avionics, flight controls, autonomy, mission systems, and ground systems teams around dependencies and interface commitments.
Keep affordability and production at the center of execution. Incorporate unit-cost targets, component availability, manufacturing complexity, and sustainment considerations into program planning and decision-making.
Manage customer and partner commitments. Lead program reviews with government stakeholders and industry partners, communicate progress candidly, and coordinate contractual deliverables with contracts and program leadership.
Anticipate and retire risk. Identify critical-path threats, immature technologies, supplier constraints, and resource gaps early; assign mitigation owners and drive timely resolution.
Build the path to production. Align development schedules with tooling, long-lead procurement, manufacturing readiness, configuration control, and quality requirements.
Provide clear executive visibility. Present concise assessments of milestone confidence, financial performance, technical progress, and decisions requiring leadership action.
 
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of progressive experience in aerospace engineering, technical program management, or complex hardware and software development.

Job Description:
Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state of the art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates?  Shield AI is just the place for you!
 
As a Sr. Staff Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will lead the design, analysis, and integration of aircraft avionics thermal management systems, with opportunities to flex into aircraft-level thermal and fluid systems.
 
This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can bridge technical disciplines with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to simplify and communicate complex problems. The engineer will be a key contributor in shaping designs, mentoring peers, and ensuring robust thermal solutions that meet mission-critical aerospace requirements.

Job Description:

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state of the art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!

As a Principal Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own the technical direction, architecture, and development of aircraft avionics thermal management systems, with scope spanning aircraft-level thermal and fluid systems. You will lead complex, cross-functional engineering efforts and establish thermal design strategies that support performance, reliability, and scalability across aircraft platforms and programs.

This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can bridge technical disciplines with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to simplify and communicate complex problems. The engineer will serve as a technical authority, shaping system architectures, resolving critical technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and driving robust thermal solutions that meet mission-critical aerospace requirements.

lists.content:
• Own thermal architecture, analysis, and design strategy for unmanned aerial vehicle avionics and aircraft-level thermal/fluid systems across programs.

  • Lead cross-functional trade studies and technical decisions, balancing thermal performance with power, weight, volume, reliability, manufacturability, and aircraft integration constraints.

  • Develop and validate analytical, numerical, and computational models for heat transfer and fluid flow using hand calculations and CFD tools such as FloEFD, and establish modeling standards and best practices.

  • Define verification and validation strategies, guiding test planning, instrumentation, and data analysis to correlate models with experimental results and resolve critical performance risks.

  • Serve as a technical authority in executive-level briefings, design reviews, and customer discussions, communicating complex findings and driving alignment on technical direction.

  • Proactively identify and retire system-level risks, influence electrical and/or PCBA design direction, and drive resolution of complex interfaces across avionics, mechanical, and aircraft systems.

  • Establish reusable thermal design methods and solutions, mentor engineers, and strengthen thermal engineering capabilities across the organization.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.

  • Minimum 12 years of professional experience in avionics or electronics thermal engineering, including technical leadership of complex, multidisciplinary systems.

  • Strong expertise in heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and fluid mechanics, with demonstrated ability to apply this expertise to system architecture and critical design decisions.

  • Deep understanding of active and passive cooling solutions and their integration at component, subsystem, and aircraft level.

  • Deep understanding of thermal management design elements including TIMs, spreaders, heat sinks, vapor chambers, heat pipes, and fans.

  • Proficiency with thermal analysis and CFD tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, STAR-CCM+), including experience establishing modeling approaches and evaluating analysis quality.

  • Proficiency with CAD design tools such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar.

  • Demonstrated experience applying first-principles reasoning to complex engineering problems and resolving ambiguous technical challenges with significant system-level impact.

  • Proven track record of owning thermal architecture and delivering thermal management solutions from concept through integration, verification, and validation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional technical decisions and presenting to executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, establish engineering best practices, and lead technical efforts across teams or programs.

  • Proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new tools, processes, and technical challenges in a fast paced, startup environment.

  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• M.S. or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering discipline.

  • Experience leading high altitude aircraft avionics cooling and thermal design.

  • Experience defining thermal architectures within aircraft integration constraints (power, weight, volume, maintainability, safety).

  • Hands-on experience developing thermal and fluid system test strategies and guiding instrumentation, validation, and root-cause investigations.

  • Knowledge of materials and manufacturing methods relevant to thermal management (pumps, heat exchangers, composites, etc.).

  • Experience leading trade studies, shaping proposals, and serving as a technical representative in customer interactions on aerospace or defense programs.

Job Description:
The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO's vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. Individuals within this team make direct and at times forward-sprinting contributions to all three pillars of Hivemind, Shield AI's software ecosystem for developing and deploying resilient intelligent teaming for aircrafts. Hivemind consists of four products: EdgeOS (C++ based high-performance middleware for autonomy development), Pilot (autonomy for the edge built atop EdgeOS; a models-based, modular and open architecture C++ codebase), Forge (Shield AI's AI Factory for the design, development, and testing of Hivemind Edge systems; a service-oriented architecture leveraged through an SDK, CLI, and web portal; a Go, Python, Typescript codebase), Commander (Software and hardware to support rich human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interactions with the Hivemind; a C++-based back-end for interaction with Pilot; and a web-application UI for mission planning, command and control by operators implemented in a Typescript/React codebase).
The Special Projects team is chartered to operate effectively within ambiguity. While this team does not own any software products, it tactically and strategically impacts the development of all foundational Hivemind products and leverages those technologies to rapidly deliver low-TRL solutions. This work happens shoulder-to-shoulder with the product teams in some cases, and in a forward-sprinting manner within the Special Projects team in other cases. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.

lists.content:
• Design and build the user experience for agentic AI products across the office of the CTO: an enterprise knowledge assistant (Brain), an agent-driven engineering platform (Springboard), and enterprise AI/data applications.
  • Prototype in code. Ship working React/TypeScript implementations, not mockups — then land them in production with the product teams.
  • Design the core interaction patterns of agentic software: streaming responses, citations and provenance, multi-modal input, artifact sharing, and human-in-the-loop review and approval surfaces.
  • Design interfaces for foundation-model based autonomy architectures and model lifecycle tooling: evaluation dashboards, trace inspection, observability, and verification surfaces.
  • Conduct user research across engineers, operators, and executives; define personae and translate findings into design decisions.

• 12+ years designing and building production software interfaces, with end-to-end ownership from research through shipped product.
  • Expert-level React/TypeScript; you write production-quality front-end code, not just prototypes.
  • Portfolio of shipped tools or applications demonstrating strong interaction design and visual craft.
  • Hands-on experience designing LLM-powered experiences: streaming, progressive rendering, loading states, context and conversation management.
  • Deep knowledge of client and UI state management, the DOM, browser APIs, WebSockets, and Server-Sent Events.
  • Experience running user research and usability testing, and acting on the results.
  • Strong software hygiene: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD.
  • Fluid intelligence that allows one to operate effectively in ambiguous conditions while finding opportunities to drive technical efforts and force multiply.
  • Experience with Linux, Docker, and a major cloud platform (Azure, GCP, AWS).
  • This role requires travel to a Shield AI location 1-3 times per quarter

• Experience designing developer tools, IDEs, or engineering workflow products.
  • Data visualization experience (D3, WebGL, dashboards); geospatial a plus.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system.
  • Experience designing debugging/inspection UIs for generative AI systems.
  • Experience with Electron (or similar).
  • Experience with user experience design for video games or interactive media.
  • Experience designing for "low code" or "no code" systems.
  • Comfort reading C++ and/or Python and/or Go.

Job Description:

The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO's vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. Individuals within this team make direct and at times forward-sprinting contributions to all three pillars of Hivemind, Shield AI's software ecosystem for developing and deploying resilient intelligent teaming for aircrafts. Hivemind consists of four products: EdgeOS (C++ based high-performance middleware for autonomy development), Pilot (autonomy for the edge built atop EdgeOS; a models-based, modular and open architecture C++ codebase), Forge (Shield AI's AI Factory for the design, development, and testing of Hivemind Edge systems; a service-oriented architecture leveraged through an SDK, CLI, and web portal; a Go, Python, Typescript codebase), Commander (Software and hardware to support rich human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interactions with the Hivemind; a C++-based back-end for interaction with Pilot; and a web-application UI for mission planning, command and control by operators implemented in a Typescript/React codebase).

The Special Projects team is chartered to operate effectively within ambiguity. While this team does not own any software products, it tactically and strategically impacts the development of all foundational Hivemind products and leverages those technologies to rapidly deliver low-TRL solutions. This work happens shoulder-to-shoulder with the product teams in some cases, and in a forward-sprinting manner within the Special Projects team in other cases. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.

Shield AI is seeking a Product Portfolio Analyst, X-BAT Family of Systems (FoS)  to strengthen the analytical rigor, long-range planning, and operating discipline of the X-BAT FoS Capture organization.
As a core member of the X-BAT FoS Product team, you will partner closely with the  X-BAT FoS Product Organization to maintain a high-confidence view of the current and future opportunity pipeline and assist in driving decisive action across the portfolio. As a core member of the X-BAT FoS Product team, you will partner closely with the  X-BAT FoS Product Organization to maintain a high-confidence view of the current and future opportunity pipeline and assist in driving decisive action across the portfolio. You will turn pipeline data into actionable insights that inform prioritization, resource decisions, revenue planning, and long-term growth strategy.

This role owns the integrity and quality of X-BAT FoS portfolio pipeline information in Salesforce and related reporting tools and will establish the standards, review the data for completeness and credibility, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and drive corrective actions across the portfolio.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, experience working with CRM and business-planning data, comfort partnering with Finance, and the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations. This role will help ensure X-BAT FoS maintains a resilient pipeline across near-term pursuits and a three- to ten-year opportunity horizon.

lists.content:
Product Portfolio Strategy and Management
  • Maintain an integrated view of the X-BAT FoS opportunity pipeline across near-term, mid-term, and long-range pursuits.
  • Analyze opportunities using criteria including timing, estimated value, probability of win, market attractiveness, strategic relevance, expected revenue contribution, and resourcing requirements.
  • Partner with the X-BAT FoS Capture Organization to identify priority opportunities, inform portfolio trade-space decisions, and recommend actions to strengthen the pipeline.
  • Track changes in opportunity value, timing, stage progression, probability of win, customer funding, and other factors that affect forecast confidence.
  • Identify pipeline gaps, timing shortfalls, concentration risks, single-point dependencies, and opportunities that lack sufficient capture activity or next steps.
  • Recommend actions to create pipeline resilience, including alternate pursuits, adjacent customers, related mission areas, acquisition pathways, partner opportunities, and additional sources of demand.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of the X-BAT FoS opportunity space across a multi-year horizon and help identify and track actions needed to mature early opportunities into successful capture efforts.
    • Salesforce Data Quality and Reporting
  • Serve as the X-BAT FoS Capture organization’s lead for pipeline-data integrity, reporting standards, and Salesforce opportunity-management discipline.
  • Establish and maintain common expectations for opportunity stages, required data fields, forecast assumptions, probability assessments, next steps, and update cadence.
  • Review Salesforce opportunity records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and credibility; coordinate with account and opportunity owners to correct gaps, stale data, and unsupported assumptions.
  • Develop and maintain concise dashboards, trackers, and pipeline-review products that provide visibility into portfolio health, capture status, forecast changes, and key risks.
  • Partner with enterprise business-systems teams, as required, to improve reports, dashboards, workflows, and data structures that support X-BAT FoS pipeline management.
  • Maintain common definitions, reporting guidance, and pipeline-management best practices across the organization.
    • Finance and Revenue Planning
  • Partner closely with Finance to ensure a clear, traceable connection between Salesforce opportunity data, bookings assumptions, revenue forecasts, customer funding expectations, and long-range financial plans.
  • Reconcile pipeline assumptions, forecast timing, probability assessments, and anticipated award values with financial-planning inputs and revenue-recognition assumptions.
  • Support scenario analysis to assess the effect of opportunity delays, funding changes, competitive losses, scope changes, and alternate capture outcomes on the X-BAT FoS forecast.
  • Help maintain a recurring pipeline-to-finance review cadence and track resulting actions, decisions, and assumption changes.
    • Pipeline Risk and Operating Rigor
  • Identify risks to current and future pipeline health, including schedule uncertainty, customer-funding risk, acquisition delays, competitive pressure, overreliance on a limited number of pursuits, and insufficient capture activity.
  • Develop risk-mitigation recommendations and contingency plans with capture leads, account owners, Finance, business development, programs, and other stakeholders.
  • Support recurring pipeline reviews through time-phased analyses and dashboards that show opportunity maturation, anticipated awards, bookings, backlog, revenue contribution, key decisions, and follow-up actions.
  • Support knowledge management by maintaining pipeline assumptions, opportunity histories, risk registers, and lessons learned from wins, losses, cancellations, and schedule slips.

• Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience or Master’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in business development, capture, sales operations, program management, finance, consulting, or another analytical operating environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate incomplete or changing data and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Experience using Salesforce to analyze opportunity data, maintain pipeline visibility, develop reports or dashboards, and support business-planning decisions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including development of concise analyses, trackers, dashboards, and briefing materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage data quality, establish reporting standards, and coordinate updates across multiple record owners or stakeholders.
  • Experience evaluating opportunities based on timing, value, probability, customer funding, strategic relevance, and expected business impact.
  • Experience leading and delivering cross-functional deliverables, decision points, and follow-up actions across multiple concurrent efforts.
  • U.S. citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

• Experience supporting U.S. Government capture, defense business development, or government-contracting pipeline management.
  • Aviation, aerospace, defense, autonomy, uncrewed systems, tactical aviation, mission systems, AI-enabled capability, or advanced-manufacturing experience.
  • Familiarity with DoD or U.S. Government acquisition processes, budget cycles, requirements development, solicitations, and program-of-record pathways.
  • Experience developing or improving Salesforce reports, dashboards, opportunity-management processes, data governance, workflow automation, or CRM reporting.
  • Experience supporting domestic and international defense pursuits, including Foreign Military Sales, Direct Commercial Sales, or allied defense-market development.

Shield AI’s Advanced Programs Division is seeking a Product Strategy & Operations Sr. Lead, Advanced Programs to strengthen the strategy, proposal development, and daily operations of the Advanced Programs organization.
 
The successful candidate will thrive in organizing and leading cross-functional teams, proposal management, vetting opportunities, and supporting capture activities for major prime opportunities within defense advanced programs. You will translate customer requirements and Shield AI’s engineering solutions into persuasive, compliant proposals that deliver a clear, cohesive, and compelling message.
 
In this role you will combine skills that include operations, proposal management, capture support, strategy, and serve as a key member of the product strategy capture team. The successful candidate is equally comfortable operating strategically and executing with discipline. You can challenge assumptions, sharpen a win strategy, lead a matrixed team through compressed timelines, and maintain momentum through color-team reviews and final production. You will work closely with Business Development, Engineering, Program Management, Customer Engagement, Finance, Contracts, and executive leadership.
 
If you thrive in high-performing environments, demonstrate extreme ownership, and enjoy turning complex opportunities into winning proposals, we would like to meet you!

lists.content:
Partner with Capture Leads and business leaders to develop proposal strategies, win themes, discriminators, customer-focused value propositions, and compelling proposal narratives. 
  • Lead cross-functional proposal-related efforts spanning Business Development, Engineering, Program Management, Customer Engagement, Finance, Contracts, and other key functions.
  • Translate customer mission needs, operational requirements, acquisition strategy, evaluation criteria, and technical constraints into compliant and persuasive proposal content.
  • Establish and manage integrated proposal plans, schedules, compliance matrices, content plans, volume outlines, writing assignments, review cycles, production plans, and submission activities.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive development of proposal artifacts across technical, management, cost, past performance, and executive volumes, ensuring message consistency and alignment with the capture strategy.
  • Develop leadership-ready strategy presentations, pursuit-planning materials, internal decision-support products, and capture artifacts.
  • Lead development of analytically rigorous responses to RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, white papers, capability statements, and other customer-facing materials.
  • Facilitate and lead proposal reviews, including blue team, black hat, pink, red, gold, and executive reviews; prepare review teams; adjudicate comments; and drive corrective actions to closure.
  • Monitor and help qualify relevant government and consortium opportunities through http://SAM.gov , customer distribution lists, industry channels, and consortium networks.
  • Travel between Shield AI locations, partner sites, and customer locations as required.

• Track proposal and solicitation-response activity across the Advanced Programs portfolio, including milestones, owners, dependencies, reviews, risks, and key decision points.
  • Develop and maintain capture trackers, reporting mechanisms, operating cadences, and dashboards that provide clear visibility into active pursuits and proposal progress.
  • Support knowledge management and development of reusable capture tools, templates, content, and best practices.

• Active secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 12+ years’ experience in defense and 3+ years of direct proposal manager, business development operations, or capture manager experience, including large-scale defense prime proposals valued at $250M+.
  • Proven ability to lead matrixed teams through complex proposal development cycles involving technical, management, cost, pricing, contracts, and executive stakeholders.
  • The ability to convert customer mission needs and engineering solutions into clear, compelling proposal content and differentiated win themes.
  • Demonstrated mastery of proposal compliance, customer instructions, evaluation criteria, proposal schedules, volume management, color-team reviews, production, and final delivery.
  • Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Exceptional PowerPoint, written communication, editing, and quality-control skills.
  • Strong analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate complex information into actionable outputs.
  • A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, humility, and bias toward action.

• Active TS/SCI clearance and experience in advanced programs.
  • Experience leading large defense-program captures as a prime contractor, particularly for weapons or similarly complex platforms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in capture strategy, proposal strategy, customer engagement, competitive analysis, price-to-win, market analysis, and opportunity qualification.
  • Experience working with non-traditional defense companies, rapid-acquisition pathways, prototyping programs, and transition-to-program-of-record strategies.

lists.content:
• Serve as the propulsion SME for Fleet Support and the primary engineering point of contact for propulsion-related escalations.

  • Troubleshoot engine mechanical and hardware issues, including vibration, wear, leaks, mounting or interface issues, actuator concerns, and component failures.
  • Investigate fuel and oil system issues, including pressure, flow, filtration, contamination, venting, priming, lubrication, and thermal-management problems.
  • Analyze flight data, maintenance records, teardown findings, and field reports to identify failure modes and define corrective actions.

  • Partner with propulsion, air vehicle, quality, manufacturing, and supplier teams to drive permanent corrective actions and reliability improvements.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of experience in aircraft, rotorcraft, unmanned aircraft system, or propulsion engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with engine systems, fuel systems, oil systems, thermal behavior, vibration, and mechanical root-cause analysis.
  • Experience troubleshooting fielded hardware and working from ambiguous or incomplete failure reports.
  • Ability to analyze technical data from flight, test, maintenance, and inspection activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in cross-functional and customer-facing environments.
  • Ability to possess a Secret DoD security clearance as required by customers

• Experience with heavy-fuel or small-aircraft propulsion systems.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced field environments and supporting customer-site troubleshooting.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Propulsion Engineering Technician to join our advanced propulsion engineering team. You will be part of a small, high-performance group responsible for designing, building, and executing propulsion system tests that push the limits of autonomous aircraft capability. This role demands initiative, technical rigor, and the ability to define and execute test procedures for systems that have never been tested before.

You will design, fabricate, and maintain test fixtures and setups, develop and run test plans, and work hands-on with cutting-edge propulsion hardware and avionics. You will be involved in testing and qualifying prototype designs, first-article units, and hot-fire engine testing. Success in this role requires accountability, precision, and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

lists.content:
• Design, fabricate, assemble, and maintain custom test setups, fixtures, and instrumentation for engine and propulsion system validation.
  • Develop and execute test plans for experimental propulsion systems and components in collaboration with engineering.
  • Define and document test procedures and work instructions for new tests in environments with little or no precedent.
  • Fabricate mechanical and electrical test hardware using composites, machined parts, 3D printing, adhesives, and aerospace-grade fasteners.
  • Conduct and monitor propulsion system tests, including piston engine/propeller tests.
  • Operate and maintain instrumentation, data acquisition systems, and specialized calibration tools.
  • Support avionics integration, wire harness fabrication, and system-level electrical testing.
  • Analyze test data, document findings, and provide feedback to engineering teams to improve designs and testing methodologies.
  • Work closely with propulsion, mechanical, aerospace, structural, manufacturing, software, and electrical engineering teams to support R&D testing.
  • Execute cross-functional test campaigns when other teams’ hardware or software integrates with propulsion systems.
  • Ensure discipline, accuracy, and repeatability in all test results and reports.

• Proven experience designing and/or executing engineering test setups/fixtures, and test campaigns.
  • Ability to self-direct test planning and execution with minimal supervision.
  • Strong hands-on background in hardware or avionics fabrication, including machining, 3D printing, adhesive bonding, and/or wiring harnesses.
  • Proficiency with precision tools, calibrated measurement equipment, power tools, thread specifications, and torque procedures.
  • Comfortable working in shop and lab environments with exposure to noise, dust, and chemicals.
  • Ability to lift and move parts and equipment (up to 50 lbs.) and perform physical work for extended periods.

• Experience in aerospace propulsion or engine development.
  • Working knowledge of piston engines, preferably two-stroke.
  • Experience with avionics systems, sensors, harness fabrication, and R&D testing environments.
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, instrumentation calibration, and sensor integration.
  • Deep understanding of torque, fastener, and adhesive specifications for aerospace hardware.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze test data to inform engineering design decisions.
  • Experience with command line syntax or microcontroller programming (Arduino or similar).
