We are seeking a Senior Engineer, Operational Analyst to drive the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft systems. This role is pivotal in evaluating the mission effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our autonomy solutions across multiple platforms and domains. You will work closely with engineering, product development, and defense stakeholders to inform design trade-offs, assess system performance, and optimize mission capabilities.

This position requires a deep understanding of military operations, wargaming, modeling & simulation (M&S), analytic techniques, and operational analysis techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy by identifying how our AI-powered platforms can best serve the evolving needs of modern warfare.

• Develop and execute operational analysis strategies to assess the effectiveness of autonomous aircraft in real-world military scenarios.
  • Lead modeling, simulation, and wargaming efforts to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational insights into design decisions and system improvements.
  • Conduct trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance under varying operational conditions and threats.
  • Utilize advanced modeling & simulation tools (e.g., AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop high-fidelity mission models.
  • Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor effectiveness, and autonomy-driven decision-making to optimize mission success.
  • Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to understand mission needs and align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Support concept of operations (CONOPS) development for new AI-driven aircraft capabilities.
  • Identify emerging threats and operational challenges, ensuring Shield AI’s systems remain ahead of adversary capabilities.
  • Develop and present technical reports, briefings, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies.
  • Leverage modern compute and development best practices (e.g., scalable cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing) to build, run, and iterate high-fidelity simulation and analysis pipelines quickly and reliably.

• 5+ years of experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S), or military operations research.
  • Expertise in military mission analysis, operational planning, and wargaming methodologies.
  • Proficiency with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, or other M&S tools used for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Deep understanding of air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or autonomous systems in contested environments.
  • Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to align capabilities with mission requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to seamlessly apply modern compute, data science, and software development best practices (e.g., cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, Git-based version control, CI/CD, automated testing, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable simulations and analytics.
  • Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.

• Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven decision-making algorithms into operational analysis frameworks.
  • Prior military service or experience working with U.S. Air Force, Navy, or Special Operations Forces.
  • Experience using GenAI to structure problems and create simulation or analysis tools.
  • Active Secret or Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

Why This Role Exists:
We build and operate the platform that our engineers and our customers rely on.
The platform isn't a product that's ever "finished." It's something we improve continuously. Every deployment, outage, bug, and annoying manual task is an opportunity to make the system better.

Why This Role Exists:

We build and operate the platform that our engineers and our customers rely on.

The platform isn't a product that's ever "finished." It's something we improve continuously. Every deployment, outage, bug, and annoying manual task is an opportunity to make the system better.

An L3 Platform Engineer is a fully contributing member of that effort.

This isn't a ticket factory. We expect engineers to think critically, collaborate closely, and continuously improve both the platform and the way we build it.

lists.content:
Our engineering culture is built on Extreme Programming and Continuous Delivery.

That means:

  • Pair programming is our default way of developing software.
  • We work in small batches.
  • We integrate continuously.
  • We automate repetitive work.
  • We test first whenever practical.
  • We optimize for learning and feedback instead of individual velocity.
  • The team owns the outcome.

    • If you're looking for a role where you're handed tickets, disappear for a week, and come back with a pull request, this isn't it.

• Build and improve the platform that deploys and operates customer environments.
  • Develop infrastructure as code using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Zarf, Big Bang, Packer, and related tooling.
  • Improve Kubernetes platforms and the systems around them.
  • Build deployment automation that reduces risk and removes manual work.
  • Pair with other engineers to design, implement, and troubleshoot platform capabilities.
  • Write automated tests for infrastructure and deployment workflows.
  • Improve observability, reliability, security, and recoverability.
  • Write documentation that explains why something exists—not just how to type commands.
  • Leave every part of the system better than you found it.

You Build for Change

Software is never finished.

Your goal isn't simply to make today's feature work.

Your goal is to leave the code, infrastructure, and deployment process easier to change tomorrow.

You Prefer Automation

If humans perform the same task repeatedly, the system probably needs improvement.

Manual processes are temporary.

Automation is the destination.

You Think in Small Batches

Large changes hide mistakes.

Small changes expose them.

We value engineers who can decompose large problems into safe, incremental improvements.

You Work as Part of the Team

Platform engineering is a collaborative discipline.

You bring potential solutions to the team, clearly explain your reasoning and tradeoffs, and help the team build a shared understanding of the code or design not merely produce it. You are responsible for understanding, validating, and clearly communicating the work you contribute.

You Improve the System

When something goes wrong, we don't stop at fixing it.

We ask:

  • Why did this happen?
  • Why wasn't it detected sooner?
  • How do we make this impossible or at least unlikely next time?

    • Incidents should improve the platform.

You should be comfortable working across most of these areas:

  • Kubernetes
  • Linux
  • Networking fundamentals
  • Git and trunk-based development
  • GitLab CI
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Ansible
  • Terraform
  • Helm
  • Zarf
  • Containers
  • PKI and certificate management
  • Secrets management
  • Observability
  • Infrastructure testing
  • Troubleshooting distributed systems

    • No one is expected to know everything.

    We do expect you to learn quickly and become productive in unfamiliar systems.

Successful L3 engineers consistently help the team:

  • Deploy more frequently.
  • Deploy more safely.
  • Recover from failures faster.
  • Remove manual work.
  • Reduce operational complexity.
  • Improve documentation.
  • Increase confidence through testing.
  • Deliver changes in small, reversible increments.
  • Make the platform easier to operate and easier to evolve.

• Simplicity over cleverness.
  • Evidence over opinion.
  • Learning over ego.
  • Automation over repetition.
  • Continuous improvement over perfection.
  • Team outcomes over individual heroics.

• Building knowledge silos.
  • Defending "the way we've always done it."
  • Optimizing for personal productivity instead of team throughput.
  • Big-bang rewrites when incremental change will work.
  • Manual work that should be automated.
  • Complexity without a clear operational benefit.

Job Description:

We are looking for a driven and hands-on test professional to support aircraft and system testing in a fast-paced aerospace environment on our XBAT program. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working closely with cross-functional teams, and seeing projects move from early development through production and flight operations. The right candidate will have experience planning and executing tests for UAV or manned aircraft platforms and be comfortable building test plans and procedures from the ground up. This individual should be organized, adaptable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple test activities while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and mission success.

lists.content:
• Manage and maintain traceability of test requirements throughout system development, integration, and test execution phases.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute aircraft/lab test execution activities, including pre-test readiness reviews, test conduct, data collection, and post-test reporting.
  • Coordinate test schedules and support comprehensive test planning activities to ensure alignment with program milestones and objectives.
  • Develop and manage test event sequencing and execution plans throughout the aircraft build and integration lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and oversee ground and flight test execution activities, ensuring adherence to approved procedures, safety requirements, and program objectives.
  • Ensure test activities, methodologies, and deliverables align with engineering, mission, and program requirements.
  • Participate in Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs), test planning meetings, and pre-test briefings to support successful test execution.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve test procedures to enhance accuracy, efficiency, repeatability, and overall execution quality.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and evaluate test anomalies, discrepancies, and system performance issues to support timely resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with Test Engineering, Quality Engineering, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues, implement corrective actions, and improve test processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing test efficiency, execution quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support extended work hours, shift work, and weekend operations as required to meet test schedules, flight operations, and program commitments.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field and 5+ years of relevant aerospace, aircraft test, or flight test experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience planning, executing, and reporting on test activities for UAV, UAS, or manned aircraft systems.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Experience developing aircraft test plans, test procedures, and test documentation for new or modified aircraft systems.
  • Hands-on experience supporting aircraft integration, test, and validation activities in a production or manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex aircraft, avionics, and system integration issues during test activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail with a proactive, safety-focused approach to testing and operations.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance and any required program access.
  • Willingness to work non-standard hours, including evenings and weekends, as required to support program objectives.
  • Ability to travel domestically to support flight test and customer site activities.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Propulsion Design Engineer to support the development and delivery of propulsion hardware for the Ranger platform, a next-generation UAV. This role spans the full lifecycle of propulsion system components - from early layout and design through production release, test support, and flight operations.

You will be a key contributor to turning propulsion architecture into manufacturable, testable, and flight-ready hardware across the engine, fuel, oil, and bleed air systems. This role is hands-on, detail-oriented, and highly cross-functional - requiring close collaboration with propulsion REs, technicians, machinists, production, controls, airframe, and flight test teams.

lists.content:
• Own the design and release of propulsion hardware supporting the engine, fuel, oil, and bleed air systems.
  • Develop and maintain CAD models, drawings, and assemblies using Siemens NX with proper GD&T.
  • Translate propulsion architecture and requirements into hardware that is manufacturable, testable, and robust in flight.
  • Work directly with the machine shop, production, and technicians to support builds, resolve non-conformances, and drive iterative improvements.
  • Support test campaigns by providing hardware design support, instrumentation accommodation, and rapid iteration based on test findings.
  • Apply engineering judgment and analysis (e.g., hand calcs, ANSYS, FEA, GFSSP, REFPROP) to support sizing, load cases, and design validation.
  • Support configuration management, BOM control, and change processes using Teamcenter or equivalent PLM.
  • Participate in design reviews, interface control efforts, and root cause investigations related to propulsion hardware.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in aerospace hardware design, preferably supporting propulsion systems.
  • Proficiency in CAD modeling and drawing creation (NX preferred) with sound application of GD&T.
  • Experience working directly with production, technicians, and machine shops to resolve real-world build issues.
  • Understanding of design for manufacturing, including machining limitations, tolerance stack-ups, and assembly workflows.
  • Some hands-on experience developing assembly guidance and supporting hardware builds and test integration.
  • US citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

• Experience with jet propulsion systems on UAVs or tactical aircraft.
  • Familiarity with GFSSP, REFPROP, ANSYS, or FEA to support design trade studies and validation.
  • Ability to write Python scripts for design automation, analysis, or data processing.
  • Experience with interface control, fastener selection for high-vibration environments, and high-temperature materials.
  • Experience designing hardware in test-driven development environments with rapid iteration cycles.
  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Reliability Engineer to lead reliability engineering activities for the development, integration, testing, and operation of aircraft systems. This position will work across engineering disciplines to establish reliability requirements, manage system reliability budgets, perform reliability analyses, and identify design improvements that increase aircraft availability and mission success.

The successful candidate will have direct experience working on aircraft or other complex aerospace systems and be proficient with industry-standard reliability tools and methods. This engineer will serve as the primary reliability point of contact for assigned programs and communicate reliability performance, risks, and improvement plans to engineering leadership and customers.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain aircraft-level reliability requirements, objectives, and program reliability plans.
  • Establish, allocate, and manage reliability budgets across systems, subsystems, and line-replaceable units.
  • Track predicted reliability against program targets and identify components or subsystems driving reliability risk.
  • Perform reliability predictions using component failure-rate data, operating environments, and mission profiles.
  • Conduct Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) analysis.
  • Support aircraft system safety assessments by providing failure rates, failure modes, and reliability data.
  • Develop and maintain Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF), mission reliability, availability, and related reliability metrics.
  • Perform reliability allocation, trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and design assessments.
  • Lead or support Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) activities.
  • Analyze ground-test, flight-test, supplier, maintenance, and field-performance data to identify reliability trends.
  • Apply Weibull analysis and other statistical methods to evaluate failure behavior and predict component life.
  • Work with design teams to eliminate single-point failures, reduce high-risk failure modes, and improve fault tolerance.
  • Review supplier reliability analyses, test results, and supporting technical data.
  • Define reliability demonstration and growth-test requirements, success criteria, and data-collection needs.
  • Support technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and reliability review boards.
  • Communicate reliability performance, budget status, assumptions, risks, and recommended corrective actions to customers and program leadership.
  • Mentor junior engineers and improve organizational reliability processes, tools, and standards.

• Bachelor’s degree in reliability engineering, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree 
  • Direct experience supporting aircraft development, integration, testing, sustainment, or operations.
  • Experience developing and managing reliability budgets at the system, subsystem, or equipment level.
  • Proficiency with reliability methods such as FMEA/FMECA, FTA, RBD, Weibull analysis, reliability predictions, and FRACAS.
  • Familiarity with reliability metrics such as MTBF, MTBCF, failure rate, mission reliability, operational availability, and inherent availability.
  • Experience using reliability analysis tools such as ReliaSoft, Windchill Quality Solutions, Isograph, RAM Commander, or equivalent.
  • Ability to interpret aircraft mission profiles, operating environments, duty cycles, and test data.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and suppliers.
  • Strong analytical, technical writing, presentation, and customer communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any security clearance required for the program.

• Experience working on military aircraft, unmanned aircraft, or other defense aerospace platforms.
  • Experience managing aircraft-level reliability allocations and flowing requirements down to suppliers.
  • Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-217, NPRD, EPRD, RIAC 217Plus, or equivalent reliability prediction methods and databases.
  • Experience integrating reliability engineering with system safety, maintainability, logistics, and availability analyses.
  • Knowledge of Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and condition-based maintenance approaches.
  • Experience supporting environmental qualification, ground testing, flight testing, or reliability growth testing.
  • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering and requirements management tools.
  • Certified Reliability Engineer credentials or equivalent professional certification.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.

The successful engineer will establish a clear aircraft reliability strategy, maintain ownership of the reliability budget, and provide program leadership with an accurate view of reliability performance and risk. They will use analysis and test data to identify the primary reliability drivers and work directly with engineering teams and suppliers to improve the design before failures affect aircraft availability or mission performance.

Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments. The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions. 
 
Shield AI is committed to developing cutting-edge autonomy for unmanned aircraft operating across all Department of Defense (DoD) domains, including air, sea, and land. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.

lists.content:
• System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

  • Experience with Git, GitLab, Backstage, or similar developer-platform technologies

  • Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, developer portals, development environments, or reusable engineering frameworks 
  • Experience applying AI or agentic systems to software development tools and workflows 
  • Proficiency in one or more relevant languages, such as Python, Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript/Node.js 
  • Experience with devcontainers, project scaffolding, service templates, or standardized local development environments

  • Familiarity with DORA metrics, developer productivity measurement, and qualitative developer-experience research

Job Description:
The Systems & Platform Integration team serves as the engineering bridge between Hivemind autonomy and operational platforms across Shield AI’s Expeditionary and Emerging Operations portfolio. Our mission is to rapidly enable new platform adoption by developing the interfaces, configurations, and integration frameworks required to deploy autonomy capabilities across a diverse portfolio, including XBAT, VBAT, Weapons, Space, Congested Logistics, and Maritime initiatives. 
As a Senior Software Integration Engineer, you will lead the integration of Hivemind autonomy onto a diverse portfolio of operational platforms. You will design and implement the software interfaces that connect autonomy with platform control systems, mission computers, payloads, sensors, and communications systems, while solving complex integration challenges across software, hardware, and networking. 
You will own integrations throughout their lifecycle—from interface design and implementation, through validation in Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments, to successful demonstrations and operational deployments. 
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, cross-disciplinary engineering problems and wants to see autonomy capabilities transition from development into real-world operational use.

lists.content:
• Lead platform integration of Hivemind autonomy across expeditionary and emerging operations platforms. 

  • Develop and maintain software interfaces between autonomy, vehicle subsystems, autopilots, payloads, mission computers, and platform services. 

  • Configure mission-computing environments, including Linux systems, middleware, containers, and deployment pipelines. 

  • Integrate mission hardware and systems, including sensors, payloads, radios, tactical networks, ground control stations, and mission systems. 

  • Develop reusable integration frameworks, platform adapters, and deployment mechanisms that accelerate onboarding of new platforms. 

  • Support SIL, HIL, VIL, and representative integration environments to reduce integration risk before flight and operational testing. 

  • Lead cross-domain debugging and troubleshooting across hardware, embedded software, networking, and autonomy interfaces. 

  • Support demonstrations, exercises, surrogate operations, and customer events. 

  • Coordinate integration activities across autonomy, systems engineering, flight test, program leadership, and external partners. 

  • Mentor junior engineers and help drive engineering best practices across the team.

  • 4–7 years of experience integrating and testing robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or similarly complex systems. 

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, with familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS). 

  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and integration environments. 

  • Experience integrating complex software systems with vehicle platforms, mission-computing environments, payloads, sensors, and communications systems. 

  • Experience with sensor integration and middleware frameworks such as ROS. 

  • Hands-on experience supporting field tests, demonstrations, or operational events. 

  • Strong systems engineering, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. 

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.

• Experience with flight-control systems such as ArduPilot or PX4. 

  • Experience with unmanned aerial systems, including fixed-wing aircraft, quadrotors, or both. 

  • Background in autonomy, robotics, or aerospace systems. 

  • Familiarity with flight controllers, radios, and communications systems. 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software deployment practices.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Sr. Structural Analyst to support the analysis and testing of advanced UAVs. In this role, you will work closely with Mechanical Systems, Propulsion, Mechanisms, and other engineering disciplines to ensure the structural integrity of our lightweight, high-performance aircraft. You will contribute to the design, analysis, testing, and optimization of airframe structures and components, ensuring they meet performance, weight, and safety requirements.

This role is ideal for engineers with 5+ years of experience looking to gain expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), composite and metallic materials, and mechanical testing in a fast-paced, high-tech aerospace environment.

lists.content:
• Assist in building and refining finite element models (FEM) to evaluate the structural performance of UAV components.
  • Perform static, modal, fatigue, and vibration analyses to assess stress, deformation, and durability.
  • Conduct hand calculations to validate FEA results, ensuring accuracy and structural reliability.
  • Work with design engineers to optimize airframe structures, balancing weight, strength, and manufacturability.
  • Support the development of test plans for structural validation, including quasi-static, vibration, and shock testing.
  • Analyze flight telemetry and structural test data to improve modeling accuracy and correlate predictions with real-world performance.
  • Assist in defining load cases, material properties, and design margins for UAV airframe and mechanical components.
  • Document and present structural analysis reports and technical recommendations to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure structural requirements align with system performance goals.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of structural analysis methodologies, tools, and best practices.

• 5+ years of experience in structural analysis, finite element modeling, or aircraft loads analysis AND B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. Alternatively, 3+ years of experience AND a M.S. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering
  • Experience with FEA tools (FEMAP, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, ANSYS, Patran, or similar).
  • Ability to perform hand calculations for structural strength and stability analysis.
  • Knowledge of composite materials and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing methods (static, vibration, and/or fatigue).
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience in aircraft structural design, UAV airframe development, or aerospace testing.
  • Hands-on experience with structural testing.
  • Exposure to CAD software (NX, Catia, SolidWorks) and PLM tools (Teamcenter or similar).
  • Understanding of aerospace industry standards, structural certification processes, and material selection.
  • Fatigue and damage tolerance (DaDT) experience including crack initiation and crack growth

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Sr. Structural Analyst to support the analysis and testing of advanced UAVs. In this role, you will work closely with Mechanical Systems, Propulsion, Mechanisms, and other engineering disciplines to ensure the structural integrity of our lightweight, high-performance aircraft. You will contribute to the design, analysis, testing, and optimization of airframe structures and components, ensuring they meet performance, weight, and safety requirements.

This role is ideal for engineers with 5+ years of experience looking to gain expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), composite and metallic materials, and mechanical testing in a fast-paced, high-tech aerospace environment.

lists.content:
• Assist in building and refining finite element models (FEM) to evaluate the structural performance of UAV components.
  • Perform static, modal, fatigue, and vibration analyses to assess stress, deformation, and durability.
  • Conduct hand calculations to validate FEA results, ensuring accuracy and structural reliability.
  • Work with design engineers to optimize airframe structures, balancing weight, strength, and manufacturability.
  • Support the development of test plans for structural validation, including quasi-static, vibration, and shock testing.
  • Analyze flight telemetry and structural test data to improve modeling accuracy and correlate predictions with real-world performance.
  • Assist in defining load cases, material properties, and design margins for UAV airframe and mechanical components.
  • Document and present structural analysis reports and technical recommendations to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure structural requirements align with system performance goals.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of structural analysis methodologies, tools, and best practices.

• 5+ years of experience in structural analysis, finite element modeling, or aircraft loads analysis AND B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. Alternatively, 3+ years of experience AND a M.S. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering
  • Experience with FEA tools (FEMAP, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, ANSYS, Patran, or similar).
  • Ability to perform hand calculations for structural strength and stability analysis.
  • Knowledge of composite materials and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing methods (static, vibration, and/or fatigue).
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience in aircraft structural design, UAV airframe development, or aerospace testing.
  • Hands-on experience with structural testing.
  • Exposure to CAD software (NX, Catia, SolidWorks) and PLM tools (Teamcenter or similar).
  • Understanding of aerospace industry standards, structural certification processes, and material selection.
  • Fatigue and damage tolerance (DaDT) experience including crack initiation and crack growth

Job Description:
As a System Integration Test Engineer, you will integrate and verify Shield AI's Hivemind mission autonomy software directly on Autonomous Collaborative Platform (ACP) flight hardware. You will serve as the hands-on technical bridge between autonomy algorithms and physical aircraft systems, working across Shield AI and aircraft platform vendors to verify system interfaces, validate edge compute performance, and resolve integration issues before flight testing. 
You will drive integration across Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments, both in Shield AI's internal laboratories and on-site at platform vendor integration facilities (including SIL, HIL, and iron bird test benches). You will turn high-level program objectives into executable integration plans, schedules, and test cards, systematically uncovering interface gaps early and formulating technical solutions to close them. This is an essential, high-impact role for an engineer who excels at the intersection where complex mission software meets real aircraft avionics and hardware.

Job Description:

As a System Integration Test Engineer, you will integrate and verify Shield AI's Hivemind mission autonomy software directly on Autonomous Collaborative Platform (ACP) flight hardware. You will serve as the hands-on technical bridge between autonomy algorithms and physical aircraft systems, working across Shield AI and aircraft platform vendors to verify system interfaces, validate edge compute performance, and resolve integration issues before flight testing. 

You will drive integration across Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments, both in Shield AI's internal laboratories and on-site at platform vendor integration facilities (including SIL, HIL, and iron bird test benches). You will turn high-level program objectives into executable integration plans, schedules, and test cards, systematically uncovering interface gaps early and formulating technical solutions to close them. This is an essential, high-impact role for an engineer who excels at the intersection where complex mission software meets real aircraft avionics and hardware.

lists.content:
• Integrate Mission Autonomy on ACP Hardware: Deploy, integrate, and verify Hivemind mission autonomy software with actual ACP software and hardware in Shield AI and platform vendor SIL and HIL labs. 
  • Develop Test & Integration Plans: Develop detailed integration test plans, test cards, schedules, and objective success criteria across lab, ground, and flight test phases. 
  • Identify & Resolve Integration Gaps: Proactively identify architectural, interface, protocol, timing, and hardware/software gaps early; formulate concrete gap-closure plans, risk mitigations, and technical workarounds alongside Shield engineering and platform partners. 
  • Coordinate Joint Vendor Lab Execution: Partner directly with aircraft OEMs and platform vendors to coordinate lab readiness, align entry/exit criteria, deconflict bench time, and co-execute joint integration campaigns. 
  • Conduct Hands-On Lab Triage: Execute integration tests, configure test benches, and lead real-time troubleshooting of multi-system anomalies 
  • Drive Test Automation & Tooling: Coordinate across engineering teams to design and build test automation and simulation scripts to accelerate development 
  • Gate Flight Readiness & Support Flight Test: Enforce empirical test entry/exit criteria to gate delivery to aircraft ground and flight test; support flight test preparation, configuration validation, real-time troubleshooting, and post-flight data analysis. 
  • Support travel to test sites, customer events, and integration activities as required

• Typically requires 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or related technical field, or 3+ years with a Master's degree. 
  • Lab & Hardware Integration: Demonstrated experience in system integration and test, including SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight test environments. 
  • Test Planning & Documentation: Proven ability to author clear, comprehensive integration test plans, procedures, and test cards, and translate test results into actionable engineering findings and gap closure roadmaps. 
  • Troubleshooting & Analysis: Strong experience troubleshooting complex system interfaces using telemetry, logs, packet capture tools (e.g., Wireshark), or hardware diagnostic equipment. 
  • Scripting & Linux: Proficiency with Linux operating systems and scripting languages (Python preferred) for test automation, data analysis, and hardware bench interfacing. 
  • Communication & Organization: Highly organized and methodical, with the ability to organize integration tasks, track dependencies, and coordinate work across distributed engineering teams and external partners. 
  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel periodically to platform vendor facilities and flight test locations as program needs require. 
  • Clearance & Citizenship: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

• Autonomous & Uncrewed Systems: Experience with Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP), Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), UAS (Group 4/5), or military aircraft mission systems. 
  • OEM / Prime Contractor Experience: Experience working directly inside aircraft manufacturer or defense prime contractor integration labs (e.g., Boeing, Northrop Grumman, Lockheed Martin, General Atomics, Anduril). 
  • Open Architecture Standards: Familiarity with open systems architectures such as Open Mission Systems (OMS), Universal Command and Control Interface (UCI), and Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA). 
  • Middleware & Frameworks: Experience with inter-process communication and messaging middleware (e.g., DDS, ROS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC). 
  • Safety & Airworthiness: Understanding of airworthiness processes, safety-of-flight standards, or software assurance guidelines (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, MIL-STD-882E). 
  • Active Clearance: Active DoD SECRET or TOP SECRET clearance.

Mission autonomy and aircraft hardware/avionics operate reliably and deterministically together in representative SIL and HIL labs well before aircraft ground and flight testing. Integration gaps and interface discrepancies are surfaced and resolved early, configurations and master test schedules are transparent and aligned across vendors, and rigorous lab test results provide the high-confidence empirical evidence needed to clear the aircraft for flight.

lists.content:

  • Design, implement, and maintain simulation-based test frameworks to validate Hivemind autonomy behavior and performance
  • Build tools and utilities in Python to automate testing, data processing, and analysis workflows
  • Develop test harnesses and data validation tools for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) / Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) / Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) and simulation environments

Job Description:
Shield AI's Software Test & Automation Team develops the verification, validation, and automation capabilities that enable rapid delivery of Hivemind autonomy across the Expeditionary and Emerging Operations portfolio. Our mission is to provide objective evidence of software quality, reliability, and mission readiness by building scalable automated test frameworks, repeatable validation environments, and data-driven readiness assessments spanning simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) environments. 
As a Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will design and develop automated test infrastructure, execute system-level verification activities, analyze software performance, and build the tooling that enables continuous validation throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with autonomy software, systems engineering, digital infrastructure, and flight test teams, you will help ensure autonomy capabilities are validated, repeatable, and ready for operational deployment.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, validation tooling, and test infrastructure supporting autonomy software.  
  • Develop and execute verification and validation strategies across simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, and representative system environments.  
  • Build automated regression, integration, functional, and performance test suites that improve software quality and deployment confidence.  
  • Develop Python-based automation, test harnesses, and analysis tools that reduce manual testing effort and improve repeatability.  
  • Analyze test results, identify software defects and integration issues, and support cross-functional root cause investigations.  
  • Develop software quality metrics, dashboards, and readiness assessments that provide objective evidence of software maturity.  
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows to enable continuous validation and rapid developer feedback.  
  • Collaborate with autonomy software, systems engineering, flight test, and integration teams to define validation strategies and readiness criteria.  
  • Improve test infrastructure, automation coverage, and validation methodologies across the Expeditionary and Emerging Operations portfolio.

• BS in Computer Science, Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related field.  
  • 4–7 years developing software test, verification, automation, or validation solutions for robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or other complex distributed systems.  
  • Strong proficiency in Python for automation, testing, and data analysis.  
  • Experience developing automated test frameworks, test harnesses, or validation infrastructure.  
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments.  
  • Experience validating software in simulation, SIL, HIL, and/or representative hardware environments.  
  • Experience debugging complex software and system integration issues.  
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous validation practices.  
  • Strong understanding of software verification, regression testing, and quality assurance methodologies.

• Experience with flight control systems such as ArduPilot or PX4. 
  • Experience with unmanned aerial systems (fixed-wing, quadrotor, or both)  
  • Background in autonomy, robotics, or aerospace systems  
  • Familiarity with flight controllers, radios, and communications systems

Our mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems, and this role supports that mission directly by working with Australian Government classified material. It requires an Australian Government security clearance at [Baseline / NV1 / NV2] level. 

You don't need to hold a clearance already, we will sponsor your clearance and support you, because mission first, people always. Australian citizenship is a mandatory requirement for this role. It is a condition of clearance eligibility set by the Australian Government, eligibility details are here: https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-suitability

Job Description:
As a Environmental Test Technician at Shield AI, you'll prepare, execute, and manage environmental tests on electronic flight hardware across the VBAT and XBAT aircraft, ensuring it meets performance requirements through rigorous thermal, vibration, shock, humidity, and altitude testing. This is a highly hands-on role. Working with design and reliability stakeholders, you'll help define test plans — stress profiles, setup, and instrumentation — then bring them to the bench: installing test articles, instrumenting hardware with thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and humidity sensors, configuring data acquisition, and programming and loading chambers. You'll frequently run several campaigns at once, prioritizing tests as needed to keep them moving without compromising data quality. 
Once tests are running, you'll operate the equipment, monitor for and investigate failures, and reduce and document results in clear reports — including the plots and visualizations stakeholders rely on to make disposition and qualification decisions. You'll work with cutting-edge deep-tech hardware, collaborate across disciplines, and directly influence product quality and long-term reliability over the vehicles’ lifecycles.

Job Description:

As a Environmental Test Technician at Shield AI, you'll prepare, execute, and manage environmental tests on electronic flight hardware across the VBAT and XBAT aircraft, ensuring it meets performance requirements through rigorous thermal, vibration, shock, humidity, and altitude testing. This is a highly hands-on role. Working with design and reliability stakeholders, you'll help define test plans — stress profiles, setup, and instrumentation — then bring them to the bench: installing test articles, instrumenting hardware with thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and humidity sensors, configuring data acquisition, and programming and loading chambers. You'll frequently run several campaigns at once, prioritizing tests as needed to keep them moving without compromising data quality. 

Once tests are running, you'll operate the equipment, monitor for and investigate failures, and reduce and document results in clear reports — including the plots and visualizations stakeholders rely on to make disposition and qualification decisions. You'll work with cutting-edge deep-tech hardware, collaborate across disciplines, and directly influence product quality and long-term reliability over the vehicles’ lifecycles.

lists.content:
• Operate and continuously improve a world-class environmental test lab for electronics that includes HALT/HASS chambers, thermal-humidity chambers, vibration/shock equipment, and data acquisition equipment.  
  • Develop and implement lab procedures for use of environmental test equipment, test setup and tear down, data acquisition, and test reporting. 
  • Perform reliability tests on electronic products, including thermal cycling, temperature-humidity soaks, HALT, HASS, vibration, and shock testing.  
  • Develop lab best-practices, including automation of data acquisition, defining test plans, documenting test results, and management of tests.  
  • Manage procurement and maintenance of lab consumables, including instrumentation, adhesives, fasteners, and fixtures.  
  • Oversee the maintenance, organization, and safety of all laboratory equipment and work areas. 
  • Work with external laboratories to perform environmental tests as necessary. 
  • Educate stakeholders on environmental test best-practices to improve test plans and design-for-test practices.
  • Stay current with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in all aspects of environmental testing and equipment. 
    •

• 2+ years of experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS). 
  • Candidate must be self-starting and come with a growth mindset, with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
  • Knowledgeable in data acquisition equipment and instrumentation, including thermocouples, accelerometers, humidity sensors, and strain gauges.  
  • Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies. Knowledgeable in failure mechanisms including solder fatigue, intermetallic growth, conductive anodic filaments, tin whiskers, electromigration, and corrosion.  
  • Team-player with clear and concise written and oral communication skills. 
  • Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product test from concept to production. 
  • Experience with management of technical projects. 
  • Familiarity with relevant industry test standards, including IPC, JEDEC, MIL, and ASTM standards. 
    •

• 5+ years of experience in a reliability testing role, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS). 
  • Familiarity with reliability concepts, including Weibull statistics, accelerated life test design, highly-accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS). 
  • Proficiency in CAD modelling software, including ANSYS SpaceClaim, NX, or Solidworks.  
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Reliability Engineering.  
  • Prior experience managing an environmental test lab. 
  • Proficiency in Python, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, and Matplotlib.

Job Description:

We are seeking an intellectually curious, learning-agile, and strategic Senior Executive Recruiter to identify and attract exceptional leaders who will help shape Shield AI's future. As a fast-growing defense technology company, our hiring priorities evolve quickly, requiring adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering results.

Reporting to the Head of Executive Search, the Senior Executive Recruiter – Aircraft will independently lead complex senior leadership searches across Shield AI's Aircraft organization, identifying leaders responsible for developing, producing, and scaling next-generation autonomous aircraft. This includes executive recruiting across hardware engineering, software engineering, manufacturing, production, supply chain, quality, and other critical technical and operational functions.

This senior individual contributor will own the full executive search lifecycle, from intake and market mapping through candidate assessment, offer negotiation, and close. The ideal candidate combines strong executive search fundamentals, business acumen, executive presence, operational rigor, and exceptional talent judgment. Success requires quickly developing expertise across technical disciplines, translating complex engineering requirements into effective recruiting strategies, building trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and delivering high-quality hiring outcomes. You will partner closely with business leaders, People Experience (PX) Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition colleagues to develop targeted search strategies aligned with business priorities.

Our Talent Acquisition team actively embraces AI and automation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, streamline execution, and create more capacity for high-value recruiting activities. We seek individuals who continuously identify innovative ways to improve executive search effectiveness.

lists.content:
Executive Search Strategy & Execution

  • Independently manage complex executive and senior leadership searches from intake and position scoping through market mapping, assessment, offer negotiation, and acceptance.
  • Partner with senior leaders to define role requirements, success profiles, assessment criteria, search strategies, and hiring milestones.
  • Identify, engage, and cultivate relationships with high-caliber, passive executive talent across aerospace and defense, AI, autonomy, software, robotics, and other relevant technical markets.
  • Build targeted executive talent pipelines supporting immediate and anticipated leadership hiring needs.
  • Execute searches across diverse technical disciplines, including mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, software, autonomy, manufacturing, production, supply chain, quality, and operations.
  • Anticipate search challenges, adjust strategies, and maintain accountability for hiring outcomes.

    • Executive Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, hiring managers, and PX Business Partners across assigned functions.
  • Provide consultative guidance on talent availability, market dynamics, compensation expectations, and competitive positioning.
  • Establish consistent communication and reporting cadences to maintain stakeholder alignment, transparency, and accountability.
  • Influence hiring decisions through market intelligence, candidate insights, and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Proactively manage expectations, resolve obstacles, and navigate competing priorities constructively.

    • Executive Assessment & Candidate Experience

  • Conduct comprehensive executive assessments evaluating technical expertise, leadership capabilities, business impact, and alignment with Shield AI's mission and values.
  • Apply structured interviews, competency frameworks, and assessment tools to support informed hiring decisions.
  • Deliver clear, balanced candidate evaluations highlighting strengths, development areas, and potential risks.
  • Partner with interview teams to drive consistent candidate calibration and effective selection decisions.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while building long-term relationships with executive talent.

    • Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping

  • Develop deep knowledge of executive talent markets across Aircraft engineering, manufacturing, production, supply chain, and related technical and operational functions.
  • Partner with Global Talent Sourcing to execute targeted market mapping, competitive research, and candidate identification strategies.
  • Provide actionable insights on talent availability, organizational structures, compensation trends, and competitive hiring practices.
  • Leverage recruiting technology, research tools, and analytics to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and search outcomes.

    • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Execute searches using established executive recruiting processes, assessment methodologies, tools, and templates.
  • Maintain accurate, timely candidate and pipeline information in applicant tracking and recruiting systems.
  • Track and communicate search metrics, including pipeline health, candidate conversion, search velocity, and hiring outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting efficiency, assessment quality, and stakeholder and candidate experience.
  • Contribute executive search expertise and best practices to strengthen team processes and execution.
  • Collaborate with Talent Sourcing, Recruiting Operations, Total Rewards, PX, and business stakeholders to achieve shared hiring objectives.

    • Leverage AI to Raise the Bar

  • Integrate AI and automation into recruiting workflows to improve speed, quality, and effectiveness throughout the executive search lifecycle.
  • Apply AI to talent research, market mapping, sourcing strategy, intake preparation, candidate engagement, interview preparation, and recruiting analytics.
  • Identify repetitive or low-value activities that can be automated, creating more capacity for strategic partnership, candidate relationships, and assessment.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools, evaluate their impact, and share successful practices across Talent Acquisition.
  • Exercise sound judgment regarding where human expertise, discretion, relationship-building, and decision-making remain essential.

    • Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Build trusted, collaborative relationships across Talent Acquisition, People Experience, Total Rewards, and business leadership.
  • Share market intelligence, candidate insights, and executive search best practices to strengthen team effectiveness.
  • Demonstrate humility, openness to feedback, and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Contribute to broader recruiting priorities while maintaining ownership and accountability for assigned searches.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive executive recruiting or search experience, including independently managing complex senior leadership searches, ideally within high-growth technology, aerospace, defense, AI, autonomy, robotics, software engineering, automotive, or related technical industries.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting senior technical leaders across hardware, software, engineering, manufacturing, production, or operations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into actionable recruiting and sourcing strategies across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Strong executive sourcing, market mapping, passive candidate engagement, and assessment capabilities.
  • Proven ability to build credibility, advise, and influence senior-level hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen, executive presence, communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience applying structured executive assessments and competency-based interviewing methodologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex searches simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality, execution, and candidate experience.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management platforms, and recruiting analytics tools.

• Experience recruiting across multiple technical disciplines rather than specializing exclusively in one talent vertical.
  • Experience recruiting cleared or clearance-eligible talent.
  • Experience recruiting executives within high-growth, mission-driven technology organizations.
  • Familiarity with executive compensation, equity programs, and complex offer negotiations.
  • Experience operating within global or matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build diverse executive talent pipelines and support equitable hiring practices.
  • Experience partnering with executive search firms and external research providers.
  • Strong understanding of organizational dynamics and technical leadership structures.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Collaborative, personable, adaptable, and calm under pressure, with a positive approach to changing priorities.

We expect our Senior Executive Recruiters to demonstrate Shield AI's core values through their judgment, actions, and relationships.

Do What Honor Dictates

  • Demonstrate integrity, sound judgment, transparency, and accountability in candidate assessments, hiring recommendations, and search outcomes.
  • Communicate candidly, honor commitments, and take ownership of results.

    • Live as a Servant Leader

  • Build trusted partnerships through collaboration, humility, responsiveness, and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Prioritize the success of candidates, hiring leaders, and the broader organization while contributing to shared team objectives.

    • Pursue Excellence

  • Maintain high standards for executive talent quality, search execution, and candidate experience.
  • Demonstrate urgency, persistence, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Continuously strengthen market expertise and leverage innovative tools, including AI, to improve hiring outcomes.

• Search Execution: Independently deliver complex executive searches, consistently building strong candidate pipelines and achieving high-quality hiring outcomes.
  • Strategic Partnership: Earn the confidence of senior leaders through business acumen, market intelligence, sound talent judgment, and proactive communication.
  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while managing competing priorities.
  • Innovation & Collaboration: Leverage AI and recruiting technology to improve efficiency and effectiveness while contributing to team success and continuous improvement.

    • This role requires substantial independence, strong functional expertise, and ownership of executive search outcomes while contributing to broader recruiting priorities within the strategic direction established by Talent Acquisition leadership.

Our Talent Acquisition team actively embraces AI and automation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, streamline execution, and create more capacity for high-value recruiting activities. We seek individuals who continuously identify innovative ways to improve executive search effectiveness.

Job Description:

We are seeking an intellectually curious, learning-agile, and strategic Senior Executive Recruiter to identify and attract exceptional leaders who will help shape Shield AI's future. As a fast-growing defense technology company, our hiring priorities evolve quickly, requiring adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering results.

Reporting to the Head of Executive Search, the Senior Executive Recruiter – Hivemind will independently lead complex senior leadership searches across Shield AI's Hivemind Autonomous Software business, identifying leaders responsible for developing and scaling next-generation autonomy and AI-powered software systems. This includes executive recruiting across Autonomy, Robotics, Perception, Planning, Controls, Embedded Software, Distributed Systems, Simulation, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, and other highly specialized software engineering disciplines.

This senior individual contributor will own the full executive search lifecycle, from intake and market mapping through candidate assessment, offer negotiation, and close. You will partner closely with business leaders, People Experience (PX) Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition colleagues to develop targeted search strategies aligned with business priorities.

Our Talent Acquisition team actively embraces AI and automation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, streamline execution, and create more capacity for high-value recruiting activities. We seek individuals who continuously identify innovative ways to improve executive search effectiveness.

lists.content:
• Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Engineering, Software, Embedded, AI/ML, Systems, Manufacturing, Operations, Product, Program Management, Corporate functions, and other critical disciplines.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

• 8+ years of technical sourcing experience, ideally in aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex hardware/software industries.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Direct experience using AI development environments or coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools) to create repeatable sourcing workflows, structured research outputs, market intelligence, process automation, or operational documentation.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting aerospace, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, or advanced vehicle engineering organizations.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

lists.content:
Security Operations & Program Execution 

  • Execute daily collateral security operations in a high-growth environment  
  • Maintain daily classified document control, accountability, and safeguarding  
  • Support classified facility operations and Restricted Areas  

    • Personnel Security & Onboarding 

  • Process badge requests and issuance with accuracy and timeliness  
  • Facilitate weekly local new hire orientation and onboarding  
  • Present New Hire Security Training as required  

    • Foreign Visits & External Engagements 

  • Daily processing, disclosure, and hosting of foreign visits in accordance with NISPOM  
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure compliant execution  
  • Support classified meetings hosting  

    • Restricted Area (RA) & Access Control 

  • Perform daily Restricted Area maintenance and access control management  
  • Enforce entry/exit procedures and access requirements  
  • Execute end-of-day Restricted Area security procedures  

    • Technology Control & Compliance 

  • Process Technology Control Plans (TCPs) in support of Corporate FSO  
  • Support ITAR/EAR compliance and controlled technology safeguards  

    • Incident Response & Operations 

  • Respond to local alarms, GSOC alerts, and security incidents  
  • Provide immediate response to outages and emergent issues  
  • Document and report incidents in accordance with policy  

    • Classified Handling & Logistics 

  • Manage classified shipping and receiving  
  • Maintain accountability and proper transfer procedures for classified materials  

    • COMSEC & Security Support 

  • Serve as Alternate Collateral COMSEC Officer  
  • Support COMSEC accountability, handling, and compliance requirements  

    • Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Act as a trusted security partner to internal teams  
  • Provide guidance on security requirements, reporting obligations, and best practices

• Must be a U.S. Citizen

  • Completion of FSO Program Management for Possessing Facilities (Safeguarding Certification)  
  • 5+ years of experience in industrial security or cleared environments  
  • Working knowledge of NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117)  
  • Experience with DISS, NISS, or equivalent systems

• Experience in a fast-paced or high-growth defense environment  
  • Familiarity with foreign visit processing and TCPs  
  • Experience supporting classified facility operations or Restricted Areas  
  • Experience delivering security training or briefings

lists.content:
• Work directly with the test team and BD on product capabilities and customer requirements.

  • Bridge autonomy-system development, test, and field employment by bringing operational realism, a mission-user perspective, logistics coordination, and deployment-readiness expertise to autonomy-enabled capabilities.

  • Develop representative mission scenarios and assess operational effectiveness, usability, suitability, supportability, and field readiness. Translate real-world mission needs into test objectives, measures, and evaluation criteria that complement the technical assessments performed by engineering and Flight Test Operations.

  • Operate flight test platforms in support of daily fly-fix-fly verification activities.

  • Serve as a primary operator for Group 1/2 UAS platforms during operational testing and demonstrations.

  • Capture field observations, operational lessons, customer feedback, and sustainment needs, then convert them into actionable recommendations for engineering and program teams to improve product design, deployment planning, training, and transition to operational use.

  • Configure, inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot aircraft, payloads, autopilot systems, and ground control stations.

  • Coordinate aircraft readiness, pre-flight inspections, launch and recovery operations, and post-flight maintenance activities.

  • Execute operational test procedures and mission plans while ensuring compliance with established safety and operational requirements.

  • Support the development, refinement, and enforcement of standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and operational best practices for demonstrations and testing.

  • Ensure compliance with FAA regulations, airspace requirements, range procedures, and company flight operations standards.

  • Assist in flight planning, airspace coordination, mission scheduling, and operational risk assessments.

• 4+ years of experience operating and maintaining Group 1/2 UAS platforms and a strong background in working with military units, both foreign and domestic.

  • Strong knowledge of COTS UAS hardware, autopilot systems, ground control stations, communications systems, and payload integration.

  • Ability to engage customer UAS and ground operators on mission requirements.

  • Clear understanding of customer mission-essential tasks and concepts of operations (CONOPS).

  • Experience developing, implementing, and executing standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and operational processes.

  • Working knowledge of FAA regulations, National Airspace System (NAS) operations, airspace coordination, and flight authorization requirements.

  • Experience conducting flight operations in dynamic and complex test environments.

  • Strong understanding of mission planning, operational employment, logistics, and field coordination.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to brief large groups.

  • Ability to turn qualitative user feedback into structured requirements or recommendations.

  • Ability to coordinate effectively with software, systems, safety, and flight operations personnel.

  • FAA Part 107 certification or equivalent UAS operational experience.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

• Experience supporting C2 operations, tactical communications, aviation or maritime operations, and operational test and evaluation events.

  • Experience supporting autonomy, AI-enabled systems, or developmental flight test programs, particularly with multi-aircraft or distributed UAS operations.

  • Experience in training delivery, sustainment planning, and range/event support.

  • Familiarity with standard control and autopilot elements such as QGC, Mission Planner, ArduPilot, and PX4.

The HMS Demo & Test Operations Support role is responsible for coordinating demo flight operations, equipment staging, transportation, logistics, site support, and field execution for flight test campaigns, demonstrations, operational evaluations, and customer events—ensuring personnel, platforms, payloads, communications, ground control systems, and supporting equipment are ready where and when needed.

This position works closely with software, systems, and flight test teams to support the integration, validation, and operational assessment of autonomy capabilities in lab, ground, and flight environments.
