description:
The Senior Flight Ops Technician is a senior, hands-on technical role supporting the development, testing, and operation of unmanned aircraft systems in Ukraine. The role bridges aircraft prototyping, hardware integration, HIL/ground testing, aircraft maintenance, and field flight operations, working closely with hardware, software, autonomy, and flight-test teams.

The technician will build and modify prototype aircraft, integrate avionics and electrical systems, fabricate parts using 3D printing and other rapid-prototyping methods, and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level issues. They will also build, maintain, and troubleshoot HIL rigs and related test infrastructure, help establish and maintain a local prototyping and flight-operations lab, and support aircraft readiness and field testing.

This role is best suited for a versatile, self-sufficient senior technician who can move seamlessly between the lab, aircraft, HIL environment, and flight-test site—rapidly solving problems and helping engineering teams get systems ready for test and flight.
Flight Ops Technician III.

lists.content:
• Build, modify, assemble, maintain, and repair prototype unmanned aircraft and related test systems.
  • Install and integrate avionics, sensors, compute hardware, radios, antennas, payloads, wiring, and other experimental hardware.
  • Fabricate prototype and replacement components using 3D printing, hand and power tools, and other rapid-prototyping methods.
  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot wiring harnesses, connectors, electrical assemblies, and aircraft electrical systems.
  • Build, wire, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot HIL rigs, test fixtures, and related engineering test infrastructure.
  • Integrate flight computers, avionics, sensors, actuators, communications equipment, and other aircraft hardware into HIL and bench-test environments.
  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, avionics, communications, networking, and system-level issues across aircraft and test equipment.
  • Support SIL, HIL, VIL, bench, ground, and live-flight testing, including aircraft functional checks and troubleshooting.
  • Perform aircraft inspections, maintenance, repairs, configuration changes, and pre- and post-flight activities.
  • Help establish and maintain a local prototyping and flight-operations lab, including tools, test equipment, fabrication equipment, spares, batteries, and support equipment.
  • Support flight operations, including aircraft setup, launch and recovery, test-site setup and teardown, and preparation of equipment for field deployments.
  • Maintain aircraft, test-system, maintenance, configuration, inventory, and other technical documentation.
  • Work closely with hardware, software, autonomy, and flight-test engineers to rapidly diagnose problems, implement modifications, and improve test capabilities.
  • Transport personnel and equipment to test sites and travel within Ukraine to support testing, demonstrations, and operations.
  • Mentor less-experienced technicians and maintain high standards for workmanship, configuration control, organization, and safety.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in UAS, aviation, aerospace, robotics, electronics, manufacturing, test support, or a related technical field.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with experience building, modifying, maintaining, or repairing complex electromechanical systems.
  • Experience integrating hardware into aircraft, robotics, prototypes, test systems, or comparable platforms.
  • Hands-on electrical experience, including wiring, connectors, soldering, crimping, cable fabrication, and electrical troubleshooting.
  • Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting HIL rigs, test stands, test fixtures, or similar hardware/software integration environments.
  • Ability to read and work from mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and engineering documentation
  • Experience with rapid prototyping, fabrication, and iterative hardware development.
  • Ability to systematically troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level problems.
  • Experience using common mechanical and electrical tools and test equipment.
  • Experience supporting engineering, ground, flight, or field testing.
  • Strong attention to detail, workmanship, safety, and configuration control.
  • Ability to work independently and solve technical problems in fast-moving workshop, laboratory, flight-line, and field environments.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to transport equipment and personnel to operational sites.
  • Ability to travel within Ukraine as required.

* Experience maintaining or integrating fixed-wing and multirotor UAS.
* Experience with autonomous or experimental aircraft and Group 1 or Group 2 UAS.
* Experience building or maintaining HIL environments for aircraft, robotics, or autonomous systems.
* Experience with 3D printing, CAD, and prototype part fabrication.
* Experience integrating avionics, flight computers, sensors, actuators, radios, antennas, or payload systems.
* Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or similar flight-control systems.
* Familiarity with Ground Control Stations, telemetry, RF systems, datalinks, and networking.
* Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, scripting, or basic software troubleshooting.
* Experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, or similar electrical test equipment.
* Experience establishing or maintaining an engineering lab, prototype shop, HIL lab, or flight-operations facility.
* Background in defense, aerospace, robotics, aircraft maintenance, manufacturing, or flight test.
* Experience working in austere or rapidly changing field environments.
* Ukrainian and English language proficiency.

Embedded within the Hivemind Learning & Development team, this role combines production AI engineering, developer experience, and technical education.

Job Description:

The Senior AI Engineer, Hivemind Learning & Development is a hands-on individual contributor who will build the AI-powered products, content systems, and measurement capabilities that help engineers learn Hivemind faster and apply it successfully. Embedded within the Hivemind Learning & Development team, this role combines production AI engineering, developer experience, and technical education. 

You will own an AI training coach that provides grounded, context-aware guidance; create tooling that turns learning objectives and product changes into high-quality workshops; and partner with autonomy experts to produce deeply technical curricula, labs, and assessments. The role works closely with Applications Engineering, Hivemind engineering and Customer Success. 

Success is defined by trusted learning products that ship, shorter time to technical proficiency, faster and more consistent workshop development, content that stays current with Hivemind releases, and clear evidence that training improves customer capability and product adoption.

lists.content:
• Develop an AI-powered training coach that helps people learn Hivemind concepts, products, and development workflows. 
  • Create highly technical Hivemind training materials and hands-on workshops for engineers and other technical learners. 
  • Build prompt-based tooling that generates workshops and supporting learning content from defined objectives, audiences, and source materials. 
  • Create LLM-based tooling that automates the ongoing upgrade and improvement of Hivemind training and educational materials. 
  • Build AI tools and systems that enable, streamline, and automate Hivemind Learning & Development workflows.

• Progressive experience building production software, AI-enabled products, developer tools, technical learning platforms, or comparable systems. 
  • Hands-on experience integrating large language models, generative AI APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, prompt workflows, or AI-assisted automation into production or enterprise environments. 
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API design, testing, observability, documentation, secure coding, maintainable architecture, and operational ownership. 
  • Professional proficiency in Python and the ability to read, debug, and create credible examples in modern C++. 
  • Experience translating complex software or systems concepts into clear technical documentation, hands-on labs, workshops, developer education, or enablement material. 
  • Ability to learn a sophisticated technical product quickly, work directly with subject-matter experts, and convert ambiguous needs into practical, testable learning solutions. 
  • Experience evaluating AI system quality using automated tests, structured human review, telemetry, or task-based performance measures. 
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, sound technical judgment, and a collaborative style suited to engineers, instructors, customers, and cross-functional partners.

• Experience with autonomy, robotics, aerospace, defense, simulation, distributed systems, or safety-critical software. 
  • Experience with developer education, instructional design, learning science, intelligent tutoring systems, or assessment design for highly technical audiences. 
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability, prompt and agent testing, vector databases, enterprise search, model gateways, and deployment in restricted or disconnected environments. 
  • Experience designing and facilitating hands-on technical workshops for customer engineers, including troubleshooting live technical environments. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, Data Science, Learning Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Hivemind gives engineers a comprehensive platform to develop, test, and deploy AI pilots. The value of that platform depends on how quickly technical teams can build sound mental models, complete real workflows, and apply the software with confidence. This engineer will create the learning systems that make expert knowledge available at the moment of need, reduce the delay between product change and customer readiness, and help the Learning & Development team scale quality without losing technical rigor.

Job Description:

The Senior IT Systems Engineer builds, improves, and sustains classified infrastructure supporting engineering work. The role covers compute, virtualization, storage, networking, identity, endpoints, and security tooling in standalone and air-gapped environments.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor position. Responsibilities include racking and imaging hardware, building and hardening systems, automating repeatable work, troubleshooting difficult issues, and helping establish technical standards across sites. The engineer must be comfortable working independently, shifting across infrastructure disciplines when needed, and owning work from design through testing, documentation, and support.

The role sits between IT operations and accreditation. Systems must be secure, reliable, and ready for review by ISSMs and government assessors. Correct implementation the first time, backed by complete documentation and technical evidence, is an expected part of every build.

lists.content:
Build and operate classified infrastructure

  • Deploy, configure, and sustain Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems, virtualization clusters, enterprise storage, and core infrastructure services in standalone and air-gapped enclaves.
  • Build and support VMware, Nutanix AHV/Prism, or similar virtualization environments. Nutanix experience is preferred.
  • Support high-density compute for AI/ML, simulation, and engineering workloads, including GPU node provisioning, performance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and coordination with facilities on rack space, power, and cooling.
  • Administer and support Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, PKI, certificate services, privileged access, and role-based access for isolated forests with no connection to corporate IT.
  • Build and maintain golden images and hardened baselines for servers, workstations, virtual desktops, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Manage patching, updates, software packages, and security content in disconnected environments through approved transfer and validation processes.
  • Administer backup, recovery, and continuity capabilities. Perform scheduled restore testing and document results and corrective actions.
  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot managed switching, VLANs, firewall rules, network segmentation, and approved network connections between facilities. Coordinate with network and security teams to maintain secure, supportable network standards.

    • Automate and standardize

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, reporting, and compliance tasks using PowerShell, Ansible, Python, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Create repeatable build processes, system baselines, checklists, and runbooks so systems can be deployed consistently rather than built by hand each time.
  • Improve existing processes by reducing manual steps, preventing common errors, and documenting effective methods for building and supporting systems.
  • Apply and validate DISA STIGs and SRGs using SCAP, STIG Viewer, ACAS/Nessus, scripted remediation, and other approved tools.
  • Maintain configuration-management records, as-built documentation, change records, and scan evidence so system configurations can be understood and defended later.
  • Review technical changes before production implementation, with attention to security, availability, rollback planning, and operational impact.

    • Support accreditation and security operations

  • Work with ISSMs, ISSOs, security teams, and program stakeholders to implement NIST SP 800-53, JSIG, RMF, and program-specific technical controls.
  • Provide technical documentation and evidence for authorization packages, continuous monitoring, assessments, and audits.
  • Implement and maintain audit logging and forwarding, including Elastic or similar centralized logging and SIEM tools.
  • Support vulnerability management through ACAS/Nessus scanning, findings triage, remediation planning, patching, and validation during approved maintenance windows.
  • Help resolve technical POA&M items and document remediation steps, validation results, and remaining risks.
  • Support approved media handling, file transfer, cross-domain processes, and contamination or spillage response alongside the security team.

    • Support users and sites

  • Act as a senior escalation point for classified IT issues that block engineering work or require deeper troubleshooting across multiple systems.
  • Identify and correct root causes rather than relying on repeated fixes or workarounds.
  • Support user-account, privileged-access, and workstation-access requests consistent with least privilege and separation-of-duties requirements.
  • Support new facility and enclave stand-ups from rack layout and cabling through infrastructure deployment, user onboarding, and operational handoff.
  • Mentor junior system administrators and site IT staff, review implementation work before production release, and help improve team standards.
  • Work independently, manage competing priorities, communicate risks early, and bring practical solutions to the team.

• Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, and enterprise endpoint management.
  • Experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux or similar enterprise Linux systems.
  • Experience with VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or similar enterprise virtualization platforms. Nutanix AHV/Prism experience is preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise storage, backup/recovery, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with managed switching, VLANs, firewall administration, network segmentation, and troubleshooting network connectivity.
  • Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation. Experience with Ansible, Python, Terraform, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs, using SCAP/STIG Viewer, supporting ACAS/Nessus findings, and working in RMF, NIST SP 800-53, JSIG, or similarly regulated environments.
  • Experience operating in disconnected, air-gapped, classified, or highly controlled environments.
  • Ability to document work clearly, follow change control, validate results, and build systems that are easy for others to support.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment, shift between infrastructure disciplines when needed, and make sound technical decisions without requiring detailed direction.

• Nutanix AHV, Prism Central, Files, Flow, or cluster lifecycle management.
  • GPU server, AI/ML, simulation, VDI, or high-performance compute infrastructure.
  • Elastic, Splunk, or other centralized logging and SIEM platforms.
  • Disconnected WSUS, offline patching, software-repository management, or approved media-transfer workflows.
  • Data-center buildouts, rack-and-stack, structured cabling, power/cooling coordination, and new-facility stand-ups.
  • Relevant technical or security certifications, such as Security+, CISSP, RHCSA/RHCE, VMware VCP, Nutanix NCA/NCP, Microsoft certifications, or CCNA/CCNP.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Hardware in the Loop Lab Technician to support the fabrication, instrumentation, and testing of new aerospace products. This role is ideal for a hands-on builder who thrives in dynamic environments, has deep experience working with aircraft systems and fabrication methods, and has a background building and maintaining a Systems Integration Lab.

You will be a key contributor in helping bring cutting-edge designs to life, playing a vital role in everything from early-stage prototype development to detailed testing and validation of final assemblies.

lists.content:
• Construct and assemble air vehicle systems and subsystems such as landing gear, mechanisms, fluid systems, test articles in alignment with engineering drawings, engineering instructions, and CAD models.
  • Support the design, prototyping, and fabrication of new products, R&D initiatives, and flight-ready hardware.
  • Work with aerospace-grade materials and perform component repairs using industry-standard techniques and tools.
  • Fabricate fixtures, machine brackets, and execute rapid modifications on prototype hardware as needed.
  • Install strain gauges, thermocouples and various sensors according to precise instrumentation schematics.
  • Route cabling, integrate data acquisition systems, and verify sensor calibration and operational status.
  • Conduct mechanical testing by applying static and dynamic loads per detailed engineering procedures.
  • Document test outcomes clearly and report anomalies or irregularities in a timely manner.
  • Ensure a clean, organized, and safe workspace across shop, lab, and composite work areas.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in instrumentation standards, testing procedures, and fabrication workflows.
  • Source and manage inventory for parts and equipment needed for component repair or replacement.

• 4-6 years of experience in aircraft/Lab maintenance, prototype fabrication, test stand design & fabrication.
  • Proficient in metallic and mechanisms fabrication, installation & removal.
  • Hands-on experience in machine shop operations, including manual and/or CNC tools.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, schematics, and detailed work instructions.
  • Comfortable working in shop and lab environments with exposure to noise, dust, and chemicals.
  • Ability to lift and move parts and equipment (up to 50 lbs.) and perform physical work for extended periods.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret level security clearance.

• Familiarity with a variety of mechanical systems (e.g., hydraulic actuators, pumps, fluids, load frames, DAQ systems).
  • Familiarity with a variety of electrical systems (e.g., cable harness checkouts, electrical connections, power requirements).
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, defense, or high-performance prototyping environments.
  • Able to work independently and adapt quickly to changing technical needs.

lists.content:
Enterprise Strategy Development:

  • Support the multi‑year strategic planning and annual operating strategy cycles.
  • Evaluate portfolio tradeoffs across platforms, software, hardware, and emerging growth vectors.
  • Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, and scenario modeling across U.S. and allied defense markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive insight through analysis.
  • Financial modeling and analytical capability (unit economics, forecasting, scenario analysis).
  • Experience or strong interest in complex, technical, or regulated industries (aerospace, defense, AI, or advanced manufacturing preferred).
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and influence senior stakeholders.
  • U.S. citizenship required (ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance).

The role is hands-on, administering and continuously optimizing Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, and partners with People Technology leadership to build the roadmap for TA and HR technology.

The role is an individual, hands-on position at the start. As Shield AI scales, it is expected to grow into a player-coach role that builds and leads a TA and PX systems team. It works with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, People Experience Operations, Total Rewards, People Analytics, Finance, Procurement, IT, Security, and other cross-functional partners to turn business requirements into durable system design, and to keep TA and PX systems well-configured, well-integrated, and well-governed.

lists.content:
• Partner with People Technology leadership to build and maintain the roadmap for TA and HR technology, aligned with TA and PX priorities and Shield AI's growth plans, and lead execution of roadmap initiatives.
  • Support the full TA technology ecosystem, including the ATS, CRM, sourcing tools, scheduling, assessments, background check, interview intelligence, and related recruiting technology.
  • Personally administer, configure, and continuously optimize Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, including approvals, offers, requisitions, pipelines, interview plans, scheduling logic, scorecards, custom fields, and reporting objects.
  • Administer and support third-party HR technology, including Lattice, Pave, Compa, and Carta, covering configuration, permissions, integrations, and upgrade management.
  • Support TA and HR technology vendor management, including evaluations, implementations, contract renewals, license administration, business reviews, and performance against service commitments, in partnership with People Technology leadership, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.
  • Define integration architecture across the TA and PX stack, including UKG, O365 / calendar, identity and SSO, and the PX data platform, and manage change control and monitoring.
  • Translate business and process requirements from TA and PX stakeholders into clear system design decisions, trade-offs, and configuration; recommend priorities across competing requests; and document the resulting workflows, permissions, and data model.
  • Establish and maintain data governance for TA and PX systems, including field taxonomies, PII classification, role-based access, retention, naming conventions, and reporting boundaries aligned to the broader PX Analytics Estate.
  • Lead release management and UAT for TA and PX system changes, including test plans, sandbox validation, rollout, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Keep recruiting and PX data pipelines reliable enough for executive reporting, with clean source data, consistent definitions, and reporting objects that downstream analytics can trust.
  • Track the TA and PX technology market, evaluate new capabilities and vendors, and build recommendations on where to configure, integrate, consolidate, buy, or hold.
  • Ensure TA and PX systems support compliance with applicable data privacy, security, and recordkeeping requirements, including EEO, OFCCP, and GDPR, by maintaining system controls and supporting audits.
  • As the function grows, help define future roles, then hire and lead a team as a player-coach while staying hands-on in configuration and design.

• Direct hands-on Ashby administration experience, including configuration, workflows, approvals, offers, permissions, integrations, and reporting objects.
  • 8+ years of experience administering and optimizing recruiting and HR technology, including deep ownership of at least one modern ATS and its surrounding TA technology stack.
  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education, experience, skills, and knowledge.
  • Experience contributing to a TA or HR technology roadmap and supporting vendor relationships and renewals across multiple platforms.
  • A hands-on builder who enjoys doing the configuration work, with experience mentoring others or leading cross-functional implementations and an interest in growing into a people leader.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end talent acquisition processes, from sourcing and pipeline management through interviewing, offers, and the onboarding handoff, and how technology enables each stage.
  • Fluency in the TA technology landscape, including ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, assessments, interview intelligence, and analytics.
  • Experience administering PX SaaS tools such as performance, compensation, equity, engagement, or HRIS-adjacent platforms.
  • A systems-thinking mindset: you look at a requirement and see the workflow, data model, permissions, and downstream reporting implications together.
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the judgment to translate ambiguous requests into clear configuration decisions and trade-offs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present roadmaps, trade-offs, and business cases to TA and PX leadership, Finance, and senior stakeholders.

• Experience leading an ATS migration or major recruiting technology consolidation onto Ashby or a comparable modern ATS.
  • Experience building or scaling a People or HR technology function, including hiring and developing systems administrators or analysts.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts for people data, including PII classification, role-based access, and reporting boundaries.
  • Experience with UKG, Workday, or another enterprise HRIS as an integration partner.
  • Working knowledge of no-code automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, Tray) or scripting.
  • Prior experience supporting people technology in a regulated, government contracting, technology, aerospace, or similarly complex environment.

• A clear, prioritized roadmap for TA and HR technology is built with People Technology leadership and delivered against.
  • Ashby, sourcing tools, and supported PX platforms are configured, integrated, and permissioned to reliably support current and future TA and PX processes.
  • TA and HR technology vendors, renewals, and licenses are supported proactively, with clear recommendations on where tools deliver value.
  • System changes go through a consistent release-management and UAT process, with clear documentation and minimal disruption.
  • TA and PX data is well-governed, well-classified, and trustworthy enough to support executive reporting and audits.
  • Stakeholders receive timely, effective support, and repeat issues decline over time.
  • As the function grows, a plan for future team roles is in place and the role transitions effectively into a player-coach.

Job Description:
We're hiring a Senior or Staff Liaison Engineer to be the engineering point of contact for hardware issues affecting V-BAT production, testing and fielded aircraft. This person holds engineering authority for nonconformance (NCR) and Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, which covers anything that isn't simply reworked to print, including use-as-is and repair. They pull in Structures, Thermal and Design when they need specialist input to confirm a path forward. 
The ideal candidate is the person Production and Quality go to when they ask, "I have this problem, how do I solve it?" They own the answer from start to finish: the disposition, the rework or repair instructions, the drawing updates, and the long-term corrective action that keeps the problem from coming back. Composite repair experience is essential. This role is focused on liaison and sustaining engineering, not new-product design.

Job Description:

We're hiring a Senior or Staff Liaison Engineer to be the engineering point of contact for hardware issues affecting V-BAT production, testing and fielded aircraft. This person holds engineering authority for nonconformance (NCR) and Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, which covers anything that isn't simply reworked to print, including use-as-is and repair. They pull in Structures, Thermal and Design when they need specialist input to confirm a path forward. 

The ideal candidate is the person Production and Quality go to when they ask, "I have this problem, how do I solve it?" They own the answer from start to finish: the disposition, the rework or repair instructions, the drawing updates, and the long-term corrective action that keeps the problem from coming back. Composite repair experience is essential. This role is focused on liaison and sustaining engineering, not new-product design.

lists.content:
• Lead the resolution of mechanical issues arising from production, testing, fielded aircraft and customer operations, including hands-on support during builds, integration and troubleshooting.
  • Serve as the engineering point of contact and approval authority for NCR and MRB dispositions, bringing in Structures, Thermal and Design as needed to confirm a path forward.
  • Disposition nonconformances as use-as-is, repair, rework, scrap or return to vendor, with documented reasoning about the effect on form, fit, function and structural integrity.
  • Evaluate and disposition issues across a wide range of hardware, including metallic, composite and plastic parts, wire harnesses and electronic assemblies.
  • Write rework and repair instructions for individual NCRs and for standard pre-approved repairs, including inspection and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with Quality to drive issues to resolution and lead formal root cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations when needed, using fault trees, 5 Whys, failure analysis and test-based troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate investigations across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test and Field Operations.
  • Decide when issues need changes to designs, drawings, processes, inspections or supplier controls, and drive CAD, drawing, specification and BOM updates through release.
  • Track recurring nonconformances and feed lessons learned back into designs and processes.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience for Senior Engineer, or 8+ years for Staff Engineer
  • Experience reviewing and dispositioning NCRs within an MRB process in aerospace, defense or another regulated industry.
  • Experience supporting production, sustaining engineering, fielded products or complex hardware troubleshooting.
  • Experience writing rework or repair instructions for production hardware.
  • A track record of resolving technical issues through verified corrective action, including formal RCCA.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD, engineering drawings, GD&T and mechanical design for manufacturing.
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills, and clear communication across teams.

• Experience as a liaison or MRB engineer on aircraft or UAS production.
  • Experience classifying structural versus non-structural repairs, or writing standard repair procedures or structural repair manuals.
  • Working knowledge of composite materials, processes and inspection methods, such as prepreg, wet layup, bonding, cure cycles, tap testing and ultrasonic testing.
  • Familiarity with workmanship standards for wire harnesses and electronic assemblies, such as IPC/WHMA-A-620 and IPC-A-610.
  • Familiarity with metallic and plastic manufacturing processes, finishes and common defect modes.
  • Ability to assess structural margin, or experience working closely with stress and thermal analysts.
  • Experience in an AS9100 quality environment.
  • Experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
  • Experience supporting fielded aircraft and customer operations.

Shield AI is a defence technology company building intelligent autonomous systems for defence programmes. We are seeking a Senior Manager, UK Security to establish and lead the UK industrial security capability required to pursue and deliver sensitive Ministry of Defence, allied-government, and prime-contractor programmes.

This hands-on leader will serve as Shield AI's senior UK security adviser and, subject to government approval and contractual need, perform the appropriate Facility Security Controller and Personnel Security Controller responsibilities. The role will align UK operations with Shield AI's global framework while preserving UK sovereign requirements and government direction.

lists.content:
• Establish and manage Shield AI's UK security programme across personnel, physical, information, cyber-enabled, and operational security.
  • Lead readiness for Facility Security Clearance (FSC) and Industry Personnel Security Assurance (IPSA), including gap assessments, secure-site preparations, evidence, corrective actions, and continuing assurance.
  • Serve as the principal interface with MoD contracting authorities, the Industry Security Assurance Centre (ISAC), United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV), customers, and prime contractors.
  • Establish and administer the authorised national security vetting process through NSVS, including role validation, sponsorship, clearance verification, transfers, renewals, aftercare, and cessation.
  • Partner with programme owners to identify positions requiring BPSS, SC, enhanced SC, DV, or other directed vetting, based on contractual need and need-to-know.
  • Advise Capture, Business Development, Contracts, Legal, and Programme teams on Security Aspects Letters, DEFCONs, classification guidance, flow-down obligations, costs, schedules, and risks.
  • Develop UK company security instructions, policies, risk assessments, appointment letters, procedures, registers, training, and inspection-ready records.
  • Lead secure-facility and classified-asset controls, including access, storage, accounting, transmission, destruction, visitor management, Requests for Visit, IVCO coordination, and classified logistics.
  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity and IT on secure systems, remote-working controls, government assurance, incident response, and remediation.
  • Work with product security, engineering, Cybersecurity and programme teams to identify UK customer security requirements early, support Secure by Design activities, and ensure product security risks, decisions and assurance evidence are tracked through the lifecycle.
  • Manage UK security incidents, aftercare reporting, foreign ownership or influence concerns, insider and supply-chain risks, and required government notifications.
  • Build metrics, budgets, vendors, and the UK security team as the business grows; support occasional out-of-hours response and UK or international travel.
  • Maintain a UK security risk register covering personnel, physical, information and programme security. Work with Cybersecurity and IT to identify and track relevant cyber risks, and advise or escalate material risks to UK leadership and the Board Level Contact.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible industrial, government, defence, intelligence, or corporate security experience, including ownership of a UK defence-security programme.
  • Experience serving as, or directly supporting, a UK Facility Security Controller, Personnel Security Controller, Security Controller, or comparable senior supplier-security role.
  • Practical experience with FSC or IPSA readiness and assurance, UKSV sponsorship, NSVS administration, SC or DV aftercare, and government inspection activity.
  • Strong knowledge of the Government Security Classifications Policy, GovS 007: Security, the UK Security Policy Framework, and MoD supplier and contract-security requirements.
  • Experience establishing or operating secure facilities and controls for classified information, systems, material, visitors, and international engagements.
  • Strong leadership, judgement, discretion, writing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical processes in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • British nationality, or qualifying dual nationality including British nationality, subject to government restrictions for designated security-controller duties.
  • Current SC or DV clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain the required level, plus legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Current SC or DV clearance and prior appointment as a Facility Security Controller or Personnel Security Controller for an FSC- or IPSA-assured supplier.
  • Experience standing up a security programme or secure facility and supporting multinational defence, NATO, allied, or AUKUS-related work.
  • Relevant degree, professional certification, or recognised security-body membership; working knowledge of U.S. industrial security and export-control requirements is advantageous.
  • Working knowledge of applicable MOD security policy, including JSP 440, and the ability to identify and implement the security requirements specified in contracts.
  • Familiarity with the MOD Cyber Security Model, Defence Standard 05-138, Defence Cyber Certification, Cyber Essentials and supplier security obligations.

Shield AI is seeking a strategic and operationally strong Senior Manager, Accounting to join our Finance organization. As Shield AI continues to scale globally, this role will serve as a critical leader within the accounting function, driving operational excellence, strengthening controllership processes, and helping mature the company’s financial infrastructure in support of continued growth and future public-company readiness. 

Reporting to the Accounting Director, this role will lead key aspects of the global accounting and close process, oversee complex accounting operations and intercompany activities, and partner cross-functionally to implement scalable systems, controls, and reporting processes. The ideal candidate brings a combination of strong technical accounting expertise, operational leadership, process transformation experience, and the ability to influence across a rapidly evolving organization. 

What you'll do: 
* Lead and oversee key global accounting operations, including the monthly and quarterly close consolidation process, general ledger accounting, and review of significant accruals, project accounting, capital projects, reconciliations, and cash activities. 
* Serve as a key leader in driving an efficient, accurate, and scalable close and reporting process across domestic and international entities, ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP and internal policies. 
* Partner closely with FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Program Finance, Operations, and international business teams to ensure alignment across financial reporting, operational initiatives, and strategic objectives. 
* Drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of accounting policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks in preparation for future SOX compliance and public-company readiness. 
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate accounting workflows, improve data integrity, and enhance reporting capabilities through systems optimization and process transformation initiatives. 
* Lead cross-functional projects related to ERP enhancements, accounting system implementations, reporting automation, and finance infrastructure scaling. 
* Support the Accounting Director in managing external audits, statutory reporting requirements, and coordination with external advisors and stakeholders. 
* Develop and maintain high-quality documentation for accounting processes, controls, and key business activities to support audit readiness and operational consistency. 
* Provide mentorship, guidance, and subject matter expertise to team members while helping cultivate a high-performance, collaborative accounting organization. 
* Analyze complex accounting and operational issues, assess business impacts, and recommend practical, scalable solutions that balance technical compliance with business objectives. 
* Monitor emerging accounting guidance, industry developments, and best practices, proactively evaluating potential impacts to the organization. 
* Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and ad hoc analyses as the company continues to grow and evolve. 

Required qualifications: 
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (preferred), Finance, or a related field. 
* 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience in a high-growth, complex operating environment. 
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, consolidations, and internal control frameworks; experience supporting SOX readiness or compliance initiatives strongly preferred. 
* Demonstrated experience leading complex close processes across multiple entities and coordinating cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. 
* Proven ability to drive process improvement, operational scalability, and systems optimization initiatives. 
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities. 
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with demonstrated success managing multiple priorities and delivering results under tight deadlines. 
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively partner with leaders and stakeholders across all levels of the organization. 
* High degree of ownership, accountability, and initiative with the ability to operate independently and proactively. 
* Experience developing process documentation, implementing controls, and supporting audit activities. 
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience working within modern ERP systems. 

Preferred qualifications: 
* Active CPA license. 
* Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries. 
* Experience within a fast-paced, high-growth technology company. 
* Familiarity with project-based accounting and government contracting environments. 
* Experience supporting ERP implementations, finance transformation initiatives, or accounting automation projects. 
* Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring or managing team members and influencing cross-functional initiatives. 
* Ability to evaluate complex operational and financial challenges, establish clear priorities, and execute practical solutions that support long-term scalability. 
* Experience supporting organizations preparing for IPO readiness, public-company reporting, or enhanced compliance environments.

lists.content:
• Lead the team responsible for the architecture and design for all mechanical, thermal, and EWIS elements of ground and flight avionics on the X-BAT program

  • While you will not be expected to design as an individual contributor, you must have this experience in your past to establish what "right" looks like for your organization

  • Experience working with electrical engineers to develop avionics packaging
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), thermal analysis, and fatigue/lifecycle testing 
  • Experience working directly with fabrication shops, contract manufacturers, and suppliers
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities

Job Description:
We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous planning, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity. 
We seek a Senior Corporate FP&A Lead with deep 3 statement modeling experience, a strong corporate FP&A background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning financial models and planning processes. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate FP&A: designing and owning the company’s fully integrated three statement and consolidated plan, leading the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), owning the company cash model, and producing Board- and Executive-ready outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite and Board level. 
Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise, mastery of complex HW/SW planning and unit economics, end-to-end ownership of the full planning cycle (AOP, forecast, long-range plan), and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high growth environment. This role has a natural path to FP&A and finance leadership as the company scales.

Job Description:

We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous planning, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity. 

We seek a Senior Corporate FP&A Lead with deep 3 statement modeling experience, a strong corporate FP&A background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning financial models and planning processes. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate FP&A: designing and owning the company’s fully integrated three statement and consolidated plan, leading the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), owning the company cash model, and producing Board- and Executive-ready outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite and Board level. 

Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise, mastery of complex HW/SW planning and unit economics, end-to-end ownership of the full planning cycle (AOP, forecast, long-range plan), and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high growth environment. This role has a natural path to FP&A and finance leadership as the company scales.

lists.content:
Own and Build the Financial Model & Consolidated Plan 
  • Architect and maintain a fully integrated, scalable, three statement model grounded in operational drivers, unit economics, and industry benchmarks. 
  • Own consolidated planning and end-to-end line-item ownership across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow—including equity planning (stock-based comp, share count, dilution, and equity roll-forward). 
  • Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), including scenario modeling, sensitivities, and driver-based forecasting. 
  • Translate production ramps, R&D investments, contract timing, government milestones, and GTM strategy directly into financial outcomes. 
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of risks, opportunities, capital needs, and strategic inflection points. 
    • Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) & Forecasting 
  • Own the AOP process end to end—calendar, templates, driver frameworks, consolidation, and executive review. 
  • Partner with functional and business leaders to build bottoms-up budgets that reconcile to top-down targets. 
  • Run the recurring forecast cycle, connecting short-term forecasting with the long-range plan. 
  • Take full accountability for forecast accuracy, improving results with each actualized quarter. 
    • Own the Company Cash Model 
  • Build and own rolling cash flow forecasts across working capital, inventory, milestone payments, production cycles, and CapEx. 
  • Model government contract payment timing, production curves, and program cash profiles. 
  • Identify liquidity risks early and support capital allocation and financing strategies. 
    • Drive Board & Executive Reporting 
  • Own the creation of Board of Directors and eStaff QBR materials—narratives, financial packages, and KPI dashboards. 
  • Translate complex financial and operational results into clear, executive-ready insights. 
  • Deliver Board-ready outputs including plan-vs-actual analysis, variance drivers, and strategic context. 
    • Digitize & Scale Planning Infrastructure 
  • Partner with data engineering/systems teams to evolve planning from Excel into modern cloud-based planning tools. 
  • Design modular, scalable model architectures; use Excel only where it provides meaningful analytical leverage. 
  • Integrate automation and analytics to improve clarity, reduce manual work, and increase decision velocity. 
    • Partner Across the Company 
  • Work closely with senior leaders on forward-looking financial planning and strategy. 
  • Translate engineering, program, and operations plans into financial impacts. 
  • Develop a point of view on unit economics, efficiency, scale, profitability, and capital allocation. 
  • Present insights that accelerate execution and elevate decision quality.

• 8–10 years of experience, including significant time in corporate FP&A. 
  • Direct FP&A experience in a publicly traded company. 
  • Proven ownership of scalable three statement models, AOP and LRP development, consolidated planning, and line-item ownership (including equity planning). 
  • Ownership of the company cash model and liquidity forecasting. 
  • Exceptional Excel modeling capability; fluent in multi scenario three statement modeling, beat-and-raise frameworks, and driver-based forecasting. 
  • Strong GAAP proficiency and command of financial statement mechanics. 
  • Demonstrated ability to build Board- and executive-ready materials and distill complex financial and technical information into clear insights for executives and the Board. 
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with high accuracy and strong judgment. 
  • Systems-oriented mindset; comfortable partnering with data and systems teams.

• Familiarity with government contract economics, milestone based revenue, and program accounting. 
  • Experience with equity / stock-based comp planning and share count and dilution modeling. 
  • Exposure to manufacturing scale, supply chain dynamics, and hardware production cycles. 
  • Experience implementing or scaling cloud-based planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive).

• An analytical athlete with exceptional modeling intuition and attention to detail. 
  • A structured, clear thinker who simplifies complexity without losing nuance. 
  • Fast, accurate, and calm under pressure. 
  • Curious, forward-looking, and driven to understand what truly moves the business. 
  • A strong communicator who elevates decision quality across the company. 
  • Mission-driven and energized by solving complex, high impact problems.

You will build and own the financial model and consolidated plan that define how the business is understood—internally, at the eStaff level, and at the Board. Your work will guide the AOP, capital allocation, cash strategy, investments, and long-range ambitions. This is Corporate FP&A at its highest level: high complexity, high visibility, high impact—and a direct path to FP&A and finance leadership.

Job Description:

We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous planning, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity. 

We seek a Senior Corporate FP&A Lead with deep 3 statement modeling experience, a strong corporate FP&A background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning financial models and planning processes. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate FP&A: designing and owning the company’s fully integrated three statement and consolidated plan, leading the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), owning the company cash model, and producing Board- and Executive-ready outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite and Board level. 

Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise, mastery of complex HW/SW planning and unit economics, end-to-end ownership of the full planning cycle (AOP, forecast, long-range plan), and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high growth environment. This role has a natural path to FP&A and finance leadership as the company scales.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Success to establish, lead, and scale the Aircraft Division Customer Success function supporting V-BAT and X-BAT customers. This leader will manage a team of Customer Success Managers and ensure customers achieve sustained mission value, operational readiness, product adoption
The Senior Manager will define the Customer Success strategy, operating model, organizational structure, performance expectations, and engagement standards for U.S. government, allied defense, and strategic commercial customers. This role requires a leader who can build a high-performing customer-facing team while remaining directly engaged with complex, high-priority, and strategically sensitive accounts.
This position will also lead the Aircraft Division Critical Accounts Program, establishing the governance and operating discipline required to identify customer risk early, coordinate cross-functional recovery, maintain executive visibility, and drive issues to measurable closure. The Senior Manager will serve as a senior customer advocate and ensure customer challenges result in lasting improvements across product, operations, training, sustainment, and support.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Success to establish, lead, and scale the Aircraft Division Customer Success function supporting V-BAT and X-BAT customers. This leader will manage a team of Customer Success Managers and ensure customers achieve sustained mission value, operational readiness, product adoption

The Senior Manager will define the Customer Success strategy, operating model, organizational structure, performance expectations, and engagement standards for U.S. government, allied defense, and strategic commercial customers. This role requires a leader who can build a high-performing customer-facing team while remaining directly engaged with complex, high-priority, and strategically sensitive accounts.

This position will also lead the Aircraft Division Critical Accounts Program, establishing the governance and operating discipline required to identify customer risk early, coordinate cross-functional recovery, maintain executive visibility, and drive issues to measurable closure. The Senior Manager will serve as a senior customer advocate and ensure customer challenges result in lasting improvements across product, operations, training, sustainment, and support.

lists.content:
Lead and Scale the Customer Success Function

  • Establish and lead the Aircraft Division Customer Success function supporting V-BAT and X-BAT customers across U.S. government, allied defense, and strategic commercial accounts.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for customer adoption, operational readiness, mission value, and long-term account success.
  • Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, account assignments, performance expectations, and career development plans.
  • Recruit and onboard Customer Success talent as the customer base and Aircraft Division continue to grow.
  • Set team priorities and allocate resources based on customer risk, strategic importance, operational activity, and business needs.
  • Establish measurable team and individual goals and conduct regular performance evaluations, coaching, and development discussions.
  • Build a culture of urgency, accountability, professionalism, transparency, operational excellence, and customer advocacy.

    • Build the Customer Success Operating Model

  • Develop and operate a scalable Customer Success model that includes account segmentation, customer health scoring, success plans, engagement cadence, executive business reviews, and lifecycle governance.
  • Ensure priority customers have documented success plans tied to mission outcomes, readiness objectives, adoption milestones, training requirements, sustainment needs, and executive stakeholder alignment.
  • Establish standards for customer onboarding, operational transition, training coordination, sustainment handoffs, adoption management, and recurring mission-value reviews.
  • Create repeatable processes, templates, playbooks, and governance mechanisms that allow the Customer Success organization to scale.
  • Define clear ownership and operating rhythms across Customer Success, Deployment Operations, Flight Operations, Training, Sustainment, Program Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Mission Operations.
  • Partner with Aircraft Operations leadership to establish organizational priorities, resource requirements, operating plans, and functional performance goals.

    • Lead the Critical Accounts Program

  • Own and operate the Aircraft Division Critical Accounts Program for escalated, at-risk, high-priority, or strategically sensitive customers.
  • Define Critical Accounts Program entry criteria, severity levels, account-health triggers, escalation paths, executive engagement requirements, and exit criteria.
  • Lead cross-functional critical-account reviews with clear owners, recovery plans, decision logs, customer communication strategies, risk-reduction actions, and measurable closure criteria.
  • Assign and hold internal owners accountable for recovery actions, commitments, and due dates.
  • Ensure the appropriate technical, operational, sustainment, supply, quality, program, and executive resources are engaged based on the severity and mission impact of each account.
  • Provide senior leadership with concise, action-oriented visibility into customer risk, mission impact, customer sentiment, commercial exposure, and recovery status.
  • Personally support customer engagements involving significant operational risk, executive attention, or strategic importance.
  • Conduct post-recovery reviews to ensure root causes are addressed and lessons learned are incorporated into products, processes, training, sustainment, and support.

    • Advocate for Customer Mission Success

  • Serve as a senior customer advocate for V-BAT and X-BAT customers and ensure Shield AI understands their missions, operating environments, readiness expectations, adoption barriers, and long-term objectives.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior military, government, operational, and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Translate customer feedback into clear product, support, training, documentation, sustainment, and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Training, Sustainment, and Business Development to resolve customer issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Ensure customer feedback, operational lessons, and recurring issues are incorporated into product and service improvement priorities.
  • Support strategic customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, operational deployments, executive briefings, and business reviews as needed.
  • Identify risks and opportunities that could affect customer retention, mission success, future adoption, or account growth.

    • Establish Metrics and Executive Visibility

  • Own Customer Success dashboards, account-health assessments, risk registers, success plans, Critical Accounts Program reporting, and executive operating reviews.
  • Define and track indicators including mission readiness, product adoption, training progress, fleet availability, support responsiveness, issue aging, customer sentiment, renewal or expansion risk, and executive engagement.
  • Establish regular reporting cadences that clearly communicate customer outcomes, emerging risks, functional performance, resource constraints, and required leadership decisions.
  • Use customer and operational data to identify trends, recurring problems, systemic risks, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Measure the effectiveness of the Customer Success organization and continuously improve team processes, tools, and operating rhythms.

• 10+ years of experience in customer success, customer operations, account management, program management, field operations, professional services, aviation operations, defense technology, aerospace, or mission-critical enterprise technology.
  • 5+ years of experience leading customer-facing, account management, support, field operations, program management, or Customer Success teams.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring, managing, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience building or scaling a Customer Success, customer operations, account management, or similar customer-facing function.
  • Demonstrated success managing escalated, at-risk, executive-level, or mission-critical customer accounts.
  • Experience operating structured escalation, customer-health, critical-account, executive-governance, or customer-recovery processes.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior military, government, enterprise, and internal executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to establish strategy while remaining actively engaged in customer execution and issue resolution.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity, urgency, conflict, and high operational stakes.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, adoption, operational readiness, sustainment, support, renewals, and expansion.
  • Experience defining performance metrics, operating cadences, team objectives, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive briefings, account plans, recovery plans, and leadership updates.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% and work effectively with customers and teams in operational, field, and headquarters environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

• Experience in defense, aerospace, autonomous systems, aviation, unmanned aircraft systems, software-defined systems, military operations, or operational technology deployed in austere environments.
  • Experience supporting the Department of Defense, U.S. military services, allied defense organizations, or government customers.
  • Experience with vertical takeoff and landing unmanned aircraft systems, aviation operations, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, mission systems, autonomy, deployed operations, aircraft sustainment, or mission-critical field operations.
  • Prior military service or direct experience working with operational military units.
  • Experience designing or operating Critical Accounts Programs, enterprise escalation frameworks, technical account management programs, Customer Success operations, or executive sponsor programs.
  • Experience managing customer-facing organizations supporting both hardware and software products.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Jira, Confluence, Tableau, Power BI, or similar customer success, support, and reporting systems.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Job Description:
Lead the future of physical AI in defense by building the reasoning models for unmanned autonomous systems, across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. 
We are looking for a leader with not only the deep technical expertise or the abilities to build a world-class team, but also someone with the strong conviction that AI will protect service members and civilians. This role is responsible for building and leading a team that researches and designs models, establishes training pipelines and rigorous evaluations, and ensures mission effectiveness at the edge under real-world constraints. These models must support individual vehicles and coordinated teams of hundreds of agents, while meeting the constraints of operating at the edge in contested environments. 
In this role, you’ll partner closely with world-class teams in perception, MLOps, large-scale simulation, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of the broader Hivemind Enterprise team. 
What success looks like: your team’s reasoning models deliver exceptional outcomes for baseline platforms and missions, which can then be rapidly and confidently adapted to new platforms and missions by our solutions engineering organisation.

Job Description:

Lead the future of physical AI in defense by building the reasoning models for unmanned autonomous systems, across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. 

We are looking for a leader with not only the deep technical expertise or the abilities to build a world-class team, but also someone with the strong conviction that AI will protect service members and civilians. This role is responsible for building and leading a team that researches and designs models, establishes training pipelines and rigorous evaluations, and ensures mission effectiveness at the edge under real-world constraints. These models must support individual vehicles and coordinated teams of hundreds of agents, while meeting the constraints of operating at the edge in contested environments. 

In this role, you’ll partner closely with world-class teams in perception, MLOps, large-scale simulation, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of the broader Hivemind Enterprise team. 

What success looks like: your team’s reasoning models deliver exceptional outcomes for baseline platforms and missions, which can then be rapidly and confidently adapted to new platforms and missions by our solutions engineering organisation.

lists.content:
• Build & lead the team that designs, trains, adapts, and evaluates reasoning and cognition models intended for deployment across our unmanned platforms. 
  • Define the technical roadmap for single-agent and multi-agent models, including architecture choices, training methods, data strategy, and evaluation criteria. 
  • Make informed tradeoffs among foundation-model approaches (e.g. VLMs, VLAs), specialized deep-learning models, and traditional AI/ML methods. 
  • Advance model capabilities for interpreting context, reasoning over time, coordinating among agents, and adapting to incomplete or changing information. 
  • Drive training efforts, including appropriate use of self-supervised learning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and distillation. 
  • Establish rigorous evaluations in simulation and with real-world data. Measure generalization, robustness, uncertainty, and performance as team size and operating conditions change. 
  • Recruit, develop, and manage a high-performing team of AI/ML engineers. 
  • Translate edge constraints into model-design and training decisions in partnership with hardware, autonomy, and inference teams. 
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and model limitations clearly to research, engineering, product, and organizational leadership. 
  • Deliver trained models and clear performance evidence to partner teams. 
  • Create tight feedback loops among model failures, data curation, training experiments, and re-evaluation.

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 8 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 
  • Exceptional track record of leading the development and deployment of state-of-the-art ML models in production environments, making difficult prioritisation decisions, and communicating tradeoffs across disciplines. 
  • 5+ years of people management experience leading engineering or applied research teams, with demonstrated success hiring, coaching, developing technical leaders, and managing performance. 
  • Deep expertise in foundation models, modern deep learning, model architectures, and the training ecosystem. 
  • Strong command of training and adaptation approaches such as self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and distillation. 
  • Experience defining datasets, training objectives, experimental workflows, benchmarks, and reproducible criteria for comparing models. 
  • Fluency in traditional AI/ML techniques and an ability to combine them thoughtfully with learned models. 
  • Experience with training frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, etc. 
  • Experience with multimodal, embodied, robotic, or autonomous-system models; familiarity with VLA models and world models is particularly relevant. 
  • Strong familiarity with traditional robotics algorithms, e.g. path planning, probabilistic modeling, optimization approaches, etc. 
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson and other edge compute platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, AMD, etc.)

• PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar degree. 
  • Expertise in optimising and deploying ML models to resource-constrained hardware platforms. 
  • Experience with simulation-to-real on autonomous systems. 
  • Experience managing managers or leading multiple engineering teams. 
  • Experience with unmanned autonomous systems in defense applications 
  • Familiarity with large, distributed systems 
  • Familiarity with high-fidelity simulation, e.g. rigid body dynamics, sensor & actuator models, etc. 
  • Experience managing and interfacing with external partners and vendors

• Lead the team responsible for the architecture and design for all mechanical, thermal, and EWIS elements of ground and flight avionics on the X-BAT program
  • Take ownership of a small team of thermal, mechanical, and EWIS engineers, establish leads and sub-managers, and grow the team to support program goals in the immediate and long term
  • While you will not be expected to design as an individual contributor, you must have this experience in your past to establish what "right" looks like for your organization
  • Develop standards and processes for thermal and mechanical engineering of critical avionics hardware
  • Partner closely with electrical engineering, RF, PCB design, reliability, supply chain, structures, manufacturing and other disciplines to drive full scope product delivery
  • Own your team's output of complex electro-mechanical solutions for flight critical avionics systems that withstand harsh environments

• B.S. in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering 
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical design around electronics and electrical systems
  • Strong experience in CAD software (NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for 3D modeling, drawing creation, and system layout
  • Experience working with electrical engineers to develop avionics packaging
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), thermal analysis, and fatigue/lifecycle testing 
  • Experience working directly with fabrication shops, contract manufacturers, and suppliers
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities 
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others 
  • Ability to obtain a Secret level security clearance

lists.content:
• Lead teams across autonomy, integration, and testing by aligning technical efforts, resolving cross-functional challenges, and driving mission-focused execution. Balance hands-on technical oversight with performance optimization, innovation, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Write production quality software in C++ 
  • Produce an Assured Position, Navigation, and Timing (A-PNT) system to enable reliable autonomy in GNSS-degraded or denied environments 
  • Extend and specialize Shield AI’s state-of-the-art state estimation framework for new sensors, platforms, and missions 
  • Write test code to validate your software with simulated and real-world data 
  • Collaborate with hardware and test teams to validate algorithms/code on aerial platforms 
  • Write analyzers to ingest data and produce statistics to validate code quality 
  • Enhance sensor models within a high-fidelity simulation environment 
  • Work in a fast-paced, collaborative, continuous development environment, enhancing analysis and benchmarking capabilities

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Ability to develop, benchmark, debug, and deploy software-based algorithms 
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills by applying a scientific approach 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 8 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years managing technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating and working with sensor payloads in the DoD space
  • Proficient with sensor fusion for noisy high-bandwidth exteroceptive sensors on compute-constrained systems
  • A solid foundation in theory related to state estimation, object detection,  data association, probabilistic robotics, and signal processing.
  • Experience working projects with 10+ contributors 
  • Offers Fast, efficient, effective problem solving approaches 
  • Exceptional collaborator and communicator 
  • Comfortability within Unix environments 
  • Hard-working, trustworthy teammate 
  • Exhibits holding themselves and others to high standards 
  • Being kind to others 
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance

• MS or greater in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Understanding of robotics technologies related to autonomous behavior development e.g. task allocation or planning. 
  • Understanding/Experience with unmanned system technologies and accompanying algorithms (specifically air domain) 
  • Familiarity with high-fidelity simulation and sensor modeling
  • Working knowledge of Kalman Filter, Factor Graphs and other modern estimator fundamentals.
  • Strong working knowledge of Computer Vision with hands-on experience with OpenCV or similar CV libraries.
  • Experience developing sensor effects (control) algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience developing or implementing state of the art object detection/recognition pipelines.
  • Active SECRET clearance 
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards
