Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production. 

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.

lists.content:
Development Program Materials Planning  

  • Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy. 

  • Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.   

  • Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy. 

  • Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule. 

  • Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans. 

  • Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.   

  • Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.   

  • Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions. 

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness  

  • Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.   

  • Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.   

  • Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.   

  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.   

Team Leadership  

  • Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.   

  • Establish standard work and training programs.   

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.   

  • 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.   

  • Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.   

  • Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.   

  • Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.   

  • Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.   

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.   

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.   

  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

• Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.   

  • Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.   

  • Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.   

  • APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.   

  • Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.   

  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.   

  • Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

Job Description:
The Senior Program Manager, International Programs will lead the execution and growth of Shield AI's international Direct Commercial Sales (DCS) programs, with significant regional responsibility within a portfolio spanning the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. This role serves as the primary interface between international government and military customers, industrial partners, business development, contracts, engineering, production, operations, and executive leadership to deliver mission-critical V-BAT capabilities and build enduring international partnerships.
The candidate will bring a proven track record leading complex, customer-facing defense programs from capture through execution, with the judgment to navigate demanding contractual, export-control, and cultural environments. They will operate comfortably in high-visibility situations, mentor and back up in-country program managers, and keep senior leadership informed with clear, candid reporting. Based at our Frisco, TX headquarters alongside the V-BAT engineering and production teams, this individual will travel internationally on a regular basis to be present with customers and partners when it matters most. As the international business grows, there may be future opportunities for an in-country assignment for candidates who are interested; this is not a condition of employment.

lists.content:
Development Quality Leadership

  • Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.
  • Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.
  • Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.
  • Support reliability growth planning and execution.
  • Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

  • Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.
  • Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.
  • Support qualification and certification efforts.

  • Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.
  • Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.
  • Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.
    • Production Readiness & Industrialization
  • Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.
  • Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.
  • Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.
  • Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.
  • Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.
    • Quality Management System
  • Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.
  • Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.
  • Support internal and external audits as required.
  • Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.
    • Leadership & Team Development
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.
  • Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.
  • Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.
  • Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.
  • Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.
  • Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.
  • Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.
  • Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

• Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.
  • Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.
  • Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.
  • Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
  • Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

As the Senior Manager of Software Test, you will lead the verification and validation of autonomy, mission-oriented, avionics software for Shield AI’s next-gen aircraft systems. These platforms demand the highest levels of system integrity, operational reliability, and test rigor. Your role will center around designing scalable, automated test infrastructure, validating mission-critical behaviors across simulation and real aircraft environments, and enabling rapid, safe deployment of software to flight operations. This role focuses on accelerating software maturity and validation through rigorous, automated, and traceable testing practices for the VBAT platform.

lists.content:
• Build a world class software and system test infrastructure for rapid software deployments   
  • Own end-to-end system test strategy for software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) environments—scaling them for continuous integration and rapid release cycles.  
  • Design and implement mission-critical system test cases validating autonomous behaviors, requirements compliance, and operational edge cases across nominal, safety-critical, and degraded conditions.  
  • Coordinate and execute flight test and software release campaigns, working cross-functionally with autonomy, embedded systems, flight ops, and safety engineering teams.

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related field 
  • 8+ years of experience in software testing, systems testing, or verification & validation for complex, safety-critical or mission-critical systems (autonomy, aerospace, defense, robotics, UAVs, etc.) 
  • 3+ years of experience leading teams, including some experience managing other managers 
  • Strong proficiency in test automation, scripting, data analysis, and test infrastructure development 
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks (SIL, HIL, VIL, CI/CD pipelines) 
  • Experience validating autonomous behaviors or distributed real-time systems 
  • Deep understanding of software verification methodologies, including requirements traceability, test planning, and regression testing 
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testbeds, embedded systems, or avionics integration 
  • Ability to design system-level test cases including edge cases, degraded modes, and safety-critical scenarios 
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with autonomy, avionics, embedded, and flight ops teams 
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, especially around test plans, procedures, and safety considerations

• Experience testing unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), rotorcraft, or airborne mission systems 
  • Knowledge of DO-178C, MIL-STD-882, STANAG, or other safety/airworthiness frameworks 
  • Experience with simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac, ROS/ROS2 simulation, custom autonomy sims, etc.) 
  • Experience with continuous integration systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, etc.) 
  • Knowledge of autonomy algorithms (navigation, planning, perception) sufficient to design adversarial or mission-based test scenarios 
  • Comfort operating in dynamic R&D environments where rapid iteration and tight feedback loops are the norm

Job Description:

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

lists.content:
• Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.
  • Establish supplier-quality priorities, allocate resources, and translate functional objectives into staffing, workload, and execution plans that support product, program, and organizational needs.
  • Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.
  • Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.
  • Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
  • Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.
  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.
  • Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality Engineering personnel.
  • Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality-management systems, as well as aerospace and defense supplier-quality requirements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.
  • Experience with supplier qualification, supplier development, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes, including AS9102 requirements.
  • Understanding of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and other requirements applicable to aerospace and defense suppliers.
  • Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, organizational development, and building high-performing technical teams.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, executive communication, and supplier relationship-management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems.
  • Ability to travel to Shield AI manufacturing locations and supplier sites domestically and, as needed, internationally—up to approximately 20% of the time.

• ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent quality certification.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Experience leading supplier-quality functions in a high-growth aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, or advanced-manufacturing environment.
  • Experience supporting the production and qualification of complex electromechanical, electronic, precision-machined, composite, or avionics hardware.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Material Planner to manage material requirements planning (MRP), with a focus on ad hoc independent demand loaded into the ERP system. This role will validate material requests, maintain accurate requirements, and coordinate with requestors and Supply Chain to support material availability.

The Material Planner will manage requests from submission through fulfillment or cancellation, ensuring demand remains accurate and does not create duplicate purchasing requirements or unnecessary inventory.

lists.content:
• Review ad hoc material requests for correct part numbers, quantities, need dates, program references, and approvals.
  • Check for existing demand, inventory, and open supply before loading new requirements.
  • Load approved independent demand into the ERP system and maintain traceability to the original request.
  • Update or cancel requirements as needs change.
  • Review related MRP outputs and resolve inaccurate or duplicate planning signals.
  • Coordinate with Procurement, Inventory Control, Engineering, and program teams to address shortages and communicate material status.
  • Reconcile fulfilled requests and remove stale or canceled demand.

Job Description: 
As a Staff Systems Integration Engineer you will provide technical leadership for the integration of major aircraft systems across the full product development lifecycle. You will establish subsystem installation architectures, guide multidisciplinary engineering teams, and lead complex integration efforts involving structures, avionics, propulsion, electrical systems, manufacturing, and suppliers.

In this role, you will influence technical direction beyond your immediate assignments by developing integration strategies, improving engineering processes, and mentoring engineers across multiple programs.

Job Description:

As a Senior Systems Integration Engineer, you will lead the design and integration of complex aircraft systems from concept through production. You will own subsystem-level integration activities, including installation design, equipment packaging, routing, interface definition, and manufacturing support, while ensuring compatibility across structures, avionics, propulsion, and other aircraft systems.

You will serve as the technical lead for integration work statements, coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve integration challenges, drive design decisions, and deliver robust, manufacturable solutions that meet program objectives.

The ideal candidate is an experienced mechanical engineer who combines strong aircraft design fundamentals with systems-level thinking. They have demonstrated success leading subsystem integration efforts, proactively identifying technical risks, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating effectively across engineering disciplines to deliver integrated aircraft solutions.

lists.content:
• Lead the mechanical integration of complete aircraft subsystems from concept through production, ensuring compatibility across structural, electrical, avionics, propulsion, and manufacturing interfaces.
  • Develop installation architecture for complex aircraft systems, including subsystem packaging, equipment mounting, and routing of electrical and fluid systems.
  • Lead the design of complex machined, composite, fabricated, and sheet metal assemblies requiring advanced engineering judgment.
  • Develop and review installation drawings, assembly documentation, and configuration baselines to ensure design consistency and production readiness.
  • Perform advanced tolerance analyses, structural hand calculations, and engineering trade studies supporting design decisions.
  • Coordinate subsystem integration activities during prototype builds, aircraft assembly, and production.
  • Mentor junior engineers in CAD modeling, GD&T application, installation design, and engineering best practices.
  • Coordinate suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues affecting integration, manufacturability, schedule, or cost.
  • Support technical planning, schedule development, and project execution for assigned work packages."

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in aircraft, aerospace, defense, robotics, or complex electromechanical system development.
  • Demonstrated experience designing machined, fabricated, composite, and sheet metal components from concept through production release.
  • Demonstrated experience leading mechanical integration of aircraft subsystems or complex assemblies.
  • Advanced CAD proficiency with NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, or equivalent.
  • Experience managing engineering data, product structures, Bills of Material (BOMs), and drawing releases using PLM systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, or 3DEXPERIENCE.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft installation practices, subsystem packaging, interface management, equipment mounting, and maintainability considerations.
  • Experience developing installation layouts and routing solutions for EWIS, hydraulic, fuel, pneumatic, ECS, or similar mechanical systems.
  • Experience developing part drawings, assembly drawings, and installation drawings.
  • Working knowledge of EWIS, hydraulic, fuel, pneumatic, or ECS routing design.
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T, ASME Y14.5, tolerance stack-up, and drawing release processes.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, prototype builds, production issue resolution, or MRB activity.
  • Ability to coordinate across Manufacturing, Stress, Systems, Avionics, Supply Chain, and Test teams."

• Aircraft integration experience on UAV, military, commercial, eVTOL, or autonomous aircraft programs.
  • Experience performing structural hand calculations, margin assessments, or preliminary stress analysis.
  • Experience with FEA including static, modal, vibration, fatigue, or thermal analysis.
  • Hands-on experience supporting build, production, testing, or hardware validation activities.
  • Experience managing technical scope, schedule, risk, or supplier coordination for subsystem work packages.
  • Familiarity with aircraft-level requirements, interface control, and configuration management."

Job Description 
 
This position will be based San Mateo, CA.

Shield AI is seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer to help advance and secure our mission-critical global infrastructure. You will design, deploy, and maintain resilient network systems that power Shield AI’s enterprise and development environments—spanning data centers, on-premises sites, and public cloud networks.

You’ll partner with cross-functional teams to innovate, automate, and optimize network performance, availability, and security for operations supporting both classified and unclassified workloads. Limited travel to Shield AI sites may be required.

lists.content:
Network Engineering
* Experience with public cloud networking in Azure and AWS, including secure connectivity models (e.g., ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN / vWAN).
* Design, architect, and implement routing, switching, WLAN, and firewall infrastructure across data centers and remote offices.
* Deploy and manage WAN and VPN connectivity, ensuring secure and reliable access for enterprise and mission environments.
* Develop and apply network automation to streamline provisioning, monitoring, and configuration management.
* Cloud, Platform, Security, and Infrastructure engineering teams to develop standardized network architectures supporting self-service platforms and engineering automation.
* Recommend and implement scalable, automated approaches to operational tasks and vulnerability remediation.
* Contribute to Agile delivery cycles and engineering principles while managing assigned network projects and deliverables.
* Conduct network capacity planning and provide recommendations for growth and optimization.      

Operations and Support
* Plan and execute network and firewall changes in accordance with change-management and security governance processes.
* Continuously monitor, analyze, and improve network performance, resiliency, and security posture.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for network-related hardware, software, and application issues.
* Configure and maintain secure connectivity services (e.g., VPN/ZTNA, HTTPS, SFTP).
* Create and maintain clear operational and configuration documentation; mentor operational teams on processes and procedures.
* Engage vendors and strategic partners for escalated troubleshooting, lifecycle planning, and technology evaluations.
* Participate in on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance activities.
Maintenance
* Lead or assist with network upgrades and patching within defined maintenance windows.
* Maintain network device software and license compliance.
* Ensure security vulnerabilities are identified and remediated in coordination with IT security teams.

* 6+ years of experience supporting and administering complex network systems in production environments.
* Expertise in network routing, switching, and security architectures.
* Proficiency in at least one Network Operating System (e.g., NX-OS, JunOS, Arista EOS).
* Proficiency in at least one Network Security OS (e.g., PAN-OS, FortiOS).
* Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Python).
* Strong understanding of firewall management, segmentation, and VPN technologies.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to work independently and deliver in a structured, process-driven environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or 6+ years of relevant experience with a professional certification (e.g., CCNP, JNCIS, VCP-NV, or equivalent).
* Experience building and managing scalable hybrid infrastructure connectivity solutions linking on-premises systems with cloud networks.

* Familiarity with Juniper and Palo Alto network solutions and centralized management platform  (Panorama preferred).
* Familiarity with WLAN technologies and wireless authentication (e.g., 802.1x, RADIUS).
* Experience with NAC solutions and network access policy enforcement.
* Experience with ZTNA / SASE solutions (Prisma, Zscaler, or Cato)
* Working knowledge of virtualization or operating system administration (VMware, Windows, or Linux).
* Demonstrated project management and leadership skills.
* Team-oriented, collaborative mindset with the ability to coach peers and present to non-technical stakeholders.
* Solution-driven, adaptable approach in a fast-paced, change-controlled environment.

Job Description:
As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will establish and lead the technical direction of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) and State Estimation within Hivemind Enterprise (HME). You will build the team and capabilities that enable customers to develop, integrate, validate, and deploy reliable autonomy across aircraft platforms. 
You will bring at least 15 years of GNC domain experience, deep expertise in aircraft dynamics, flight controls, navigation, and state estimation, and a demonstrated record of delivering production autopilot or flight-control software. As a hands-on technical leader, you will develop algorithms, contribute production software, guide critical engineering decisions, and establish a fast, rigorous development cycle spanning simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and flight testing. 
Working with stakeholders across Hivemind Enterprise, Hivemind Solutions, and Shield AI’s aircraft organizations, you will define HME’s GNC and State Estimation technical roadmap and translate it into reusable platform capabilities and customer deliverables. You will help drive our Runtime Assurance (RTA) solution and deliver the required capabilities that will help our customers develop the technical evidence needed to support airworthiness of their platforms.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will establish and lead the technical direction of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) and State Estimation within Hivemind Enterprise (HME). You will build the team and capabilities that enable customers to develop, integrate, validate, and deploy reliable autonomy across aircraft platforms. 

You will bring at least 15 years of GNC domain experience, deep expertise in aircraft dynamics, flight controls, navigation, and state estimation, and a demonstrated record of delivering production autopilot or flight-control software. As a hands-on technical leader, you will develop algorithms, contribute production software, guide critical engineering decisions, and establish a fast, rigorous development cycle spanning simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and flight testing. 

Working with stakeholders across Hivemind Enterprise, Hivemind Solutions, and Shield AI’s aircraft organizations, you will define HME’s GNC and State Estimation technical roadmap and translate it into reusable platform capabilities and customer deliverables. You will help drive our Runtime Assurance (RTA) solution and deliver the required capabilities that will help our customers develop the technical evidence needed to support airworthiness of their platforms. 

This role combines senior individual-contributor leadership with the opportunity to establish a new engineering team. You will attract and mentor exceptional engineers and build trusted relationships with GNC and State Estimation leaders throughout Shield AI.

lists.content:
• Establish the technical vision and roadmap. Own HME’s GNC and State Estimation technical strategy, architecture, and development priorities. Align investments with product management, customer requirements, aircraft needs, and the roadmaps of partner organizations. 
  • Build the team from the ground up. Define the capabilities and technical roles the team needs, help recruit and assess outstanding engineers, and establish effective onboarding, mentorship, and engineering standards. Partner with engineering leadership to grow a strong, collaborative technical organization. 
  • Lead hands-on algorithm development. Design, implement, tune, and validate guidance, navigation, flight-control, and state-estimation capabilities. Take direct ownership of difficult technical problems and contribute to critical algorithms, production code, and engineering tools. 
  • Deliver production autopilot and flight-control software. Guide capabilities from requirements and initial models through embedded implementation, integration, verification, customer deployment, and sustainment. Address real-time behavior, numerical robustness, hardware constraints, and fault handling. 
  • Build a reusable GNC platform. Establish modular algorithms, interfaces, vehicle and sensor abstractions, configuration mechanisms, and validation tools that support multiple aircraft and customer integrations. Enable portability between simulation and deployed environments while preserving platform-specific performance and assurance requirements. 
  • Accelerate the simulation-to-flight development cycle. Work with simulation and test teams to establish high-fidelity vehicle and sensor models, automated software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, Monte Carlo analysis, and regression coverage. Use flight data to improve models, tune algorithms, investigate anomalies, and validate subsequent releases. 
  • Drive GNC and estimation contributions to RTA. Partner with the RTA, safety, and HME pilot teams on monitoring, protection, and recovery capabilities. Lead relevant algorithm development, tuning, integration, and validation. 
  • Guide customers through technical airworthiness work. Help customers establish platform-specific assumptions, requirements, operating limits, verification plans, and supporting evidence. Work with systems safety and airworthiness specialists to address findings and support technical reviews throughout integration and qualification. 
  • Build trusted technical partnerships across Shield AI. Develop strong working relationships with peer GNC and State Estimation leaders. Establish shared reviews, exchange lessons from simulation and flight testing, identify opportunities for reuse, and resolve technical differences through clear analysis and collaborative decisions.

• At least 15 years of professional experience in GNC, including substantial hands-on development of aircraft flight controls, autopilot capabilities, navigation, and state estimation. 
  • Expert knowledge of aircraft dynamics, stability and control, guidance, and estimation, with demonstrated ability to apply that knowledge to practical flight systems. 
  • Deep experience with state estimation and sensor fusion, including inertial navigation, Kalman or nonlinear filtering, sensor characterization, and evaluation of estimation accuracy, consistency, and robustness. 
  • A demonstrated record of shipping and supporting production autopilot, flight-control, or integrated GNC software, including direct involvement in flight testing and deployment to operational aircraft or customer platforms. 
  • Significant experience as a technical lead, Principal Engineer, chief engineer, or equivalent, with ownership of complex technical decisions and influence across multiple engineering teams. 
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor, and develop strong technical talent, including experience establishing a new engineering capability or building and growing a specialist team. 
  • Strong current proficiency in C++ for production, real-time software, together with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent modeling tools and Python or comparable analysis and automation tools. 
  • Extensive experience designing, tuning, and validating GNC systems through high-fidelity simulation, software-in-the-loop testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and flight-test analysis. 
  • Experience with safety-critical development and verification, including requirements traceability, technical reviews, configuration management, and generation of evidence supporting qualification or airworthiness. 
  • Experience designing reusable algorithms, libraries, interfaces, or development tools that serve multiple platforms, programs, or engineering teams. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a modern development environment using version control, code review, continuous integration, automated testing, and reproducible simulation and analysis workflows. 
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a record of establishing technical roadmaps, delivering against commitments, incorporating customer feedback, and earning the trust of senior technical peers. 
  • Master's degree in aerospace engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Applied Mathematics or Computer Science

• Experience with GCAS / ACAS, detect-and-avoid, flight-envelope protection, or related flight-safety capabilities. 
  • Direct experience developing or validating Runtime Assurance architectures, safety monitors, recovery controllers, or assured-autonomy capabilities. 
  • Experience guiding customers or aircraft programs through military or civil airworthiness processes, including engagement with relevant technical authorities. 
  • Familiarity with DO-178C or comparable development-assurance processes and RTA guidance. 
  • Experience deploying navigation and estimation capabilities in GNSS-degraded or denied environments, including integration of APNT sources. 
  • Experience across multiple aircraft configurations, such as fixed-wing, VTOL, or rotorcraft, and adapting shared GNC capabilities to different flight envelopes. 
  • Advanced expertise in areas such as robust or nonlinear control, model predictive control, trajectory optimization, system identification, or advanced estimation. 
  • Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis on controls, navigation, estimation, robotics, or autonomous systems.

About Shield AI:
Shield AI is building the world’s best AI pilot. Our autonomous systems, including V-BAT and Hivemind Enterprise, operate in the most contested environments in the world. As next-generation aircraft programs transition from development into production, operational agility and production discipline are critical to delivering mission-ready systems while enabling rapid innovation.
We are seeking a Senior Production Planner for Development Programs to drive production planning and execution for developmental and prototype aircraft builds. This role operates at the intersection of Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to ensure aircraft build schedules remain executable despite evolving designs, changing priorities, and material constraints.
 
Job Description:
The Senior Production Planner – Development Programs is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing production plans for prototype and developmental aircraft programs. Unlike traditional production environments, this role must navigate incomplete engineering definition, evolving bills of material, shifting program priorities, and dynamic supply chain conditions while maintaining progress toward key build and flight test milestones.
You will serve as a critical coordination point between Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to translate rapidly changing program requirements into actionable production plans.

We are seeking a Senior Production Planner for Development Programs to drive production planning and execution for developmental and prototype aircraft builds. This role operates at the intersection of Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to ensure aircraft build schedules remain executable despite evolving designs, changing priorities, and material constraints.

 

Job Description:

The Senior Production Planner – Development Programs is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing production plans for prototype and developmental aircraft programs. Unlike traditional production environments, this role must navigate incomplete engineering definition, evolving bills of material, shifting program priorities, and dynamic supply chain conditions while maintaining progress toward key build and flight test milestones.

You will serve as a critical coordination point between Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to translate rapidly changing program requirements into actionable production plans.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain detailed production schedules for prototype aircraft builds, major assemblies, and integration activities
  • Translate engineering release plans, build priorities, and program milestones into executable manufacturing schedules
  • Release and manage work orders in support of aircraft builds, including builds with incomplete engineering definition or evolving configurations or bills of material
  • Coordinate schedule adjustments resulting from engineering changes, design revisions, and shifting program priorities
  • Monitor production progress and proactively identify risks to key build, integration, and flight test milestones
  • Coordinate temporary planning structures and workarounds to enable manufacturing progress while maintaining configuration control
  • Facilitate rapid schedule recovery plans when design, material, or technical issues affect build progress
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain to align material availability with build requirements and timelines
  • Support ERP/MRP system accuracy through effective planning and work order management

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in production planning, manufacturing planning, production control, or supply chain operations
  • Experience supporting complex hardware, aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other highly engineered products
  • Experience working within ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Costpoint, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, work order management, bills of material, and production scheduling
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly dynamic environment
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

• Experience supporting prototype, NPI (New Product Introduction), or developmental manufacturing programs
  • Experience in UAV, aerospace, defense, or aircraft production environments
  • Familiarity with engineering change management and configuration control processes
  • APICS CPIM certification

At Shield AI, prototype aircraft builds are where innovation becomes reality. Every developmental aircraft completed advances the future of autonomous aviation and accelerates mission capability for our customers.

This role sits at the center of that effort, helping transform evolving designs into flight-ready aircraft while building the production foundation for future scale.

If you are excited about solving complex manufacturing challenges and enabling next-generation autonomous aircraft programs, we want to hear from you.

Join us in building the world's best AI pilot.

lists.content:

  • Analyze data trends to develop business insights and deliver actionable recommendations to leadership
  • Partner closely with Program Management and Aircraft Ops teams to provide financial support on program health, spend trends, and headcount planning
  • Develop reporting cadences and dashboards to track KPIs and business performance using tools like Power BI and Excel
  • Participate in the month-end and quarter-end close process, including variance analysis and executive reporting

  • Solid understanding of financial statements and business metrics
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment

• MBA or Master’s degree in a related discipline
  • Experience supporting operations or customer-facing teams in a manufacturing, aerospace, or tech environment
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, or other data transformation and modeling tools
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Costpoint) and planning tools (e.g., Vena)
  • Track record of being a high performer with a bias for action, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail
  • Passion for using data to tell a story and drive strategic decisions

lists.content:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Program Finance Analyst to support financial execution, forecasting, and analysis across key programs. This role will partner closely with Program Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Development, and Finance leadership to provide visibility into program performance and turn program execution data into reliable forecasts and useful financial analysis.
The ideal candidate has experience in the aerospace and defense industry, specifically within program finance, FP&A, or similar roles; thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment; and can balance financial rigor with changing business needs. This role combines program finance execution and financial modeling support in approximately equal measure. Execution responsibilities provide the foundation: accurate inputs, dependable deliverables, and timely visibility into changes. Your modeling work will connect that information to broader product lifecycle economics.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. The Senior Program Finance Analyst will maintain financial models, analyze actual performance against plan, identify financial risks and opportunities, and support process improvements.
 
What you'll do:
Own assigned program finance deliverables
* Maintain recurring forecasts and EAC schedules, incorporating validated inputs from Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other functional owners.
* Coordinate input deadlines, follow up on missing information, and investigate assumptions that appear incomplete or inconsistent.
* Analyze actuals against forecasts and budgets; explain cost, timing, and schedule-related changes and prepare clear program reporting.
* Investigate variances directly with stakeholders, resolve routine discrepancies, and escalate material risks, assumption changes, or unresolved questions.
* Own assigned deliverables through completion, with appropriate review of significant changes and leadership-facing conclusions.
Connect execution data to lifecycle analysis
* Translate program actuals, forecasts, milestones, and operational assumptions into inputs for product lifecycle financial models.
* Reconcile program-level information with assumptions across RDT&E, Production, and Sustainment, maintaining traceability to source data.
* Help explain differences between an individual program’s performance and broader product economics.
* Work with team members to assess whether execution results warrant changes to longer-term assumptions, recognizing that one program may not represent the entire product.
Build and improve financial analyses
* Develop and maintain Excel templates, supporting schedules, and moderately complex analyses, including work that begins with incomplete inputs.
* Use transparent formulas, consistent structures, documented assumptions, and checks that make analysis understandable and reviewable.
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses with guidance; communicate findings, uncertainties, and implications clearly.
* Improve recurring spreadsheets and workflows to reduce manual effort and strengthen reliability.
* Build, maintain, and scale financial models used for forecasting, budgeting, and long-term planning

Required qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field
* 3+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, independent cost estimating, corporate finance, or FP&A
* Experience supporting operations or customer-facing teams in a manufacturing, aerospace, or tech environment
* Familiarity with cost accounting concepts and government contracting structures (e.g., T&M, CPFF, FFP)
* Familiarity with product lifecycles from design through execution, production, and sustainment
* Solid understanding of financial statements and business metrics
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex financial data to non-financial stakeholders
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, and data analysis
* Ability to obtain Secret clearance

Preferred qualifications:
* MBA or Master’s degree in a related discipline
* Strong understanding of US GAAP, with practical experience applying accounting principles in a government contracting or manufacturing environment
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, or other data transformation and modeling tools
* Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Costpoint) and planning tools (e.g., Anaplan)

The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across functional, technical, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. lists.content:
• Lead end-to-end project management for Oracle Fusion ERP implementations, enhancements, migrations, and transformation programs from charter through go-live and hypercare.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain an integrated project plan covering business, functional, technical, data, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Build and maintain core project management deliverables including schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and executive status reporting.  
  • Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to align scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Facilitate planning, requirements, fit-gap, and workstream checkpoint sessions with functional leads and business process owners.
  • Drive governance routines, executive updates, decision forums, and escalation paths, while clearly communicating risks, issues, dependencies, and required actions.  
  • Actively manage the project schedule, critical path, overdue actions, and cross-workstream blockers to keep delivery on track.
  • Coordinate delivery activities across integrations, reporting, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
  • Partner with program leadership and finance stakeholders on budget tracking, forecast updates, variance reporting, and go-live readiness activities.
  • Manage vendor and systems integrator performance against plans, milestones, and contractual commitments.

• 6+ years of project management experience, including 5+ years leading ERP programs or large enterprise transformation initiatives in mid-to-large organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Oracle Fusion ERP projects or closely related Oracle ERP transformation programs.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
  • Strong understanding of ERP delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
  • Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope, schedule, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
  • Experience working with executive sponsors, business process owners, IT leaders, vendors, and third-party systems integrators.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.
  • We are ONLY seeking candidates local to the Bay Area (and willing to commute to San Mateo, CA). At this time, we will not be relocating candidates.

Experience in a PMO or enterprise transformation office supporting large cross-functional programs is preferred. Experience with Oracle Fusion workstreams such as Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Projects, HCM, or Reporting/Analytics is helpful. Additional value comes from cloud ERP transformation experience, enterprise governance exposure, and prior experience as a business analyst, functional lead, or ERP power user.

lists.text: What you will do in this role:
lists.content:
• Conduct engine assembly, disassembly, and integration for UAV propulsion systems.
  • Perform pre-flight and post-flight inspections, ensuring all propulsion systems meet operational standards.

  • Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues related to propulsion systems.
  • Work closely with engineers and flight test teams to ensure system readiness.
  • Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities, inspections, and modifications.
  • Follow strict safety protocols and standard operating procedures in handling high-performance UAV propulsion systems.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience working on aircraft engines (military or civilian).
  • Prior experience at an aerospace company or military aviation unit.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with gas turbine, reciprocating, or hybrid propulsion systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and engineering documents.
  • Comfortable working in high-energy, high-precision environments.
  • Strong safety mindset, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) License.
  • Military background, particularly in jet propulsion, UAVs, or rotary-wing aircraft.
  • Experience with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) propulsion.
  • Knowledge of fuel systems, ignition systems, and advanced propulsion technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with engine dynamometers, test cells, or ground support equipment.
  • FAA Powerplant or military equivalent engine qualifications.
  • Ability to work independently, taking ownership of full-cycle propulsion system maintenance.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Propulsion Test Engineer to lead the planning and execution of propulsion test campaigns for the X-BAT platform. This role is responsible for end-to-end ownership of propulsion test activities—from test architecture and test stand design through execution, data analysis, and iteration - supporting a low-bypass turbofan-powered Group 5 UAV.

You will serve as the focal point for propulsion testing, ensuring test results accurately characterize engine and subsystem performance, de-risk integration, and inform flight readiness decisions. This role is hands-on, data-driven, and highly cross-functional - requiring close collaboration with propulsion engineers, design engineers, technicians, controls, airframe, and flight test teams.

lists.text: What you will do in this role:
lists.content:
• Own the propulsion test program from requirements through execution, data review, and test-to-flight handoff.
  • Architect, design, analyze, and build test stands and fixtures for engine, fuel, oil, bleed air, and TVC-related testing.
  • Define and implement instrumentation plans, DAQ architecture, calibration methods, and test procedures.
  • Lead ground test campaigns, including performance mapping, transient response, and edge-of-envelope testing.
  • Analyze test data to validate performance, identify anomalies, and drive design or control updates.
  • Partner with propulsion REs and controls engineers to ensure test coverage closes risk against CONOPS and mission profiles.
  • Drive root cause investigations for test anomalies and implement corrective actions.
  • Author test plans, reports, and readiness reviews; represent propulsion test in design and flight readiness reviews.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion or engine testing in aerospace development environments.
  • Hands-on experience with engine test cells, test stand design, instrumentation, and DAQ systems.
  • Strong understanding of gas turbine engine performance, transients, and test methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Python (or similar) for data reduction, automation, and analysis workflows.
  • Experience supporting flight test readiness and test-to-flight transitions.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience testing low-bypass turbofan engines or propulsion subsystems on UAVs or tactical aircraft.
  • Familiarity with REFPROP, GFSSP, ANSYS, or FEA to support test interpretation and correlation.
  • Experience designing structural test fixtures, load paths, thermal management, and safety systems for hot-fire environments.
  • Background in controls integration, actuator testing (e.g., TVC), and transient characterization.
  • Experience operating in a test-driven, hardware-centric aerospace development environment.
  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

lists.content:
• Own full-cycle recruiting for complex and senior-level roles across G&A functions
  • Advise senior and executive leaders on workforce needs, candidate profiles, and hiring strategy
  • Lead intake and calibration sessions that translate business priorities into actionable search and interview plans
  • Use AI to accelerate market research, talent mapping, sourcing, and personalized candidate engagement
  • Build proactive pipelines across technology, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and adjacent industries
  • Assess candidates using structured, consistent practices focused on expertise, leadership, motivation, and organizational alignment
  • Apply AI, automation, and recruiting data to identify trends, improve workflows, and address pipeline risks
  • Drive hiring processes with urgency, resolving bottlenecks and maintaining stakeholder accountability
  • Provide market intelligence and constructively challenge requirements that may limit hiring outcomes
  • Lead candidate engagement, complex offer negotiations, and closing strategies
  • Deliver a personalized candidate experience while maintaining ATS accuracy, compliance, and operational rigor
  • Pilot emerging AI capabilities and translate successful use cases into responsible, repeatable team practices
  • Mentor recruiters and sourcers on G&A hiring, sourcing strategy, and AI-enabled recruiting workflows

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant G&A or corporate functions hiring
  • Success recruiting across areas such as Finance, Legal, or other functions with unique complexity to each search
  • Experience independently leading complex, senior-level searches from intake through offer acceptance
  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives and influence hiring decisions using data and market expertise
  • Hands-on experience using AI, automation, and recruiting technology to improve quality, speed, and productivity
  • Ability to identify practical AI use cases and turn them into scalable recruiting workflows
  • Strong analytical instincts and experience translating talent data into actionable recommendations
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and consultative partnership skills
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including privacy, confidentiality, bias mitigation, and human oversight
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, changing priorities, and rapid organizational growth
  • High discretion, sound judgment, and a team-oriented approach to mentoring and knowledge sharing

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI’s future engineering bench is built on campus. We’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to own university recruiting end to end—from campus strategy and full-cycle hiring for interns, co-ops, and new graduates to intern-to-full-time conversion, in close partnership with our internship program team.
You will lead the full university recruiting lifecycle—Plan, Attract, Engage, Assess & Hire, Convert, Retain, and Optimize—across Software Engineering (C++ and autonomy), Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Integration & Test, Mechanical Engineering, and select business functions. You will have real autonomy to shape strategy and clear accountability for outcomes: meeting hiring demand on time, securing offer acceptances in a fiercely competitive market, and converting interns into full-time engineers.
You are equal parts strategist, closer, and program partner. You are as comfortable presenting a school portfolio and ROI analysis to a VP in the morning as you are leading a technical calibration with hiring managers at midday or closing a rising senior with three competing offers that evening.

lists.content:
• Own Shield AI's university recruiting strategy end to end, including the target school portfolio, annual plan, calendar, and budget for your business
  • Lead demand collection with business leaders for interns, co-ops, and intern-to-FTE conversions, driving iHIRE approvals and req postings on schedule for your business
  • Build Shield AI's campus brand through technical storytelling, faculty and career center relationships, and engagement with robotics, AI, and diversity student organizations
  • Represent Shield AI at career fairs, tech talks, and info sessions, and build early pipelines of high-potential candidates ahead of req approval
  • Run full-cycle recruiting for all intern, co-op, and new grad roles for Aircraft
  • Maintain a structured, bias-reduced evaluation process and run intern interview training and calibration to keep the bar consistent across teams and sites
  • Extend timely offers within the standard framework by role, location, and level, and partner with Compensation on salary and housing stipend benchmarking
  • Own the accepted-offer-to-Day-1 experience to reduce reneges and strengthen onboarding readiness
  • Partner with the intern program team on mentorship matching, project scoping, reviews, and intern events
  • Own the intern conversion cycle, from identifying full-time-eligible interns through extending return-intern and full-time offers
  • Report on demand fulfillment, offer and accept rates, conversion, diversity, and school ROI, and use those metrics to reshape each season's strategy

• 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years focused on university, early-career, or campus recruiting
  • Demonstrated ownership of a campus strategy end to end — school selection, event planning, budget, and season execution — not just requisition execution
  • Track record of high-volume technical hiring for engineering roles, and of closing candidates in a competitive market
  • Experience partnering directly with senior business and engineering leaders on workforce planning and demand
  • Strong data instincts: you build and use funnel metrics, conversion rates, and ROI analysis to make decisions and to influence leaders
  • Proficiency with an ATS and sourcing tools; comfort building process, templates, and reporting from scratch
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you represent the company credibly to students, faculty, and executives
  • Willingness to travel during peak campus season
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others

• Experience recruiting in AI, robotics, aerospace, or defense technology
  • Experience running or supporting an internship or co-op program, including intern-to-full-time conversion processes
  • Familiarity with U.S. defense-industry hiring considerations, including export control (ITAR/EAR) and work authorization requirements for early-career candidates

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking an engineer to help design, develop, and integrate a safety critical Run-Time Assurance (RTA) product. The Hivemind Foundations team is responsible for a suite of core products and capabilities that brings resilient autonomy and intelligence to aircraft and other platforms operating in complex environments. The RTA product that the Foundations team develops is a real-time safety capability that helps keep autonomy safe, predictable, and effective at the edge. 
As a member of the Foundations team, you will be responsible for C++ software development, integration of reusable safety capabilities into production systems, defining clean interfaces and tests, and turn safety-critical designs into reliable software that can fly, including support for X-BAT, Shield AI's flagship Group 5 Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) UAV.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an engineer to help design, develop, and integrate a safety critical Run-Time Assurance (RTA) product. The Hivemind Foundations team is responsible for a suite of core products and capabilities that brings resilient autonomy and intelligence to aircraft and other platforms operating in complex environments. The RTA product that the Foundations team develops is a real-time safety capability that helps keep autonomy safe, predictable, and effective at the edge. 

As a member of the Foundations team, you will be responsible for C++ software development, integration of reusable safety capabilities into production systems, defining clean interfaces and tests, and turn safety-critical designs into reliable software that can fly, including support for X-BAT, Shield AI's flagship Group 5 Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) UAV.

lists.content:
• Develop, integrate, and test configurable Run-Time Assurance (RTA) components that monitor autonomy behavior and support safe operation across representative platforms and scenarios. 
  • Adapt reusable C++ safety capabilities into production runtime components, including interface integration, configuration wiring, and unit, component, and integration tests. 
  • Implement real-time C++ code at the boundary between mission autonomy, high-assurance middleware, and flight-control interfaces. 
  • Integrate safety-critical software with aircraft hardware for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and flight-test campaigns, scaling from single-aircraft test points to multi-agent collaborative CONOPS. 
  • Strengthen engineering evidence through CI, static and dynamic analysis, focused code reviews, software documentation, software designs, ICDs, system models, test results, and traceability artifacts. 
  • Share safe software practices through code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical write-ups.

• Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years with a Master’s degree; or 2 year with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 
  • Strong C++ development experience, including modern C++, testing, debugging, and performance-aware design. 
  • Experience building software for real-time, embedded, robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or similarly constrained systems. 
  • Experience integrating software with hardware, simulation, Hardware in the Loop (HIL), or production-like test environments and diagnosing reliability or performance issues. 
  • Familiarity with C++ software design patterns and the ability to work effectively within an existing architecture. 
  • Strong Git and Linux development skills, along with modern software development practices such as CI/CD and test-focused development. 
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation and collaborate across software, systems, test, and platform teams.

• Experience with autonomy middleware, interface definitions, Python-based configuration tooling, CMake, Conan, or reusable C++ library integration. 
  • Familiarity with high-reliability or safety-critical development practices, such as static analysis, coding standards, traceability, and requirements-based testing. 
  • Experience developing against strict C++ coding standards such as MISRA C++ or JSF AV C++. 
  • Hands-on experience with airworthiness or software assurance frameworks such as MIL-HDBK-516, DO-178C, or equivalent safety standards. 
  • Experience taking a software component through verification, qualification, or certification evidence review.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Sensor Integration Engineer to support selection, characterization, calibration, and integration of multi-modal navigation and localization sensors for the X-BAT State Estimation team. This role operates at the intersection of software, electrical, and mechanical engineering, requiring the ability to work across disciplines and directly contribute to cross-functional engineering efforts.

lists.content:
Sensor Selection, Integration & Characterization 
  • Support sensor integration activities from specification through production 
  • Develop and execute sensor characterization and calibration procedures for IMUs, GNSS receivers, cameras, and other navigation sensors 
  • Contribute to sensor trade studies and selection processes 
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration 
  • Work closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and software engineering teams on: 
  • Electrical interfaces, power distribution, and signal conditioning 
  • Mounting solutions, alignment, and thermal/vibration considerations 
  • Software interfaces, drivers, data acquisition, and calibration implementation 
  • Participate in design reviews across EE/ME/SW disciplines, providing interdisciplinary perspective and coordination 
    • Technical Contributions 
  • Develop and execute test plans for sensor performance characterization and validation 
  • Document sensor characteristics, trade studies, and integration requirements 
  • Develop or modify calibration scripts and data processing tools 
  • Support development of calibration procedures and tooling 
  • Debug issues spanning hardware-firmware-software boundaries 
  • Review and contribute to schematics, CAD models, and code as necessary

Education & Experience 
  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or related field 
  • 4+ years of relevant experience
  • Demonstrated ability to work across at least two of: electrical, mechanical, software domains 
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance.
    • Technical Skills 
  • Understanding of sensor measurement principles and error sources 
  • Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and/or mechanical drawings 
  • Basic proficiency in scripting or programming for data analysis (Python, MATLAB, or similar) 
  • Familiarity with sensor communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, etc.) 
  • Hands-on experience with lab equipment and sensor testing 
    • Cross-Functional Aptitude 
  • Comfortable learning and working outside primary discipline 
  • Ability to communicate effectively with engineers from different backgrounds 
  • Willingness to engage with hardware, firmware, and software aspects of sensor systems 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills across multiple domains

• Experience with navigation or localization sensors (IMUs, GNSS, cameras, altimeters, etc.) 
  • Exposure to sensor calibration or characterization activities 
  • Familiarity with embedded systems or real-time software 
  • Understanding of coordinate transformations or sensor fusion concepts 
  • Experience with automated testing or data acquisition systems 
  • Knowledge of aerospace environmental testing or standards

• Collaborative team environment working with EE, ME, and SW engineers 
  • Hands-on lab work combined with analysis and documentation 
  • Occasional travel for team and supplier coordination or testing support

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Site Infrastructure Engineer to plan, design, document, and support physical IT infrastructure across offices, engineering facilities, labs, manufacturing environments, and data centers.
 
As part of the Cloud & Infrastructure team within Enterprise Operations, this role will help deliver scalable and reliable site infrastructure, including rack layouts, structured cabling, power and cooling capacity, MDF/IDF design, DCIM, equipment sizing, and infrastructure documentation. You will partner closely with Network, Systems, Cloud, Security, Facilities, Workplace, and external vendors to support new site buildouts, expansions, relocations, and data center deployments.

lists.content:
* Plan and design physical IT infrastructure for offices, labs, manufacturing facilities, and data centers.
* Lead and support new site buildouts, office expansions and relocations, data center deployments, hardware refreshes, and infrastructure moves.
* Develop rack layouts, MDF/IDF requirements, equipment placement plans, and infrastructure bills of materials.
* Create and maintain accurate rack elevations, physical connectivity diagrams, equipment records, cable documentation, and DCIM data across office and data center environments.
* Support capacity planning across rack space, site and data center power, cooling, cabling, and equipment growth.
* Administer and improve DCIM/IPAM/CMDB platforms such as Nautobot, NetBox, Device42, or equivalent.
* Establish and maintain physical infrastructure documentation and labeling standards to ensure environments remain accurately documented throughout their lifecycle.
* Review floor plans, low-voltage drawings, vendor designs, proposals, and statements of work.
* Manage site and data center circuit inventory and lifecycle planning, including circuit documentation, utilization and capacity planning, renewal tracking, upgrades, relocations, disconnects, and coordination with carriers and internal procurement teams. 
* Coordinate with architects, contractors, colocation providers, carriers, OEMs, and field-service vendors.
* Partner with Network, Systems, and Cloud Engineering teams to ensure site and data center infrastructure supports compute, storage, connectivity, wireless, security, hybrid connectivity, and public cloud requirements.
* Identify capacity constraints, documentation gaps, and opportunities to improve infrastructure standards and processes.
* Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and support teams as needed.

* 5+ years of experience in data center, enterprise site, or physical IT infrastructure engineering.
* Experience designing and supporting infrastructure across offices, data centers, labs, or similar enterprise environments.
* Strong experience creating and maintaining rack elevations, physical infrastructure diagrams, cabling documentation, equipment layouts, and infrastructure records.
* Strong knowledge of rack design, structured copper/fiber cabling, equipment placement, and physical infrastructure standards.
* Strong working knowledge of data center and site power, including A/B power, UPS/PDU systems, circuit capacity, equipment power draw, redundancy, and related cooling/airflow considerations.
* Experience designing MDF/IDF environments and sizing infrastructure for new or expanding facilities.
* Experience with DCIM/IPAM/CMDB platforms such as Nautobot, NetBox, Device42, Sunbird, or similar.
* Working understanding of enterprise networking, including switching, wireless, WAN connectivity, and carrier services.
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings, floor plans, low-voltage designs, and equipment specifications.
* Experience working with colocation providers, low-voltage contractors, carriers, and technology vendors.
* Strong technical documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to independently execute infrastructure projects from planning through deployment.
* Ability to travel periodically for site and data center deployments.

* Experience supporting a geographically distributed or rapidly growing enterprise.
* Experience across offices, engineering labs, manufacturing environments, and colocation data centers.
* Hands-on experience with Nautobot or NetBox for DCIM, IPAM, rack elevations, circuits, and infrastructure documentation.
* Experience supporting data center migrations, expansions, or greenfield site deployments.
* Familiarity with hybrid infrastructure and public cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, including connectivity between enterprise sites, data centers, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with infrastructure from vendors such as Juniper, Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Dell, APC, or Vertiv.
* Experience developing infrastructure BOMs, cost estimates, lifecycle plans, and capacity forecasts.
* Experience using APIs, scripting, or automation to improve DCIM and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Experience within aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other regulated environments.
* Relevant certifications such as BICSI, CDCP, CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent.

  • Program leadership to define the appropriate systems engineering scope and level of effort.
