lists.content:
• System Ownership: Define, allocate, and own the FCAS requirements and verification traceability matrix.
  • Actuator Performance: Design and analyze control surface actuation systems, including sizing, dynamic response, bandwidth, redundancy, and failure modes.
  • Control-Law Integration: Drive the control law-actuator interface with Flight Controls and Vehicle Management Systems, including actuator dynamics modeling and control surface authority requirements.
  • Power and Thermal Integration: Drive actuator power source architecture and load analysis with EPS and hydraulic systems leads, and resolve actuator heat-generation and local thermal-load interfaces with thermal management.
  • Structural Integration: Drive coordination of control surface hinge moments and actuator reaction loads with structures.
  • Qualification and Hardware Delivery: Define and execute FCAS qualification test plans per MIL-HDBK-516 and MIL-STD-810, using test results to mature qualified flight-control actuation hardware.
  • Program Execution: Lead FCAS design-maturity and qualification-status reviews at SRR, PDR, and CDR.

• Experience: 8 to 15 years in flight control actuation system design on fixed-wing aircraft.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Proven track record sourcing COTS/custom aerospace components, driving suppliers to schedule, and assembling benchtop or vehicle-level test setups.

• Prior fighter or fighter-adjacent program experience, manned or unmanned.
  • Unmanned or autonomous flight control experience, including the redundancy philosophy differences from manned aircraft.

Job Description:
As a Staff Systems Engineer on Shield AI's next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating the Launch & Recovery Vehicle (LRV), the system that transports, deploys, launches, and recovers our autonomous aircraft in a variety of environments. Job Description:

As a Staff Systems Engineer on Shield AI's next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating the Launch & Recovery Vehicle (LRV), the system that transports, deploys, launches, and recovers our autonomous aircraft in a variety of environments. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, hydraulics, electrical power distribution, navigation, and the mechanical, electrical, and data interfaces to the aircraft.

You will work with the air vehicle’s propulsion, hardware, software, flight operations, and manufacturing teams to deliver a mobile, mission-ready LRV that works as part of the full UAS platform. You will also help shape how the system is transported, emplaced, and operated in the field. That means developing CONOPs that set deployment timelines, crew roles, logistics footprint, and how the system survives in the field.

lists.content:
• System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the LRV architecture, integrating avionics, hydraulics, electrical power distribution, navigation, and launch and recovery mechanisms into one vehicle that works reliably.
  • System Behavior & Safety: Define and document LRV modes, states, transitions, and fault responses for transport, emplacement, launch, recovery, and stow. Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions.
  • Requirements Management: Establish top-level LRV requirements, break them down into subsystem requirements, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • CONOPs Development: Develop transportation and deployment CONOPs that cover road, air, and ship transportability, rapid relocation, crew workload, and sustainment. Turn these operational needs into system requirements.
  • Trade Studies & Risk Management: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Integration & Test: Support LRV integration, ground testing, and verification, and support combined LRV and aircraft testing through flight test and operational deployment.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Work with DoD stakeholders, end users, and industry partners to align LRV capabilities and CONOPs with operational requirements.

• Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree
  • Demonstrated experience defining system architecture, behavior logic, and operational modes for complex electromechanical systems
  • Experience integrating avionics, hydraulic systems, electrical power distribution, and navigation on vehicles, launch and recovery systems, or ground support equipment
  • Proficiency in MBSE tools such as SysML, Cameo, DOORS, or similar
  • Experience developing or applying CONOPs, including transportability, deployment, and field operations considerations
  • Strong background in system integration, test, and performance validation, ideally on a program taken from clean sheet to first operation
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes and relevant standards (e.g., MIL-STD-882, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-1275, MIL-STD-1366, MIL-STD-1472)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, agile environment with shifting priorities
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance

• Experience with launch and recovery systems for Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, catapult or rail launchers, or military tactical vehicles
  • Experience with expeditionary or distributed operations concepts and their logistics and sustainment needs
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA)
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance

Job Description:

We are seeking a Mission Engineer to own the mission representation of various programs, applying systems engineering, modeling, simulation, and operational analysis techniques to evaluate how Shield AI’s autonomous systems enable desired mission effects. This role is pivotal in analyzing mission architectures, system interactions, capability gaps, and performance drivers across multiple platforms and domains. You will work closely with engineering, product development, operational analysis, and defense stakeholders to translate mission needs into traceable autonomy requirements that inform design trade-offs, system requirements, technology priorities, and operational concepts. 

This position requires a strong understanding of military operations, systems engineering, modeling & simulation (M&S), mission analysis, operational analysis techniques, requirements traceability, and model verification and validation techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy and product development by connecting mission objectives and operational needs to system capabilities, architectures, and engineering decisions.

lists.content:
• Employ the Mission Engineering process to develop pertinent analyses and assess how current and emerging autonomous capabilities enable  desired mission effects in representative military scenarios. 
  • Utilize systems engineering tools (e.g., Cameo, Sysml 2.0) alongside modeling and simulation tools (AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop mission models, architectures, analytical frameworks, requirements, and traceability artifacts. 
  • Development of Mission Engineering artifacts such as mission threads, concepts of operations (CONOPS), and mission architectures for new AI-driven autonomous capabilities. 
  • Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to translate mission needs and operational insights into system requirements, design decisions, and capability improvements. 
  • Define trade studies and sensitivity analyses to identify key mission drivers, capability gaps, system dependencies, and performance thresholds under varying operational conditions and threats. 
  • Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to characterize missions, define measures of effectiveness and performance, establish the data, modeling, and analysis required to assess them, and align system capabilities with operational needs.  
  • Develop and present technical reports, mission architectures, trade studies, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies. 
  • Leverage modern compute and development best practices (e.g., scalable cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing) to build, run, and iterate mission models and analysis pipelines quickly and reliably.

• 5+ years of experience in mission engineering, systems engineering, operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S) or a related discipline. 
  • Prior experience in mission-thread analysis, force-on-force analysis, capability-gap analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling. 
  • Proficiency with SysML or other systems engineering tools in conjunction with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, or Python for aerospace and defense applications. 
  • Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to characterize mission needs and translate operational objectives into system capabilities, requirements, and engineering trades. 
  • Demonstrated ability to apply systems engineering, modern compute, data analysis, and software development best practices to build and maintain reliable models, simulations, and analytical workflows. 
  • Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting technical and operational analyses to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities. 
  • Active Secret or Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

• Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), digital engineering, and SysML 2.0. 
  • Familiarity with DoD Mission Engineering methodologies, systems-of-systems engineering, DoD acquisition processes and JCIDS. 
  • Experience integrating AI-driven decision-making algorithms or autonomous systems into mission engineering and operational analysis frameworks. 
  • Prior military service or experience working with U.S. Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Army, or Special Operations Forces.

Job Description:

 

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

lists.content:
• AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.
  • AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.
  • Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.
  • Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.
  • Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.
  • Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.
  • Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

• Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.
  • High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.
  • Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.
  • AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.
  • Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.
  • The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.
  • Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

• Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.
  • Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.
  • Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

• Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.
  • Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.
  • Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.
  • Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

lists.content:
• AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.
  • AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.
  • Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.
  • Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.
  • Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.
  • Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.
  • Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

• Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.
  • High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.
  • Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.
  • AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.
  • Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.
  • The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.
  • Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

• Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.
  • Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.
  • Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

• Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.
  • Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.
  • Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.
  • Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

Job Description:
We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 

This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments.

lists.content:
• Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.
  • Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.
  • Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.
  • Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.
  • Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.
  • Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.
  • Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.
  • Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 
  • Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.
  • Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

• Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.
  • Active Secret at a minimum.  
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
  • Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
  • Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment
  • Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
  •  Experience developing technical expertise in a team to execute analyses for system design and analysis.
  • Preferred Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

Job Description:

As a PCB Designer at Shield AI, you will be responsible for creating the layouts that support our aircraft. You’ll work closely with electrical, mechanical and manufacturing engineers to translate schematics and requirements into robust, manufacturable PCBA designs. You will be involved in all steps of the PCBA design process including stack-up design, constraint management, mechanical placement planning, generating drawings and manufacturing outputs.

lists.content:
• Create PCB layouts for complex digital, analog, RF, high-speed, and power electronics designs.
  • Plan and manage PCB stack-ups in collaboration with fabrication vendors and manufacturing engineers.
  • Partner with electrical engineers to interpret schematics, routing rules, and design intent.
  • Collaborate with mechanical engineers to ensure proper board form factor integration, connector positioning, placement constraints.
  • Apply best practices for signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, impedance control, and thermal/EMI mitigation.
  • Conduct design reviews and implement feedback to ensure manufacturability, reliability, and compliance with company standards.
  • Generate and maintain manufacturing documentation, including Gerber/ODB++ files, fabrication and assembly notes and drawings.
  • Work with manufacturing engineering to ensure designs meet supplier DFM requirements.
• 10+ years of experience in PCB layout for production hardware (or equivalent combination of education and experience)

• Solid understanding of IPC standards (IPC-2221/2222, IPC-7351, etc.)
  • Familiar with PCB materials and manufacturing process, and stack-up construction.
  • Familiarity with controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length matching, and high-current power distribution.
  • Experience with scripting and automation
  • Experience with Altium Designer
  • Experience using simulation tools to validate layout designs

lists.content:
• System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

lists.content:
• Examples of Projects You will Work On: 
  • Autonomous teaming drones.
  • Teaming between helicopters and drones.

  • and more!

  • Tactical Autonomy Design – Design tactical autonomy algorithms to enable unmanned aircraft to perform complex missions across air, land, and sea domains with minimal human supervision.
  • High-Performance Software Development – Develop high-performance software modules that incorporate planning, decision-making, and behavior execution strategies for dynamic and adversarial environments.
  • Behavior Architecture Implementation – Implement and test behavior architectures that enable multi-agent coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios.
  • Hybrid Autonomy Integration – Work at the intersection of classical autonomy and machine learning, blending rule-based systems with learning-based methods such as reinforcement learning to achieve robust, adaptive behavior.
  • Hardware Software Integration:
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams including perception, planning, simulation, hardware, and flight test to ensure seamless integration of autonomy solutions on real-world platforms.
  • Deployment & Field Testing – Deploy autonomy capabilities to real platforms and participate in field tests and flight demos, validating performance in operationally relevant conditions.
  • Mission Data Analysis – Analyze mission logs and performance data to diagnose failures, optimize behavior models, and inform iterative development.
  • R&D and Roadmapping – Contribute to the autonomy roadmap by researching and prototyping new algorithms, identifying tactical capability gaps, and proposing novel solutions that advance Shield AI’s mission.
  • Program Support & Adaptation – Support defense-focused programs and customer needs by adapting autonomy solutions to evolving mission sets, compliance requirements, and operational feedback.
  • Handover / Training: Provide software handover and training to customers for their autonomy development efforts.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation for customer as well as internal use.

  • 12+ years of experience of industry experience
  • Ability to travel and stay deployed at customer sites across India/Asia.
  • 3+ years of experience hands on writing software for autonomy/robotics applications.
  • 2+ years of experience working in a startup environment. 
  • Strong technical background in software engineering. 
  • Strong proficiency in writing modern C++ code. 
  • Intermediate proficiency in writing Python code. 
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
  • Ability converse fluently in Hindi and English.

• Experience in the defense aviation or robotics industry.  
  • Ability to travel to USA for up to 3 months at a time for training.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Staff Structural Analyst to provide advanced technical leadership in the structural analysis and validation of next-generation UAV platforms. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject-matter expert for airframe structures, leading complex analysis efforts, supporting test correlation, and ensuring structural integrity across development, flight test, and production.

This role is ideal for engineers with 12–15+ years of experience who have led major structural workstreams on aerospace programs and are comfortable owning analysis execution, mentoring engineers, and influencing key design tradeoffs within a program.

lists.content:
• Lead structural analysis efforts for UAV airframes, major substructures, and critical components within a program scope.
  • Define and execute finite element modeling approaches, load cases, assumptions, and margin assessments.
  • Perform and oversee static, modal, fatigue, vibration, and damage-tolerance analyses.
  • Establish sound practices for hand calculations, model validation, and analysis-to-test correlation.
  • Drive structural optimization across performance, weight, cost, and manufacturability targets.
  • Support structural test strategy, including defining requirements, participating in execution, and correlating results to analysis.
  • Review structural analysis deliverables, test reports, and technical documentation for design reviews.
  • Mentor and technically guide structural analysts across varying experience levels.
  • Partner cross-functionally with design, loads, aero, propulsion, and systems teams to balance structural requirements with overall aircraft performance goals.
  • Contribute to evolving analysis methodologies and improving structural standards within the organization.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in structural analysis, aircraft structures, or aerospace systems.
  • Strong expertise with FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in hand calculations for strength, stability, fatigue, and damage tolerance.
  • Significant experience with composite and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Experience supporting structural testing, model correlation, and flight test validation.
  • Ability to lead complex technical workstreams and influence design decisions within a program.
  • Strong communication skills and experience presenting analysis findings to engineering leadership.
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
  • Experience serving as a senior technical lead on aircraft or UAV structural programs.
  • Hands-on involvement in flight test support and certification efforts.
  • Experience contributing to internal analysis standards or best practices.
  • Familiarity with CAD, PLM, and enterprise engineering toolchains.

  • Experience designing deployable, transportable, and field-ready aerospace support equipment.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Staff Structural Analysis & Vibration Engineer to serve as the structural and vibration subject-matter expert (SME) for V-BAT. V-BAT is a Group 3 vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) unmanned aircraft system in production and deployed with customers worldwide. 

You will be the structural technical authority for V-BAT. You will own system loads, stress and dynamics analysis, vibration requirements and testing, and weight optimization. 

This is a high-impact, company-level role. You will develop and define system-level structural requirements, design criteria, analysis methods, and material allowables that will guide structural work across V-BAT. You will also mentor engineers in FEA and structural fundamentals. 

This role is ideal for engineers with 12–15+ years of experience who have served as the structural lead or technical authority on an aircraft program.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain company structural standards, including design criteria, factors of safety and margin policy, analysis methods, material allowables, and joint design practices. 
  • Own V-BAT system loads, and define structural requirements for subsystems, components, and suppliers. 
  • Lead and perform static, stability, modal, dynamic, and fatigue analyses of V-BAT structures using hand calculations and FEA (Simcenter). 
  • Lead composite structural analysis and define composite design requirements. 
  • Serve as the bolted joint expert for the program. 
  • Own vibration and shock environments. Assess existing profiles and use measured flight data to develop defensible test requirements. 
  • Define and improve vibration test requirements and processes, from test planning through verification, validation, and model-to-test correlation. 
  • Lead a program-wide weight optimization review of existing designs, and analyze new designs for weight efficiency and material selection. 
  • Review structural analyses, test reports, and design review content, and present findings to engineering leadership and customers. 
  • Mentor engineers in FEA and structural fundamentals, and build the team's structural analysis capability. 
  • Provide structural guidance on design changes and production issues as needed

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. 
  • 12+ years of structural analysis experience on aircraft, UAS, or comparable complex system, including serving as a structural lead or technical authority. 
  • Experience creating structural design criteria, analysis methods, or engineering standards. 
  • Expert knowledge of structural mechanics and hand calculations, including strength, stability, fatigue, and structural dynamics. 
  • Expertise with FEA tools, preferably Siemens Simcenter (Nastran or Femap), or equivalents such as ANSYS or Abaqus. 
  • Significant experience analyzing composite aircraft structures and defining composite design requirements. 
  • Expert-level knowledge of bolted joint analysis and design. 
  • Hands-on experience with vibration and shock testing, including test planning, instrumentation, and data review, plus working knowledge of MIL-STD-810. 
  • Proven track record of mentoring engineers. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. 
  • Experience as the lead structural engineer on a Group 2–5 UAS, rotorcraft, or VTOL aircraft. 
  • Experience deriving vibration environments from flight test data (PSD analysis, fatigue damage spectrum, test tailoring). 
  • Experience with modal testing and FEA model correlation. 
  • Experience leading structural weight reduction programs. 
  • Experience developing composite allowables (e.g., CMH-17) and knowledge of composite manufacturing processes. 
  • Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-516, RTCA DO-160, and aircraft structural certification. 
  • Experience in startup or high-growth defense environments.

Job Description:

At Shield AI, we are building intelligent autonomous aircraft designed to operate and survive in highly contested environments. We are seeking a Survivability Materials Engineer to lead the selection, qualification, specification, and production implementation of low-observable and signature-control materials for next-generation autonomous aircraft.


This role is ideal for an engineer with experience in radar-absorbing materials, specialty coatings, electromagnetic material characterization, and aerospace manufacturing processes. You will work across survivability analysis, design engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and sustainment teams to ensure material solutions meet signature-performance requirements while remaining producible, inspectable, durable, and supportable throughout the aircraft lifecycle.

lists.content:
• Conduct material surveys and evaluate radar-absorbing materials, conductive materials, dielectric materials, specialty coatings, adhesives, sealants, and other survivability-related material systems.
  • Develop and maintain a survivability materials database containing performance, cost, supplier, part-number, availability, application, and sustainment information.
  • Partner with survivability analysis, design, manufacturing, and program teams to down-select materials based on signature performance, durability, producibility, weight, cost, and supply-chain risk.
  •  Develop material qualification plans and oversee electromagnetic, electrical, mechanical, thermal, chemical, and environmental testing.
  • Establish and maintain laboratory capabilities for material characterization, process development, receiving inspection, and production verification.
  • Provide hands-on production support for material application, inspection, troubleshooting, repair, supplier coordination, and sustainment.

• B.S. or M.S. in Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in aerospace materials engineering, low-observable materials, electromagnetic materials, specialty coatings, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of radar-absorbing materials, conductive coatings, dielectric materials, adhesives, sealants, or specialty surface treatments.
  • Understanding of how complex permittivity, complex permeability, conductivity, and thickness affect electromagnetic and radar-signature performance.
  • Experience with material characterization, laboratory testing, production inspection, or supplier qualification.
  • U.S. Citizenship and active Secret clearance required.

• Experience developing or qualifying radar-absorbing materials, low-observable coatings, structural RAM, conductive treatments, or signature-control appliqués.
  • Experience measuring electromagnetic material properties using free-space, waveguide, coaxial, resonant-cavity, or reflectivity-based test methods.
  • Familiarity with vector network analyzers, free-space measurement systems, conductivity equipment, coating-thickness instruments, environmental chambers, and mechanical test equipment.
  •  Active Secret, Top Secret, or SCI security clearance.

This ecosystem combines developer tools, APIs, data infrastructure, simulation, AI/ML workflows, and GenAI-enabled automation to accelerate the delivery of autonomous capabilities using Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, world models, foundation models, and other applied AI technologies.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an experienced System Architect to own the architecture of Hivemind Forge – an AI development ecosystem and the segment of Hivemind that enables developers to build, train, tune, evaluate, optimize, and deploy learning-based autonomy solutions. You will join the Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test (SEIT) team in the Hivemind Enterprise organization.

This ecosystem combines developer tools, APIs, data infrastructure, simulation, AI/ML workflows, and GenAI-enabled automation to accelerate the delivery of autonomous capabilities using Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, world models, foundation models, and other applied AI technologies.

As the responsible architect, you will define the comprehensive architecture for this product area, maintain architectural integrity across development teams, and ensure the ecosystem can operate across enterprise cloud, high-performance computing, and secure or disconnected deployment environments. You will work at the intersection of software architecture, AI/ML, data architecture, systems engineering, developer experience, and Generative AI-enabled engineering to create an ecosystem that dramatically reduces the time required to transform mission needs and data into deployable, intelligent autonomous capabilities.

lists.content:
• Own and evolve the architecture of the Hivemind Forge AI development ecosystem.
  • Define and maintain architecture products in an integrated model-based systems engineering (MBSE) environment, connecting architectural intent to engineering execution.
  • Establish architectural patterns, interfaces, APIs, SDK concepts, and technical standards across software, AI/ML, data, simulation, and deployment capabilities.
  • Define the data and metadata architecture underpinning the AI development lifecycle, including schemas, relationships, lineage, provenance, versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure traceable pedigree across datasets, training configurations, model artifacts, evaluations, software versions, and deployed capabilities to support reproducibility and auditability.
  • Architect GenAI-enabled and agentic development workflows that accelerate data curation, autonomy development, experimentation, evaluation, troubleshooting, and deployment while preserving human oversight, security, verification, and traceability.
  • Define architectural patterns for integrating AI coding assistants, agents, foundation models, and natural-language interfaces with Hivemind development tools, APIs, SDKs, data, simulation, and engineering workflows.
  • Define architecture for scalable AI/ML workloads across cloud, high-performance compute (HPC), and on-premises infrastructure, including orchestration, workload scheduling, containerization, storage, and data movement.
  • Ensure the ecosystem can be deployed and operated in classified, air-gapped, disconnected, and other constrained enterprise environments while preserving security, configuration control, and reproducibility.
  • Ensure AI-assisted and agentic development workflows preserve appropriate provenance, traceability, human oversight, verification, security, and reproducibility, particularly when contributing to deployed autonomous capabilities.
  • Guide architecture for workflows spanning data ingestion and curation, synthetic data generation, model training and tuning, evaluation, optimization, validation, and deployment.
  • Review and approve detailed software and data designs, resolve cross-team architectural issues, and maintain architectural integrity through implementation and integration.
  • Partner with software, AI/ML, data, systems, product, and technical leadership teams to reduce the time from mission need to validated, deployable autonomy.

• 10+ years of experience in software or software-intensive systems development, design, and/or architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting complex software platforms, developer ecosystems, SDKs, APIs, AI/ML platforms, or distributed systems.

  • Experience in data modeling and data architecture, including metadata, lineage, provenance, versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of how data, training configurations, model artifacts, evaluations, software, and deployments must be connected to provide end-to-end traceability, reproducibility, and auditability.

lists.content:

You will lead cross-functional teams across engineering, safety, and program management, aligning stakeholders around clear objectives, disciplined execution, and continuous learning.

lists.content:
• Act as Test Director for system-level integration and flight test campaigns of Hivemind Mission Autonomy on UAS and external platforms
  • Own test readiness decisions, including entry/exit criteria for lab, simulation, ground, and flight test phases
  • Plan, direct, and execute fly–fix–fly test campaigns, ensuring rapid iteration while maintaining disciplined configuration control and safety
  • Define and enforce test strategy, including system-level verification and validation, test phasing, and prioritization of objectives
  • Direct cross-functional test execution, coordinating across various engineering disciplines and test operators.
  • Determine test infrastructure requirements, including SIL, HIL, simulation environments, flight test assets, and automated test pipelines
  • Approve and oversee test procedures, test cards, and execution plans, serving as the final authority during test conduct
  • Define performance metrics and success criteria, ensuring test data is actionable and traceable to requirements and mission outcomes
  • Lead flight test risk assessments, hazard analyses, and mitigation planning; enforce safety-of-flight discipline during operations
  • Serve as primary test interface to internal leadership, customers, and external stakeholders, providing clear reporting on test progress, results, and risks
  • Establish test standards, SOPs, and best practices aligned with industry and DoD DT&E/OT&E expectations
  • Document test results, anomalies, corrective actions, and lessons learned, driving continuous improvement across autonomy flight test efforts
  • Support travel to test sites, customer events, and integration activities as required
  • Perform other duties as assigned

• B.S. degree in a STEM discipline (Aerospace Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field)
  • 7+ years of experience in system integration and test, including SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight test environments 
  • Demonstrated experience leading test execution, including authority over test conduct, readiness, and risk decisions
  • Strong background working cross-functionally with systems engineering, software, hardware, safety, and program management teams
  • Highly organized and methodical, with the ability to manage complex, fast-paced test campaigns
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefing technical status to leadership and customers
  • Demonstrated integrity, accountability, and commitment to high standards while fostering a collaborative, respectful team environment

• Working knowledge of DoD DT&E and OT&E processes and documentation expectations
  • Direct experience with UAS, autonomy, or robotic flight test operations
  • Prior role as Test Director, Test Conductor, or Lead Flight Test Engineer
  • Experience operating within DoD software and hardware laboratories or government flight test ranges
  • Familiarity with safety-of-flight processes, hazard analysis, and configuration control in flight test environments

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Staff Engineer, Weapons Integration to own the technical architecture, development, and integration of weapons mission critical subsystems for an advanced autonomous aircraft. This engineer will serve as a technical authority across mission computing, avionics, payloads, communications, and associated support systems, translating operational needs into robust, integrated, and verifiable system designs.

In this role, the engineer will define mission system architectures, lead requirements development and allocation, establish performance budgets and interface definitions, and drive complex technical trade studies across hardware, software, and aircraft systems. They will guide technical execution from concept through integration, verification, flight test, and fielding, ensuring that subsystem capabilities collectively satisfy mission performance, safety, airworthiness, and applicable compliance requirements.

lists.content:
• Own architecture, requirements development and allocation, and integration strategy across data storage, weapons, payloads, avionics, and supporting aircraft systems. Establish performance budgets, interface definitions, and verification criteria that align subsystem designs with vehicle level objectives.
  • Serve as a technical authority for weapons integration, leading complex trade studies and system of systems analyses to balance performance, latency, bandwidth, storage capacity, reliability, power, cost, and schedule. Resolve architectural conflicts and guide consequential hardware and software decisions.
  • Define and guide integration and verification campaigns from laboratory and hardware in the loop testing through flight test and fielding. Partner with safety, airworthiness, and certification teams to establish compliance approaches addressing applicable MIL Standards and objectives, and drive resolution of critical anomalies and performance gaps.
  • Lead multidisciplinary technical reviews and readiness assessments, aligning engineering teams, program leadership, customers, and partners on architecture decisions, technical maturity, integration risks, and mitigation plans. Mentor engineers and establish consistent practices for requirements quality, interface management, configuration control, and verification.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 10 or more years of relevant aerospace or defense experience, including at least 5 years developing and integrating weapons or complex aircraft mission systems.
  • Demonstrated technical ownership of mission system architectures spanning mission computing, data storage, avionics, payloads, and communications, including line of sight and beyond line of sight systems. Experience translating operational needs into requirements, performance budgets, interface definitions, and hardware and software specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of systems engineering and product development practices, including requirements decomposition, architecture trade studies, interface management, configuration control, technical risk management, and verification and validation. Experience applying Modular Open Systems Approach principles and relevant frameworks such as Open Mission Systems, Government Reference Architectures, or modular avionics standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams and supplier engineering activities from architecture definition through integration, test, and fielding. Experience guiding design reviews, resolving complex integration issues, assessing technical maturity, and supporting safety and airworthiness compliance activities involving applicable DO 178C and DO 254 objectives.
  • Strong technical communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting architecture decisions, performance evidence, technical risks, and recommendations to engineering leaders, executives, and customers. Active U.S. Secret security clearance and the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

• Master’s or PhD in Aerospace, Systems, or Electrical Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with flight test operations and mission system validation
  • Direct experience integrating advanced sensors, autonomy, AI-enabled payloads, or guided weapons
  • Background in model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and SysML tools
  • Strong knowledge of current aircraft mission systems vendors and capabilities
  • Active DoD Top Secret clearance

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer based in Frisco to support technical capture and pre-sales engagement for the X-BAT aircraft platform in the US. This role will serve as the technical lead for Business Development, bridging US operational requirements with Shield AI’s product roadmap. The ideal candidate has prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM) in roles spanning engineering, technical sales, program management, or advanced capture, with exposure to tactical jet aircraft, CCA/ACA concepts, or Group 4/5 UAS programs. This individual will focus on shaping opportunities within the US market, supporting Go To Market of tactical aircraft, crafting proposal documentation, and providing technical expertise. This individual will also cross-train in Shield AI’s other products to support integrated solution discussions.

lists.content:
• Lead X-BAT technical capture efforts for US Domestic opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI’s product roadmap.
  • Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development. 
  • Develop and execute technical strategies that result in high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals to maximize win probability.
  • Serve as the primary technical lead for Go To Market (GTM) engagements, interfacing cross-functionally with BD, BD Operations, Engineering, Operations, Program Management, and Product Management to ensure customer needs are met.
  • Manage technical content for proposals, requests for information (RFIs), white papers, and capability briefs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance. 
  • Support early-phase acquisition activities (concept notes, requirements drafts, unsolicited proposals).
  • Shape early operational concepts aligned to X-BAT capabilities. 
  • Support BD and Account Executives by becoming a Subject Matter Expert in Shield AI products, providing technical expertise in customer engagements, capability briefings, and solution discussions to drive successful sales outcomes.
  • Act as a liaison between BD and Engineering, ensuring that new customer requests are technically feasible and align with product capabilities, timelines, and roadmaps.
  • Contribute to the technical documentation repository, maintaining capability briefs, specifications, FAQs, and other sales collateral for internal and external use.
  • Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.
  • Support competitive analysis and market intelligence specific to the US tactical aircraft market, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.
  • Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.
  • Analyze the unique operational and environmental factors of the assigned region, producing high-impact white papers and briefs that inform the product roadmap and drive solutions aligned to customer mission needs.

• 10+ years of experience in technical sales, capture, engineering, or program management within defense or aerospace industries.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with US Department of War procurement processes and military force structures.
  • Prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM or equivalent) supporting tactical aircraft, CCA/ACA, or Group 4/5 UAS programs. 
  • Experience interfacing with government or military acquisition stakeholders.
  • Strong systems-level understanding of aircraft design tradeoffs, operational CONOPS, and mission-based engineering.
  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

• Experience supporting defense sales or industrial partnerships.
  • Background in maintenance / sustainment on combat aircraft and/or in mission systems integration.
  • Experience contributing to early-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.
  • Prior military service experience.
  • Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business. 
  • 5+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role.
  • 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment. 
  • Demonstrated understanding of specific DoW operational scenarios and systems.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff Lab Manager to lead the design, development, operation, and long-term strategy of our engineering laboratories. This is a highly technical leadership role responsible for creating world-class lab environments that enable hardware and software engineering teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and validate complex systems.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong operational leadership, driving lab architecture, infrastructure modernization, asset management, and engineering support while leading a team of engineers and technicians.

lists.content:
Lab Strategy & Infrastructure

  • Own the overall vision, architecture, and roadmap for engineering laboratory infrastructure.
  • Design, build, and commission new laboratory spaces to support evolving engineering programs.
  • Define standards for laboratory layout, power distribution, networking, cooling, safety, security, and scalability.
  • Develop long-term modernization plans to ensure laboratory capabilities remain aligned with engineering needs.
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies, tools, and automation to improve laboratory efficiency and reliability.

    • Lab Operations

  • Own day-to-day laboratory operations across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Develop scheduling processes that maximize lab utilization while minimizing conflicts and downtime.
  • Plan and coordinate preventative maintenance, calibration, repairs, and equipment lifecycle management.
  • Manage laboratory uptime, availability, and operational readiness.
  • Establish operational metrics, KPIs, and reporting for lab performance.

    • Engineering Systems & Integration

  • Support complex hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), integration, and validation environments.
  • Develop laboratory standards for networking, compute infrastructure, storage, instrumentation, and data acquisition.
  • Partner with engineering teams to architect robust development and test environments.
  • Ensure laboratories support rapid system integration and reproducible testing.

    • Leadership

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of lab engineers, infrastructure engineers, and technicians.
  • Recruit, mentor, and grow high-performing technical staff.
  • Prioritize work across multiple concurrent engineering programs.
  • Establish standard operating procedures, documentation, and best practices.
  • Foster a culture of safety, ownership, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.

    • Collaboration

  • Work closely with Hardware, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering organizations.
  • Partner with IT, Facilities, Security, and EH&S teams to deliver reliable and secure laboratory environments.
  • Manage vendor relationships for laboratory equipment, infrastructure, and service providers.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting complex engineering laboratories or technical infrastructure.
  • 5+ years of technical leadership or people management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building engineering labs from concept through deployment.
  • Strong understanding of laboratory infrastructure, including:
    • Power distribution
    • Network architecture
    • Server and storage systems
    • Instrumentation
    • Environmental controls
    • Safety systems
    • Experience managing equipment lifecycle, maintenance, calibration, upgrades, and modernization.
    • Experience supporting multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
    • Laboratory infrastructure design and architecture
    • System-level engineering and integration
    • Networking (Ethernet, VLANs, managed switches, routing)
    • Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-loop (SIL) systems
    • Asset management and inventory systems
    • US Citizenship required due to security clearance requirements.
      Active Secret clearance.

• Experience supporting robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, or autonomous systems development.
  • Experience with secure laboratory environments and classified or regulated development environments.
  • Knowledge of systems engineering processes and system architecture.
  • Experience implementing laboratory automation and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud-connected engineering workflows and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Programming and scripting experience:    
    • Python, MATLAB, C/C++, etc.
    • Active Top Secret clearance or eligible to achieve

Job Description:
Hivemind is looking for an experienced SRE lead to help drive the establishment of our SRE function.  

As the SRE Lead, you will establish and mature the reliability practices used across our cloud infrastructure and platform services. You will work with Cloud Engineering and product teams to define reliability targets, improve observability, and ensure that production systems can be operated and recovered predictably. 

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You will investigate complex failures, improve the systems and tooling used to operate our platforms, and turn lessons from incidents into engineering improvements. You will provide technical leadership for reliability engineering, helping teams adopt practices that improve system health without adding unnecessary process. 

You will act as a thought-leader and mentor within the Cloud Engineering and Reliability teams to level up teammates and encourage building with a reliability-first mindset.

Hivemind is looking for an experienced SRE lead to help drive the establishment of our SRE function.  

As the SRE Lead, you will establish and mature the reliability practices used across our cloud infrastructure and platform services. You will work with Cloud Engineering and product teams to define reliability targets, improve observability, and ensure that production systems can be operated and recovered predictably. 

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You will investigate complex failures, improve the systems and tooling used to operate our platforms, and turn lessons from incidents into engineering improvements. You will provide technical leadership for reliability engineering, helping teams adopt practices that improve system health without adding unnecessary process. 

You will act as a thought-leader and mentor within the Cloud Engineering and Reliability teams to level up teammates and encourage building with a reliability-first mindset.

descriptionPlain: We are seeking a highly motivated engineer to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

lists.content:
• Design complex electro-mechanical solutions for avionics packaging, electrical interconnects, thermal management, and aircraft integration
  • Perform structural, preliminary thermal, and modal analyses for avionics to ensure survivability in harsh environments
  • Ensure avionics meet performance, safety, environmental, and EMI/EMC compliance standards, including DO-160, DO-254, DO-178C, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-STD-461
  • Own your design work from concept to reviews through system validation, failure analysis, and flight test readiness.

• B.S. and/or MS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical & electrical equipment design for aerospace, including harness integration and mechanical component design
  • Expertise in CAD software (NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for 3D modeling, drawing creation, and system layout.
  • Familiarity with eCAD software (Altium, Cadence, Allegro), and harness design software (Capital, Zuken)
  • Experience working with electrical engineers to define PCB constraints, develop circuit cards, and care for all the mechanical interfaces
  • Familiarity with the PCB layout process and advanced manufacturing methods
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), thermal analysis, and fatigue/lifecycle testing
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


We are seeking an Operational Analyst to drive the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft systems. This role is pivotal in evaluating the mission effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our next gen UAS and other autonomous platforms. You will work closely with engineering, product development, and defense stakeholders to inform design trade-offs, assess system performance, and optimize mission capabilities.

This position requires a deep understanding of military operations, wargaming, modeling & simulation (M&S), and operational analysis techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy by identifying how our AI-powered aircraft can best serve the evolving needs of modern warfare.

This position requires a deep understanding of military operations, wargaming, modeling & simulation (M&S), and operational analysis techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy by identifying how our AI-powered aircraft can best serve the evolving needs of modern warfare.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute operational analysis strategies to assess the effectiveness of autonomous aircraft in real-world military scenarios.
  • Lead modeling, simulation, and wargaming efforts to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to translate operational insights into design decisions and system improvements.
  • Conduct trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance under varying operational conditions and threats.
  • Utilize advanced modeling & simulation tools (e.g., AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop high-fidelity mission models.
  • Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor effectiveness, and autonomy-driven decision-making to optimize mission success.
  • Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to understand mission needs and align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Develop and present technical reports, briefings, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies.
  • Support concept of operations (CONOPS) development for new AI-driven aircraft capabilities.
  • Identify emerging threats and operational challenges, ensuring Shield AI’s systems remain ahead of adversary capabilities.

• 10+ years of experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S), or military operations research.
  • Expertise in military mission analysis, operational planning, and wargaming methodologies.
  • Proficiency with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or other M&S tools used for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Deep understanding of air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or autonomous systems in contested environments.
  • Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to align capabilities with mission requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.

• Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven decision-making algorithms into operational analysis frameworks.
  • Prior military service or experience working with U.S. Air Force, Navy, or Special Operations Forces.
  • Active Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).
