descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


The Autonomous Pilot Integration team for launched effects builds autonomy solutions for small, often air- or ground-launched platforms that operate in multi-agent fleets and frequently in disconnected or air-gapped environments. We combine capabilities from the Autonomy Capabilities team (motion planning, tactics), the Perception team (e.g., track fusion), and the HivemindSDK to develop the autonomy software that runs on launched effects platforms, then integrate, validate, and field it on the real hardware—for U.S. and international defense customers. Our engineers write new autonomy code—such as mission behaviors, platform-specific control, multi-agent coordination, contingencies, and executive autonomy—and own it end-to-end from software-in-the-loop, to hardware-in-the-loop, to vehicle-in-the-loop, to live test exercise. 
In this role, you'll lead the technical delivery of complex autonomy capabilities spanning platform integration, fleet operations, and operational deployment. You'll own some of the team's most challenging technical problems while driving technical direction across multiple subsystems and collaborating closely with the Autonomy Capabilities team, Perception, feature crews, autopilot vendors, C2 providers, and customer partners. You'll combine deep technical expertise with systems thinking to deliver scalable autonomy solutions for fleet-scale operations.
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Autonomous Pilot Integration team for Emerging Domains builds autonomy solutions for new platforms and mission profiles outside Shield AI's established portfolios—including space (satellites, missile defense), maritime (USV and UUV integration), and contested logistics (unmanned helicopters and related autonomous resupply platforms). The team takes on short-term R&D and integration efforts—often standing up the first autonomy on a brand-new platform or mission—with the intent that successful efforts grow into larger, multi-year programs. We combine capabilities from the Autonomy Capabilities team (motion planning, tactics), the Perception team (e.g., ViDAR, ATR), and the HivemindSDK—selectively leveraging existing Shield AI autonomy solutions where they apply—to develop autonomy that runs on these new platforms. Our engineers write new autonomy code—such as mission behaviors, platform-specific control, multi-agent coordination, contingencies, and executive autonomy—and own it end-to-end from software-in-the-loop, to hardware-in-the-loop, to vehicle-in-the-loop, to live test exercise. 

In this role, you'll define the technical direction for Emerging Domains, guiding autonomy strategy across multiple new platforms and mission areas while helping transform early-stage R&D efforts into scalable, long-term programs. You'll solve the organization's most complex technical challenges, influence engineering strategy across organizations, and partner with engineering leadership, platform teams, and customer stakeholders to shape the future of Shield AI's next generation of autonomy portfolios.

lists.content:
Stand Up New Programs – Define the technical strategy for establishing autonomy on entirely new platforms and mission areas, determining what should be built, reused, or extended from existing Shield AI capabilities. 

Navigate Ambiguity & Shifting Priorities – Lead engineering through evolving customer needs, changing priorities, and uncertain technical landscapes while maintaining execution and long-term technical vision. 

Technical Strategy & Portfolio Leadership – Define long-term technical direction across Emerging Domains, establishing architecture, integration strategies, and engineering patterns that enable successful transition from R&D to operational programs. 

Develop & Field Autonomy – Guide development and deployment of autonomy capabilities across space, maritime, contested logistics, and future emerging platforms while ensuring successful operational delivery. 

Platform Team Partnerships – Build deep technical partnerships with platform organizations and influence interface evolution, integration strategy, and long-term platform architecture. 

Collaboration Across Teams & Partners – Influence architecture across Autonomy Capabilities, Perception, GCS, platform teams, engineering leadership, customer organizations, and external partners. 

Design & Documentation – Lead architecture reviews, engineering standards, ICDs, and technical best practices across multiple organizations. 

Pre-deployment Preparation – Guide release strategy, mission validation, and operational readiness across multiple emerging programs. 

On-site Test & Mission Support – Provide senior technical leadership during critical demonstrations, operational exercises, and customer events where deep systems expertise is required. 

Hardware/Software Debugging – Lead resolution of the organization's most challenging autonomy integration problems spanning software, hardware, embedded systems, and platform interfaces. 

Mission Data & Debrief Support – Drive organizational learning from operational testing and shape future technical investments based on mission outcomes. 

Continuous Improvement – Drive long-term improvements to engineering processes, developer experience, testing infrastructure, and integration workflows across the Emerging Domains portfolio. 

C2 Interoperability & Standards – Define technical strategy for command-and-control interoperability and guide adoption of platform-appropriate open-systems standards across emerging programs. 

Grow R&D into Programs – Partner with engineering leadership and customers to evolve successful R&D efforts into scalable, long-term programs while helping shape technical strategy for future portfolios. 

Hiring & Developing Technical Talent – Help define the technical hiring bar for senior engineering roles, mentor future technical leaders, and partner with managers to grow organizational capability. 

Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10–20% of the year to different office locations, customer sites, operator training events, flight tests, and integration exercises.

• BS/MS in a relevant engineering discipline or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires 10+ years of relevant experience.  

  • Expert-level C++ and Linux systems development experience.  

  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy across multiple programs or engineering organizations.  

  • Proven track record solving highly complex systems integration challenges in ambiguous environments.  

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering direction without formal authority.  

  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Experience leading first-of-kind autonomy or advanced R&D efforts.  

  • Experience across multiple autonomy domains (air, maritime, space, ground, or robotics).  

  • Experience transitioning prototypes into operational systems.  

  • Experience with government R&D programs and defense customers.  

  • Experience shaping engineering practices across an organization.  

  • Experience with UCI, OMS, STANAG 4586, or other defense interoperability standards.

• Develop & Field Autonomy — Develop & integrate autonomy software solutions onto unmanned platforms (air, maritime, space, or effects/expendables), including payload computer bring-up, container-based deployment (e.g., k3s/k3d), and configuration across onboard compute, sensors, and command-and-control interfaces — and own the technical direction across a set of related programs, driving the autonomy reference implementation and common patterns that keep delivery coherent across portfolios. 
    • Technical Strategy & Leadership — Set the technical direction across multiple programs; drive the autonomy reference implementation and common patterns that portfolios adopt; anticipate where the stack needs to go and adapt as priorities shift; align with engineering leadership early and maintain outward status; serve as the subject-matter expert that the broader org reaches for when hard, ambiguous problems in unknown solution spaces land on the team. 
    • Collaboration & Cross-Engineering Influence — Build effective working relationships across engineering; represent the team to engineering leadership, customer/program offices, standards bodies, and external partners (platform integrators, vehicle/autopilot control vendors, C2 providers); shape architecture decisions beyond the team. 
    • Mentorship & Growth — Mentor senior engineers and other team leads; provide cross-functional mentorship to engineers in adjacent departments; help shape the leveling and career bar for the team and the broader engineering organization. 
    • Design & Documentation — Drive cross-functional design reviews, architecture documents, and post-mortems across many teams; publish content that informs decisions beyond the team; set the rigor and process bar for the broader engineering org. 
    • Pre-deployment Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for mission-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility, mission readiness, and release cadence with capability and feature teams. 
    • On-site Test & Mission Support — Travel to test sites and support live mission operations (flight tests, range exercises, on-water trials, integration events), including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints. 
    • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy stacks, payload computers, and embedded systems in lab and field environments — including memory, CPU, and timing profiling under operationally-representative loads. 
    • Mission Data & Debrief Support — Capture mission and test data, reproduce issues in simulation, and partner with autonomy capability owners to drive fixes back into the next build. 
    • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, test/mission reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles. 
    • C2 Interoperability & Standards — Set the strategy for C2 interoperability across our portfolio; shape interface evolution with internal and external stakeholders; own implementation and compliance against command-and-control standards (e.g., A-GRA, UCI, OMS). 
    • Hiring — Define the skills bar and hiring strategy for senior roles in your area; partner with managers on long-term staffing plans; assess candidates accurately and onboard new senior engineers. 
    • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-20% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and integration/test events).

  • Proficiency in C++, with experience developing or integrating real-time or latency-sensitive systems. 
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics. 
  • Familiarity with middleware, pub-sub, or IPC frameworks used in autonomy or robotics systems (e.g., DDS, message buses). 
  • Hands-on experience supporting demos, exercises, or field/mission tests for unmanned or autonomous systems. 
  • Experience with autonomy simulation environments for testing and validation. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple teams or driving cross-program technical initiatives from concept through fielded delivery. 
  • Track record as the subject-matter expert sought across engineering on hard, ambiguous problems in unknown solution spaces in your discipline. 
  • Track record of setting forward-looking technical strategy and adjusting course as programs and priorities evolve. 
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and team leads, and shaping the career bar for the discipline. 
  • Experience shaping architecture decisions, interface contracts, and standards across multiple teams. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance across the full stack. 
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. 
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance. 

    •

• Direct experience supporting unmanned systems (air, maritime, space, ground, or effects/expendables) or similar field test campaigns. 
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and analysis. 
  • Experience leading multiple programs or driving cross-program technical initiatives in an unmanned systems context. 
  • Experience interfacing with customers and external stakeholders, representing the company in technical engagements, briefing senior leadership, and presenting to non-technical audiences.

lists.content:
• Develop & Field Autonomy — Develop & integrate autonomy software solutions onto unmanned platforms (air, maritime, space, or effects/expendables), including payload computer bring-up, container-based deployment (e.g., k3s/k3d), and configuration across onboard compute, sensors, and command-and-control interfaces — and own the technical direction across a set of related programs, driving the autonomy reference implementation and common patterns that keep delivery coherent across portfolios. 
    • Technical Strategy & Leadership — Set the technical direction across multiple programs; drive the autonomy reference implementation and common patterns that portfolios adopt; anticipate where the stack needs to go and adapt as priorities shift; align with engineering leadership early and maintain outward status; serve as the subject-matter expert that the broader org reaches for when hard, ambiguous problems in unknown solution spaces land on the team. 
    • Collaboration & Cross-Engineering Influence — Build effective working relationships across engineering; represent the team to engineering leadership, customer/program offices, standards bodies, and external partners (platform integrators, vehicle/autopilot control vendors, C2 providers); shape architecture decisions beyond the team. 
    • Mentorship & Growth — Mentor senior engineers and other team leads; provide cross-functional mentorship to engineers in adjacent departments; help shape the leveling and career bar for the team and the broader engineering organization. 
    • Design & Documentation — Drive cross-functional design reviews, architecture documents, and post-mortems across many teams; publish content that informs decisions beyond the team; set the rigor and process bar for the broader engineering org. 
    • Pre-deployment Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for mission-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility, mission readiness, and release cadence with capability and feature teams. 
    • On-site Test & Mission Support — Travel to test sites and support live mission operations (flight tests, range exercises, on-water trials, integration events), including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints. 
    • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy stacks, payload computers, and embedded systems in lab and field environments — including memory, CPU, and timing profiling under operationally-representative loads. 
    • Mission Data & Debrief Support — Capture mission and test data, reproduce issues in simulation, and partner with autonomy capability owners to drive fixes back into the next build. 
    • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, test/mission reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles. 
    • C2 Interoperability & Standards — Set the strategy for C2 interoperability across our portfolio; shape interface evolution with internal and external stakeholders; own implementation and compliance against command-and-control standards (e.g., A-GRA, UCI, OMS). 
    • Hiring — Define the skills bar and hiring strategy for senior roles in your area; partner with managers on long-term staffing plans; assess candidates accurately and onboard new senior engineers. 
    • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-20% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and integration/test events). 

      •

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 
  • Proficiency in C++, with experience developing or integrating real-time or latency-sensitive systems. 
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics. 
  • Familiarity with middleware, pub-sub, or IPC frameworks used in autonomy or robotics systems (e.g., DDS, message buses). 
  • Hands-on experience supporting demos, exercises, or field/mission tests for unmanned or autonomous systems. 
  • Experience with autonomy simulation environments for testing and validation. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple teams or driving cross-program technical initiatives from concept through fielded delivery. 
  • Track record as the subject-matter expert sought across engineering on hard, ambiguous problems in unknown solution spaces in your discipline. 
  • Track record of setting forward-looking technical strategy and adjusting course as programs and priorities evolve. 
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and team leads, and shaping the career bar for the discipline. 
  • Experience shaping architecture decisions, interface contracts, and standards across multiple teams. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance across the full stack. 
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. 
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance. 

    •

• Direct experience supporting unmanned systems (air, maritime, space, ground, or effects/expendables) or similar field test campaigns. 
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and analysis. 
  • Experience leading multiple programs or driving cross-program technical initiatives in an unmanned systems context. 
  • Experience interfacing with customers and external stakeholders, representing the company in technical engagements, briefing senior leadership, and presenting to non-technical audiences. 
  • Track record of improvements that span the broader engineering organization (process, architecture, technical bar, or platform-wide tooling). 
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, motion planning, or vehicle-control integration. 
  • Competence in vehicle electronics bring-up (avionics, spacecraft buses, or vessel control), payload computer integration, or hardware-in-the-loop debugging. 
  • Experience with container orchestration (e.g., k3s, k3d, Docker) on embedded or payload compute. 
  • Familiarity with platform control / autopilot stacks (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, spacecraft flight software, vessel autopilots). 
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing. 
  • Build-system experience (e.g., Conan, CMake) and CI/CD pipeline familiarity. 
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews. 
  • Experience with C2 standards such as A-GRA, UCI, or OMS. 
  • Familiarity with government-furnished simulation environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) is a plus.

This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.

  • Behavior Architecture Implementation – Implement and test behavior architectures that enable multi-agent coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios.
  • Hybrid Autonomy Integration – Work at the intersection of classical autonomy and machine learning, blending rule-based systems with learning-based methods such as reinforcement learning to achieve robust, adaptive behavior.

  • R&D and Roadmapping – Contribute to the autonomy roadmap by researching and prototyping new algorithms, identifying tactical capability gaps, and proposing novel solutions that advance Shield AI’s mission.
  • Program Support & Adaptation – Support defense-focused programs and customer needs by adapting autonomy solutions to evolving mission sets, compliance requirements, and operational feedback.

  • Significant background in robotics technologies related to motion planning, behavior modeling, decision-making, or autonomous system design.

This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


The Hivemind Solutions Perception team develops the next generation of perception capabilities for autonomous systems by combining state-of-the-art machine learning with the proven foundations of computer vision. The team advances how autonomous platforms understand and interpret the world by developing vision, vision-language (VLM), and vision-language-action (VLA) models that tackle core perception challenges such as object understanding, scene interpretation, and mission-relevant environmental awareness. Working at the intersection of research and production, our engineers build the data pipelines, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) workflows, evaluation frameworks, and deployment infrastructure needed to transform cutting-edge AI research into reliable, mission-ready perception capabilities.
 
In this role, you'll develop and deploy advanced machine learning models that enable autonomous systems to better understand, reason about, and interact with their environment. You'll partner closely with machine learning researchers, autonomy engineers, perception engineers, and platform teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready systems for U.S. and international defense customers. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who enjoy building state-of-the-art AI systems while solving the practical challenges of deploying them on operational autonomous platforms.

The Hivemind Solutions Perception team develops the next generation of perception capabilities for autonomous systems by combining state-of-the-art machine learning with the proven foundations of computer vision. The team advances how autonomous platforms understand and interpret the world by developing vision, vision-language (VLM), and vision-language-action (VLA) models that tackle core perception challenges such as object understanding, scene interpretation, and mission-relevant environmental awareness. Working at the intersection of research and production, our engineers build the data pipelines, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) workflows, evaluation frameworks, and deployment infrastructure needed to transform cutting-edge AI research into reliable, mission-ready perception capabilities.
 
In this role, you'll develop and deploy advanced machine learning models that enable autonomous systems to better understand, reason about, and interact with their environment. You'll partner closely with machine learning researchers, autonomy engineers, perception engineers, and platform teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready systems for U.S. and international defense customers. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who enjoy building state-of-the-art AI systems while solving the practical challenges of deploying them on operational autonomous platforms.

lists.content:
Model Development – Design, train, fine-tune, and maintain state-of-the-art vision, vision-language, and vision-language-action models that improve perception and decision-making for autonomous systems. 

Data Pipelines & Model Training – Build scalable data pipelines, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) workflows, and evaluation loops that continuously improve model performance on mission-relevant tasks. 

Model Deployment & Optimization – Deploy and optimize machine learning models for embedded hardware using technologies such as ONNX, TensorRT, and hardware-accelerated inference frameworks. 

Perception & Autonomy Applications – Apply modern machine learning techniques to solve challenging perception and autonomy problems across aerial and other autonomous systems operating in complex, real-world environments. 

Research-to-Production – Translate cutting-edge machine learning research into production-ready capabilities by balancing model performance, robustness, computational efficiency, and operational reliability. 

Cross-functional Collaboration – Partner closely with perception, autonomy, platform, and software engineering teams to integrate machine learning capabilities into mission-ready autonomous systems. 

Model Evaluation & Validation – Develop benchmarks, testing methodologies, and evaluation frameworks to measure model performance, identify failure modes, and guide future improvements. 

Continuous Improvement – Improve training infrastructure, developer tooling, deployment workflows, and model lifecycle management to accelerate experimentation and production delivery.

• Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.

  • Mastery of machine learning fundamentals. 

  • Experience training an deploying ML models for computer vision in a production setting. 

  • Strong understanding of 3D vision problems/algorithms. 

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow. 

  • Demonstrated expertise in deploying models using TensorRT and ONNX. 

  • Proficiency in C++ and Python. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate research into practical applications. 

  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance

• Experience with developing autonomous systems for defense customers. 

  • Experience with training/finetuning vision-language models, vision-language-action models, and/or world models.  

  • Contributions to open-source projects in machine learning or computer vision. 

  • Track record of publications in leading computer vision and robotics conferences and journals (e.g., CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, RAL, ICRA).

Job Description

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Staff Systems Security Engineer specializing in Program Protection, Anti-Tamper (AT), and Critical Program Information (CPI) to support the development of next-generation autonomous military aircraft and associated mission systems.

This role will lead the identification and protection of critical technologies through CPI assessments, threat and vulnerability analysis, protection architecture development, and anti-tamper engineering. The engineer will leverage established DoD program protection guidance and engineering frameworks to translate protection objectives into actionable system requirements, evaluate design alternatives, and drive protection measures through implementation and verification.

Working within Systems Engineering & Integrated Test (SEIT), this individual will collaborate with systems engineering, platform engineering, hardware, software, cybersecurity, and Government stakeholders to integrate program protection throughout system development, integration, testing, and fielding.

lists.content:
• Program Protection & CPI: Lead CPI identification, criticality assessments, and technical protection strategies utilizing the DoD CPI Horizontal Protection Guide (HPG), including evaluation of organic and inherited CPI and horizontal protection considerations.
  • Anti-Tamper Engineering: Lead anti-tamper engineering activities in accordance with the DoD Anti-Tamper Engineering Framework (ATEF), including threat and exploitation analysis, protection requirements, architecture development, design trade studies, and implementation planning.
  • Systems Engineering: Define and decompose program protection and anti-tamper requirements into system, subsystem, hardware, and software requirements while maintaining traceability through design implementation and verification.
  • Architecture & Integration: Collaborate with systems and platform engineering teams to integrate protection measures across aircraft, mission systems, embedded computing, ground control systems, and supporting equipment.
  • Technical Planning: Lead technical development of CPI assessments, Program Protection Implementation Plans (PPIP), Anti-Tamper Plans, protection trade studies, and associated engineering documentation.
  • Risk & Trade Analysis: Evaluate protection alternatives based on technical effectiveness, implementation feasibility, cost, system performance, integration complexity, and residual risk.
  • Verification & Validation: Develop protection verification criteria and support laboratory evaluations, integration testing, and assessments to demonstrate the effectiveness of implemented protection measures.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide subject-matter expertise during SRR, PDR, CDR, and other engineering milestones. Coordinate with Government program protection authorities, suppliers, and internal engineering teams to resolve technical risks and mature protection designs.

• Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in aerospace, defense, embedded systems, systems security engineering, or mission-critical technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience in program protection, anti-tamper engineering, critical technology protection, or related systems security engineering disciplines.
  • Experience developing system security architectures, technical requirements, engineering design artifacts, and protection implementation approaches.
  • Experience with CPI assessments, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, exploitation risk assessments, or protection trade studies.
  • Strong understanding of hardware, firmware, embedded software, and system integration considerations associated with protecting critical technologies.
  • protecting critical technologies.
  • Experience with systems engineering processes, requirements decomposition, technical risk management, and verification activities.
  • Strong technical leadership, analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance and required program access.

• Direct experience designing, implementing, or verifying anti-tamper protections for military aircraft, weapon systems, autonomous platforms, or embedded mission systems.
  • Experience applying the DoD Anti-Tamper Engineering Framework (ATEF) and CPI Horizontal Protection Guide (HPG) to program protection assessments, engineering design, and technical implementation.
  • Experience developing Program Protection Plans, Program Protection Implementation Plans, Anti-Tamper Plans, or CPI assessments for DoD programs.
  • Familiarity with DoDI 5200.39, DoDD 5200.47E, DoDI 5200.44, NIST SP 800-160, and applicable DoD program protection and systems security engineering guidance.
  • Experience with embedded protection technologies, including secure boot, hardware roots of trust, tamper detection and response, secure storage, software protection, and hardware or firmware assurance.
  • Experience working with microelectronics, FPGAs, mission computers, or other critical embedded technologies.
  • Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), SysML, Cameo Systems Modeler, DOORS, and requirements traceability.
  • Understanding of supply chain risk management, trusted systems, defense exportability, and technology release considerations.
  • Experience coordinating with Government program protection organizations, anti-tamper authorities, and defense industry partners.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance; SAP eligibility or prior SAP experience preferred.

As a Senior Staff Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class engineering talent.

lists.content:
• Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Operations, Strategy, IT, Procurement, Facilities, and other G&A and corporate disciplines.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

• 8+ years of sourcing experience, ideally supporting G&A, corporate functions, or other complex, high-growth organizations.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Direct experience using AI development environments or coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools) to create repeatable sourcing workflows, structured research outputs, market intelligence, process automation, or operational documentation.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Operations, Strategy, IT, Procurement, or other G&A and corporate functions.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

Job Description:

Hivemind Catalyst: A Faster Path to First Flight 

Shield AI is building the world's best AI pilot. Hivemind powers intelligent aircraft, drones, and robotic systems that operate autonomously in the most demanding environments. Hivemind Catalyst accelerates the adoption of autonomy by enabling customers to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy sovereign autonomous capabilities on their own platforms. 

As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager for Hivemind Catalyst, you will operate at the intersection of technology, strategy, business development, and execution. You will help customers define their autonomy roadmaps, shape technical solutions, drive software alignment across internal teams, and ensure successful execution of customer programs from initial engagement through delivery. 

This role requires exceptional technical judgment, executive communication skills, and the ability to create structure and clarity in highly ambiguous environments. You will work directly with senior engineering leaders, business leaders, international partners, and customers to accelerate the adoption of autonomy at scale.

lists.content:
Program Leadership and Execution 

  • Lead technical program management activities for Hivemind customer programs.
  • Develop technical execution plans that drive technology maturation and successful customer outcomes.
  • Establish clear milestones, entry criteria, exit criteria, and measurable success metrics across programs.
  • Manage program cost, schedule, scope, risk, dependencies, and resource allocation.
  • Track customer spending against contractual budgets and program commitments.
  • Identify risks early and drive mitigation strategies that reduce technical, schedule, and business uncertainty.
  • Hold internal and external stakeholders accountable to commitments while maintaining strong customer relationships. 

    • Software and Roadmap Alignment 

  • Embed closely within Hivemind Enterprise teams to ensure customer needs are accurately represented in product and engineering priorities.
  • Drive closed-loop communication between customers, engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Support software release planning, roadmap development, prioritization, and resource allocation decisions.
  • Ensure technical investments align with strategic priorities, revenue opportunities, and customer outcomes.
  • Advocate for the capabilities that create the greatest impact for customers and the business. 

    • Customer Strategy and Technical Planning 

  • Review and assess Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates, Statements of Work (SOWs), proposals, bids, and customer engagements across domestic and international markets.
  • Develop pricing recommendations, high-level technical decompositions, project plans, and execution strategies.
  • Partner with customers to define technical roadmaps that accelerate the development, deployment, and operationalization of sovereign autonomy capabilities.
  • Help customers establish practical paths from prototype to production and mission-ready deployment.
  • Support business development, capture, and growth initiatives through technical planning, proposal development, and customer engagement. 

    • Internal Strategic Execution 

  • Own and maintain technical execution roadmaps across internal Catalyst priorities.
  • Create structure, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans for internal research and development efforts.
  • Drive alignment across multiple technical roadmaps and identify interdependencies, conflicts, and resource constraints.
  • Monitor program health, track progress against objectives, and facilitate data-driven decision making.
  • Support organizational OKRs and key performance metrics through disciplined execution and reporting. 

    • Executive Communication and Stakeholder Management 

  • Develop executive-level communications, briefings, summaries, and decision materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support Monthly Portfolio Reviews, Executive Steering Committees, Quarterly Business Reviews, Board Reviews, and other strategic forums.
  • Communicate effectively with senior engineering, business, government, and international stakeholders.
  • Drive alignment across technical, operational, financial, and strategic priorities. 

    • Strategic Initiatives 

  • Lead and support high-impact strategic initiatives that enable company growth and global expansion.
  • Partner across engineering, legal, compliance, finance, facilities, business development, and operations teams to solve complex cross-functional challenges.
  • Contribute to international expansion efforts, including establishment of new offices, partnerships, and operating models.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management within a fast-paced technology organization. 
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs involving software, systems, and external stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing project plans, execution roadmaps, schedules, and risk mitigation strategies. 
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, release planning, and technical product roadmaps. 
  • Experience supporting customer-facing programs, proposals, SOW development, or technical business development activities. 
  • Demonstrated ability to drive clarity, alignment, and execution in ambiguous environments. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level communications. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make informed decisions using incomplete information. 
  • Ability to work effectively across engineering, product, business development, finance, and operations organizations. 
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%, including domestic and international travel.

• Experience in autonomy, robotics, aerospace, defense technology, aviation, or complex software platforms. 
  • Experience supporting international customers, partners, or technology programs. 
  • Experience developing technical proposals, ROMs, pricing strategies, or capture plans. 
  • Familiarity with government, defense, or national security acquisition environments. 
  • Experience managing programs involving multiple stakeholders across technical and business domains. 
  • MBA, Master's degree, or advanced technical degree.

At Shield AI, you will help define the future of autonomy. You will work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and business leaders to deliver transformational technology that enables customers to build and deploy sovereign autonomous capabilities faster than ever before. 

If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving complex technical and business problems, and want to play a central role in shaping the future of autonomous systems, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a YouTube Producer to lead the development, production, publishing, and growth of the company’s YouTube channel. This role combines the craft and editorial judgment of a senior video editor with channel strategy, audience development, and performance ownership.

The YouTube Producer will turn Shield AI’s work in autonomy, aviation, defense, and artificial intelligence into clear, accurate, audience-focused stories. They will manage projects from concept through final edit, packaging, publishing, and analysis while partnering with technical experts, executives, and communications teams.

lists.content:
• Own Shield AI’s YouTube programming strategy, editorial calendar, publishing cadence, and channel-growth plan.
  • Develop and produce video concepts including explainers, product stories, interviews, flight-test content, event coverage, customer narratives, and short-form video.
  • Lead projects from creative brief through scripting, interviews, production planning, editing, review, and delivery.
  • Edit high-quality long-form and short-form content, including story structure, pacing, sound, graphics, color, captions, and final delivery.
  • Package and publish videos using effective titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, playlists, metadata, and calls to action.

• 7+ years of experience in video production, post-production, digital media, editorial, or content marketing.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating video editing, visual storytelling, interview production, narrative structure, and digital-video judgment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent tools.
  • Demonstrated experience producing and publishing content for YouTube or similar digital-video platforms.
  • Strong understanding of YouTube packaging and analytics, including thumbnails, titles, audience retention, click-through rate, watch time, and subscriber growth.
  • Ability to independently develop concepts and manage productions from idea through published video.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for production, events, customer activities, or field shoots.

• Experience managing or growing a YouTube channel for a technology, aerospace, defense, industrial, science, or mission-driven organization.
  • Experience with camera operation, lighting, location audio, and directing interviews or on-camera talent.
  • Experience managing freelance editors, motion designers, production crews, agencies, or vendors.
  • Familiarity with YouTube Shorts and adapting long-form content for short-form distribution.
  • Experience working with regulated, security-conscious, or high-growth technology organizations.

• A consistent YouTube publishing cadence that supports Shield AI’s brand and business priorities.
  • Clear, compelling content that makes Shield AI’s mission, people, products, and technology more understandable to broad audiences.
  • Stronger channel performance across watch time, retention, engagement, returning viewers, and subscribers.
  • Reliable, scalable production workflows that maintain quality, accuracy, and security.

Job Description:

This role is a partner to the Director of Workplace AI. It focuses on collaborating with stakeholders to understand their business problems, shaping AI use cases, quantifying impact, and producing decision-quality analyses and materials that help the Director and VP make smart, fast calls. 

The person in this role will work across business units to clarify needs, analyze processes and data, support build-versus-buy recommendations, and track how AI solutions perform against baselines and ROI expectations.

lists.content:
• Work with business stakeholders to unpack ambiguous asks into clear problem statements, hypotheses about where AI adds leverage, and testable success criteria. 
  • Map current workflows, identify pain points and inefficiencies, and quantify potential impact of new AI solutions(e.g., time saved, error reduction, risk reduction, throughput gains). 
  • Collaborate with the Director and technical partners to define use-case scope, requirements, and business value; build simple business cases comparing options. 
  • Run targeted market research, compile vendor information, and build comparison frameworks (capabilities, cost, risk, fit) that inform the Director’s buy vs build recommendations. 
  • Partner with business teams to establish pre-deployment baselines; design practical, business-facing metrics and dashboards to track adoption and value post-deployment. 
  • Draft concise business case documents, evaluation summaries, and ROI updates that senior leaders can consume quickly and act on. 
  • Monitor usage and outcome data, compare performance against baselines and expectations, and highlight where AI solutions are succeeding or underperforming. 
  • Use data (feedback, usage, outcomes) to inform training focus, messaging, and iteration priorities; surface insights that help the Director fine-tune adoption strategies.

• 12 years in consulting, business analysis, product strategy, transformation, or similar analytically heavy IC roles. 
  • Strong fluency with modern AI/GenAI concepts and enterprise productivity tools; able to understand solution patterns and constraints. 
  • Demonstrated experience structuring ambiguous business problems and delivering clear, data-informed recommendations. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable with quantitative analysis on operational and business metrics (Excel/Sheets, BI tools, or similar). 
  • Ability to turn stakeholder conversations and data into crisp narratives, business cases, and recommendation documents. 
  • Experience working cross-functionally with business stakeholders on technology-enabled change (tools, workflows, or process improvements). 
  • Strong communication skills, especially in written form (memos, decks, summaries) for senior, non-technical audiences.

• Consulting background (strategy, operations, or analytics) or internal strategy/ops roles with a focus on data-driven decision-making. 
  • Experience building simple ROI models or value frameworks for technology or process changes. 
  • Exposure to vendor selection, SaaS evaluations, or market scans in a B2B/enterprise context. 
  • Familiarity with basic BI or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker) for building simple adoption/value views.

 The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of the enterprise IT infrastructure supporting Shield AI's business operations. This role designs, implements, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise systems across cloud, endpoint, identity, server, and collaboration platforms while ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable services.

The Senior Systems Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver operational excellence, improve system reliability, automate administrative processes, and support strategic IT initiatives. This position serves as a technical lead for enterprise infrastructure projects and provides advanced troubleshooting for complex operational issues.

lists.content:
• Administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise Windows, Linux, and macOS systems supporting corporate business operations.
  • Design, implement, configure, and support enterprise infrastructure including cloud services, identity management, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and core IT systems.
  • Analyze system performance, availability, and operational metrics to proactively improve reliability, scalability, and security.
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Group Policy, authentication services, and role-based access controls.
  • Deploy, maintain, and support endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, JAMF, and related management technologies.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patch management, and lifecycle replacement initiatives.
  • Lead technical implementation of enterprise IT projects while coordinating with Infrastructure, Security, Networking, and business stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, operating system, cloud, and application issues using root cause analysis methodologies.
  • Support LAN/WAN connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and network-related troubleshooting in partnership with networking teams.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Manage enterprise hardware and software assets throughout their lifecycle including procurement, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Participate in incident response, change management, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity activities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and perform scheduled maintenance outside normal business hours as required.
  • Mentor junior administrators and provide technical guidance across the Enterprise IT organization.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of progressively responsible experience administering enterprise IT infrastructure and systems.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems within enterprise environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and identity management.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune.
  • Experience managing endpoint platforms such as JAMF, Intune, or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing, VPN, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and SaaS platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills across operating systems, infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience implementing system upgrades, migrations, and enterprise infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high operational standards.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and support planned maintenance activities.

• Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments including Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
  • Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Experience administering ITSM and asset management platforms such as Jira Service Management and Snipe-IT.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL service management practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
  • Industry certifications such as Microsoft Certified, Azure Administrator, CompTIA Server+, Security+, VMware VCP, Cisco, or ITIL Foundation.
  • Experience supporting highly secure or regulated enterprise environments.

descriptionPlain:
The Systems Engineer, Autonomy & Software at Shield AI is responsible for solving complex systems engineering challenges associated with the development, integration, and deployment of advanced autonomous systems for defense applications.

This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software engineering, and autonomy. The Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate mission and customer needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies while maintaining a deep technical understanding of the software and autonomy capabilities being delivered.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in software and autonomy, is comfortable developing and debugging software in C++ and Python, and has significant experience applying systems engineering principles within complex defense programs. They should be equally comfortable working at the system level and diving into technical implementation when required.
description:
The Systems Engineer, Autonomy & Software at Shield AI is responsible for solving complex systems engineering challenges associated with the development, integration, and deployment of advanced autonomous systems for defense applications.

This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software engineering, and autonomy. The Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate mission and customer needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies while maintaining a deep technical understanding of the software and autonomy capabilities being delivered.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in software and autonomy, is comfortable developing and debugging software in C++ and Python, and has significant experience applying systems engineering principles within complex defense programs. They should be equally comfortable working at the system level and diving into technical implementation when required.

lists.content:
• Apply systems engineering principles to the development and integration of autonomous systems for defense applications.
  • Translate operational needs, mission objectives, and customer requirements into clear system, subsystem, software, and autonomy requirements.
  • Develop and maintain system architectures, functional decompositions, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, requirements traceability, and verification strategies.
  • Work closely with autonomy, software, guidance, navigation and control, avionics, hardware, test, and platform engineering teams to ensure successful system integration.
  • Define and manage interfaces between Hivemind Autonomy, vehicle systems, mission systems, sensors, communications, payloads, and external systems.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying autonomy and software architecture, including how system level requirements translate into software behavior and implementation.
  • Develop software, prototypes, analysis tools, test infrastructure, and engineering utilities using C++ and Python when required to solve integration and system level engineering problems.
  • Use code, simulation, logs, telemetry, and other engineering data to investigate system behavior, diagnose failures, validate assumptions, and support technical decision making.
  • Lead and support system integration activities across simulation, software in the loop, hardware in the loop, ground test, and flight test environments.

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, or delivering complex software intensive systems, preferably within aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems.
  • Strong software engineering background with hands on experience developing and debugging software in C++ and Python.
  • Experience with autonomous or robotic systems, including familiarity with areas such as perception, planning, estimation, guidance, navigation, controls, or mission autonomy.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and their application to complex defense systems.
  • Experience developing and managing system and subsystem requirements, including requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification.
  • Experience developing system architectures, functional architectures, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, and other system level engineering artifacts.

Job Description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.

Job Description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.
 
This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.
 
Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

lists.content:
• Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
  • Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
  • Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
  • Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
  • Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

• 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
  • Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
  • Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
  • Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
  • Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
  • Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
  • Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

As we scale rapidly across our APJ region, we’re looking for a highly driven Senior Talent Sourcer who lives and breathes talent discovery - someone who can take a complex, highly specialized needs and translate it into a precision sourcing strategy. You’ll be the go-to expert for market mapping, proactive candidate generation, and pipeline cultivation across our Go-to-Market and Engineering groups.

This isn’t just a "find resumes" role - it’s about building intelligence, relationships, and repeatable systems that fuel our engineering hiring engine. As a Senior Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class engineering talent.

lists.content:
• Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Go-To-Market, G&A, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Embedded, AI/ML, Systems, Manufacturing, and other disciplines across the organization.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

• 5+ years of talent sourcing experience, ideally in aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex hardware/software industries.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting aerospace, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, or advanced vehicle engineering organizations.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

lists.content:
• Manage complex software development projects. Lead and be accountable for projects that span multiple functional teams and cross-functional initiatives. This includes hardware and software engineering, legal, safety and security, business and commercial development, finance, supply chain, and operations.
  • Create cohesive project plans. Develop detailed plans that track and drive product deliverables, both internal and external to Shield AI, across all phases of the program. Ensure timely completion, resolve dependencies, evaluate risks, and effectively communicate status to upper management and project stakeholders.
  • Solicit, aggregate, and track product and technical requirements. Gather requirements from stakeholders, both internal and external, and aggregate them into a single source of truth. Track the status of requirements throughout the development process to ensure that they are met.

• Project Management Experience: Experience managing complex software development projects from start to finish, including setting and managing budgets, schedules, and resources. Experience working with multidisciplinary teams, running multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to run advanced projects/programs consisting of multiple interrelated projects, in a manner that is largely self-directed. Competency in both waterfall and agile project processes.
  • Scheduling Tool Experience: Experience using scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet.
  • Microsoft Office Suite Experience: Significant experience and excellent skills with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Leadership, Time Management, Organization, and Team Management Skills: Excellent skills in leadership, time management, organization, and team management. The ability to motivate and inspire others, set clear expectations, and delegate tasks effectively is essential.
  • Project Management Knowledge: Theoretical and practical knowledge of project management principles and practices. The ability to identify and manage risks, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and make sound decisions under pressure is essential.

Job Description:

The HMS UAS Operations Technician is responsible for the execution of surrogate flight test operations supporting the Hivemind portfolio. This role conducts day-to-day flight activities, aircraft preparation, system configuration, field operations, and operational support for autonomy testing.

The HMS UAS Operations Technician serves as the primary operator and technical lead for Group 1/2 UAS test assets, ensuring aircraft, payloads, ground control systems, and supporting equipment are mission-ready and operated in accordance with established procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.

This position works closely with software, systems, and flight operations teams to support the integration, validation, and operational assessment of autonomy capabilities in laboratory, ground, and flight environments.

lists.content:
• Operate flight test platforms in support of daily fly-fix-fly verification activities
  • Serve as a primary operator for Group 1/2 UAS platforms during developmental and operational testing.
  • Configure, inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot aircraft, payloads, autopilot systems, and ground control stations.
  • Coordinate aircraft readiness, pre-flight inspections, launch and recovery operations, and post-flight maintenance activities.
  • Execute operational test procedures and mission plans while ensuring compliance with established safety and operational requirements.
  • Support development, refinement, and enforcement of standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and operational best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with FAA regulations, airspace requirements, range procedures, and company flight operations standards.
  • Assist in flight planning, airspace coordination, mission scheduling, and operational risk assessments.

• 5+ years of experience operating and maintaining Group 1/2 UAS platforms in test, military, commercial, or operational environments.
  • Strong knowledge of COTS UAS hardware, autopilot systems, ground control stations, communications systems, and payload integration.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and executing standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and operational processes.
  • Working knowledge of FAA regulations, National Airspace System (NAS) operations, airspace coordination, and flight authorization requirements.
  • Experience conducting flight operations in dynamic and complex test environments.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and mission planning skills.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with software, systems, safety, and flight operations personnel.
  • FAA Part 107 certification or equivalent UAS operational experience.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

• Experience supporting autonomy, AI-enabled systems, or developmental flight test programs, particularly with multi-aircraft or distributed UAS operations.
  • Fabrication experience with design, build of mechanical and electrical systems
  • Familiarity with standard control and autopilot elements such as QGC, Mission Planner, Ardupilot, Px4
  • Military UAS operations or test experience.

Job Description:

As a part of this team, you’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Program Management, and Engineering to guide the compliant movement of U.S. State Department (ITAR) and U.S. Commerce Department (EAR)–controlled goods and technologies. 

We’re looking for a proactive professional with experience in ITAR and EAR regulations, with strong project management skills and the ability to balance compliance with business growth. This individual will operate independently, communicate across functions, and help drive Shield AI’s mission while maintaining full alignment with U.S. trade laws and company policies.

lists.content:
• Review, prepare, submit, and manage various Export/Import Authorizations (Licenses: DSP-5, DSP-85, DSP-73, DSP-61, DOC licenses; Agreements: MLAs and TAAs; Exemptions/Exceptions) to authorize the transfer of regulated hardware, technical data, software, and services. 
  • Implement and manage divisional trade compliance procedures, including visitor vetting, foreign travel, and restricted party screening, in accordance with ITAR and EAR regulations. 
  • Provide clear, actionable guidance on compliance matters across Shield AI’s business units. 
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records for all U.S. State and Commerce Department license activity. 
  • Review and ensure all export authorizations meet Shield AI and U.S. Government requirements. 
  • Apply and uphold corporate trade compliance policies consistently across teams. 
  • Evaluate the use and applicability of Exemptions and Exceptions within the business. 
  • Monitor changes to U.S. Government export authorization policies and ensure Shield AI’s continued compliance and awareness.

• Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 5 years’ prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 2 years of experience. 
  • Experience with U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and/or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) licensing and compliance frameworks.

• Working experience managing export authorizations and regulatory interactions. 
  • Experience with trade compliance systems and tools, including: DECCS / SNAP-R licensing platforms. 
  • Strong working knowledge of export licensing workflows, classification, and jurisdiction determinations. 
  • Working experience influencing and partnering with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and program management teams.
