Job Description:
The Demonstration Team - Senior Associate Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for planning, executing, and leading domestic and international unmanned aircraft operations in support of customer demonstrations, evaluations, training events, operational exercises, and business development activities. 
This position serves as one of the primary customer-facing representatives of the company and plays a critical role in showcasing the capabilities of the V-BAT system to military, government, and commercial customers worldwide. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate exceptional aviation judgment, professionalism, technical expertise, and adaptability while operating in dynamic and often austere environments. 
Unlike traditional flight operations, Demonstration Team AVOs are expected to independently execute missions with limited support while simultaneously serving as operators, instructors, maintainers, mission planners, technical advisors, and customer liaisons. Success in this role requires the ability to rapidly solve complex technical and operational problems while maintaining a relentless commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. 
The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys frequent travel, embraces uncertainty, and is motivated by building customer confidence through exceptional operational execution.

Job Description:

The Demonstration Team - Senior Associate Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for planning, executing, and leading domestic and international unmanned aircraft operations in support of customer demonstrations, evaluations, training events, operational exercises, and business development activities. 

This position serves as one of the primary customer-facing representatives of the company and plays a critical role in showcasing the capabilities of the V-BAT system to military, government, and commercial customers worldwide. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate exceptional aviation judgment, professionalism, technical expertise, and adaptability while operating in dynamic and often austere environments. 

Unlike traditional flight operations, Demonstration Team AVOs are expected to independently execute missions with limited support while simultaneously serving as operators, instructors, maintainers, mission planners, technical advisors, and customer liaisons. Success in this role requires the ability to rapidly solve complex technical and operational problems while maintaining a relentless commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. 

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys frequent travel, embraces uncertainty, and is motivated by building customer confidence through exceptional operational execution.

lists.content:
• Customer-Focused Flight Operations- Safely executes complex demonstrations while building customer confidence through professional, disciplined, and mission-focused flight operations.
  • Mission Planning & Operational Leadership- Plans and leads all aspects of flight operations including risk management, airspace coordination, contingency planning, crew coordination, and mission execution.
  • Technical Troubleshooting & Systems Knowledge- Rapidly identifies, diagnoses, and resolves aircraft, payload, datalink, and ground system issues to maximize mission success and aircraft availability.
  • Instruction, Mentorship & Team Development- Develops customers and teammates through classroom instruction, simulator training, live-flight instruction, mentorship, and standardization.
  • Adaptability & Independent Decision-Making- Thrives in rapidly changing domestic and international environments by exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and maintaining operational effectiveness under pressure.

• Minimum 1,000 documented unmanned flight hours or 250 manned flight hours   

  • Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate  

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret DoD Security Clearance  

  • Ability to pass required background investigations, drug screenings, and customer medical/dental requirements  

  • Willingness and ability to travel 60–75%, including frequent CONUS and OCONUS deployments  

  • Demonstrated experience operating independently in dynamic, high-tempo, and austere environments  

  • Strong aviation decision-making, operational risk management, and safety mindset  

  • Excellent verbal communication and professional customer engagement skills

• FAA Private Pilot Certificate (PPL) or FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

  • FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot Certificate  

  • Previous instructor qualification in manned or unmanned aviation  

  • Prior military aviation or UAS operational experience  

  • Experience supporting DoD, allied, or international military operations  

  • Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

  • Experience leading customer demonstrations, operational evaluations, or flight operations  

  • Experience troubleshooting aircraft, payload, datalink, or ground control systems 

  • Familiarity with ISR payloads, SATCOM, BVLOS operations, and tactical communications  

  • Experience coordinating international deployments, logistics, or expeditionary operations

Job Description:
The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 
 
The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 
 
This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence.

Shield AI is looking for a hands-on Vibration Test Engineer to help validate the next generation of intelligent autonomous systems through rigorous dynamic testing.

The Mechanical Test team's mission is to inform and improve Shield AI hardware design by quantifying product performance through custom measurement systems, specialized testing, and rigorous analysis. As a Vibration Test Engineer, you will serve as the team's subject matter expert in vibration and structural dynamics, leading efforts to characterize hardware response, validate analytical models, and ensure products can withstand demanding operational environments.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about structural dynamics, curious about how complex systems behave under dynamic loading, and excited to solve challenging engineering problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You will partner closely with Mechanical Design, Analysis, Flight Test, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to develop test strategies, investigate failures, and improve hardware performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise in vibration testing, strong analytical thinking, exceptional organization, and the ability to communicate complex technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.

lists.content:
• Lead the planning, execution, and analysis of vibration test programs supporting product development, qualification, and flight readiness.
  • Design, build, and deploy instrumented test setups for vibration, modal, structural, and environmental testing using industry-standard measurement equipment.
  • Execute shaker table testing including sine sweep, random vibration, sine-on-random, resonance search, dwell, and shock testing.
  • Perform experimental modal analysis to characterize structural dynamics and validate finite element models.
  • Develop fixture designs and test methodologies that accurately replicate operational loading conditions while minimizing fixture influence.
  • Instrument hardware using accelerometers, strain gauges, force sensors, displacement sensors, and other dynamic measurement systems.
  • Analyze vibration response data using frequency-domain and time-domain techniques to identify resonances, mode shapes, damping characteristics, and potential failure mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with Mechanical Design and Structural Analysis engineers to correlate test results with analytical models and improve future designs.
  • Investigate vibration-related hardware issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend design improvements.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, reports, and technical presentations that clearly communicate results and engineering recommendations.
  • Maintain vibration testing equipment, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and calibration records.
  • Support environmental qualification testing and other mechanical test activities as needed.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience performing vibration testing of mechanical or aerospace systems through industry, research, internships, or competitive engineering projects.
  • Experience operating electrodynamic shaker systems and associated vibration control software.
  • Experience with accelerometers, signal conditioning, data acquisition systems, and dynamic instrumentation.
  • Working knowledge of structural dynamics, vibration theory, modal analysis, and frequency response functions.
  • Experience performing or supporting experimental modal testing and finite element model correlation.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810 vibration and shock testing or equivalent aerospace qualification standards.
  • Experience interpreting vibration data and identifying resonances, structural response characteristics, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of CAD software (NX preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical work, drive projects independently, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret//Special Access Required (S//SAR) security clearance is desired.

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field with an emphasis in structural dynamics or vibration.
  • Experience designing vibration test fixtures and specialized dynamic test equipment.
  • Experience using vibration control and data acquisition platforms such as Data Physics, Brüel & Kjær (HBK), Crystal Instruments, m+p International, LMS/Simcenter Testlab, or similar systems.
  • Experience with finite element analysis software (ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran, or equivalent) and test-analysis correlation.
  • Experience with strain gauge testing, digital image correlation (DIC), or other advanced structural measurement techniques.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, UAV, or other high-reliability hardware development programs.
  • Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, and failure investigation.

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior / Staff C++ Software Engineer, Edge Systems to help define and build the software foundations that power autonomous systems operating in demanding real-world environments. 
This role sits within the Edge Systems team, where software meets hardware. You'll solve complex engineering problems spanning Linux edge computing, imaging, sensor integration, mission systems, and autonomy, building software that runs on real hardware in operational environments rather than laboratory prototypes. 
As one of our senior technical contributors, you'll combine hands-on software engineering with technical ownership. You'll influence architecture, mentor engineers, guide technical direction, and help shape the long-term evolution of our edge software platform while remaining close to implementation. 
You will develop modern C++ applications for Linux-based edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson-class systems, ARM64, and Windows systems. Your work will span sensor integration, imaging pipelines, calibration, diagnostics, deployment, developer tooling, and mission-critical applications that demand high performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
This is an application and systems software role, focused on Linux-based edge computing rather than bare-metal firmware or microcontroller development. 
No two weeks look the same. One day you might be optimising image-processing pipelines on embedded GPUs. The next you could be designing software architecture for future autonomous platforms, integrating new sensors, or collaborating with AI researchers to bring new capabilities into production. 
You'll work alongside highly capable systems, hardware, autonomy, AI, product, and test engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems together. We believe our strongest technical leaders remain hands-on, and we expect our Staff Engineers to continue writing software while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them. 
This position may be hired at Senior or Staff Engineer level depending on experience. Responsibilities and scope will be aligned to the successful candidate.

lists.content:
Technical Leadership

  • Lead the technical direction of significant edge software capabilities spanning edge compute, imaging, sensor integration, and mission systems. 

  • Influence software architecture across multiple projects and engineering teams. 

  • Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering practices. 

  • Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise the technical capability of the wider organisation. 

  • Partner with systems, autonomy, AI, and product teams to translate long-term capability into engineering roadmaps. 

  • Identify technical risks early and guide teams toward robust, maintainable solutions. 

  • Balance long-term architectural investment with practical product delivery. 

    • Software Engineering

    • Design, develop, test, and maintain production C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, developer tooling, and automated test infrastructure. 

    • Build user-space Windows and Linux applications for NVIDIA Jetson, ARM64, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 

    • Integrate RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras alongside GPS, IMU, and other sensors using interfaces such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Ethernet, serial, or comparable hardware-facing protocols. 

    • Develop calibration, synchronisation, data capture, diagnostics, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 

    • Optimise software for latency, throughput, reliability, power consumption, and thermal performance on constrained edge compute platforms. 

    • Debug challenging issues spanning application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration. 

    • Own technical outcomes from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

    • Collaborate across systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test teams to deliver integrated capability.

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 

  • Strong commercial experience developing modern C++ software for Linux. 

  • Demonstrated experience developing user-space applications that interface with cameras, sensors, networking, GPUs, storage, or other hardware through operating system APIs, middleware, or vendor SDKs. 

  • Practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux. 

  • Experience developing complex C++ applications on Linux, Windows, or both. Experience deploying software to Linux-based edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable ARM64 systems is highly regarded. 

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals including concurrency, interfaces, memory management, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 

  • Proven ability to diagnose complex issues across software, Linux, networking, timing, hardware integration, and deployment boundaries. 

  • Experience owning technical work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

  • Excellent collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out. 

  • Runtime-critical, multi-threaded, or performance-sensitive C++ software. 

  • High-throughput imaging or sensor processing pipelines, including camera integration, ISP tuning, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 

  • Hardware-accelerated processing on edge compute platforms including NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm Snapdragon, CUDA, GPU compute, embedded AI accelerators, or accelerated video processing. 

  • Integration of RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras, GPS, IMU, GPUs, or comparable peripheral hardware. 

  • Robotics, aerospace, defence, autonomy, unmanned systems, automotive, or other mission-critical domains. 

  • Systems architecture, interface design, software decomposition, reliability, maintainability, and testability. 

  • Low-level Linux, vendor SDKs, driver-adjacent debugging, NixOS, edge AI inference, containerisation, or deployment tooling. 

  • Automated testing, simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, CI/CD, or deployment infrastructure.

lists.text: Additional Experience for Staff Level Engineers:
lists.content:
While we hire across multiple experience levels, successful Staff Engineer candidates will typically demonstrate several of the following: 

  • Experience defining architecture for large or technically complex software systems. 

  • A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams or products. 

  • Proven technical leadership through influence rather than organisational authority. 

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping grow engineering capability across an organisation. 

  • Ownership of long-term technical strategy alongside day-to-day software delivery. 

  • Strong judgement when balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery. 

  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or software platforms adopted by multiple teams.

lists.content: Simulation is a key growth lever for Aechelon and Shield AI. Customers rely on high-fidelity simulation, visual systems, terrain databases, sensor simulation, and mission rehearsal tools to improve readiness and mission outcomes. This position provides dedicated specialist sales and business development support to accelerate Aechelon simulation growth across accounts and programs.

• Serve as the specialist business development resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across assigned accounts and priority pursuits. 
  • Partner with sales leaders, account owners, business development, program management, product, marketing, contracts, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities. 
  • Support achievement of annual sales goals by helping develop new customers, partners, and opportunities aligned with current and planned product offerings. 
  • Maintain visibility into a two-year sales forecast and opportunity funnel, including named programs, estimated value, budget timing, customer stakeholders, procurement path, technical fit, competition, risks, and next steps. 
  • Actively pursue new customers and partners outside Aechelon's traditional customer base while supporting existing customer relationships. 
  • Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, trade events, and follow-up actions to progress opportunities. 
  • Articulate Aechelon's simulation value proposition in a clear, mission-relevant, and customer-oriented manner. 
  • Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities and coordinate technical support for demonstrations, solution definition, and pursuit shaping. 
  • Manage or support preparation of customer-facing materials, presentations, proposals, quotations, white papers, and competitive positioning. 
  • Provide regular opportunity updates and reports to senior management, including pipeline status, forecast changes, customer engagement activity, and support needs. 
  • Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve messaging, campaign focus, product positioning, and win probability. 
  • Drive disciplined follow-up across active opportunities and ensure internal stakeholders are aligned on priorities, owners, schedules, and customer commitments. 
  • Exercise sound commercial judgment, protect Aechelon from poorly scoped commitments, and avoid overpromising on technical, schedule, or contractual matters.

• Build trusted working relationships with U.S.-based defense, government, aviation, simulation, prime contractor, OEM, and integrator stakeholders. 
  • Support account strategy and opportunity planning for assigned customers and pursuits. 
  • Represent Aechelon professionally in customer briefings, industry events, demonstrations, and partner discussions. 
  • Understand customer budgets, constraints, operational needs, and training objectives in order to focus the team on value-added opportunities.

• Partner closely with GTM, Product, Marketing, Programs, Contracts, Finance, Engineering, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives. 
  • Translate field feedback into actionable input for messaging, enablement, product positioning, demos, and campaign planning. 
  • Support operating cadence, forecast reviews, opportunity reviews, and pursuit coordination as needed. 
  • Ensure customer engagement plans, demonstration requests, proposal support, and internal actions are clearly communicated and tracked.

• Develops strong fluency in Aechelon's simulation, geospatial, visual, sensor, and defense training value proposition. 
  • Builds a prioritized AMER territory and account plan covering target customers, primes, OEMs, integrators, programs, partners, and near-term opportunities. 
  • Creates and maintains a qualified pipeline with realistic opportunity values, budget timing, customer stakeholders, incumbent competitors, procurement paths, technical fit, and next steps. 
  • Improves Aechelon visibility through customer engagement, events, demonstrations, partner discussions, and professional follow-up. 
  • Advances multiple opportunities into active customer evaluation, demonstration, RFI, RFP, proposal, quotation, capture, or teaming stages. 
  • Provides strong specialist support to sales and business development teams for Aechelon-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits. 
  • Clearly connects simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, mission outcomes, and customer value. 
  • Maintains disciplined forecasts, timely CRM or reporting updates, and clear internal coordination across active pursuits.

• 5+ years of experience in simulation, sales, business development, capture support, account management, overlay sales, or related customer-facing roles. 
  • Experience supporting or driving complex technology sales in enterprise, government, defense, aerospace, simulation, training, or mission-systems environments. 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and qualify new business opportunities, manage key accounts or pursuits, and contribute to sales targets. 
  • Strong communication, presentation, public speaking, active listening, and interpersonal skills. 
  • Commercial acumen and ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value, mission relevance, and operational outcomes. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, organizational, and follow-through skills. 
  • Ability to work cross-functionally, influence stakeholders, and manage multiple active opportunities and customer needs. 
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project or equivalent planning tools.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, aviation, defense, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
  • Prefer software engineering experience related to training simulation.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001:2015 quality management systems or experience operating in a quality-driven defense/aerospace environment.

Aechelon is looking for a technically minded Simulation Specialist who can help expand our simulation, geospatial, visual systems, and synthetic training business across its markets. This role is focused on developing new business and strong technical understanding of simulation systems and interfaces.  

The ideal candidate is collaborative, technically curious, disciplined in follow-up, and comfortable operating in a matrixed and fast-moving environment. This person should be able to build technical credibility with customers, support opportunity development, and represent Aechelon's simulation portfolio with consistency and professionalism.

lists.content:
Specialist Sales Support 

  • Serve as the specialist sales resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across priority international markets. 

    • Partner with regional sales leaders, account owners, and business development teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities. 

      • Support account strategy, opportunity planning, and customer engagement efforts related to the Aechelon portfolio. 

        • Help drive pipeline development for simulation opportunities and maintain visibility into key pursuits, risks, and next steps. 

          • Customer and Partner Engagement 

          • Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, and follow-up actions to help progress opportunities. 

            • Articulate the value of Aechelon’s simulation offerings in a clear, mission-relevant, and customer-oriented way. 

              • Support relationship development with international defense, government, and partner stakeholders. 

                • Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities in coordination with sales, product, and technical teams. 

                  • Pursuit and Deal Support 

                  • Support the development of customer-facing materials, presentations, proposals, and competitive positioning for simulation opportunities. 

                    • Coordinate with internal teams to support demos, strategic pursuits, bids, and executive engagements. 

                      • Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve positioning and increase win probability. 

                        • Help drive disciplined follow-up and execution across active opportunities. 

                          • Cross-Functional Alignment 

                          • Partner closely with GTM, International, Product, Marketing, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives. 

                            • Provide field feedback to improve messaging, enablement, campaign focus, and product positioning. 

                              • Contribute to business reporting, opportunity updates, and operating cadence as needed. 

                                • Help ensure internal alignment on priorities, customer engagement plans, and support needs. 

                                  • What Success Looks Like 

                                  • International simulation opportunities are identified early, well supported, and advanced with clear coordination and momentum. 

                                    • Regional sales teams have strong specialist support for Aechelon-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits. 

                                      • Customer interactions clearly connect simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, and mission outcomes. 

                                        • Cross-functional teams are aligned in support of international simulation growth priorities.

• 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, overlay sales, capture support, account management, or related customer-facing roles. 

    • Demonstrated ability to support or drive complex technology sales in international, enterprise, government, or defense environments. 

      • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. 

        • Commercial acumen and the ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and mission relevance. 

          • Strong organizational skills and follow-through, including the ability to manage multiple active opportunities and stakeholder needs. 

            • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

• Experience in simulation, training, mission systems, enterprise software, autonomy, aerospace, or defense technology. 

    • Familiarity with international sales motions, government or defense procurement, and partner-driven growth models. 

      • Experience working in a specialist seller or overlay role in support of regional sales teams. 

        • Background supporting multi-region customers, channel partners, or strategic international pursuits. 

          • Fluency in an additional language relevant to priority markets is a plus.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist to help drive growth of the Aechelon simulation portfolio across international markets. This role will serve as a specialist seller within GTM, partnering with regional sales leaders and account teams to identify, shape, and advance simulation opportunities with customers and partners. 

The International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist will combine product and market knowledge with strong commercial execution. This person will help position the Aechelon portfolio, support customer engagement, and drive opportunity development across priority international regions. The role is designed for a mission-focused, customer-facing professional who can work across functions, support complex pursuits, and help translate simulation capabilities into customer value. 

Why This Role Matters:

Simulation is a key growth lever for Shield AI and an important part of how customers train, rehearse, and prepare for mission success. As Shield AI integrates Aechelon and scales its simulation go-to-market efforts, this role will provide dedicated specialist sales support to regional teams and help accelerate growth in international markets. 

This is an overlay-style role for someone who can combine solution selling, customer engagement, pursuit support, and strong internal collaboration. Success in this position requires ownership, responsiveness, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across teams, regions, and time zones. 

Role Profile:

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded specialist seller who is comfortable operating in a matrixed and fast-moving environment. This person should be able to build credibility with customers, support regional sales teams, and help move complex opportunities forward with consistency and professionalism. 

This role offers broad exposure across GTM, product, and international business and is a strong opportunity to help scale Shield AI’s simulation business globally while supporting customer missions and advancing a strategically important portfolio. 

This person must speak fluent Arabic and English.

We are seeking Autonomous Software Engineers for full-time roles starting in 2027! This is a paid, in-person, full-time position for students graduating during the 2026-2027 academic year. We are now reviewing applications for positions starting after graduation in 2027. 
What you'll do
Design, implement, test, and ship C++ and/or Python features, tools, and tests alongside experienced engineers.
Write embedded firmware in C/C++ for real-time software that controls our advanced UAV while in flight.
Develop tests, reporters, and tooling in Python to validate software behavior and performance.
Develop and evaluate autonomy software across areas such as mission behavior, planning, multi-agent coordination, decision-making, platform integration, or perception (object detection, tracking, sensor fusion, localization, situational awareness, or AI/ML-enabled workflows).
Build unit and integration tests, run and analyze simulation or bench results, and investigate failures using logs, telemetry, traces, and debugging tools.
Support software integration across autonomy capabilities, platform/vehicle interfaces, sensors, perception products, mission compute, and operator or command-and-control (C2) systems, including simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and bench testing.
Work with real and simulated data from cameras, EO/IR sensors, IMUs, GPS, radars, or other mission payloads.
Work cross-functionally with electrical and mechanical engineers to help determine and validate software requirements.
Write documentation for setup steps, interface assumptions, configuration, test procedures, and findings to make workflows repeatable.
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and test debriefs, and take on more ownership of features and fixes over time.

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


The Autonomy Capabilities Team develops functionality to automate single- and multi-agent teams of platforms in pursuit of mission objectives and acts as a central discipline-aligned focal-point for encouraging consistent usage of technical approaches across business portfolios.  This team operates at all levels of the command-and-control hierarchy (from advanced control laws, through motion planning, and up to advanced tactical behaviors and multi-agent coordination) and across a multitude of mission sets, platform types, and operational domains (e.g., air, sea, space).  The team puts a strong emphasis on both fundamentals (e.g., aircraft kinematics/dynamics, trajectory design, optimization, information fusion, efficient algorithms, etc.) and software integration skillsets (e.g. structures, protocols, threading, interface management, etc.) to bring market-differentiating capabilities to customers that seamlessly operate within their integration contexts. 
This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.

lists.content:
• Implement tactical autonomy software features that enable unmanned platforms to perform complex missions across air, land, sea, and space domains
  • Develop and test behaviors supporting coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios
  • Participate in the software development lifecycle, including implementation, testing, debugging, and supporting verification and validation efforts
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to integrate software components with broader system elements (e.g., sensor processing, communications, and actuation)
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and team practices
  • Support integration and testing across simulation and real-world environments
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and support successful feature delivery
  • Continue building expertise in software engineering, autonomy, and robotics systems
  • Travel up to 20% to support testing, integration, and collaboration with partner teams

• BS in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in production-level C++ software development
  • 2-3 years of experience in one or more of the following: software sub-system scheduling and integration, behavior planning, task and resource allocation, motion planning, optimization, or flight controls
  • Experience with collaborative software development tools for version control, issue tracking, code reviews, release management
  • Ability to contribute to the design, development, and integration of complex software systems as part of a multi-disciplinary team
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to learn new technologies in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to collaborate closely with teammates and support team objectives
  • Interest in growing technical skills and, over time, providing guidance to more junior engineers
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative, fast paced, and mission-driven environment
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Exposure to systems operating at different technology readiness levels (TRLs) through academic, research, or internship experience
  • Experience in the delivery of a military mission system
  • Familiarity with mission systems integration concepts, testing, or demonstrations
  • Experience (academic or project-based) in one or more of the following areas:
  • Motion planning, behavior planning, or multi-agent coordination
  • Expose to autonomy, control, or decision-making systems
  • Safety mechanisms such as collision avoidance or constraint enforcement
  • Familiarity with robotic software tools (e.g., ROS, OMPL, or similar frameworks)
  • Experience using simulation environments for development or testing
  • Basic understanding of navigation and/or communications systems
  • Awareness of the software or systems development lifecycle
  • Familiarity with systems engineering fundamentals
  • Exposure to high-assurance or safety-critical software concepts (e.g., DO-178C or similar)

Job Description:

As a Software Engineer (Networking & OS) on V-BAT, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and optimizing the network infrastructure for our Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) which is deployed in some of the most challenging environments worldwide. V-BAT is designed to operate in contested, GNSS-denied airspace, and our network must maintain highly reliable, secure, and efficient communication between all air and ground devices.

lists.content:
• Design and build custom, resilient Layer 2 / Layer 3 network topologies optimized specifically for V-BAT mission profiles, focusing on device isolation, dynamic traffic management, and transmitting traffic across multiple links. 

  • Implement networking features directly on embedded Linux operating systems, including custom routing, TUN/TAP interfaces, user-space tunnels, and socket-level applications. 

  • Work backward from operator capabilities to build bandwidth-optimized, low-latency communication paths over lossy or constrained radio and satellite links. 

  • Write clean, production-grade C, C++, or Python code to build things like software-defined network interfaces, traffic shaping policies, and link failover mechanisms. 

  • Partner with software engineers, hardware engineers, and field operators to validate end-to-end network performance in both hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) labs and flight test environments.

• Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s with 4+ years, or PhD with 2+ years. 

  • Strong proficiency writing software in C, C++, or Python in a Linux environment, with a track record of shipping software that interacts directly with the OS networking stack. 

  • Deep understanding of Linux networking fundamentals (netlink, IP route/tables, iptables/nftables, TUN/TAP interfaces, Linux network namespaces, and socket programming). 

  • Solid grasp of Layer 2 and Layer 3 network fundamentals, custom routing protocols, VLAN tagging, QoS/traffic management, and VPN/tunneling mechanisms (e.g., OpenVPN, GRE, IPsec, or custom user-space tunnels). 

  • Practical experience troubleshooting network degradation using low-level tools (e.g., tcpdump, wireshark, iproute2, iperf) in lossy, high-latency, or bandwidth-constrained environments. 

  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate through development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and exceed expectations in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Ability to obtain security clearance.

• Experience developing embedded Linux networking applications using build systems like Yocto or OS-level customization tools. 

  • Experience working with RF and other hardware engineers to design network protocols and topologies which are tailored for a novel radio network design. 

  • Experience architecting network solutions for robotics, autonomous vehicles, aerospace, or edge computing hardware. 

  • Familiarity with network security, public key infrastructure (PKI), and cryptographic tunnels in embedded systems.

About Shield AI

Shield AI develops AI-powered autonomy software and aircraft systems that protect service members and civilians by enabling intelligent operations in contested environments. As part of the X-BAT program, you will help develop and validate next-generation autonomous aircraft and mission-critical hardware that must perform reliably in demanding operational conditions.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the X-BAT Hardware Test Software team. This team builds and sustains automated production test stands used to functionally test avionics and aircraft electrical assemblies.

You will lead software engineers developing test frameworks, station-control software, equipment interfaces, data collection, and automated pass/fail evaluation. Our systems interact with custom fixtures, instrumentation, embedded devices, FPGA-enabled hardware, and avionics units under test.

The ideal candidate has managed engineering teams and has personally built or led the development of automated hardware test systems used in production, manufacturing, qualification, or other high-consequence environments. You know what robust test automation looks like: safe operation, repeatable results, useful diagnostics, configuration control, traceability, maintainability, and a practical path from prototype to sustained production use.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers supporting X-BAT avionics production test.

  • Own the technical roadmap and execution for automated test stands, reusable test frameworks, station software, and test-data systems.

  • Build scalable Python-based software for test sequencing, instrument and fixture control, unit-under-test communication, measurement collection, pass/fail evaluation, and reporting.

  • Guide software architecture, code quality, configuration management, CI/CD, release processes, documentation, and operational support.

  • Partner closely with electrical engineers to translate avionics interfaces, functional requirements, and failure modes into automated test coverage.

  • Partner with mechanical engineers to ensure fixtures, cabling, connectors, serviceability, safety, and operator workflows support reliable production testing.

  • Work with FPGA and embedded-software teams to configure, communicate with, and validate FPGA-enabled avionics hardware.

  • Improve test coverage, station uptime, throughput, failure triage, test repeatability, and traceability.

  • Establish metrics and processes for regression health, station reliability, first-pass yield, retest rate, false failures, and recurring failure modes.

  • Support root-cause analysis across the unit under test, fixture, instrumentation, test software, embedded software, FPGA behavior, and electrical interfaces.

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, test automation, embedded systems, hardware-integrated software, manufacturing test, avionics, aerospace, robotics, automotive, industrial systems, or similar fields.

  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience leading software, test, or hardware-integration engineers.

  • Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and sustaining automated functional-test systems for complex hardware.

  • Strong Python experience, particularly for automation frameworks, hardware communication, instrument control, data acquisition, and test orchestration.

  • Experience with C++ or C in embedded, systems, device-control, or hardware-facing applications.

  • Experience working directly with electrical hardware, test fixtures, instrumentation, and devices under test.

  • Familiarity with FPGA-enabled hardware and the ability to work effectively with FPGA engineers on system-level test and debug.

  • Familiarity with common interfaces and protocols such as Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, serial, CAN, SPI, I2C, USB, GPIO, PCIe, or JTAG.

  • Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, and configuration control.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across software, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and program teams.

• Experience developing automated production test equipment for avionics, aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, robotics, or other mission-critical hardware.

  • Experience designing reusable test frameworks rather than only writing one-off test scripts.

  • Experience with programmable power supplies, electronic loads,, DAQ systems, digital I/O, network equipment, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or custom test fixtures.

  • Experience with FPGA programming, bitstream management, register-level control, JTAG, board bring-up, or FPGA-adjacent debug.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, microcontrollers, board-support packages, device drivers, or real-time systems.

  • Experience with production traceability, serial-number tracking, test-result databases, calibration workflows, manufacturing systems, or quality systems.

  • Experience in a regulated, safety-critical, mission-critical, or configuration-controlled engineering environment.

We’re looking for a software engineer, well versed in development and testing, to help continue building V-BAT's test operations, specifically automation capabilities and tools used to test software components ranging from autonomy, embedded systems, ground control applications, and more - you will gather requirements and write software to automate them.

lists.content:
• Work directly with our GNC and Embedded teams daily to build software that leverages simulation, avionics, and/or custom hardware to automate testing 
  • Define test cases to verify and validate embedded or GNC software at a system level, automating them to run continuously 
  • Implement software interfaces and drivers to orchestrate simulation environments, hardware devices, and test equipment – enabling real-world behaviors, failure injection, and hardware manipulation for various test scenarios 
  • Quickly prototype solutions using software & hardware to unblock testing, harden your prototype into scalable products for continuous release testing 
  • Support release test planning and execution leading up to flight test events and major product milestones

• Senior: Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 4+ years, or PhD with 2+ years.
  • Staff: Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 6+ years, or PhD with 4+ years.
  • Senior Staff: Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, or Masters with 9+ years, or PhD with 7+ years.
  • Strong Python skills
  • Familiarity with common version control (git) and build/packaging systems (CMake, Poetry, etc) 
  • Passion for growth, fast-paced environments, and holding self to a high standard of excellence

• 5+ years of related experience building automated test solutions
  • Experience building automated test solutions for aircraft of autonomous vehicles
  • Experience in automated testing, bare-metal firmware development, or simulation tooling
  • Ability to obtain security clearance

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

  • Familiarity with cost accounting and inventory management.

Job Description:
We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous strategic analysis, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity.
We seek a Senior Strategic Finance Lead with deep Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience, a strong strategic or corporate finance background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning long-range financial models. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate Finance: designing the company’s fully integrated long-range three‑statement and unit economics model, driving enterprise-level financial strategy, and producing investor-grade outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite, Board, and ultimately public investors.
Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise (IB/PE/HF/Equity Research), mastery of complex HW/SW unit economics, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high‑growth environment.

Job Description:

We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous strategic analysis, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity.

We seek a Senior Strategic Finance Lead with deep Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience, a strong strategic or corporate finance background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning long-range financial models. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate Finance: designing the company’s fully integrated long-range three‑statement and unit economics model, driving enterprise-level financial strategy, and producing investor-grade outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite, Board, and ultimately public investors.

Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise (IB/PE/HF/Equity Research), mastery of complex HW/SW unit economics, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high‑growth environment.

lists.content:
Own and Build the Strategic Financial Model

  • Architect and maintain a fully integrated, scalable, three‑statement model grounded in unit economics, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.
  • Lead the Long Range Plan (LRP), including scenario modeling, sensitivities, and valuation frameworks.
  • Translate production ramps, R&D investments, contract timing, government milestones, and GTM strategy directly into financial outcomes.
  • Deliver investor-grade outputs including valuations, strategic insights, and Board-ready narratives.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of risks, opportunities, capital needs, and strategic inflection points.

    • Digitize & Scale Modeling Infrastructure

  • Partner with data engineering/systems teams to evolve modeling from Excel into modern cloud-based planning tools.
  • Design modular, scalable model architectures; use Excel only where it provides meaningful analytical leverage.
  • Integrate automation and analytics to improve clarity, reduce manual work, and increase decision velocity.

    • Analyze the Business Like an Investor

  • Benchmark peers across defense, autonomy, robotics, aerospace, and industrial tech.
  • Build competitor profiles, KPI benchmarks, and market analyses that inform strategy.
  • Develop a point of view on unit economics, efficiency, scale, profitability, and capital allocation.
  • Support M&A modeling, valuation, synergy analysis, and diligence.
  • Provide strategic insights that go beyond the numbers.

    • Lead Cash Flow & Liquidity Modeling

  • Build rolling cash flow forecasts across working capital, inventory, milestone payments, production cycles, and CapEx.
  • Model government contract payment timing, production curves, and program cash profiles.
  • Identify liquidity risks early and support capital allocation and financing strategies.

    • Partner Across the Company

  • Work closely with the VP FP&A, CFO, CEO, and senior leaders on forward-looking financial strategy.
  • Translate engineering, program, and operations plans into financial impacts.
  • Connect short-term forecasting with the long-range plan.
  • Present insights that accelerate execution and elevate decision quality.
  • Take full accountability for forecast accuracy, improving results with each actualized quarter.

• 8–10 years of experience, including significant time in investment banking, PE, hedge funds, or equity research.
  • Direct strategic finance leadership experience in a publicly traded company.
  • Deep A&D industry exposure (defense, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, industrial tech, or complex HW/SW).
  • Proven ownership of scalable three‑statement models, LRP development, valuations, sensitivities, and unit economics.
  • Exceptional Excel modeling capability; fluent in multi‑scenario three‑statement modeling, beat-and-raise frameworks, and driver-based forecasting.
  • Strong GAAP proficiency and command of financial statement mechanics.
  • Demonstrated ability to distill complex financial and technical information into clear insights for executives, Board, and investors.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with high accuracy and strong judgment.
  • Systems-oriented mindset; comfortable partnering with data and systems teams.

• Familiarity with government contract economics, milestone‑based revenue, and program accounting.
  • M&A experience including modeling, valuation, and diligence.
  • Exposure to manufacturing scale, supply chain dynamics, and hardware production cycles.

• An analytical athlete with exceptional modeling intuition and attention to detail.
  • A structured, clear thinker who simplifies complexity without losing nuance.
  • Fast, accurate, and calm under pressure.
  • Curious, forward-looking, and driven to understand what truly moves the business.
  • A strong communicator who elevates decision quality across the company.
  • Mission-driven and energized by solving complex, high‑impact problems.

You will build the strategic financial model that defines how the business is understood—internally, at the Board level, and eventually by public investors. Your work will guide product strategy, capital allocation, investments, and long-range ambitions. This is Strategic Finance at its highest level: high complexity, high visibility, high impact.

Job Description:

Join a high-impact quality engineering team supporting the development and production of next-generation autonomous systems. This role is focused on dimensional analysis, metrology strategy, and inspection planning to ensure hardware meets critical design and manufacturing requirements. You will work closely with design, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production teams to develop scalable inspection methodologies that improve product quality, repeatability, and manufacturing confidence.

We are seeking a Metrology Engineer with experience in dimensional inspection, GD&T interpretation, measurement system analysis, and metrology process development within aerospace, defense, robotics, or precision manufacturing environments.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute dimensional inspection strategies for complex mechanical assemblies and precision components
  • Perform dimensional analysis and measurement studies to validate design intent, manufacturing capability, and assembly fit
  • Define metrology processes, tooling, and inspection methods using CMMs, laser trackers, scanners, and other precision measurement systems
  • Partner with design and manufacturing teams to improve tolerance schemes, GD&T application, and inspection efficiency
  • Support root cause investigations related to dimensional nonconformance, assembly variation, and manufacturing defects
  • Analyze measurement and process capability data to improve repeatability, product quality, and production readiness

• 5+ years of experience in metrology, dimensional engineering, manufacturing quality, or precision inspection environments
  • Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, datum structures, and dimensional validation methods
  • Experience programming or operating metrology equipment such as CMMs, laser trackers, structured light scanners, or portable measurement systems
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and manufacturing documentation for complex assemblies
  • Experience developing inspection plans, measurement strategies, and process capability studies in production environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate technical findings across cross-functional teams

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems programs
  • Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, and regulated manufacturing environments
  • Experience with NX, PolyWorks, PC-DMIS, SpatialAnalyzer, or similar metrology and dimensional analysis software
  • Experience supporting first article inspections (FAI), production qualification, or supplier quality initiatives

With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. The primary function of this Proposal Manager role is managing international government, U.S. government, and commercial proposals and other related BD Ops deliverables (e.g., ROM pricing estimates, RFI responses, and white papers) for Shield AI’s Taiwan team and broader  Asia/Middle East (ASME) Go To Market (GTM) team. The Business Development Operations (BD Ops) team is looking for a candidate who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to join a rapidly scaling, nontraditional defense contractor. This ideal candidate will have strong oral and written communication skills (technical writing experience preferred), attention to detail, curiosity, and a proven ability to coordinate and work as a member of cross-functional teams.

lists.content:
• Leadership skills: Lead all Taiwan proposal efforts and support the ASME region generally, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights. 

    • Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations  

      • Attention to detail in a fast-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.  

        • Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI. 

          • Extreme ownership: BD Ops serves as the primary cross-functional lead for Bids/Proposals across product lines and geographic regions. We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process. 

            • Team-first mentality: The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to be flexible, work hard, hold themself and others to high standards, embrace teammates, and act with kindness.

• Manage competing priorities across proposal and other deliverable (WPs, RFIs, ROMs, etc.) development in the fast-paced environment of the Int’l BD Ops team.  

    • Lead end-to-end proposal execution from pre-RFP planning through submission and closeout.  

      • Drive cross-functional proposal teams to deliver compliant, high-quality submissions on schedule. 

        • Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices. 

          • Mentor proposal contributors and foster high-performing, collaborative teams. 

            • Support Taiwan team and broader ASME GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements.  

              • Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required.  

                • Provide additional support to BD Ops and GTM team leadership as needed.

• 2-4+ years of U.S. Federal or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.  

    • In lieu of direct government proposal experience, have 3+ years of experience working with U.S. Federal or International government requirements.  

      • Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.  

        • Strong record of academic achievement. 

          • Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes. 

            • Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.  

              • Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing. 

                • Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly as part of a team, embrace the startup environment. 

                  • Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization. 

                    • Demonstrated record of hard work, trustworthiness, holding oneself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.

                    • Fluent in Mandarin, can read and write in traditional Chinese.

• Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale bids/proposals. 

    • Strong technical background especially with unmanned/uncrewed systems and/or autonomy software.  

      • Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of Taiwan defense industry, military operations, and/or ASME defense acquisition processes. 

      • Understanding of international markets/geopolitical trends in aerospace / defense industry.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Staff Product Support to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This role will lead the logistics planning, supply support, sustainment analysis, and lifecycle support activities across development, flight test, production, and operational sustainment.

The ideal candidate has strong experience supporting military or defense aviation programs and understands how logistics products, supportability analysis, maintenance planning, and supply chain execution contribute to mission availability and operational readiness. This position requires hands-on experience with Maintenance Task Analysis, Logistics Control Numbers, Reliability and Maintainability artifacts, and Supply Support planning and execution.

lists.content:
• Lead logistics and sustainment planning activities for a UAS program across design, production, deployment, and field support phases.
  • Develop, manage, and maintain integrated logistics support products, including maintenance concepts, support equipment design, provisioning inputs, spares planning, and sustainment documentation.
  • Perform and manage Maintenance Task Analysis to define preventive and corrective maintenance requirements, task frequencies, required tools, support equipment, skill levels, labor hours, and maintenance levels.
  • Develop and maintain Logistics Control Number structures to support provisioning, maintenance planning, technical documentation, configuration tracking, and sustainment data management.
  • Partner with engineering, program management, manufacturing, supply chain, field operations, and customer stakeholders to ensure logistics requirements are incorporated into system design and program execution.
  • Support Reliability and Maintainability activities, including Level of Repair Analysis, FMECA data analysis, maintainability assessments, corrective action planning, reliability growth inputs, and operational availability improvement initiatives.
  • Lead supply support activities, including spares analysis, provisioning, parts forecasting, inventory planning, reorder recommendations, repair pipeline coordination, sustainment risk identification, and obsolescence management.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, depots, repair vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely availability of parts, support equipment, and logistics resources.
  • Support proposal development, basis of estimate inputs, staffing plans, sustainment strategies, and logistics cost estimates for new and existing UAS programs.
  • Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable defense standards, contract requirements, export control requirements, and company processes.

• Bachelor’s degree in logistics, engineering, supply chain, aviation maintenance, business, or a related field; equivalent military or defense logistics experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting UAS or fighter aircraft logistics and sustainment
  • Demonstrated experience with Maintenance Task Analysis and development of maintenance planning data.
  • Expertise of Logistics Control Number structures and their use in provisioning, maintenance planning, and supportability analysis.
  • Experience with Reliability and Maintainability principles, including failure modes, maintainability drivers, reliability growth, availability metrics, and field performance analysis, and LORA development
  • Hands-on supply support experience, including spares planning, provisioning, inventory management, parts forecasting, repairables management, and sustainment execution.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, bills of material, configuration data, maintenance data, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, program management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, field service, and customer teams.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to lead logistics efforts in a fast-paced program environment.
  • Active and current security clearance with ability to obtain SAP

• Proven experience with integrated product support elements, including product support management, supply support, support equipment, manpower and personnel, facilities, maintenance planning,
  • Experience with provisioning, sparing, or supportability tools such as PowerLOG-J, SLICwave, COMPASS, CASA, OPUS10, EAGLE, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-1388 legacy logistics concepts, GEIA-STD-0007, SAE TA-STD-0017, MIL-HDBK-502A, or related product support standards.
  • Experience developing logistics inputs for CDRLs, technical manuals, maintenance plans, provisioning data, sparing recommendations, or lifecycle sustainment plans.
  • Experience with ERP, PLM, or MRP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Costpoint, Teamcenter, Arena, Windchill, or similar platforms.

Shield AI is seeking a Sr. Director of People Operations to lead and evolve our People Operations function as we continue to scale. In this role, you'll shape how we deliver an exceptional employee experience by building efficient, technology-enabled, and AI-powered processes that support every stage of the employee lifecycle. You'll balance strategic transformation with hands-on operational leadership, partnering closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, Legal, and business leaders to create a high-performing, scalable People organization that enables our employees—and our business—to thrive.

lists.content:
Strategic Leadership & Team Management 
  • Define and execute a unified People Operations vision, operating model, and multi-year roadmap spanning candidate interviewing, hiring, employee onboarding and employee lifecycle operations.
  • Lead day-to-day operations, ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery across the employee lifecycle.
  • Lead and scale a rapidly growing People Operations function through direct leadership, with full accountability for team performance, service quality, and outcomes across the candidate and employee lifecycle.
  • Establish team structure, capacity planning, KPIs, and operating rhythms to support hiring velocity, onboarding effectiveness, and ongoing operational excellence.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executives on workforce operations, hiring experience, service delivery, and AI enablement.
    • Service Delivery & AI Enablement 
  • Transform People Operations into a self-service-first, AI-enabled support model.
  • Design and implement service delivery architecture, including automation, case management, and digital support channels to support rapid company scaling and global expansion.
  • Lead enterprise knowledge management to enable self-service and improve consistency and AI effectiveness.
  • Own and drive service performance, including SLAs, response times, quality, and employee satisfaction.
  • Establish governance for AI-enabled execution and support, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and appropriate escalation.
  • Continuously improve services through analytics, feedback, and process optimization.
  • Select and manage external vendors and platforms specific People Operations.
    •  Operational Excellence & Process Design 
  • Own end-to-end workforce lifecycle processes, from interview coordination and candidate logistics through onboarding, employee changes, and offboarding.
  • Ensure seamless handoffs between recruiting and employee operations to deliver a cohesive, high-quality experience.
  • Lead process redesign initiatives to improve hiring efficiency, onboarding speed, service quality, and risk reduction.
  • Establish policies, documentation, controls, and service standards.
  • Drive automation strategies to reduce manual effort and improve quality.
  • Ensure operational continuity and audit readiness.
  • Lead change management and adoption for new processes, tools and capabilities.
    • Data Governance & Compliance 
  • Ensure accuracy, security, and integrity of employee data and workforce transactions.
  • Establish governance, audit, and validation practices to reduce risk.
  • Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Legal, and Finance to maintain compliance and alignment with internal controls.
  • Drive enterprise accountability for data quality across People systems.
    • Technology & Enablement 
  • Partner with HRIS, IT, Talent Acquisition, and Digital teams to define and execute the People Operations technology roadmap.
  • Support adoption and optimization of platforms such as UKG, Jira Service Management, Ashby, and automation tools.
  • Translate business needs across the People Operations function into scalable systems and workflows.
    • Analytics & Continuous Improvement 
  • Establish related service metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
  • Monitor SLAs, KPIs, and operational health indicators.
  • Use data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement and data-informed decision-making.
  • Measure service effectiveness, employee experience, and AI performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and evolving best practices to continuously modernize and scale People Operations.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive HR or People Operations experience in complex or high-growth environments.
  • 7+ years leading People Operations or HR Shared Services teams.
  • Experience designing and scaling shared services and service delivery models.
  • Proven track record of operational transformation, including automation and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Strong expertise in employee lifecycle operations, compliance, and data governance.
  • Experience partnering with HRIS and enterprise technology teams.
  • Demonstrated success with KPIs, SLAs, and operational reporting.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or MBA in a related field.
  • Experience in technology, aerospace, defense, or high-growth industries.
  • Experience building AI-enabled service models and knowledge management systems.
  • Experience with UKG, Ashby and Jira
  • Background in service management, digital transformation, or operational excellence.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or ITIL methodologies.
  • Experience supporting multi-state or global workforce operations.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., SHRM-SCP, SPHR, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL).

lists.content:
• Lead and execute field marketing across priority defense and government accounts in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and other priority Southeast Asian and Oceanian markets, tightly aligned with regional Go-to-Market priorities.
  • Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for priority accounts, mapping buying centers and orchestrating multi-touch engagement across executive briefings, targeted campaigns, industry events, and owned customer programs.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of defense procurement environments, acquisition cycles, government structures, regional security frameworks, and country-specific stakeholder landscapes across Southeast Asia and Oceania.
  • Engage key ministries, agencies, and defense organizations including, but not limited to:
  • Australian Department of Defence and Australian Defence Force
  • New Zealand Ministry of Defence and New Zealand Defence Force
  • Indonesian Ministry of Defense and Indonesian Armed Forces
  • Malaysian Ministry of Defence and Malaysian Armed Forces
  • Philippine Department of National Defense and Armed Forces of the Philippines
  • Royal Thai Armed Forces and relevant Thai defense agencies
  • Vietnam Ministry of National Defence and relevant defense organizations
  • Own strategy and execution for major defense and aerospace events across the region, prioritizing high-value account engagement, customer relationships, and executive-level meetings over brand presence alone.
  • Plan and execute owned customer events, private briefings, roundtables, and targeted engagements in partnership with Sales and Capture teams to accelerate opportunity progression.
  • Align marketing programs with regional sales objectives, pipeline targets, account plans, and strategic capture priorities to drive measurable revenue impact.
  • Own Salesforce campaign execution, including creating and managing Campaign IDs, ensuring proper campaign structure, tracking member status, and maintaining data integrity in partnership with Sales.

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Job Description:
Shield AI was founded to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are building the world’s best AI pilot and the aircraft that enable autonomy at scale. Our technology operates in complex, contested environments where GPS and communications may be denied, degraded, or unavailable.
The technology we build demands cross-functional teaming and collaborative execution to solve the hardest problems in autonomy, aerospace engineering, and robotics. Engineers at Shield AI do not work in silos — they work shoulder-to-shoulder across disciplines to rapidly move from concept to flight-ready systems deployed in the real world.  
X-BAT represents the next generation of autonomous airpower: a runway-independent, AI-piloted aircraft designed to execute missions in highly contested environments. Powered by Hivemind, Shield AI’s combat-proven autonomy stack, X-BAT combines long-range performance, survivability, and autonomous mission execution into a scalable operational platform.  
The Sr Manager of Aerostructures Design for X-BAT, role requires a technically elite aerospace leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, can build and scale high-performing engineering organizations, and is energized by solving complex problems that directly impact national security.

lists.content:
• Lead the aerostructures design organization for the X-BAT program.
  • Drive development of lightweight, manufacturable, survivable aircraft structures optimized for autonomous combat aircraft operations
  • Partner closely with flight sciences, propulsion, avionics, manufacturing, autonomy, flight test, and supply chain teams to deliver integrated aircraft solutions
  • Establish engineering processes, design standards, configuration management, and structural development roadmaps across the program lifecycle
  • Oversee development and validation of composite and metallic airframe structures, including primary load-bearing assemblies
  • Build and mentor a world-class aerostructures engineering team capable of rapid execution and technical excellence
  • Support transition from development programs into scalable production environments

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field
