Job Description:
At Shield AI, we are revolutionizing defense technology to protect service members and civilians with intelligent, autonomous systems. Our Integration Test Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring the X-BAT remains the most reliable, mission-ready UAV in the industry. We design cutting-edge test solutions—custom-built electrical and mechanical systems that push our hardware to its limits in real-world and extreme environments.
As a Senior Integration Engineer on our Test team, you will own the design and development of test systems that push our hardware to its limits. From specifying software and hardware architecture for test to writing code and designing circuits for custom interfaces, you’ll be at the forefront of ensuring the highest reliability in aerospace hardware. This is a high-impact role where your expertise in System Interconnect, Protocol and Behavioral analysis, and automation will help shape the future of intelligent defense systems.

Our Integration Test Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring the X-BAT remains the most reliable, mission-ready UAV in the industry. We design cutting-edge test solutions—custom-built electrical and mechanical systems that push our hardware to its limits in real-world and extreme environments.

As a Senior Integration Engineer on our Test team, you will own the design and development of test systems that push our hardware to its limits. From specifying software and hardware architecture for test to writing code and designing circuits for custom interfaces, you’ll be at the forefront of ensuring the highest reliability in aerospace hardware. This is a high-impact role where your expertise in System Interconnect, Protocol and Behavioral analysis, and automation will help shape the future of intelligent defense systems.

lists.content:
• Lead the design, validation, and deployment of advanced test systems for X-BAT’s critical components and subsystems.
  • Architect Test Framework Software and test interfaces for power electronics, compute complex, and communication systems.
  • Build and maintain scalable test infrastructure and shared libraries, promoting modularity, reusability, and consistency across teams and platforms.
  • Automate system provisioning and configuration management to accelerate deployment and maintenance of new test frameworks.
  • Develop real-time monitoring and data visualization tools (e.g., Grafana) to deliver actionable insights during test execution and system debugging.
  • Lead and participate in design and code reviews, championing sound architectural principles, testability, observability, and reliability throughout the software stack.
  • Assure coverage of requirements while balancing exhaustive testing against minimum and sufficient checks as the product and testing mature.
  • Own and drive cross-functional design reviews, advocating for design-for-testability (DFT) improvements.
  • Work in partnership with HASS, ESS, and HALT testing, validating performance in simulated harsh environments.
  • Be a technical mentor, guiding junior engineers and contributing to Shield AI’s growing expertise in system test engineering.
  • Other duties as assigned.

• B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • 3+ years of industry experience in Software design and test engineering (or equivalent experience with advanced degrees).
  • Deep expertise in electrical design, mechanical, and software engineering principles as applied to system test infrastructure.
  • Experience with Linux including Bash scripting and networking.
  • Ability to configure and maintain small computer networks. 
  • Proven ability to design, implement, and validate multidisciplinary test systems in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  • Track record of ownership—driving projects from concept to execution, delivering exceptional results.
  • A team-first mindset, with high standards for yourself and others, and a passion for solving complex technical challenges.
  • Track record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.

• Comfort working with hardware, as the testcases you write will interface with circuit boards, motors, and sensors.
  • Experience with Stell, JAMA, DOORS or other system requirements frameworks.
  • Experience writing drivers for electronics test equipment.
  • Hands-on experience with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCAD, Eagle) and CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA).
  • Experience working in rugged, high-reliability industries like aerospace, defense, or automotive.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to pivot quickly in dynamic, evolving environments.

lists.content:
• Lead manufacturing engineering activities for electrical and avionics systems from prototype through full-rate production 
  • Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 
  • Wiring harnesses and EWIS 
  • PCB/PCBA assemblies 
  • Avionics systems 
  • Power distribution systems 
  • Batteries and energy storage systems 
  • Sensors and navigation systems 
  • Mission system integration 
  • Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 
  • Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electrical manufacturing issues 
  • Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods

  • Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 
  • Develop electrical assembly standards, inspection methods, and quality control processes 
  • Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 
  • Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 
  • Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 
  • Mentor junior manufacturing engineers

• MES & QMS systems
  • 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems
  • Supplier manufacturing processes
  • 5S/visual management
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field  
  • Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 
  • Experience with:  
  • Wiring harness manufacturing  
  • EWIS standards  
  • PCB/PCBA manufacturing and assembly  
  • Electrical integration and troubleshooting  
  • Aerospace or defense electrical systems

  • Knowledge of automated test systems and electrical validation

  • Have delivered motor products from design through production
  • Hands on experience to verify performance and integrate with power electronics
  • Experience testing for noise, vibration, and harshness (NVH)
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting
  • You have a demonstrated record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others

lists.content:
• Lead manufacturing engineering efforts for electromechanical subsystems and assemblies 
  • Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 
  • Actuators 
  • Motors and drives 
  • Hydraulic systems 
  • Pneumatic systems 
  • Pumps and fluid systems 
  • Powertrain components 
  • Motion-control assemblies 
  • Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 
  • Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electromechanical manufacturing issues 
  • Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  
  • Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 
  • Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 
  • Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities 
  • Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 
  • Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 
  • Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 
  • Mentor junior manufacturing engineers

• MES & QMS systems
  • 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems
  • Supplier manufacturing processes
  • 5S/visual management
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in experience in electromechanical systems 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field 
  • Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 
  • Experience with:  
  • Actuators and motion systems  
  • Hydraulics and pneumatics  
  • Mechanical/electrical integration  
  • Precision mechanical assemblies 
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 
  • Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  
  • Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  
  • Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies

• Aerospace, defense, robotics, or automotive industry experience  
  • Experience with servo systems and motor control assemblies  
  • Knowledge of GD&T and mechanical inspection methods  
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 
  • Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 
  • Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 
  • Proficiency in CAD software

• 5+ years of experience in quality engineering, field engineering, systems integration, manufacturing quality, or related technical roles
  • Strong experience with root cause analysis, failure investigation, and corrective action implementation in complex hardware environments
  • Ability to diagnose system-level issues across mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces
  • Experience analyzing reliability data, defect trends, and operational performance metrics
  • Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to coordinate across engineering and operations teams
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced development and operational environments

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems programs
  • Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, or regulated engineering environments
  • Experience with environmental testing, system validation, or field operations support
  • Experience using data analysis and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, Jira, Power BI, or Tableau

You will translate program objectives into executable integration and flight test plans across multiple test environments.  Using disciplined test, analysis, and feedback methodologies, you will drive rapid capability maturation while maintaining rigorous safety, configuration control, and mission assurance standards. 

This role serves as the technical contributor for integration and flight test execution on assigned ACP programs, responsible for coordinating test readiness, managing technical and safety risk, and leading day-to-day test execution.  Here, you will serve as the primary focal point to facilitate coordination across internal program leadership and functional teams, OEM partners, and government customers and stakeholders to deliver high-impact autonomy capabilities at scale.  Successful candidates are curious engineers who use disciplined integration and flight test to generate knowledge, reduce technical risk, and accelerate delivery of operational capability.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute detailed integration and flight test plans that support the overall program verification and test strategy across simulation, SIL, HIL, ground, and flight test environments 
  • Coordinate readiness of simulation environments, integration laboratories, aircraft, and flight test assets required to execute program objectives 
  • Apply aviation knowledge, aircraft performance and operational mission understanding to develop safe, efficient, and operationally relevant integration and flight test plans 
  • Define test objectives, performance metrics, and success criteria, ensuring traceability from requirements to test outcomes and operational capability 
  • Lead and support aircraft integration and flight test activities, including system configuration, software integration, mission planning, real-time troubleshooting, flight execution support, and post-flight data analysis 
  • Coordinate with platform OEMs, government ranges, and flight operations personnel to establish test readiness criteria and ensure technical and safety requirements are satisfied prior to test execution 
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across software, hardware, systems engineering, flight operations, safety, and program leadership teams 
  • Evaluate test results, identify technical issues, and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and accelerate capability maturation

• Typically requires 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years with a Master’s 
  • Demonstrated experience planning, conducting, and evaluating flight test of aircraft systems in military or defense aviation environments 
  • Strong understanding of safety-of-flight principles, risk management, and disciplined test execution in aviation environments 
  • Demonstrated understanding of aircraft performance, flight operations, and environmental effects influencing aircraft mission planning, test execution, and safety 
  • Experience with system-level verification & validation across multiple test environments (SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight) 
  • Experience working cross-functionally across software, hardware, avionics, systems engineering, safety, and program teams 
  • Experience with scripting or software tools (Python preferred) for test automation, data analysis, or system validation 
  • Ability to effectively communicate with pilots, operators, and engineers to develop executable flight test objectives, mission plans, and risk mitigations 
  • Excellent technical leadership and communication skills, including briefing to program leadership and external customers 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required

• Military aviation experience as aircrew, flight test engineer, mission systems operator, or engineer supporting military aircraft development or test programs 
  • Prior role as Flight Test Director, Test Conductor, or Lead Flight Test Engineer on full-scale aircraft programs 
  • Understanding of military air operations, mission planning, and Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) supporting autonomous aircraft employment 
  • Experience supporting Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP), loyal wingman concepts, or multi-vehicle autonomous systems 
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition and developmental test processes 
  • Experience operating in or supporting government flight test ranges and operational environments 
  • Background in autonomy, AI/ML-enabled systems, or human-machine teaming in aviation contexts 
  • Experience with airworthiness processes, flight clearance, and configuration control for aircraft systems 
  • Familiarity with tools such as Git, Jira/Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines 
  • Active SECRET clearance

lists.content:
• Fluid System Layouts: Develop and mature aircraft fluid system layouts for ram-air circuits, liquid cooling loops, ECS/TMS fluid circuits, and hydraulic distribution as applicable, including routing, packaging, and installation concepts.
  • Fluid and Thermal Sizing: Perform pressure-drop, flow-balance, pump and reservoir sizing, and thermal-transport capacity calculations to establish system performance and hardware requirements.
  • Modeling and Analysis: Build and maintain fluid and thermal system models using Flowmaster, AMESim, GFSSP, or equivalent tools to support design decisions, trade assessments, and requirements verification.
  • Mechanical Design Support: Design supporting mechanical hardware, brackets, mounts, line supports, and installation provisions; perform tolerance analysis, clearance assessments, hand calculations, and basic FEA as needed.
  • Component and Hardware Selection: Select and specify pumps, valves, heat exchangers, accumulators, filters, lines, fittings, actuators, and associated hardware for fluid and actuated system installations.
  • Vehicle Integration: Resolve interfaces with structures, EWIS, thermal management, electrical power, and adjacent mechanical systems, including routing, maintainability, and installation-clearance requirements.
  • System Robustness: Support failure mode analysis, contamination control, leak prevention, and system-level redundancy definition for assigned fluid and actuated systems.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Support component sourcing, technical specifications, supplier technical execution, prototype assembly, and test-fixture development.
  • Qualification and Hardware Delivery: Define and execute qualification test plans per MIL-STD-810, using results to mature the design into production-ready hardware and support MIL-HDBK-516 Airworthiness Certification.

• Clearance required: US Citizens Only & Must have an Active Secret or higher clearance.

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Core Fundamentals: Deep mastery of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, mechanical design fundamentals, and tolerance stack-up methodologies.
  • Modeling and Analysis: Demonstrated capability with fluid system sizing and analysis, including pressure drop, flow networks, heat transfer, and 1D fluid or thermal system modeling.

  • Mechanical Design: Hands-on capability designing brackets, mounts, supports, and installation hardware using hand calculations, tolerance analysis, and basic structural analysis.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Proven track record sourcing COTS/custom aerospace components, driving suppliers to schedule, and assembling benchtop or vehicle-level test setups.
  • Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to self-direct, prioritize technical tasks without oversight, and deliver functional hardware under tight timelines.

• Aircraft ram-air, liquid cooling, hydraulic, fuel, or thermal transport loop design experience.
  • ECS or thermal management system design and integration experience.
  • Experience with electro-mechanical or electro-hydrostatic actuation systems and associated mechanical installations.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-HDBK-516, and airworthiness verification planning for fluid and mechanical systems.
  • Hands-on prototype-build, fabrication, or mechanical assembly experience in a rapid R&D environment.

lists.content:
• Serve as the Responsible Engineer for the aircraft fuel system, owning requirements, architecture, interfaces, hardware, and technical decisions from concept through operational deployment.
  • Design, size, and integrate fuel tanks, pumps, valves, plumbing, venting and pressurization systems, filtration, level sensing, and associated fuel system hardware.
  • Analyze fuel system performance across the aircraft operating envelope, including pressure and flow requirements, transient engine demand, elevated-G maneuvering, tank depletion, slosh, vapor pressure, cavitation, vapor ingestion, and thermal effects.
  • Lead technical design reviews, supplier engagements, and hardware procurement while ensuring the fuel system meets performance, mass, thermal, reliability, safety, and mission requirements.
  • Plan and execute component, subsystem, and vehicle-level testing, including instrumentation, procedures, data acquisition, performance validation, and flight readiness.
  • Analyze ground and flight data to validate system performance, quantify margin, identify anomalies, and drive hardware or operational improvements.
  • Lead failure investigations and root cause efforts using analysis, inspection, testing, and data to develop effective corrective actions.
  • Work hands-on with design engineers, technicians, propulsion, controls, airframe, manufacturing, supply chain, test, and flight teams to build, integrate, troubleshoot, and iterate flight hardware.

• Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in aerospace fuel systems, fluid systems, propulsion, or related aircraft system development, with demonstrated ownership of complex aerospace hardware.
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and compressible and incompressible flow.
  • Strong understanding of aerospace fuel system design, including pressure losses, pump performance, venting, vapor pressure, cavitation, transient flow behavior, and thermal effects.
  • Hands-on experience with fluid system hardware integration, instrumentation, testing, flight support, and technical failure investigations.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or similar tools for engineering analysis, data reduction, and model correlation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive ambiguous technical problems to measurable results in a fast-paced development environment.
  • U.S. Citizenship and active security clearance.

• Experience developing fuel systems for high-performance aircraft, tactical aircraft, UAVs, or similar aerospace platforms.
  • Experience designing fuel systems for elevated-G maneuvering, aggressive vehicle dynamics, or challenging fuel delivery conditions.
  • Experience with fuel tanks, pumps, valves, regulators, level sensing, venting, pressurization, and fuel system control hardware.
  • Familiarity with GFSSP, REFPROP, CFD, ANSYS, FEA, or similar thermal-fluid analysis tools.
  • Experience working with aerospace suppliers through component selection, procurement, development, qualification, and integration.
  • Background in rocket propulsion or propellant systems with experience transferable to aerospace fuel system design, analysis, integration, or test.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

About Shield AI 
Shield AI is a defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We build autonomy systems for air, maritime, space, and other platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 
Forge is the engineering platform used to build, integrate, test, and operate Hivemind capabilities. It connects autonomy developers with the applications, services, compute, data, and workflows they need to move from local development to deployed systems. 
The Role 
We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help shape the future of physical AI by building tools to develop, train, and validate autonomous systems. You will work across TypeScript and React applications, backend services, APIs, and Python data workflows, with an emphasis on extensibility and reuse. Your work will bring together internal platforms and open-source software across local and Kubernetes environments. 
You will build Forge capabilities for simulation, synthetic data generation, training, and test and evaluation, helping engineers turn ideas into proven autonomy capabilities. Working directly with Hivemind Pilot developers, Hivemind Solutions teams, and domain experts, you will translate complex workflows into reliable applications and reusable services. You will own features from user needs and design through implementation, deployment, and support. 
This role suits a generalist who wants meaningful ownership, enjoys moving between frontend and backend work, and is curious about the systems that connect them. You will help shape technical decisions and deploy and troubleshoot containerized services alongside platform engineers. Practical Kubernetes experience is a plus, particularly supporting applications in cloud or on-premises environments.

  • Work directly with users, product, design, and engineering teams to define scope, make practical tradeoffs, and deliver improvements iteratively.

A successful engineer in this role will help deliver the following outcomes: 
  • Hivemind teams can complete development and evaluation workflows through coherent applications and dependable services. 
  • Features work reliably across supported local and cluster environments, with clear diagnostics when something goes wrong. 
  • Other teams can integrate with and extend Forge through documented APIs and reusable components. 
  • Changes are straightforward to test, deploy, maintain, and support as the platform evolves.

• Experience delivering and supporting production applications, with meaningful contributions to both frontend and backend development. 
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and React, including component design, state management, asynchronous data handling, and API integration. 
  • Experience building backend services in Go, Python, or a comparable language, including API design, validation, and error handling. 
  • Experience working with databases and application data models, including querying, persistence, and schema changes. 
  • Ability to reason about service interactions, authentication, authorization, background jobs, and failures across application boundaries. 
  • Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, and deploying and debugging services in a shared environment. 
  • Clear communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to work directly with users and carry work from an ambiguous problem to a supported solution.

Experience in every area below is not expected. Relevant experience may include: 
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience deploying or troubleshooting applications, including Helm charts, service configuration, networking basics, and persistent storage. 
  • Developer tools or technical applications for simulation, experimentation, training, test and evaluation, or deployment. 
  • Job orchestration, distributed execution, or data-processing workflows using tools such as Ray, Kubernetes Jobs, Argo Workflows, or Dagster. 
  • Schema-driven APIs, generated clients, or service integrations using OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Protocol Buffers, gRPC, or WebSockets. 
  • Extensible applications, plugin systems, shared component libraries, or AI-assisted workflows and agent-tool integrations. 
  • Applications deployed across cloud, on-premises, edge, or air-gapped environments; familiarity with robotics, autonomy, or simulation.

• Own complete solutions. Shape the user experience, implement the services behind it, and see your work through deployment and real use. 
  • Build software with direct mission impact. Help engineers develop, validate, and deliver autonomy capabilities more effectively. 
  • Work alongside engaged users. Partner with autonomy, ML, and simulation experts and see how your decisions affect their daily work. 
  • Influence a growing platform. Turn practical application needs into shared capabilities that benefit teams across Hivemind, including new AI-assisted engineering workflows.

descriptionBody:
About Shield AI 

Shield AI is a defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We build autonomy systems for air, maritime, space, and other platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

Forge is the engineering platform used to build, integrate, test, and operate Hivemind capabilities. It connects autonomy developers with the applications, services, compute, data, and workflows they need to move from local development to deployed systems. 

The Role 

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help shape the future of physical AI by building tools to develop, train, and validate autonomous systems. You will work across TypeScript and React applications, backend services, APIs, and Python data workflows, with an emphasis on extensibility and reuse. Your work will bring together internal platforms and open-source software across local and Kubernetes environments. 

You will build Forge capabilities for simulation, synthetic data generation, training, and test and evaluation, helping engineers turn ideas into proven autonomy capabilities. Working directly with Hivemind Pilot developers, Hivemind Solutions teams, and domain experts, you will translate complex workflows into reliable applications and reusable services. You will own features from user needs and design through implementation, deployment, and support. 

This role suits a generalist who wants meaningful ownership, enjoys moving between frontend and backend work, and is curious about the systems that connect them. You will help shape technical decisions and deploy and troubleshoot containerized services alongside platform engineers. Practical Kubernetes experience is a plus, particularly supporting applications in cloud or on-premises environments.

Job Description:

You will collaborate with robotics and autonomy software engineers to understand their workflows, remove friction, and enable effective GenAI-assisted development in both commercial and government environments while meeting requirements for secure, controlled data. 
You will build the automation, infrastructure, and integration layers that make GenAI useful across the software engineering organization. You will streamline processes across GitLab, Jira, and Confluence so colleagues spend less time coordinating work and more time creating software. You will apply your expertise in C++, Python, build systems, and developer tooling to provide more power and context to our developers and GenAI tools. 
This is a high-leverage role where your impact scales through the work of others: every improvement you make to GenAI tooling, automation, and developer workflows will help engineers across HMS move faster, work more securely, and spend more time solving the hardest robotics and autonomy problems.

Job Description:
Help shape the future of physical AI in defense by building reasoning models for unmanned autonomous systems across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. 
We’re looking for a deeply technical engineer who can turn emerging research into reliable autonomous capabilities and shares our conviction that AI can protect service members and civilians. As a Staff Engineer on the Hivemind Reasoning team, you’ll drive the design, training, adaptation, and evaluation of reasoning and cognition models intended for deployment on unmanned platforms. 
You’ll take hands-on ownership of complex technical problems, from defining model architectures and training objectives to establishing rigorous evidence of mission effectiveness. Your work will support individual vehicles and coordinated teams of hundreds of agents, while accounting for limited compute, intermittent communications, incomplete information, and other constraints of operating at the edge in contested environments. 
You’ll partner closely with teams in perception, MLOps, large-scale simulation, autonomy, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of Hivemind Enterprise.

Help shape the future of physical AI in defense by building reasoning models for unmanned autonomous systems across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. 

We’re looking for a deeply technical engineer who can turn emerging research into reliable autonomous capabilities and shares our conviction that AI can protect service members and civilians. As a Staff Engineer on the Hivemind Reasoning team, you’ll drive the design, training, adaptation, and evaluation of reasoning and cognition models intended for deployment on unmanned platforms. 

You’ll take hands-on ownership of complex technical problems, from defining model architectures and training objectives to establishing rigorous evidence of mission effectiveness. Your work will support individual vehicles and coordinated teams of hundreds of agents, while accounting for limited compute, intermittent communications, incomplete information, and other constraints of operating at the edge in contested environments. 

You’ll partner closely with teams in perception, MLOps, large-scale simulation, autonomy, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of Hivemind Enterprise.

lists.content:
• Design, implement, train, adapt, and evaluate reasoning and cognition models for unmanned autonomous platforms. 
  • Make and validate tradeoffs among foundation-model approaches, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), specialized deep-learning models, and traditional AI/ML methods. 
  • Develop capabilities for interpreting context, reasoning over time, coordinating among agents, and adapting to incomplete or changing information. 
  • Build reproducible training and adaptation workflows using appropriate combinations of self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and distillation. 
  • Define data requirements, training objectives, benchmarks, and evaluation methods that support meaningful comparisons among model approaches. 
  • Establish rigorous evaluations in simulation and with real-world data, measuring generalization, robustness, uncertainty, and performance as team size and operating conditions change. 
  • Incorporate edge constraints into model architecture and training decisions in partnership with hardware, autonomy, and inference teams. 
  • Diagnose model failures and create feedback loops among data curation, training experiments, and re-evaluation. 
  • Deliver trained models, reproducible results, and clear performance evidence to partner teams. 
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, experimental findings, and model limitations clearly to research, engineering, product, and organizational leadership.

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 
  • A demonstrated track record of developing and deploying advanced ML models in production environments, with substantial hands-on contributions to model design, training, and evaluation. 
  • Deep expertise in foundation models, modern deep learning, model architectures, and the training ecosystem. 
  • Strong command of training and adaptation approaches such as self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and distillation. 
  • Experience defining datasets, training objectives, experimental workflows, benchmarks, and reproducible criteria for comparing models.
  • Fluency in traditional AI/ML techniques and an ability to combine them thoughtfully with learned models. 
  • Experience with training frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, etc.
  • Experience with multimodal, embodied, robotic, or autonomous-system models; familiarity with VLA models and world models is particularly relevant. 
  • Familiarity with traditional robotics algorithms, e.g. path planning, probabilistic modeling, optimization approaches, etc.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson and other edge compute platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, AMD, etc.).

Job Description:

Help shape the future of physical AI in defense by building reasoning models for unmanned autonomous systems across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. 

We’re looking for a deeply technical engineer who can turn emerging research into reliable autonomous capabilities and shares our conviction that AI can protect service members and civilians. As a Staff Engineer on the Hivemind Reasoning team, you’ll drive the design, training, adaptation, and evaluation of reasoning and cognition models intended for deployment on unmanned platforms. 

You’ll take hands-on ownership of complex technical problems, from defining model architectures and training objectives to establishing rigorous evidence of mission effectiveness. Your work will support individual vehicles and coordinated teams of hundreds of agents, while accounting for limited compute, intermittent communications, incomplete information, and other constraints of operating at the edge in contested environments. 

You’ll partner closely with teams in perception, MLOps, large-scale simulation, autonomy, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of Hivemind Enterprise.

lists.content:
• Write, configure, and maintain robust GitLab CI/CD pipelines and runner environments for C++, Python, and Node.js software projects, ensuring fast compilation and test execution.
  • Build, test, and deploy automated tooling integrations, webhook dispatchers, and state-change scripts connecting GitLab, Jira, and Confluence to orchestrate release workflows.
  • Write custom Python or Bash extensions for our pi-gov harness, configuring secure, audited LLM routing rules and local container configurations.
  • Deploy, scale, and configure the Forge simulation and test orchestrator in Azure Gov Cloud, optimizing runner autoscaling and cloud compute consumption.
  • Maintain, configure, and secure Artifactory package registries, implementing secure container builds via BuildKit, secret injection, and Entra ID integration.
  • Partner with development teams to migrate legacy project build systems to reproducible Nix developer environments, writing default Nix derivations and flake configurations.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, broken builds, registry access issues, and system-level configuration drift across development environments.

• Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Practical experience building, maintaining, and scaling enterprise CI/CD systems, with deep expertise in GitLab CI/CD pipelines and runner infrastructure.
  • Direct experience writing scripts (Bash, Python) and utilizing webhooks/APIs to automate and integrate engineering tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and GitLab).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, multi-stage builds) and package managers (such as Conan, Poetry, or Nix).
  • Familiarity with deploying and managing application workloads in cloud environments (such as Azure Gov Cloud or AWS).
  • Experience with secure software development practices, secret management, and identity providers (Active Directory, Entra ID).
  • Solid Linux system administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

Job Description:

We’re looking for an experienced Staff Engineer, Human Machine Interface to join our Hivemind Solutions team and lead the development of operator-facing software for autonomous uncrewed systems. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning HMI, mission systems, and autonomous-platform integration. You will help build the ground-control, mission-planning, command-and-control, and debrief tools through which operators understand, supervise, and control complex autonomous systems. 

You will bring strong frontend engineering experience across modern web and/or desktop technologies, supported by practical C++ and backend or distributed-systems foundations. You will work closely with autonomy, systems, flight-test, product, and operational teams to turn sophisticated platform capabilities into clear, responsive, and mission-effective operator experiences.

lists.content:
• Lead technical direction and architecture for HMI capabilities across Hivemind Solutions products. 
  • Design and deliver applications for mission planning, command and control, vehicle and payload supervision, system health, and post-mission debrief. 
  • Build map-centric and data-rich interfaces that clearly convey vehicle state, autonomy intent, mission status, constraints, alerts, and degraded conditions. 
  • Develop HMI using appropriate frontend technologies, including web frameworks such as React and TypeScript, and native desktop frameworks such as Qt/QML where appropriate. 
  • Design robust data flows and interfaces between frontends, C++ services, backend systems, autonomy software, vehicle interfaces, simulation, payloads, telemetry, and video sources. 
  • Define and negotiate APIs, data models, schemas, interface contracts, and ICDs with internal teams and external partners. 
  • Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, architecture decisions, and engineering practices for quality, performance, maintainability, and release readiness. 
  • Support simulation, operator-in-the-loop testing, system integration, flight test, field activity, and customer demonstrations. 
  • Debug complex HMI and mission-system issues spanning application performance, memory use, data freshness, networking, messaging, video, and vehicle integration. 
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across frontend, HMI, and mission-system software.

• A tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related discipline; 
  • Significant professional experience delivering complex user-facing software, ideally as a staff, principal, lead, or senior technical engineer. 
  • Strong experience with one or more modern HMI/frontend technology stacks, such as React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Qt/QML, or comparable web and desktop frameworks. 
  • Strong C++ fundamentals and experience contributing to production native software, backend services, integrations, or performance-sensitive systems. 
  • Experience with APIs, distributed systems, asynchronous data flows, messaging, service integration, data models, and client/server architectures. 
  • Experience developing interfaces that consume real-time, operationally significant, or high-rate data. 
  • Demonstrated experience owning software capabilities from architecture through integration, testing, deployment, and operational support. 
  • Strong debugging, profiling, technical communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance.

• Experience with uncrewed systems, aviation, robotics, autonomy, ground control stations, mission management, command and control, defence systems, or other mission-critical technology. 
  • Experience with geospatial or map-based applications, telemetry visualisation, sensor or payload control, live video, or mission replay/debrief tools. 
  • Familiarity with any of MAVLink, ROS/ROS 2, DDS, REST, WebSockets, STANAG 4586, or related mission-system technologies. 
  • Experience with real-time, edge, bandwidth-constrained, disconnected, or degraded-network environments. 
  • Familiarity with RTSP, WebRTC, GStreamer, H.264/H.265, GPU-accelerated visualisation, or multimedia pipelines. 
  • Experience with human factors, operator workflows, autonomy supervision, alerting, mode awareness, usability testing, or human-autonomy teaming. 
  • Experience supporting field integration, flight test, range activity, customer demonstrations, or operational troubleshooting. 
  • Defence industry experience and/or an existing Australian Government security clearance.

Our mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems, and this role supports that mission directly by working with Australian Government classified material. It requires an Australian Government security clearance at [Baseline / NV1 / NV2] level. 

You don't need to hold a clearance already, we will sponsor your clearance and support you, because mission first, people always. Australian citizenship is a mandatory requirement for this role. It is a condition of clearance eligibility set by the Australian Government, eligibility details are here: https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-suitability

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Advance Industrial Engineer to design, optimize, and scale world-class manufacturing systems for advanced aerospace products. In this role, you will lead factory and production system design, including facility layouts, material flow, line balancing, capacity planning, and production readiness. You will also play a critical role in planning and executing greenfield manufacturing facilities, developing factory concepts from the ground up, including production layouts, infrastructure requirements, equipment planning, material flow strategies, and manufacturing standards. 

Partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, Quality, EHS, and Program Management, you will develop efficient, scalable, and data-driven manufacturing solutions that enable rapid production growth. This is a high-impact role responsible for transforming manufacturing concepts into production-ready factories while driving safety, quality, throughput, and operational excellence.

lists.content:
• Lead factory layout development, production line design, and manufacturing system optimization for new and existing production programs.  

  • Support the planning and execution of greenfield manufacturing facilities, including factory master planning, space allocation, utility requirements, equipment placement, production flow, and long-term capacity planning.  

  • Develop manufacturing concepts from initial factory planning through production launch, ensuring scalability, flexibility, and operational efficiency.  

  • Design and optimize material flow, point-of-use storage, supermarkets, kitting strategies, replenishment systems, tugger routes, and warehouse logistics.  

  • Develop detailed 2D factory layouts and 3D manufacturing models, including equipment placement, utilities, workstations, safety zones, production support infrastructure, and future expansion plans.  

  • Perform capacity planning, line balancing, takt time analysis, labor planning, buffer sizing, and bottleneck analysis to achieve production targets.  

  • Conduct time studies, ergonomic assessments, spaghetti diagrams, and workflow analyses to improve productivity and eliminate waste.  

  • Develop manufacturing standards for material presentation, packaging, FIFO management, visual controls, workstation design, and factory operating standards.  

  • Lead cross-functional factory design reviews with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Facilities, Supply Chain, Quality, EHS, and Program Management.  

  • Utilize discrete-event simulation tools to model production throughput, identify constraints, validate factory designs, and optimize manufacturing strategies before implementation.  

  • Support facility construction, equipment installation, tape-outs, utility coordination, commissioning, and production readiness activities during factory launches.  

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, visual management, standardized work, continuous improvement, and value stream optimization.  

  • Develop and maintain factory design standards, launch playbooks, production system guidelines, and manufacturing best practices to support future factory expansions and replication.  

 

Tools & Skills 

  • AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Revit, Visio, or equivalent CAD/layout software  

  • Siemens Plant Simulation, FlexSim, AnyLogic, or equivalent discrete-event simulation software  

  • Time studies, MTM/MOST, work measurement, and labor analysis  

  • Capacity modeling, line balancing, takt planning, and production system design  

  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), 5S, Kanban, and Visual Management  

  • Material flow analysis, warehouse and logistics design  

  • Factory master planning and facility layout development  

  • Strong analytical, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.  

  • 8+ years of experience in industrial engineering, factory design, manufacturing systems, production planning, advanced manufacturing engineering, or greenfield facility development.  

  • Experience designing factory layouts, production lines, and scalable manufacturing systems for complex products.  

  • Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing projects, facility expansions, or major production line launches.  

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, composites, electrical assemblies, precision mechanical assemblies, and final integration.  

  • Experience supporting production ramp-up, new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing process development.  

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment.  

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Aerospace, defense, automotive, or advanced manufacturing industry experience.  

  • Experience leading greenfield factory development, factory relocation, or major manufacturing expansion projects.  

  • Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments.  

  • Experience with automated material handling systems, robotics, AGVs/AMRs, automated storage systems, or Industry 4.0 technologies.  

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification.  

  • Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ERP systems, digital factory technologies, and production simulation software.

Job Description:

As a Staff or Senior Staff Landing Gear Engineer, you will take full technical ownership of the landing gear architecture, kinematic mechanism design, structural analysis, and vehicle integration for a new UAV platform. Serving as the sole landing gear subject matter expert on this program, you will work from first principles to execute mechanism trades, perform structural hand calculations, design hardware, manage external component suppliers, support proposals and capture, and deliver flight-ready systems in a rapid-iteration development environment. This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

lists.content:
• Architecture and Kinematic Trades: Lead landing gear architecture definition and trade studies (e.g., electro-mechanical vs. hydro-mechanical actuation, fixed vs. retractable kinematics, stowage packaging) to meet vehicle mass, volume, and ground ground handling requirements. 
  • Mechanism and Structural Design: Own the full CAD design lifecycle from initial concept through drawing release, including complex linkage kinematics, clearance envelopes, structural load paths, material selection, and rigorous tolerance stack-ups. 
  • Structural and Dynamic Sizing: Perform first-principles classical stress and fatigue hand calculations, backed by finite element analysis (linear/non-linear, modal, buckling) and dynamic landing load assessments. 
  • Subsystem Sizing and Selection: Size and select wheels, tires, brakes, shock absorption systems, actuators, and nose wheel steering mechanisms tailored to vehicle landing and taxi envelopes.
  • Component Sourcing and Vendor Management: Author technical specifications and statements of work (SOW) for landing gear components, evaluate vendors, and drive supplier technical execution. 
  • Test, Drop Qualification, and Validation: Define verification test plans, design mechanical test fixtures, support drop test campaigns, and execute functional validation against performance requirements. 
  • Integration and Flight Test Support: Support prototype assembly, ground taxi testing, and flight test operations to identify discrepancies, resolve mechanism anomalies via root-cause investigation, and implement rapid design changes.

• Experience: minimum 7 years (L4) to 12 years (L5) of direct experience in aerospace mechanism design, aircraft landing gear systems, or primary structural development.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Core Fundamentals: Deep mastery of classical solid mechanics, kinematics, dynamics, fatigue, materials selection (alloys, heat treatments, surface treatments, allowables), and GD&T/tolerance stack-up methodologies.
  • Analysis and Modeling: Demonstrated capability performing closed-form hand calculations and FEA analysis (linear, non-linear, buckling, modal) for high-load mechanism and structural components.
  • CAD and PLM: Extensive experience in 3D CAD modeling, mechanism layout, and drawing release (Siemens NX preferred, or equivalent like CATIA/Creo) with PLM workflows.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Proven track record sourcing aerospace hardware, collaborating with specialized mechanism/actuator suppliers, and supporting physical builds and test rigs.
  • Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to self-direct, prioritize technical tasks without oversight, and deliver functional hardware under tight timelines.
  • Clearance: Secret eligible

• Direct experience with UAV, autonomous aircraft, or rotorcraft landing systems and arresting gear integration.
  • Familiarity with aerospace structural, environmental, and mechanism drop-test standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160, AS6053, MIL-A-8866/MIL-A-8867).
  • Hands-on machine shop, fabrication, or mechanical assembly experience in a prototype or rapid R&D environment.

Job Description:

As a Mass Properties Engineer for Ranger, you will play a critical role in the development and optimization of autonomous aircraft systems, ensuring precise mass properties tracking and analysis throughout the product lifecycle. Your expertise will support aircraft performance trade studies, loads development, structural analysis, cost analysis, and mission effectiveness evaluations. This role is essential in driving the success of Shield AI’s next-gen autonomous vehicles, ensuring they meet stringent weight, balance, and efficiency requirements.

lists.content:
• Lead and participate in system-level trade studies to optimize payload, propulsion, power distribution, thermal management, and flight dynamics.
  • Conduct mass properties estimation for early-stage designs, prototyping, and full-scale production.
  • Estimate, calculate, and verify weight, center of gravity, and inertia properties for components, assemblies, and complete aircraft systems.
  • Develop and refine analysis tools and methods for mass properties estimation and optimization.
  • Generate and maintain mass properties reports for engineering, manufacturing, and leadership teams.
  • Implement and execute mass properties verification tests to validate design assumptions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including aerodynamics, structures, avionics, propulsion, and manufacturing to ensure mass properties are controlled throughout development.
  • Maintain and update the mass properties database to track weight trends across vehicle programs.

• B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Science/Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in mass properties analysis within aerospace, defense, or high-tech vehicle development.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Siemens NX, or similar).
  • Familiarity with mass properties industry standards (ATA100, SAWE RP A-7, RP 7, RP 8, or predecessors).
  • Experience defining mass properties requirements and ensuring compliance across design iterations.
  • Experience developing and maintaining a Mass Properties Management and Control Plan.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Staff Mechanical Engineer who can lead complex hardware efforts from concept through deployment. This individual will own mechanical design and system integration while developing high-quality, production-ready engineering definitions. 

The ideal candidate combines system-level technical leadership with deep, hands-on experience in 3D CAD, 2D production drawings, advanced GD&T, material selection, and manufacturing processes. This role will integrate electronics, RF systems, and composite structures into rugged, field-ready airborne platforms.

lists.content:
• Lead mechanical design and integration for airborne or ruggedized systems from concept through production and field deployment.
  • Develop and review complex 3D CAD models, assemblies, interfaces, 2D production drawings, BOMs, and release packages.
  • Establish functional datum structures, apply advanced GD&T, and perform tolerance analyses to ensure fit, function, interchangeability, and inspectability.
  • Own system-level packaging of electronics, including radios, antennas, PCBAs, and harnessing.
  • Design components and assemblies using metallics, plastics, composites, elastomers, adhesives, and other engineering materials.
  • Select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes based on structural, thermal, environmental, producibility, cost, and schedule requirements. 
  • Design for manufacturing processes including CNC machining, additive manufacturing, injection molding, composite fabrication, sheet metal, and bonded assembly.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across electrical, RF, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test teams.
  • Serve as technical or project lead on select efforts, managing scope, schedule, risk, and technical execution.
  • Lead design reviews and guide structural, thermal, tolerance, environmental, and manufacturability analyses.
  • Support prototype builds, qualification, production integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations.
  • Ensure designs meet reliability, manufacturability, inspectability, maintainability, and performance requirements.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field. 
  • 8+ years of mechanical design and product-development experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex products or subsystems from concept through production.
  • Advanced proficiency in GD&T and ASME Y14.5, including functional datum selection, position, profile, form and orientation controls, composite feature control frames, tolerance-zone modifiers, and design for inspection.
  • Deep experience creating and releasing detailed 2D production drawings for complex parts and assemblies, demonstrated through a substantial body of work
  • Strong proficiency with a production CAD platform such as NX, Creo, CATIA, SolidWorks, or Inventor, including complex part modeling, large assemblies, drawing creation, and revision-controlled release.
  • Experience developing hardware using a broad range of materials, including metallics, engineering plastics, composites, elastomers, and structural adhesives.
  • Practical design-for-manufacturing experience across multiple processes, including CNC machining, additive manufacturing, injection molding, composite fabrication, sheet metal, and bonded or mechanically fastened assembly.
  • Strong understanding of material selection, tolerance analysis, manufacturing variation, assembly processes, and inspection methods.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with manufacturing, quality, electrical engineering, supply chain, technicians, suppliers, and machine shops.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead technical decisions and resolve complex design, manufacturing, and integration problems.

• Experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
  • Experience designing and integrating airborne, aerospace, defense, or other ruggedized hardware.
  • Experience packaging radios, antennas, PCBAs, sensors, connectors, and embedded electronics.
  • Familiarity with coaxial cables, RF cables, wiring harnesses, bend-radius requirements, and connector integration.
  • Experience designing composite structures and hybrid composite-metal assemblies.
  • Understanding of electronics thermal management, grounding, shielding, and EMI/EMC considerations.
  • Familiarity with environmental requirements involving vibration, shock, temperature, corrosion, and ingress protection.
  • Experience with ground support equipment, test fixtures, or qualification hardware.
  • Hands-on experience supporting prototype builds, production, environmental testing, and field troubleshooting. 

    • Leadership Expectations 

  • Act as the technical lead for complex projects, systems, or major subsystems.
  • Lead design reviews and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information.
  • Review and approve CAD models, engineering drawings, tolerance schemes, material selections, and manufacturing approaches.
  • Mentor engineers in mechanical design, GD&T, drawing creation, material selection, and design for manufacturing.
  • Balance development speed with the rigor required to deliver reliable, production-ready aerospace hardware.

lists.content:
• Design and develop mechanical systems for Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including power units, transport structures, launch & recovery systems, and maintenance tools.
  • Create detailed CAD models, drawings, and specifications for manufacturing and assembly.
  • Conduct structural, thermal, and fatigue analysis to ensure durability and reliability of GSE in field environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate GSE with aircraft systems and mission operations.
  • Perform trade studies and system optimization to enhance portability, ruggedness, and maintainability of support systems.
  • Oversee prototyping, testing, and validation of GSE designs to meet military and aviation standards.
  • Develop technical documentation, test procedures, and support manuals for field operations.
  • Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to ensure cost-effective production and sustainment of GSE.
  • Support flight test campaigns by providing engineering support for ground systems and test operations.

• 7+ years of experience in mechanical design for aerospace, ground support equipment, or heavy industrial systems.
  • Expertise in CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, NX, or similar) for 3D modeling, drawing creation, and system layout.
  • Strong background in structural analysis, material selection, and manufacturing processes for ruggedized systems.
  • Experience designing deployable, transportable, and field-ready aerospace support equipment.
  • Knowledge of MIL-STD design requirements for aerospace ground support systems.
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), thermal analysis, and fatigue/lifecycle testing.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience designing UAS or military aircraft ground support equipment.
  • Knowledge of power distribution, hydraulics, and environmental control systems for aerospace applications.
  • Experience with DoD acquisition, sustainment, and field deployment strategies.
  • Prior experience supporting military aircraft maintenance and sustainment operations.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

lists.content:

Job Description:
The Hivemind Simulation team provides the simulation capabilities that power the AI Factory’s training and evaluation for the next generation autonomous AI pilots. The Simulation Platform team builds the simulation framework and foundational infrastructure that allows engineers to bring together simulators, scale experiments, and confidently evaluate autonomy before flight. The team’s work enables simulation applications to build on a shared, performant, and extensible foundation. Our guiding principle is simple: autonomy should not know it is in a simulation.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Simulation Platform team, you will shape how autonomous pilots are tested by building and integrating simulators and developing Monte Carlo infrastructure. Drawing on experience building and running real-time aircraft simulations, you will enable teams to evaluate autonomy, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), and runtime assurance (RTA) systems at scale. This individual contributor role includes driving technical direction and mentoring engineers.

lists.content:

  • Partner with autonomy, GNC, and RTA engineers as well as operators in the field to translate evaluation needs into simulation interfaces and infrastructure.
  • Support platform specific performance validation using physics models (e.g, 6DoF, 3DoF, etc.).

  • Demonstrated experience building and running multithreaded/multiprocess real-time simulations involving aircraft dynamics.
  • Experience both developing Monte Carlo infrastructure and using it to design, execute, and analyze simulation campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive technical decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate across software and domain engineering teams.

  • Experience with industry-standard simulation tools such as JSBSim, FlightGear, X-Plane, Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Simulink, or equivalent environments.
  • Experience with closed-loop autonomy simulation, including sensor inputs and interfaces between autonomy and the simulated environment.
  • Experience with uncertainty modeling, statistical analysis, and scenario coverage for Monte Carlo evaluation.
  • Testing / Operating Safety Critical Software (e.g., DO-178C)

lists.content:
We are seeking a Staff Engineer, Operational Analyst to drive the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft systems. This role is pivotal in evaluating the mission effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our autonomy solutions across multiple platforms and domains. You will work closely with engineering, product development, and defense stakeholders to inform design trade-offs, assess system performance, and optimize mission capabilities.

This position requires a deep understanding of military operations, wargaming, modeling & simulation (M&S), analytic techniques, and operational analysis techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy by identifying how our AI-powered platforms can best serve the evolving needs of modern warfare.

• Develop and execute operational analysis strategies to assess the effectiveness of autonomous aircraft in real-world military scenarios.
  • Lead modeling, simulation, and wargaming efforts to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational insights into design decisions and system improvements.
  • Conduct trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance under varying operational conditions and threats.
  • Utilize advanced modeling & simulation tools (e.g., AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop high-fidelity mission models.
  • Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor effectiveness, and autonomy-driven decision-making to optimize mission success.
  • Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to understand mission needs and align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Support concept of operations (CONOPS) development for new AI-driven aircraft capabilities.
  • Identify emerging threats and operational challenges, ensuring Shield AI’s systems remain ahead of adversary capabilities.
  • Develop and present technical reports, briefings, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies.
  • Leverage modern compute and development best practices (e.g., scalable cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing) to build, run, and iterate high-fidelity simulation and analysis pipelines quickly and reliably.

• 7+ years of experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S), or military operations research.
  • Expertise in military mission analysis, operational planning, and wargaming methodologies.
  • Proficiency with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, or other M&S tools used for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Deep understanding of air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or autonomous systems in contested environments.
  • Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to align capabilities with mission requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to seamlessly apply modern compute, data science, and software development best practices (e.g., cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, Git-based version control, CI/CD, automated testing, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable simulations and analytics.
  • Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.

• Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven decision-making algorithms into operational analysis frameworks.
  • Prior military service or experience working with U.S. Air Force, Navy, or Special Operations Forces.
  • Experience using GenAI to structure problems and create simulation or analysis tools.
  • Active Secret or Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

Job Description:

We are looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to contribute to the Platform solutions and infrastructure that power Forge, the AI Factory. These components provide distributed runtime capabilities that enable teams to reliably orchestrate workloads, process data, and underpin the workflows of building an AI Pilot. 

The Forge Platform Engineering team provides Kubernetes-native capabilities that support autonomy development, simulation, testing, training, evaluation, deployment, and operational workflows across commercial cloud, on-premises infrastructure, sovereign deployments, edge environments, and fully air-gapped systems. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will define platform architecture, implement production software, establish reusable operational patterns, and partner with teams across autonomy, ML, simulation, test, infrastructure, and product engineering. Success requires balancing developer productivity, reliability, extensibility, performance, portability, and long-term operational maintainability.

lists.content:
• Build Kubernetes-native platform services: Develop and operate Kubernetes-based services, controllers, operators, deployment patterns, and runtime integrations that support distributed workloads across multiple environments.     
  • Develop distributed orchestration capabilities: Design and build reusable primitives for authoring, scheduling, and scaling pipeline work. 
  • Build reliable data-processing infrastructure: Develop platform capabilities for data storage, ingestion, validation, transformation, and governance. 
  • Develop highly extensible platform components: The Forge Platform base provides standardized tooling around authentication, authorization, observation, networking, routing, secret management, and more to the services that are integrated on top of the ecosystem. 
  • Create reference architectures: Establish recommended deployment patterns, operating profiles, capacity guidance, benchmarks, reliability practices, and distribution approaches across cloud providers, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments. 
  • Advance observability and operability: Establish end-to-end metrics, logs, traces, structured events, dashboards, alerting, service-level objectives, operational diagnostics, and runbooks for workflows, pipelines, event streams, and platform services. 
  • Partner with downstream teams: Work directly with autonomy, ML Ops, simulation, test, infrastructure, product, and customer-facing teams to turn recurring distributed-systems problems into reusable platform capabilities.

• The Forge Platform continues to improve in KPIs around reliability, scalability, operational use cases, and customer adoption. 
  • New services from downstream teams are guided to successful platform integration. Shared distributed services have clear ownership, repeatable deployment patterns, tested recovery procedures, practical observability, and well-defined operational standards. 
  • The Platform is demonstrated, evaluated, and benchmarked across a wide variety of operational environments. 
  • Interfaces are maintained for long periods of time to instill customer confidence and reduce upgrade burdens.

• Significant experience designing and operating production distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, backend infrastructure, or data-intensive services. 
  • Strong software engineering skills and a record of delivering production systems in Go and Python. 
  • Deep understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, including failure handling, idempotency, consistency tradeoffs, retries, ordering, delivery semantics, backpressure, partitioning, state management, and fault tolerance. 
  • Experience designing or operating workflow orchestration, distributed job execution, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, or long-running service workflows. 
  • Ability to define architecture and technical standards while remaining hands-on in implementation, production troubleshooting, performance analysis, and reliability improvement. 
  • Experience working across multiple teams to turn recurring infrastructure needs into reusable, well-documented platform capabilities. 
  • Clear technical communication and the ability to make complex distributed-systems architecture understandable to both specialists and downstream users.

Experience in any of the following is beneficial but not required: 
  • Kubernetes controllers, operators, Custom Resource Definitions, admission control, scheduling extensions, KubeRay, or workload-management systems.  
  • Distributed execution and workflow technologies such as Ray, Temporal, Argo Workflows, Flyte, Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Kubernetes Jobs, or comparable systems. 
  • Durable messaging and event-streaming technologies such as NATS JetStream, Kafka, Redpanda, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, or comparable systems. 
  • ETL/ELT, batch processing, event-driven data pipelines, CDC, schema evolution, data validation, artifact processing, or large-file transfer workflows. 
  • Service networking technologies and practices such as Envoy, service meshes, Kubernetes networking, and CNI plugins. 
  • Observability software such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Jaeger, distributed tracing, structured logging, SLOs, service-level indicators, alerting, and incident-management practices. 
  • Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, GitOps, Kubernetes package management, repeatable platform distribution, and Infrastructure as Code.

Platform Engineering is foundational to how Shield AI develops, tests, evaluates, deploys, and operates autonomy systems. This role offers the opportunity to shape the distributed systems foundation used by engineering teams across the company and delivered into demanding customer environments. 

Your work will determine how reliably data moves through the organization, how services coordinate across complex environments, how teams execute and recover long-running workflows, and how operators understand the health of mission-critical systems. You will work at the intersection of Kubernetes, distributed computing, event-driven architecture, data processing, networking, observability, and autonomy. 

You will help establish reusable platform capabilities that allow specialized teams—including autonomy, simulation, test, ML Ops, and application engineering—to move faster while building on dependable operational foundations.

lists.content:

  • Design power electronics for the high voltage and low voltage systems. This includes inverters, DC-DC converters, battery management, and other power electronics

  • Lead others to execute design, verification, and manufacturing deployment
