Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Supplier Development Engineer to join Shield AI, focusing on electrical components/PCBA. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in supplier development, quality engineering, production process improvement, and supply chain management within the aerospace industry. This role is critical in enhancing supplier performance by solving supplier challenges that impact quality/on-time delivery/scaling, supporting the onboarding of suppliers to new designs, and delivering on our mission to deliver affordable and autonomous mass at scale.

lists.content:
• Process Improvement: Audit and embed into core supplier processes to understand improvement opportunities to cost, lead-times, and quality
  • Identify and resolve manufacturing defects, process inefficiencies, and quality issues in SMT assembly, such as solder paste application, component placement, reflow soldering, and automated optical inspection (AOI)
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for production failures, utilizing tools like PFMEA
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001)
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct on-site audits to root cause supplier quality issues or performance challenges
  • Supplier Development: Assess and improve supplier capabilities, ensuring alignment with engineering and operational priorities.
  • Engineering Technical Support: Provide technical guidance to suppliers on part specifications, manufacturing processes and standards, and quality measures
  • Supplier Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze supplier performance metrics, including delivery, quality, and cost. Implement corrective actions and continuous improvement plans as necessary.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate risks within the supply chain to ensure uninterrupted production and delivery of components
  • New Product Introduction (NPI): Support the introduction of new products by ensuring suppliers meet all quality and delivery requirements during the development phase

• Hands on experience with SMT (Surface Mount Technology) and PCBA
  • Knowledge of industry standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001)
  • ability to analyze PCBA drawing and critical features on electronic assemblies
  • Ability to travel to domestic and international suppliers ~50%+ of time

• M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent. 
  • Problem solving skills including root cause investigation and failure analysis
  • Leadership experience on a cross-functional project team (e.g., engineering, supply chain, production)

Job Description:

As a Supplier Quality Specialist, you would be joining a small team that supports PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) rework for a variety of aircraft electronics. Furthermore, you would work alongside our engineering team in the development of new products such as PCBA, harness, electronic components, and test rack systems.

lists.content:
• Own and execute new product introduction (NPI) rework builds across all relevant work centers, delivering qualified processes on aggressive timelines.
  • Establish the framework for reliable PCBA rework and repair.
  • Lead triage of non-conforming PCBAs, drive root-cause resolution, and implement preventative actions with Supplier Development Engineers.
  • Own resolution of production rework issues while safeguarding design integrity, product quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Identify, prioritize, and deliver continuous improvement projects that improve rework yield, performance, and time.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate and 5+ years of professional experience with SMT and/or PCBA rework equipment and processes. 
  • IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and/or IPC-7711/7721 (rework/repair) certification.

• Associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience owning SMT rework equipment operation and process control in a high-volume production setting.
  • Proven experience implementing Design for Manufacturability (DFM) specifically for complex SMT assemblies.
  • Ability to create and deliver technical presentations for rework process readiness, design reviews, and manufacturing readiness reviews.
  • Experience leading the transition of SMT rework processes from design/NPI to volume manufacturing as part of cross-functional teams in fast-paced iterative environments.

Job Description:

Our Supply Chain team strengthens supplier performance and protects production by overseeing supplier quality worldwide, assessing risk through supplier evaluations and internal reviews, leading failure investigations, and supporting proactive source qualification.

In this role, you will own day-to-day supplier quality execution, bringing discipline and responsiveness to issue management while enabling engineering teams to focus on high-priority technical challenges and preventive improvements. You will work across production and suppliers with internal stakeholders to contain defects quickly, resolve nonconformances, and implement corrective and preventive actions that minimize disruption to engineering and production.

lists.content:
• Own supplier-related nonconformances identified at supplier facilities, during receiving and precision inspection, and throughout production, including Supplier Deviation Requests (SDRs).
  • Manage nonconformance workflows, including Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, Return to Vendor (RTV) activities, supplier Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), and production issue ticket reviews.
  • Drive open issues toward resolution, coordinating containment, investigation, disposition, and corrective action with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Coordinate containment of nonconforming material by locating affected products, partnering with Supplier Development Engineers to mitigate flight risk, and supporting root cause investigations.
• Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience in an engineering, supply chain, manufacturing or quality field,

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or supply chain
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to liaise cross functionally, internally and externally, make presentations to team members and management
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and technical requirements
  • Deep technical domain experience in PCBA manufacturing and Rework
  • Qualified to IPC J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, IPC 7711/7721
  • Experience reading engineering drawings, including Geometric Dimension and Tolerance (GD&T)
  • Experience with AS9100 or similar quality management system standard.
  • Knowledge of supplier quality processes (Part or Supplier Approval Processes, First Article Inspection Reports, etc.)
  • Direct experience interfacing with suppliers, corrective/ preventive action systems, supplier portals
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications
  • Proficiency with lean concepts and statistical and data analytics

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Staff Logistics Manager, Support Equipment to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This role will lead the logistics planning, supply support, sustainment analysis, and lifecycle support activities across development, flight test, production, and operational sustainment.

The ideal candidate has strong experience supporting military or defense aviation programs and understands how logistics products, supportability analysis, maintenance planning, and supply chain execution contribute to mission availability and operational readiness. This position requires hands-on experience with Maintenance Task Analysis, Logistics Control Numbers, Reliability and Maintainability artifacts, Supply Support planning and execution, and Support Equipment development.

lists.content:
• Lead logistics and sustainment planning activities for a UAS program across design, production, deployment, and field support phases.
  • Develop, manage, and maintain integrated logistics support products, including maintenance concepts, support equipment design, provisioning inputs, spares planning, and sustainment documentation.
  • Perform and manage Maintenance Task Analysis to define preventive and corrective maintenance requirements, task frequencies, required tools, support equipment, skill levels, labor hours, and maintenance levels.
  • Develop and maintain Logistics Control Number structures to support provisioning, maintenance planning, technical documentation, configuration tracking, and sustainment data management.
  • Lead support equipment design, development, and implementation across all IPTs common ground support equipment and peculiar support equipment.
  • Lead supply support activities, including spares analysis, provisioning, parts forecasting, inventory planning, reorder recommendations, repair pipeline coordination, sustainment risk identification, and obsolescence management.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, depots, repair vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely availability of parts, support equipment, and logistics resources.
  • Support proposal development, basis of estimate inputs, staffing plans, sustainment strategies, and logistics cost estimates for new and existing UAS programs.
  • Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable defense standards, contract requirements, export control requirements, and company processes.

• Bachelor’s degree in logistics, engineering, supply chain, aviation maintenance, business, or a related field; equivalent military or defense logistics experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting UAS or fighter aircraft logistics and sustainment
  • Demonstrated experience with Maintenance Task Analysis and development of maintenance planning data.
  • Expertise of Logistics Control Number structures and their use in provisioning, maintenance planning, and supportability analysis.
  • Experience with Reliability and Maintainability principles, including failure modes, maintainability drivers, reliability growth, availability metrics, and field performance analysis, and LORA development
  • Hands-on supply support experience, including spares planning, provisioning, inventory management, parts forecasting, repairables management, and sustainment execution.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, bills of material, configuration data, maintenance data, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, program management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, field service, and customer teams.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to lead logistics efforts in a fast-paced program environment.
  • Active and current security clearance with ability to obtain SAP

• Proven experience with integrated product support elements, including product support management, supply support, support equipment, manpower and personnel, facilities, maintenance planning,
  • Experience as Support Equipment specialist or Field Support engineer on 4th or 5th generation weapons systems
  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-1388 legacy logistics concepts, GEIA-STD-0007, SAE TA-STD-0017, MIL-HDBK-502A, or related product support standards.
  • Experience developing logistics inputs for CDRLs, technical manuals, maintenance plans, provisioning data, sparing recommendations, or lifecycle sustainment plans.
  • Experience with ERP, PLM, or MRP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Costpoint, Teamcenter, Arena, Windchill, or similar platforms.

The Software Test & Quality Assurance team serves both, and ensures release of verified and assured product. As Lead Engineer, Software Test & Quality Assurance, you will lead a team of Software Test & Automation Engineers working across both Hivemind Vision and Hivemind Solutions. You will turn the Australian software test strategy into day-to-day execution, set technical direction for test automation and infrastructure, and own the test evidence and release recommendations behind every software release. The team spans simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL), perception and imagery validation, and live flight test. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay technically involved in framework design, test architecture, and complex integration issues while developing the people and capability of the team. You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering (Systems Engineering and Test), and work closely with the Systems Engineering and Quality Process Engineering teams, as well as perception, autonomy, integration, flight test, program management, and Shield AI's international engineering teams.

lists.content:
Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Software Test & Automation Engineers and Quality Assurance Engineers, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance feedback, and career development.

  • Plan and prioritise test work across Hivemind Vision and Hivemind Solutions programs, balancing competing schedules and allocating people where they are most needed.

  • Identify risks, delays, and resourcing constraints early and communicate them clearly to the Senior Manager, Engineering and to program stakeholders.

  • Build a team culture of technical rigour, ownership, continuous improvement, and psychological safety. Test execution and release assurance ·

  • Implement the Australian software test strategy shaped and endorsed by key stakeholders and leadership across unit, integration, simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, and flight-test environments.

  • Tailor test approaches to the needs of each team: perception, computer vision, and imagery validation for Hivemind Vision, and autonomy integration and platform validation for Hivemind Solutions.

  • Own the software release process, including release readiness criteria, test evidence, approval matrices, and go / no-go recommendations.

  • Work with Systems Engineering to maintain traceability from requirements and interface control documents (ICDs) through test cases to verification results.

  • Prepare test readiness and verification evidence for formal technical reviews (e.g., TRR), customer acceptance, and airworthiness submissions.

  • Develop and report software quality metrics, dashboards, and readiness assessments that give engineering and program leadership objective evidence of software maturity. Technical direction

  • Set the technical direction for automated test frameworks, test harnesses, and validation tooling, with Python-based automation at the core.

  • Drive integration of automated regression, integration, functional, and performance testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation and rapid developer feedback and coordinate cross functionally with key stakeholders including DevOps.

  • Guide the development of repeatable perception test approaches, including curated test datasets, ground-truth comparison, and performance benchmarking for computer vision and imaging-sensor capabilities.

  • Guide the build-out and maintenance of test environments, including hardware setup, device flashing, SIL/HIL rigs, and cross-platform (Windows and Linux) environments.

  • Lead or support cross-functional root cause investigations into defects and system integration issues, and make sure lessons learned feed back into process and test coverage.

  • Coordinate operational and integration testing on flights in and around Melbourne with the flight test team. Process and governance

  • Apply and help mature the Australian Engineering Management System (EMS) for software test and release, working with Quality Process Engineering on configuration management, defect management, and nonconformance and corrective action.

  • Maintain a common, right-sized test and QA baseline across Hivemind Vision and Hivemind Solutions, while respecting the different needs of each team's products and customers.

  • Contribute software test and QA content to proposals, statements of work, and test plans.

  • Partner with Shield AI test and quality teams globally to share tooling, methods, and best practice.

  • Serve as the program manager for assigned USV programs, leading the integration of Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software onto USV platforms.

    • Establish Clear Objectives 

    • Work closely with product managers, engineering leads, operations, and executive leadership to define clear program objectives tied to mission impact, customer success, strategic growth, financial outcomes, and technical performance. 

      • Program & Project Management 

      ·      Own the development and execution of integrated program and project plans, including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource allocation. Continuously evaluate and rebalance customer priorities, technical risks, cost constraints, and schedule demands throughout the program.

      Drive Timely, High-Quality Decisions 

      • Facilitate rigorous, fast, and effective technical and programmatic decision-making across cross-functional teams. While not expected to design systems directly, you will possess sufficient technical depth to identify risks, challenge assumptions, and drive alignment. Hands-on experience with software or autonomy products is an accelerator.

        • Integration & Test Readiness 

        • Coordinate system integration activities across labs, ground testing, and sea trial operations. Drive readiness reviews, integration milestones, and closure of technical dependencies required to support successful USV/UUV integration and operational deployment.

        • Identify potential bottlenecks, critical-path risks, and schedule delays, and drive mitigation strategies to achieve program milestones and delivery commitments. Conduct critical-path analyses and support program execution through Gate Reviews, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), and Estimates at Completion (EACs). 

          • Communicate with Excellence 

          • Drive a consistent cadence of well-organized, effective meetings, including preparation, facilitation, action tracking, and follow-up. Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on status, milestones, priorities, risks, integration readiness, and technical challenges. 

            • Drive Technical Execution 

            • Support the development and refinement of technical and operational documentation, engineering change orders, work instructions, service bulletins, operational procedures, and integration documentation. 

              • Empower Teams & Remove Obstacles 

              • Create an environment where teams have the clarity, tools, accountability, and support needed to execute effectively. Escalate issues quickly, streamline processes, eliminate blockers, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement. 

                • Deliver Outcomes 

                • Drive accurate and timely tracking and reporting of program financials, resources, schedules, integration status, and customer deliverables. 

                  • Support Growth & Strategic Initiatives 

                  • Support business development activities related to current and future autonomy integration programs, including proposals, requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposals (RFPs), technical evaluations, and strategic customer engagements.

• Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 

  • Experience leading complex cross-functional engineering programs from concept through production and operational deployment.  

  • Strong technical understanding of software-enabled systems, autonomy, aerospace systems, or complex integrated products.  

  • Demonstrated success managing program execution across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and technical performance in fast-paced environments. 

  • Experience with Program Management Reviews (PMRs), gate reviews, and estimates. 

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead through influence across distributed teams.  

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments.  

  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and ability to drive execution with high standards and collaboration. 

  • Willingness to travel internationally

• Experience integrating autonomy or software systems onto defense platforms. 

  • Experience in software development, autonomy development, or systems engineering.  

  • Experience managing clean-sheet defense or technology development programs.  

  • PMP and/or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.  

  • Familiarity with DoD contracting, defense acquisition, or national security programs.  

  • Experience balancing aggressive timelines with complex engineering constraints. 

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance or higher.

Shield AI is seeking an experienced V-BAT Technical Writer to support the integration and operational lifecycle of next-generation autonomous aircraft systems. This role is embedded within engineering and flight test environments and is responsible for translating highly complex aerospace, avionics, and autonomy systems into precise, usable technical documentation.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience working alongside engineers and subject matter experts to produce clear, structured documentation across all program phases, from early design and system development through initial flight testing and sustained mission operations. lists.content:
• Partner closely with aerospace, software, and systems engineers to develop accurate, high-fidelity technical documentation for advanced aircraft systems.

  • Manage multiple documentation efforts across development, flight test, and operational phases in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

  • Translate complex engineering concepts, including avionics, autonomy, and mission systems, into clear, structured guidance for operators, maintainers, and internal teams.

  • Review and edit technical content for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to program standards.

  • Research and interpret engineering artifacts such as system architectures, design specifications, interface control documents, software descriptions, and test procedures.

  • Aggregate and synthesize technical inputs from cross-functional teams, including flight test, hardware, software, and operations.

  • Develop and maintain technical publications, including service bulletins, aircraft operating procedures, maintenance manuals, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and mission documentation.

  • Create and manage supporting visuals such as system diagrams, workflows, illustrations, and annotated graphics.

  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or missing technical information and proactively drive resolution with engineering teams.

  • Maintain documentation standards, templates, and version control across a growing body of technical publications.

  • Support rapid updates to documentation based on flight test results, system changes, and operational feedback.

  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as required in support of V-BAT program objectives.

• 3-10 years of technical writing/editing experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, or complex engineering systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, Engineering, English, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining technical documentation for aircraft systems, complex hardware/software platforms, or similar domains.

  • Proven ability to work directly with engineers and subject matter experts to extract and document technical information.

  • Strong understanding of structured documentation practices and lifecycle documentation management.

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and organizational skills with a focus on clarity and precision.

  • Ability to distill complex system behavior into concise, user-focused documentation.

  • High attention to detail and consistency across large documentation sets.

  • Self-sufficient, proactive work style with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines.

  • Ability to identify missing, ambiguous, or conflicting technical information.

  • Comfortable working across distributed teams and time zones.

  • Interest in working in a fast-moving, non-traditional defense and aerospace environment.

• Experience with advanced aircraft systems, UAVs, autonomy, avionics, or mission systems documentation.

  • Familiarity with DoD technical manual standards and specifications (e.g., MIL-STD, S1000D, or service-specific formats).

  • Experience using Microsoft Office, Adobe FrameMaker, or XML-based authoring tools.

  • Background in flight test documentation or operational procedure development.

  • Defense industry or aerospace program experience.

  • Master’s degree in English, Technical Communication, or a related discipline.

  • Project management experience supporting complex technical programs.

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to enhance documentation workflows.

Job Description: 

Shield AI is seeking an experienced V-BAT Technical Writer to support the development, release, and lifecycle management of aircraft system service bulletins. This is a hands-on technical publications role that works closely with engineering, quality, manufacturing, and field support teams to translate complex technical changes, safety concerns, inspection requirements, corrective actions, and operational limitations into clear, accurate, and actionable communications for operators and maintainers. The successful candidate may come from an A&P, military aviation maintenance, UAS maintenance or operations, avionics, flight-test, aerospace technician, or field-service background, with demonstrated ability to write and maintain technical publications. 

The ideal candidate understands how aircraft are assembled, operated, inspected, troubleshot, repaired, and returned to service and is able to turn that knowledge into precise, usable, configuration-controlled documentation. The Technical Writer will be responsible for determining the appropriate scope and audience for service bulletins; identifying affected aircraft configurations, serial-number ranges, components, and software versions; documenting required inspections, modifications, repair actions, or operational restrictions; and ensuring released content aligns with approved engineering data and internal document-control processes.

lists.content:
• Partner closely with mechanical, electrical, software, systems, quality, and fleet support engineers to develop and maintain accurate, actionable service bulletins to communicate required inspections, corrective actions, modifications, operational limitations, maintenance actions, parts replacements, or configuration changes affecting aircraft safety, airworthiness, reliability, or maintainability. 
  • Develop step-by-step maintenance and inspection procedures that are technically accurate, safe, complete, and usable in operational environments. 
  • Observe and document maintenance, assembly, inspection, troubleshooting, ground-test, and flight-test activities to ensure procedures reflect actual work execution. 
  • Develop or coordinate supporting technical visuals, including annotated photographs, exploded views, system diagrams, task flows, wiring or schematic excerpts, illustrations, and other graphics required for safe operation and maintenance. 
  • Assess the documentation impact of engineering changes, software releases, flight-test findings, and operational feedback; coordinate reviews and issue timely configuration-controlled updates. 
  • Determine and clearly document bulletin applicability, prerequisites, compliance requirements, labor estimates, required tools, consumables, replacement parts, and return-to-service requirements. 
  • Write and maintain warnings, cautions, notes, limitations, and hazard statements that communicate risks associated with maintenance, aircraft configuration changes, energized systems, rotating components, fuel, batteries, and other applicable hazards. 
  • Manage multiple service bulletin efforts across issue identification, engineering investigation, drafting, technical review, validation, release, revision, and field communication in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Facilitate cross-functional reviews with engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, flight operations, maintenance, training, and customer-support stakeholders. 
  • Research and interpret engineering artifacts, including drawings, bills of material, engineering change orders, software release notes, wiring diagrams, maintenance procedures, inspection criteria, test reports, and configuration records. 
  • Work with engineering, quality, flight test, manufacturing, and operations teams to identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, unsafe, or ambiguous technical content and drive resolution before release. 
  • Maintain service bulletin templates, style guides, numbering conventions, revision histories, distribution records, and document-control processes. 
  • Support rapid publication and revision of service bulletins in response to flight-test findings, field issues, reliability trends, supplier notifications, production escapes, and operational feedback. 
  • Review field feedback and maintenance data to identify opportunities to improve bulletin clarity, reduce maintenance burden, and prevent recurring discrepancies. 
  • Ensure published bulletins align with applicable technical publications, maintenance manuals, illustrated parts catalogs, operator manuals, and approved engineering configurations. 
  • Maintain organized source material, technical references, revision histories, review comments, and approval records in accordance with company processes. 
  • Maintain traceability between published technical content and the applicable hardware configuration, software version, engineering change, product effectivity, and release approval. 
  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as required in support of V-BAT program objectives.

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Equivalent experience may include aircraft maintenance, military aviation, UAS maintenance or operations, avionics, flight test, aerospace field service, engineering technician work, or technical publications. 
  • 3+ years of or relevant experience in maintenance documentation, service engineering, or technical writing in aerospace, defense, aviation, unmanned aircraft systems, or other complex electromechanical systems. 
  • Demonstrated ability to create, revise, or technically validate maintenance procedures, troubleshooting instructions, operator procedures, service bulletins, work instructions, test procedures, or other post-delivery documentation. 
  • Experience developing maintenance instructions for aircraft systems, unmanned aircraft systems, avionics, propulsion systems, electrical systems, mechanical assemblies, or complex hardware/software products. 
  • Practical working knowledge of aircraft or UAS systems, including the ability to understand and document mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, payload, ground-support, and/or mission-system interfaces. 
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, CAD outputs, schematics, system architectures, requirements, interface control documents, test data, and engineering changes. 
  • Proven ability to work directly with engineers, quality personnel, maintainers, flight-test teams, and other subject matter experts to obtain, validate, and document technical information. 
  • Demonstrated ability to produce clear, sequential, user-focused procedures for inspection, removal, installation, modification, troubleshooting, functional testing, and return-to-service activities. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and organizational skills, with a consistent focus on technical accuracy, clarity, completeness, and usability. 
  • Ability to identify ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or potentially unsafe technical information and drive resolution with the responsible stakeholders. 
  • Experience working in a configuration-managed product environment with controlled document revisions, technical reviews, and formal approvals. 
  • Self-sufficient and proactive work style, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority publication efforts under compressed timelines. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work in a fast-paced development environment.

• FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) certificate, military aviation maintenance specialty, or equivalent civilian or military aircraft maintenance experience. 
  • Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, inspecting, or supporting fixed-wing aircraft, rotorcraft, UAS, or other autonomous or robotic platforms. 
  • Experience supporting corrective-action, reliability, quality, safety, or fleet-support programs. 
  • Familiarity with ATA iSpec 2200, S1000D, MIL-STD-40051, MIL-STD-38784, MIL-STD-1808, service technical-order/manual formats, or comparable technical-publication frameworks. 
  • Background supporting developmental test, operational test, flight test, field sustainment, deployed operations, depot maintenance, or field-service operations. 
  • Experience using PLM, document-control, change-control, configuration-management, requirements-management, or engineering-release systems. 
  • Experience with Adobe FrameMaker, Arbortext, XML/DITA, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Visio, or comparable technical-authoring and illustration tools. 
  • Experience developing or managing technical illustrations, wiring diagrams, and other maintenance graphics.

lists.content:
Key Responsibilities

  • Support daily execution of QMS processes and activities.
  • Assist with maintaining procedures, work instructions, and quality records.
  • Help track and follow up on audit findings, corrective actions, and process updates.

    • New Product and Production Support

  • Assist engineers in ensuring new products and processes meet QMS requirements.
  • Support documentation and readiness activities prior to production or manufacturing reviews.
  • Participate in inspections and verification activities as needed.

    • Documentation and Systems

  • Maintain document control processes, including updates, revisions, and archival of records.
  • Enter and manage data within quality systems, ERP systems, or tracking tools.
  • Help ensure accuracy and completeness of quality documentation and training records.

    • Audit and Compliance Support

  • Support preparation activities for internal and external audits.
  • Compile documentation and objective evidence for audit reviews.
  • Participate in internal audits under guidance from certified auditors.

    • Continuous Improvement

  • Assist with root cause investigations using structured problem-solving tools.
  • Support implementation and verification of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Help monitor key quality metrics and report trends to engineering or management.

    • Training and Cross Functional Coordination

  • Support coordination of QMS related training and maintain training records.
  • Work with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to communicate quality requirements.

• 1 to 3 years of experience in a quality, manufacturing, or technical support role, preferably in aerospace or a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with basic root cause analysis methods such as 5 Whys or Fishbone.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to follow established procedures.

• Working knowledge of AS9100 or ISO 9001 standards.
  • Experience with document control systems, ERP systems, or quality data tracking tools preferred.
  • Certification or training in quality (e.g., Six Sigma Yellow/Green Belt)

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Test Technician to support the fabrication, instrumentation, and testing of X-Bat. This role is ideal for a hands-on builder who thrives in dynamic environments, has deep experience working with test stands, understands precision instrumentation techniques, and has a background in machine shop operations, 3D printing, and product prototyping.

You will be a key contributor in helping bring cutting-edge designs to life, playing a vital role in everything from early-stage prototype development to detailed testing and validation of final assemblies.

lists.content:
• Construct and assemble large-scale structures and test articles in alignment with engineering drawings and CAD models.
  • Support the design, prototyping, and fabrication of new products, R&D initiatives, and flight-ready hardware.
  • Maintain accurate records of test equipment configurations and device designations across all projects.
  • Work with aerospace-grade materials and perform structural repairs using industry-standard techniques and tools.
  • Fabricate fixtures, machine brackets, and execute rapid modifications on prototype hardware as needed.
  • Install strain gauges, thermocouples and various sensors according to precise instrumentation schematics.
  • Route cabling, integrate data acquisition systems, and verify sensor calibration and operational status.
  • Conduct mechanical testing by applying static and dynamic loads per detailed engineering procedures.
  • Document test outcomes clearly and report anomalies or irregularities in a timely manner.
  • Ensure a clean, organized, and safe workspace across shop, lab, and composite work areas.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in instrumentation standards, testing procedures, and fabrication workflows.
  • Source and manage inventory for parts and equipment needed for component repair or replacement.

• 3+ years of experience in fabrication or aerospace-grade instrumentation.
  • Strong background in strain gauge installation and sensor wiring.
  • Hands-on experience in machine shop operations, including manual and/or CNC tools.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, schematics, and detailed work instructions.
  • Comfortable working in shop and lab environments with exposure to noise, dust, and chemicals.
  • Ability to lift and move parts and equipment (up to 50 lbs.) and perform physical work for extended periods.

• Familiarity with mechanical testing systems (e.g., load frames, DAQ systems).
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, defense, or high-performance prototyping environments.
  • Knowledge of adhesives, fasteners, and bonding processes for composite-to-metal interfaces.
  • Able to work independently and adapt quickly to changing technical needs.
  • Hands-on experience performing MIL-STD testing including vibration, shock, thermal testing.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented, dependable Tool Crib Technician to support tooling operations for advanced aerospace aircraft testing on our Group 5 UAVs.
 
You'll run the tool crib day to day. That means issuing and receiving tools, keeping inventory accurate, and making sure production teams get the tools, equipment, and consumables they need on time. The right person is organized, works well with technicians and mechanics, and understands that tool control matters for safety and quality.
 
This role keeps production moving. It reduces downtime and keeps tools accounted for and compliant as manufacturing grows.

lists.content:
Tool Crib Operations
  • Issue and receive tools, equipment, and consumables. Record every transaction accurately in the tool tracking system.
  • Keep the tool crib clean, organized, and secure, with tools stored correctly and easy to find.
  • Inspect returned tools for damage, wear, or missing parts. Tag and set aside anything that needs repair or replacement.
  • Follow standard procedures for checking tools in and out, and for tool accountability.
  • Answer questions from technicians and production staff and help them find the right tools.
    • Tool Control & Inventory
  • Track hand tools, power tools, precision measuring equipment, specialized aerospace tooling, and production consumables.
  • Do routine cycle counts and inventory checks, and report any discrepancies to your supervisor.
  • Watch stock levels and flag items that are near reorder points so production isn't interrupted.
  • Receive, label, and put away incoming tools and supplies.
  • Follow up on overdue, lost, or misplaced tools.
    • Calibration, Quality & Compliance
  • Track calibration due dates. Pull expired or out-of-calibration tools from service.
  • Make sure calibrated tools are labeled correctly and their records are current.
  • Follow AS9100 and company quality procedures.
  • Support Foreign Object Debris (FOD) prevention through careful tool accountability.
  • Keep accurate records for internal audits and customer inspections.
  • Report tooling discrepancies and help Quality with investigations when asked.
    • Production Support
  • Work with production teams to prepare tools and kits for scheduled builds.
  • Tell your supervisor about tooling shortages or delays right away.
  • Help roll out barcode, RFID, or other digital tool tracking tools.
  • Suggest ways to improve tool crib organization and efficiency.

• Tool crib experience in an aerospace, defense, aviation, automotive, or precision manufacturing facility.
  • Familiarity with AS9100 or ISO 9001 quality requirements.
  • Experience with FOD prevention and tool accountability programs.
  • Knowledge of calibrated tools, torque tools, or aircraft assembly equipment.
  • Experience with barcode or RFID tool tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with 5S or Lean practices.
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, or a similar ERP system.

• High school diploma or GED.
  • 1+ year of experience in a tool crib, warehouse, inventory, or manufacturing environment.
  • Basic knowledge of hand tools, power tools, and measuring instruments.
  • Comfortable using computers and inventory or tracking systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and good organizational skills.
  • Clear communication and a customer-service mindset.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and adjust to changing priorities.
  • Able to lift up to 50 lbs and stand for long periods.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking highly skilled and disciplined Aircraft Mechanic IV to support the development, testing, and maturation of X-BAT, an autonomous VTOL jet aircraft. This  hands-on position is responsible for performing complex aircraft maintenance, troubleshooting, inspections, modifications, and ground-test support in a developmental aerospace environment.

The Aircraft Mechanic IV will work closely with engineering teams, and test personnel to maintain aircraft readiness, configuration accuracy, and safe execution of test activities. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical judgment, disciplined documentation practices, and the ability to work independently within approved procedures while mentoring less-experienced technicians.

lists.content:
• Perform advanced maintenance, inspections, servicing, repairs, and component replacement on X-BAT propulsion, flight control, mechanical, electrical, and avionics systems.
  • Support aircraft assembly, integration, modification, and instrumentation installation in accordance with approved engineering instructions and technical documentation.
  • Execute pre-test and post-test inspections, identify discrepancies, and document aircraft condition and maintenance status.
  • Support engine start, ground runs, hover preparation, shutdown, and other ground-test activities under the direction of the Crew Chief and designated test personnel.
  • Diagnose complex mechanical, electrical, and avionics discrepancies using technical drawings, wiring diagrams, approved procedures, and diagnostic equipment.
  • Coordinate with engineering to resolve discrepancies, clarify technical requirements, and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, component traceability, configuration status, and discrepancy documentation.
  • Verify that assigned maintenance and modification tasks are complete and properly documented before presenting the aircraft for readiness review.
  • Follow test cards, safety plans, hazard controls, PPE requirements, and test-area access restrictions; promptly report unsafe conditions.
  • Maintain tool accountability, foreign object debris prevention, and serviceability of assigned ground support equipment.
  • Identify requirements for tools, consumables, replacement parts, and support equipment needed to complete assigned work.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less-experienced mechanics and technicians, including task coordination when assigned.
  • Support root-cause investigations, anomaly resolution, and improvements to maintenance procedures and operational processes.
  • Support aircraft recovery activities, field-site setup and teardown, and maintenance during extended test deployments.
  • Represent the X-BAT program with professionalism and alignment to Shield AI’s mission and values.

• 10+ years of aviation maintenance experience with military or commercial aircraft.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting turbine propulsion, flight controls, aircraft mechanical systems, electrical systems, or avionics.
  • Ability to independently complete complex maintenance tasks within approved procedures and recognize when engineering direction or additional authorization is required.
  • Proficiency interpreting technical manuals, engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, maintenance instructions, and configuration documentation.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve aircraft discrepancies under time and operational pressure without compromising safety or maintenance quality.
  • Experience maintaining accurate aircraft maintenance records, tool accountability, and configuration control.
  • Strong understanding of aviation maintenance safety, ground-test hazards, and risk management practices.
  • Experience providing technical guidance or mentorship to other mechanics and technicians.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with maintenance, engineering, and test teams.
  • Ability to travel frequently and support extended field-test deployments as required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain relevant clearances or certifications if needed.

• Prior experience as a senior aircraft mechanic, lead maintainer, or military aircraft maintenance craftsman.
  • Experience supporting developmental aircraft, prototype assembly, flight-test programs, or unmanned aircraft systems.
  • Experience with VTOL aircraft, tail-sitter platforms, turbine propulsion, or autonomous systems.
  • FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) certification or military equivalent.
  • Experience with aircraft modification, system integration, rigging, and functional checks.
  • Familiarity with flight-test operations, test readiness reviews, and data collection processes.
  • Experience with structured safety processes such as Operational Risk Management (ORM), Task Hazard Analysis (THA), or Safety Management Systems (SMS).
  • Experience supporting aircraft recovery and operating ground support equipment.

Job Description:
The Ukraine Training Manager is responsible for the leadership, management, and execution of Shield AI's V-BAT customer training program supporting Ukraine. This position oversees all aspects of training operations, ensuring instruction is delivered safely, effectively, and in accordance with approved Programs of Instruction (POIs) while meeting contractual requirements and customer expectations.
The Ukraine Training Manager serves as the primary operational liaison for all Ukraine training activities, providing oversight of instructor staffing, personnel readiness, aircraft availability, student progression, and day-to-day course execution. Working closely with the Ukraine Senior Manager, Fleet Support, Curriculum Development, Engineering, Security, Program Management, and the customer, this individual identifies operational risks, develops personnel courses of action, and ensures training teams have the resources required to accomplish the mission.
This role is responsible for developing and standardizing the Ukraine instructor cadre while continuously improving course delivery, student outcomes, and operational effectiveness.
Location & Deployment: This role is based in Dallas, TX and will initially support an extended deployment to Ukraine. Once the deployment is complete, the role will be based in Dallas, and relocation will be required for anyone not already local to the area.

lists.content:
• Operate fixed-wing and multirotor unmanned aircraft systems in test and operational environments

  • Operate Ground Control Stations (GCS) and associated mission systems  
  • Support pre-flight setup, aircraft inspections, launch and recovery operations, and post-flight activities  
  • Configure, setup, transport, and maintain aircraft, support equipment, batteries, radios, networking equipment, and operational infrastructure  
  • Troubleshoot and repair aircraft systems and field support equipment  
  • Transport equipment and personnel to test and demonstration sites

  • Experience with RF communications, datalinks, and networking systems  
  • Mechanical or electrical maintenance experience on unmanned aircraft systems  
  • Experience operating in austere or rapidly changing field environments  
  • Familiarity with BVLOS operations and operational risk management  
  • Ukrainian and English language proficiency  
  • Prior experience supporting defense or tactical UAS operations

Job Description

A V-BAT Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for executing deployed flight operations and maintenance activities in both CONUS and OCONUS environments in direct support of customer mission requirements. This role is deployment-focused and requires a high degree of adaptability, discipline, and the ability to operate effectively in austere, high-tempo, and often ambiguous environments.

AVOs are expected to develop proficiency across core V-BAT skillsets, including flight operations, mission planning, payload employment, troubleshooting, and basic maintenance support. They must be capable of operating as part of a small team, maintaining system readiness, and executing missions in accordance with established procedures, safety standards, and customer expectations.

In deployed settings, AVOs support DoD and international customers in both maritime and land-based operations. Responsibilities include executing missions, assisting with system setup and recovery, maintaining equipment, and supporting day-to-day operational requirements. AVOs are also expected to communicate effectively with customers, demonstrate professionalism, and represent Shield AI in forward environments.

This role emphasizes hands-on operational execution and reliability, with a focus on building experience and proficiency while contributing to overall mission success, team effectiveness, and safe employment of V-BAT systems.

lists.content:
• Operational proficiency: Ability to safely execute flight operations, mission planning, and payload employment in accordance with established procedures 
  • Technical troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose and resolve system, software, and hardware issues in both training and deployed environments

  • Adaptability in deployed environments: Comfortable operating in austere, high-tempo conditions with minimal oversight

descriptionBody:
Job Description

A V-BAT Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for executing deployed flight operations and maintenance activities in both CONUS and OCONUS environments in direct support of customer mission requirements. This role is deployment-focused and requires a high degree of adaptability, discipline, and the ability to operate effectively in austere, high-tempo, and often ambiguous environments.

AVOs are expected to develop proficiency across core V-BAT skillsets, including flight operations, mission planning, payload employment, troubleshooting, and basic maintenance support. They must be capable of operating as part of a small team, maintaining system readiness, and executing missions in accordance with established procedures, safety standards, and customer expectations.

In deployed settings, AVOs support DoD and international customers in both maritime and land-based operations. Responsibilities include executing missions, assisting with system setup and recovery, maintaining equipment, and supporting day-to-day operational requirements. AVOs are also expected to communicate effectively with customers, demonstrate professionalism, and represent Shield AI in forward environments.

This role emphasizes hands-on operational execution and reliability, with a focus on building experience and proficiency while contributing to overall mission success, team effectiveness, and safe employment of V-BAT systems.

lists.content:

lists.content:
• Drive Strategic Capture: Identify, shape, and capture high-value opportunities across Middle Eastern next-gen airpower programs relevant to CCAs and autonomy. 
  • Drive Regional Sales Pipeline: Lead the full business development lifecycle for CCA-focused efforts, from customer engagement through proposal, negotiation, and contract award. 
  • Engage Key Stakeholders: Build and maintain trusted relationships with Ministries of Defence, defense primes, integrators, and key partners. 
  • Shape Requirements & CONOPS: Influence customer requirements and future CCA CONOPS to align with Shield AI’s product offerings. 
  • Support Demonstrations & Campaigns: Lead Shield AI’s positioning and participation in regional flight demos, technical trials, and program pilots. 
  • Coordinate Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with engineering, product, legal, and program teams to align technical solutions with customer needs and delivery requirements. 
  • Inform Product Direction: Provide field intelligence to guide feature development, integration strategy, and roadmap priorities for Hivemind-enabled CCA solutions.

• 15+ years in a relevant air force occupation, bringing significant depth of understanding of relevant CONOPs and platform applications (preference for real-world operational experience flying tactical fighter aircraft with a strong technical background). 
  • 3–5+ years of experience in defense acquisition, business development, sales, or strategy, ideally with a focus on air platforms or autonomy. 
  • 5+ years of experience in region either operationally or from a defense business perspective 
  • Strong track record of capturing and closing defense programs or tech insertions with relevant ministries of Defense or multinational frameworks. 
  • Understanding of next-gen air combat trends, including CCAs, MUM-T, and AI-enabled CONOPS. 
  • Ability to credibly represent technically complex products to both strategic and operational-level audiences. 
  • Familiarity with key regional acquisition pathways. 
  • Willingness to live in regional (preferably Abu Dhabi) and to travel extensively across the Middle East (30–50%).
